description: Find all the differences within the time limit. Click to select a difference. Description: Animal Differences is a fun and challenging HTML5 puzzle game where players are tasked with spotting the differences between two images featuring adorable animals. The goal is simple: find all the differences between two nearly identical pictures before time runs out or you run out of moves. Each level presents two images of cute animals with subtle differences that you must identify and click on to progress. The game tests your observation skills, attention to detail, and patience. The images are filled with charming animals and scenes, ranging from playful puppies and kittens to exotic wildlife. As the game advances, the difficulty increases, with more differences to find, more complex images, and less time to complete each round. It’s a perfect casual game for animal lovers and puzzle enthusiasts alike.

name: Animal Mahjong
description: Mahjong Solitaire game with Animals. Remove all tiles in pairs of the same free tiles. Description: Animal Mahjong is a fun and visually appealing Flash-based Mahjong game that features a cute animal theme. It offers a relaxing and engaging twist on the classic Mahjong solitaire game, where players must match and remove pairs of animal tiles to clear the board. With charming animal illustrations, vibrant graphics, and soothing background music, Animal Mahjong provides a delightful and stress-free puzzle experience. In this game, you play the role of a Mahjong enthusiast looking to clear the game board by finding matching pairs of tiles. Unlike traditional Mahjong, which uses Chinese characters and symbols, this version swaps in colorful and adorable animal-themed tiles, such as cats, dogs, birds, and more. Players must strategize carefully to remove pairs of matching tiles while navigating around obstacles and uncovering hidden tiles.

name: Animal Maze
description: "Animal Maze" is an engaging Flash puzzle game where players navigate through a series of mazes filled with adorable animals. The objective is to help the animals find their way to safety or to specific destinations within each maze. Game Features: Maze Navigation: Players control animals and guide them through intricate mazes, avoiding obstacles and dead ends. Variety of Animals: The game features a range of cute animal characters, each with their own unique traits or abilities that may aid in navigating the maze. Challenging Levels: Each level presents increasingly complex mazes, requiring strategic planning and problem-solving skills to complete. Collectibles and Bonuses: Players can collect items or bonuses within the maze that may provide helpful boosts or extra points. Colorful Graphics: The game features bright, cheerful visuals that enhance the playful atmosphere, making it appealing to players of all ages. Objective: The primary goal is to guide each animal to its destination in the shortest amount of time possible, earning points for efficiency and skill. Players may also strive to complete all levels and unlock additional challenges.

name: Animal Orchestra
description: "Animal Orchestra" is a charming Flash game hosted on CITV that invites players to create music using various adorable animal characters. In this interactive game, players can experiment with sounds and melodies, making it both fun and educational. Game Features: Animal Musicians: Players choose from a selection of cute animals, each representing different musical instruments or sounds, such as drums, violins, or flutes. Interactive Gameplay: Players can click on the animals to make them play their instruments, allowing for creative exploration of sound combinations. Customization: Players can arrange the animals in different ways to create unique musical ensembles, adding a personal touch to their compositions. Colorful Graphics: The game features vibrant and playful visuals that appeal to children and enhance the joyful atmosphere. Fun Sound Effects: Each animal produces distinctive sounds, making it enjoyable to experiment with different combinations and rhythms. Objective: The main goal is to create fun musical compositions by interacting with the animals, fostering creativity and an appreciation for music. Players can explore various melodies and rhythms, making each session unique.

name: Animal Quest
description: Animal Quest is a simple learning game for children (or adults). After selecting an animal, you proceed through the different maps capturing prey and avoiding predators. You can also learn more about each of the animals featured in the game. Choosing different animals affects the difficulty of the game. Animal Quest is a fun and engaging DOS-based adventure game where you embark on a journey through vibrant, animal-filled worlds to solve puzzles, complete tasks, and uncover secrets. The game puts you in the role of a young adventurer who must navigate different environments, meet animal companions, and complete quests to restore peace and harmony to the animal kingdom. Features: Adventure Gameplay: Explore different environments like forests, jungles, and savannas, each filled with puzzles and challenges that require problem-solving skills. Animal Companions: Befriend various animals, each with unique abilities that can help you on your quest. Use their strengths to overcome obstacles and complete tasks. Puzzle Solving: Solve environmental puzzles, interact with characters, and help animals in need to progress through the game. Interactive Story: A heartwarming narrative where you help animals and restore balance in the world, filled with surprises and twists. Charming Graphics: Colorful and whimsical pixel art representing various animal habitats and characters, creating a delightful and immersive world. Educational Elements: Learn about different animals, their habitats, and how they interact with the environment as you play.

name: Animal Tetris
description: Tetris game with Animals. Drop down blocks and create complete horizontal lines with the animals. Description: Animal Tetris is a fun and exciting twist on the classic Tetris game, featuring adorable animal-themed blocks. Like the original Tetris, players need to arrange falling shapes into complete lines to clear them from the screen. However, in Animal Tetris, the game pieces are not just random shapes—they are cute, colorful animals, making the experience even more engaging and delightful. The goal of the game is to strategically place these animal blocks as they fall from the top of the screen, aiming to fill horizontal lines. When a line is filled, it disappears, allowing more room for the next pieces. The game gets progressively faster as you advance, challenging your reflexes and spatial awareness. With its charming visuals, upbeat soundtrack, and simple mechanics, Animal Tetris offers a fun and relaxed version of the beloved Tetris puzzle game.

name: Animals Connect
description: Mahjong Connect game with funny Animals. Connect 2 of the same animals to remove them. The connecting line cannot have more then two 90 degree angles. Description: Animals Connect is a fun and relaxing HTML5 puzzle game that challenges players to connect matching animal tiles in a limited number of moves. The goal is simple: clear the board by connecting two identical animal tiles with a line that can bend at most twice, while avoiding obstacles and blocked paths. As the game progresses, more complex layouts and additional obstacles make it harder to find available moves. With colorful, animal-themed tiles and simple mechanics, Animals Connect is perfect for casual gaming sessions and puzzle enthusiasts alike. The game features a variety of adorable animal characters like dogs, cats, elephants, and more, each represented by vibrant and easy-to-recognize tiles. Players must find and connect pairs of matching tiles, and the game rewards efficiency, speed, and clever thinking as they work to clear each level.

name: Animals Connect 2
description: Another Mahjong Connect game with funny Animals. Connect 2 of the same animals to remove them. The connecting line cannot have more then two 90 degree angles. Animals Connect 2 is a fun and engaging puzzle game where players connect matching animal tiles to clear the board. This sequel to the original Animals Connect brings more complex puzzles, new challenges, and additional features, all while retaining the cute animal theme. The objective is to connect two identical animal tiles by drawing a line that can bend at most twice (up to three straight lines). The twist is that you need to carefully strategize your moves, as obstacles and blocked paths may make it difficult to find matches. With its colorful animal tiles, increasingly challenging levels, and smooth gameplay, Animals Connect 2 provides a relaxing yet stimulating puzzle experience. The game is perfect for casual gamers who enjoy a good challenge with cute visuals and a fun, easy-to-understand premise. Game Features: Animal-Themed Tiles: Animals Connect 2 features a variety of adorable animal tiles, including cats, dogs, birds, lions, elephants, and other creatures. Each tile is clearly illustrated, making it easy to identify matching pairs and adding a charming visual appeal to the game. Connect Matching Tiles: The main objective is to connect two identical animal tiles by drawing a line between them. The line can bend at most twice, but it cannot cross over other tiles or obstacles. The challenge is to find the best path to connect the pairs while dealing with limited space and blocked tiles. Increased Difficulty: As you progress through the levels, the game becomes more challenging. New obstacles such as locked tiles, blocked paths, and more complicated board layouts are introduced, requiring careful thought and planning. The levels start easy but get more intricate, making the game more engaging as you advance. Limited Moves and Time Challenges: Some levels in Animals Connect 2 come with time limits, while others impose a move limit, adding an extra layer of difficulty. You’ll need to clear the board within these constraints, making each move count. Hints and Power-ups: If you’re stuck on a level, Animals Connect 2 provides helpful hints that show you a possible match. In addition, there are power-ups that can shuffle tiles, remove obstacles, or provide other helpful tools to clear the board. These features are limited, so use them wisely to maximize your progress. Progressive Levels: The game includes a wide range of levels, each with unique tile arrangements and challenges. The game’s difficulty increases as you move through levels, with more tiles to match, harder-to-reach spots, and increasingly complex board layouts. Colorful and Charming Graphics: Animals Connect 2 is designed with vibrant and colorful graphics, featuring playful animal tiles that are appealing to both younger and older players. The game interface is user-friendly and intuitive, ensuring smooth and enjoyable gameplay. Soothing Soundtrack: The game includes a light, relaxing background soundtrack that complements the puzzle-solving experience. Sound effects are satisfying, offering positive feedback when you successfully match tiles or clear the board. Leaderboard and Achievements: Players are encouraged to perform well on each level by earning high scores. Completing levels quickly, using fewer moves, and clearing the board efficiently will increase your score. Some versions of the game may also include leaderboards or achievements, adding a competitive element for players who want to track their performance.

name: Animals Connect 3
description: Number 3 of our Animals connect games. Connect 2 of the same animals to remove them. The connecting line cannot have more then two 90 degree angles. Animals Connect 3 is the third installment in the popular Animals Connect series. This HTML5 puzzle game builds on its predecessors by offering more complex puzzles, a variety of new obstacles, and an expanded set of adorable animal-themed tiles. The gameplay centers around matching pairs of tiles that feature cute animals, such as cats, dogs, pandas, and birds, but with added challenges that test your logic, planning, and quick thinking. In Animals Connect 3, the objective is to clear the board by connecting matching animal tiles using a line that can bend at most twice (up to three straight segments). The catch is that the line cannot pass through other tiles or obstacles, so you must think strategically to find paths that connect the tiles efficiently. With colorful visuals, an engaging soundtrack, and progressively challenging levels, Animals Connect 3 provides an enjoyable and brain-stimulating puzzle experience.

name: Animaniacs Nations of the World
description: Animaniacs: Nations of the World is a fun and educational Flash game based on the famous song from the Animaniacs TV show, where Yakko Warner sings a lively and rapid-fire list of countries around the globe. In this game, players are tasked with identifying and selecting the countries listed in the song, while matching them to their locations on a world map. The game serves as a lighthearted and engaging way to learn about geography and the nations of the world, all while enjoying the catchy, upbeat tune made famous by the Animaniacs cartoon. The game is designed to be both entertaining and educational, with the zany humor of the Animaniacs characters adding a unique flair to the learning experience. Whether you're a fan of the show or just looking for a fun way to expand your knowledge of world geography, Animaniacs: Nations of the World offers a lively challenge that blends music, trivia, and map recognition.

name: Animated Clock
description: This simple drill-style program helps children learn how to read the hands on a clock. It has modes that teach how the hour and minute hands move as well as how to convert from analog to digital time and vice-versa. The presentation is fairly generic (the EGA graphics are uninspired) but it's quite thorough at what it does. Animated Clock is a simple and educational DOS game designed to help players, especially children, learn how to tell time. Through the use of an interactive animated clock, players can practice reading analog clocks, understand the relationship between hours and minutes, and improve their time-telling skills in a fun and engaging way. Features: Interactive Clock: A customizable animated clock where players can adjust the hour and minute hands to set the time and see it visually represented. Time-Telling Practice: Helps players learn how to read analog clocks by setting times based on various scenarios or challenges. Multiple Time Formats: Choose between different time formats, such as 12-hour and 24-hour clocks, to increase learning flexibility. Educational Challenges: The game presents time-related questions and tasks, such as setting the clock to a specific time or determining the time based on a given scenario. Colorful Animations: Fun and engaging animations make learning enjoyable for younger players, with friendly graphics that keep them interested in learning. Simple Interface: Easy-to-use controls make the game accessible for children and beginners who are just learning about time.

name: Animation Comission: Solomen
description: "Animation Commission: Solomen" is a unique Flash game that allows players to explore the world of animation through a character named Solomen. This game combines storytelling with interactive elements, enabling players to engage in a creative process while navigating various challenges. Game Features: Character Design: Players get to interact with Solomen, a charming character, as they guide him through different scenarios and adventures. Animation Elements: The game may include mini-games or tasks that require players to create or manipulate animations, providing insight into the animation process. Interactive Storytelling: Players can make choices that affect the storyline, leading to different outcomes and enhancing replayability. Artistic Graphics: The game features colorful and engaging visuals that highlight the artistic style of the animation, creating an immersive experience. Challenges and Puzzles: Players may encounter puzzles or challenges that need to be solved to progress through the story, adding an element of strategy. Objective: The primary goal is to navigate Solomen through various animated scenarios, making choices that shape the narrative while completing challenges related to animation. Players aim to explore creativity and storytelling in a fun, interactive way.

name: Anime Avatar Creator
description: "Anime Avatar Creator" is a fun and interactive Flash game that allows players to design and customize their own anime-style avatars. This game is perfect for fans of anime and manga who want to express their creativity through character design. Game Features: Extensive Customization Options: Players can choose from a wide variety of hairstyles, facial features, eye shapes, and colors to create a unique avatar. Outfit Selection: The game offers a range of clothing options, from casual outfits to fantasy-themed costumes, allowing for a personalized style. Accessories and Props: Players can add accessories like glasses, hats, and jewelry to further customize their avatars. Background Choices: Users can select different backgrounds for their avatars, enhancing the overall presentation of their creations. Save and Share Options: Many versions of the game allow players to save their avatars and share them on social media or with friends. Objective: The primary goal is to create a unique anime avatar that reflects the player’s personal style and preferences. Players can experiment with different combinations of features and outfits, making each avatar distinct.

name: Anime Boys Dress Up Game
description: "Anime Boys Dress Up Game" is an engaging Flash game that allows players to customize and style anime-inspired male characters. Perfect for fans of anime and fashion, this game provides a creative outlet for designing unique looks. Game Features: Character Selection: Players can choose from a variety of anime boy characters to dress up and style. Extensive Wardrobe: The game offers a wide range of clothing options, including casual outfits, formal wear, and fantasy costumes, allowing for diverse fashion choices. Hairstyles and Colors: Players can experiment with different hairstyles and colors, giving each character a distinct look. Accessories and Props: Add accessories such as hats, glasses, and jewelry to enhance the character’s style. Background Options: Players can select various backgrounds to display their styled characters, adding to the overall presentation. Save and Share Functionality: Many versions allow players to save their creations and share them with friends or on social media. Objective: The main goal is to create a stylish anime boy character that reflects the player’s personal taste and creativity. Players can mix and match various elements to create endless unique combinations.

name: Anime Character Generator
description: "Anime Character Generator" is an interactive Flash game that allows players to create unique anime characters through a simple and fun design process. This game is perfect for anime enthusiasts who enjoy character customization and creativity. Game Features: Customizable Attributes: Players can adjust various attributes such as hair color, eye shape, facial features, and expressions to create their ideal character. Outfit Selection: The generator includes a wide range of clothing options, from casual wear to elaborate costumes, allowing for diverse styles. Accessories and Extras: Players can add accessories like hats, glasses, and jewelry to personalize their characters further. Background Options: Users can choose from different backgrounds to showcase their creations, enhancing the overall look of the character. Random Generation Option: Many versions allow for random character generation, providing a fun way to discover new designs. Save and Share Features: Players can save their characters and share them with friends or on social media platforms. Objective: The primary goal is to create a unique and visually appealing anime character that reflects the player's style and preferences. Players can experiment with different combinations, encouraging creativity and exploration.

name: Anime Christmas Makeover
description: "Anime Christmas Makeover" is a festive Flash game that combines character customization with a holiday theme, allowing players to create stylish anime characters ready for Christmas celebrations. It’s perfect for fans of anime and holiday cheer. Game Features: Character Selection: Players can choose from a variety of anime characters, including boys and girls, to customize for the holiday season. Holiday-Themed Outfits: The game offers a wide range of clothing options, including festive dresses, cozy sweaters, and traditional Christmas attire. Accessories and Decorations: Players can add holiday-themed accessories such as Santa hats, reindeer antlers, and Christmas ornaments to enhance the festive look. Hairstyles and Colors: Users can experiment with different hairstyles and colors, giving each character a unique holiday flair. Backgrounds: Players can select from various Christmas-themed backgrounds, such as snowy landscapes or decorated rooms, to display their characters. Save and Share Functionality: Many versions allow players to save their creations and share them with friends or on social media. Objective: The main goal is to create a visually appealing anime character that embodies the spirit of Christmas, mixing and matching outfits, accessories, and hairstyles to achieve the perfect festive look.

name: Anime Disney Princess
description: "Anime Disney Princess" is a delightful Flash dress-up game that allows players to merge the charm of Disney princesses with anime aesthetics. In this game, players can customize and style their favorite princesses, giving them a unique anime twist. Game Features: Character Selection: Players can choose from various beloved Disney princesses, such as Cinderella, Ariel, and Belle, each rendered in an anime style. Extensive Wardrobe: The game offers a wide selection of outfits, including iconic dresses, casual wear, and accessories that fit both Disney and anime themes. Hairstyle Options: Players can experiment with different hairstyles and colors, allowing for creative expressions and unique looks. Accessories and Props: Players can add various accessories, such as tiaras, jewelry, and themed items that enhance the character's style. Background Choices: Users can select from a variety of beautiful backgrounds that complement their styled princesses. Save and Share Features: Many versions of the game allow players to save their creations and share them with friends or on social media. Objective: The main goal is to create a visually stunning anime version of a Disney princess, combining elements of both worlds to achieve a unique and stylish character. Players can mix and match different outfits and accessories to bring their vision to life.

name: Anime Fighting Jam: Wing
description: "Anime Fighting Jam: Wing" is an exciting flash game that brings together various characters from popular anime series for intense one-on-one battles. Players can select from a diverse roster, each with unique abilities and fighting styles, and engage in fast-paced combat across dynamic stages. The game features a mix of special moves, combos, and ultimate attacks, allowing players to unleash powerful techniques inspired by their favorite characters. With intuitive controls and vibrant graphics, "Anime Fighting Jam: Wing" offers an engaging experience for both casual gamers and anime fans. In addition to single-player modes, the game often includes multiplayer options, letting friends challenge each other in epic showdowns. The combination of beloved characters and thrilling gameplay makes this title a must-play for fighting game enthusiasts and anime lovers alike.

name: Animutation - Jesus H. Christ
description: "Animutation - Jesus H. Christ" is a quirky and humorous Flash game inspired by the popular Animutation genre, known for its fast-paced, surreal animations and catchy soundtracks. This game blends absurd humor with interactive gameplay elements. Game Features: Unique Animation Style: The game features colorful, cartoonish graphics that reflect the distinct style of animutation, with rapid transitions and unexpected visual gags. Catchy Music: Players can enjoy an upbeat soundtrack that often includes humorous or ironic lyrics, adding to the overall enjoyment. Interactive Elements: The game may involve various mini-games or challenges that require quick reflexes and timing, often with a comedic twist. Character Variety: Players encounter a range of whimsical characters, including a cartoonish portrayal of Jesus, along with other fantastical figures. Absurd Humor: The gameplay and animations are filled with absurd and random humor, appealing to fans of offbeat comedy. Objective: The main goal is to navigate through the game, completing challenges and enjoying the humorous animations. Players often aim to achieve high scores while experiencing the fun and randomness characteristic of animutation.

name: Annihilator Tank
description: Annihilator Tank is an example of a game that looks good and has a lot of potential but is let down by the way the game plays. The goal is to operate your tank and destroy the enemy vehicles. Sounds simple enough, however there are multiple enemies shooting at you while you try to shoot at them, and avoiding getting hit in your tank is not easy. Annihilator Tank is a classic DOS action game where players control a powerful tank on a mission to destroy enemy forces, conquer fortresses, and survive waves of hostile enemies. Packed with intense combat, strategic planning, and explosive action, the game challenges players to navigate through a series of increasingly difficult levels, using firepower and tactical thinking to overcome a variety of enemies and obstacles. Features: Tank Combat: Command a heavily-armed tank through warzones, equipped with a range of weapons, including cannons, rockets, and explosives. Intense Action: Face off against waves of enemy tanks, helicopters, and other military vehicles in high-intensity battles. Strategic Gameplay: Plan your movements carefully to avoid enemy fire and position yourself for the best attacks. Varied Environments: Battle through different terrains, including cityscapes, open fields, and enemy bases, each offering unique challenges. Upgrade System: Earn upgrades for your tank's armor, weapons, and speed to make it even more powerful in later levels. Classic Retro Graphics: Enjoy pixelated visuals with detailed environments, explosions, and tank animations that evoke the nostalgia of early 90s arcade games.

name: Annoying Orange: Escape From Dr. Fruitenstein
description: "Annoying Orange: Escape From Dr. Fruitenstein" is an entertaining Flash game based on the popular web series featuring the Annoying Orange. In this action-packed adventure, players help the Annoying Orange and his friends escape from the clutches of the villainous Dr. Fruitenstein. Game Features: Action-Packed Gameplay: Players navigate through various levels filled with obstacles, enemies, and challenges, all while trying to escape Dr. Fruitenstein's lab. Character Abilities: Players can switch between different characters, each with unique abilities that aid in overcoming obstacles and defeating enemies. Humorous Graphics: The game features vibrant and cartoonish graphics, capturing the comedic style of the Annoying Orange series. Collectibles: Players can collect items throughout the levels, such as fruits and power-ups, to enhance gameplay and score points. Boss Battles: Players face off against Dr. Fruitenstein and his minions in exciting boss battles that require strategy and quick reflexes. Objective: The primary goal is to guide the Annoying Orange and his friends to safety while collecting items and defeating enemies. Players aim to complete levels as efficiently as possible, earning high scores and unlocking new content.

name: Anon PartyHard V2
description: Anon PartyHard V2 is a quirky and entertaining flash game from 2007 that invites players to engage in a unique party experience. In this game, players take on the role of a character trying to navigate a lively party scene while avoiding detection and causing a bit of chaos. The objective is to complete various missions, such as sneaking past partygoers, interacting with objects, and creating distractions. The gameplay emphasizes stealth and strategy, encouraging players to think creatively about how to achieve their goals without being caught. With its playful graphics, humorous sound effects, and an upbeat soundtrack, Anon PartyHard V2 delivers a fun and lighthearted atmosphere. It's a great choice for those looking for a whimsical challenge in a party setting!

name: Another Day 4
description: "Another Day 4" is a captivating Flash game that continues the adventure of survival in a post-apocalyptic world. Players must navigate through various challenges while managing resources, solving puzzles, and making critical decisions that affect the storyline. Game Features: Engaging Narrative: Building on the previous installments, the game features a rich story where players must survive in a world filled with dangers and mysteries. Exploration: Players can explore different environments, such as abandoned buildings and wastelands, gathering essential resources and items. Puzzle Elements: The game includes various puzzles that need to be solved to progress, often requiring players to think critically about their surroundings. Character Development: Players can upgrade their character’s skills and abilities, enhancing their chances of survival and allowing for different play styles. Immersive Graphics: The game boasts atmospheric graphics and sound design that enhance the experience of a desolate world. Objective: The main goal is to survive and progress through the game by completing objectives, making choices that affect the story, and solving puzzles. Players aim to uncover the secrets of the world while keeping their character alive and well.

name: Another Day 5
description: "Another Day" is a thrilling Flash game that combines elements of adventure, survival, and puzzle-solving in a post-apocalyptic setting. Players navigate through a world filled with challenges and must make strategic decisions to progress. Game Features: Engaging Storyline: The game features a gripping narrative where players take on the role of a survivor in a harsh environment, facing various obstacles and enemies. Exploration: Players can explore different locations, gathering resources and items that are crucial for survival. Puzzle-Solving: The game includes puzzles that players must solve to unlock new areas or access vital supplies. Character Development: Players can upgrade their character's skills and abilities based on the choices they make throughout the game. Atmospheric Graphics: The game features detailed graphics that create an immersive experience, capturing the mood of a post-apocalyptic world. Objective: The primary goal is to survive and navigate through the challenges of the game, completing objectives and making choices that impact the story's outcome. Players aim to uncover the mysteries of the world while keeping their character alive.

name: Another Maple Story
description: "Another Maple Story" is a fan-made Flash game inspired by the popular MMORPG MapleStory. This game offers a unique take on the classic MapleStory experience, incorporating elements of platforming, adventure, and character customization. Game Features: Character Creation: Players can create and customize their own characters, choosing from various classes and appearances reminiscent of the original game. Platforming Gameplay: Unlike the traditional MapleStory, this version emphasizes platforming mechanics, requiring players to jump, dodge, and navigate through various levels and obstacles. Quests and Missions: Players can embark on quests that involve defeating monsters, collecting items, and completing objectives to progress through the game. Vibrant Graphics: The game features colorful, pixel-art graphics that evoke the nostalgic style of the original MapleStory. Exploration: Players can explore different environments and zones, each filled with challenges, enemies, and treasures. Objective: The main goal is to navigate through levels, complete quests, defeat enemies, and ultimately develop your character's skills. Players aim to achieve high scores and enjoy the nostalgic elements of the MapleStory universe.

name: Another Xmas
description: Blue Rabbit and friends enjoy Christmas. The song Dim used ended up becoming a little too famous for its own good. Oh well! Original description from Newgrounds Christmas is nearly here, so I felt a Christmas edition of the Another Day series would be nice. This one follows Blue Rabbit and friends as they enjoy the Christmas holidays, drawn in the style I've come to know so well. If some of it seems strange and new to you, then you can always watch the other cartoons in the series. I recommend 3 and 4, as these explain who the characters are and where they live. Some credit goes to Soph, for making sure I finished it, and for helping me come up with ideas.

name: Ant Attack
description: Ant Attack is a action game which includes a little strategy but mainly it's a race to kill the (giant? mutant?) ants before they defile the picnic basket(s). You have three tools available to stop the ants (which cannot kill you): The bulldozer destroys rocks, the water can be placed to stop ants, and the insecticide kills them (and also prevents further spread of ants). Ant Attack is a thrilling DOS action game where players must fend off swarms of giant ants that have overrun a city. The game combines strategy, action, and resource management as you navigate through city streets, rescuing civilians, gathering supplies, and facing off against increasingly powerful ant enemies. Features: Strategic Combat: Fight off the giant ants using a variety of weapons and tools. Choose between different types of attacks and defenses to survive. Rescue Missions: Save civilians who are trapped in buildings or caught by the ants, all while avoiding or confronting the giant pests. Resource Management: Collect supplies like food, ammunition, and medicine to sustain yourself and the people you’re rescuing. Multiple Levels: Progress through various stages, each with different layouts, enemies, and increasing difficulty. Retro Graphics: The game features classic DOS-era pixel graphics with a top-down view of the city, capturing the chaos of the ant invasion. Action-Packed Gameplay: Each level brings new challenges, such as larger swarms, faster ants, and tougher enemies, requiring quick reflexes and strategic thinking.

name: Ant City
description: "Ant City" is an engaging Flash simulation game that allows players to build and manage their own ant colony. In this game, players take on the role of an ant queen, tasked with creating a thriving underground city. Game Features: Colony Building: Players can dig tunnels, create chambers, and expand their ant colony, strategically planning the layout to optimize resources and space. Resource Management: Players must gather food and other resources to feed their colony, ensuring the survival and growth of their ants. Ant Types: The game features different types of ants, each with unique abilities, such as workers, soldiers, and foragers, allowing for diverse strategies in managing the colony. Environmental Challenges: Players must navigate various challenges, including predators and environmental obstacles, while expanding their city. Graphics and Animation: The game features charming graphics and animations that bring the ant world to life, enhancing the overall experience. Objective: The main goal is to build a successful ant colony by managing resources, expanding the city, and ensuring the well-being of your ants. Players aim to create the largest and most efficient ant city possible.

name: Ant Kendo
description: "Ant Kendo" is a fun and quirky Flash game where players control an ant engaged in kendo battles against various opponents. This unique take on martial arts combines humor with skill-based gameplay. Game Features: Character Control: Players can control their ant character, using various kendo moves and techniques to defeat opponents in one-on-one matches. Multiple Opponents: The game features a variety of adversaries, each with different skills and fighting styles, requiring players to adapt their strategy. Training Mode: Players can practice their moves and improve their skills in a training mode before entering competitive matches. Power-Ups: During battles, players can collect power-ups that enhance their abilities or provide temporary advantages against opponents. Colorful Graphics: The game features vibrant, cartoonish visuals that add to the fun, lighthearted atmosphere. Objective: The primary goal is to win kendo matches against various opponents, improving your skills and unlocking new challenges as you progress. Players aim to become the ultimate ant kendo champion!

name: Ant Run
description: Antrun is a great puzzle game. It's an adaption of the popular pipe-laying genre ... in this case, the task is to keep an ant running through tunnels as long as possible. You can rotate the tunnel pieces to try to keep him going. Ant Run is a classic arcade-style game that was originally released for MS-DOS systems. The game follows the simple yet engaging premise of controlling an ant as it navigates various environments, collecting food and avoiding obstacles. Game Overview Genre: Action/Platformer Platform: MS-DOS Developer: (varies, often attributed to small independent developers) Release Year: Typically around the early 1990s (exact year varies by version) Gameplay The player controls a small ant, tasked with collecting food items while avoiding natural predators and obstacles. The environment is often set in outdoor, nature-themed stages like grassy fields, garden areas, or sometimes more abstract environments. The game's difficulty increases as the player progresses, with more challenging obstacles, enemies (such as spiders, beetles, or other ants), and more complex levels. Objective: The primary goal is to collect all the food items (often depicted as crumbs or small pieces of food) while avoiding dangers and reaching the exit before time runs out or the player loses all lives. Obstacles and Enemies: Players must dodge spiders, other insects, and environmental hazards like water or sharp plants. Controls: The controls are simple, usually involving the arrow keys for movement and sometimes a single key for jumping or special actions.

name: Antarctic Adventure
description: Antarctic Adventure is a classic arcade-style game that was released for MS-DOS in 1983, originally developed by Konami. It’s a charming and colorful platformer featuring a penguin protagonist who embarks on a journey across the icy Antarctic landscape. Game Overview Title: Antarctic Adventure Genre: Platformer/Action Platform: MS-DOS, with later releases on other systems Developer: Konami Release Year: 1983 Story and Setting In Antarctic Adventure, you play as a penguin named Penta, who must travel across the Antarctic in search of his family. The journey is perilous, with the penguin encountering various environmental hazards, obstacles, and other challenges along the way. The game is set in a series of icy, snow-covered terrains filled with enemies and traps. Gameplay Objective: The primary goal of the game is to race across multiple stages of the Antarctic, dodging obstacles, collecting items, and trying to reach the end of each level safely. The player needs to gather as much fish as possible while avoiding dangers like seals and icebergs. The game is divided into several "stages" or "legs," with each stage representing a part of the penguin’s journey across the frozen land. Movement: Penta can move left and right and jump to avoid obstacles. The penguin can also slide and “ski” across certain parts of the level, which adds a unique and fun dynamic to the gameplay. Obstacles and Enemies: Throughout the game, you will face a variety of hazards, such as: Seals that chase the penguin across the ice. Icebergs and other impassable terrain that must be avoided. Rocks and other environmental obstacles that slow the penguin down. Power-ups: You can collect fish along the way, which are both points and essential to progressing. At certain points in the game, you may also find power-ups that boost your speed or protect you from enemies. Time Limit: Each level has a time limit, and you must race to complete it before time runs out. This adds an element of urgency to the gameplay. Graphics and Sound

name: Antbuster
description: "Antbuster" is an engaging Flash tower defense game where players protect their picnic from invading ants. The objective is to strategically place various defenses to thwart the relentless advance of the ants trying to steal your food. Game Features: Tower Defense Mechanics: Players can choose from different types of defensive towers, each with unique abilities and effects, to stop the ants from reaching the picnic. Variety of Ants: The game features various ant types, each with distinct strengths and weaknesses, requiring players to adapt their strategies. Upgrades: Players can upgrade their towers and defenses, improving their effectiveness as the game progresses and the ants become more challenging. Multiple Levels: The game includes various levels with increasing difficulty, presenting new challenges and layouts for players to tackle. Colorful Graphics: The game features vibrant and playful visuals, enhancing the overall fun and lighthearted atmosphere. Objective: The primary goal is to prevent the ants from reaching your picnic by strategically placing towers and upgrading them effectively. Players aim to achieve high scores by stopping waves of ants and protecting their food at all costs.

name: Anti Air Tank
description: Anti Air Tank is a fast-paced Flash game where you take control of a heavily armed tank designed to defend against waves of aerial enemies. Armed with powerful anti-aircraft cannons and guided missiles, your mission is to protect your base from relentless airstrikes. As planes, helicopters, and drones swoop down to attack, players must aim quickly and strategically to shoot them down before they cause damage. The game features increasingly difficult waves, upgradeable weapons, and various power-ups to enhance your tank's firepower and durability. With intense gameplay, vibrant explosions, and a variety of enemy types, Anti Air Tank delivers a thrilling blend of strategy and action for fans of defense games!

name: Anti Pac-Man
description: "Anti Pac-Man" is a creative twist on the classic Pac-Man gameplay, where players take on the role of the ghosts instead of the titular character. The objective is to strategically capture Pac-Man while avoiding being eaten by him. Game Features: Ghost Mechanics: Players control one or more ghosts, using their unique abilities to chase and trap Pac-Man throughout the maze. Dynamic Gameplay: The game features a blend of strategy and quick reflexes as players navigate the maze, anticipating Pac-Man's movements and planning their attacks. Power-Ups: Players can collect various power-ups that enhance their abilities, allowing them to move faster or temporarily stun Pac-Man. Challenging Levels: The game includes multiple levels with increasing difficulty, introducing new maze layouts and obstacles to keep players engaged. Classic Graphics: The game retains a retro aesthetic, reminiscent of classic arcade games, with colorful visuals and nostalgic sound effects. Objective: The main goal is to successfully capture Pac-Man before he collects all the dots in the maze. Players aim to strategize and coordinate their ghost movements to outsmart the elusive Pac-Man while achieving high scores.

name: Anti Tower Defense
description: "Anti Tower Defense" is a unique twist on the traditional tower defense genre, where players take on the role of the attacking force rather than defending against waves of enemies. In this game, the goal is to strategically overcome the defenses set up by the opponent. Game Features: Offensive Gameplay: Players control various units and troops to attack and breach enemy defenses, rather than placing towers to stop an invasion. Diverse Units: The game features a variety of attacking units, each with different abilities and strengths, allowing for strategic planning in choosing the right combination for each assault. Resource Management: Players must manage resources to deploy units effectively and upgrade their attacking capabilities. Challenging Levels: Each level presents different defensive setups, requiring players to adapt their strategies to overcome increasingly tough challenges. Upgrades and Unlocks: As players progress, they can unlock new units and upgrades to enhance their attacking power and effectiveness. Objective: The primary goal is to successfully breach enemy defenses in each level, employing strategy and resource management to defeat the opponent. Players aim to achieve high scores by completing levels efficiently and with minimal losses.

name: Anti-Idle: The Game
description: "Anti-Idle: The Game" is a fun and quirky incremental (idle) game created by Starfruit Games. It blends the traditional idle game mechanics with active, interactive gameplay elements. It’s a parody of the "idle" genre, where instead of just passively watching numbers increase, you're constantly engaged with various activities and challenges. The game was originally developed in Flash and quickly became popular for its unique take on the idle genre, as well as its humor and variety of mechanics. Key Features: Idle Mechanics with Active Engagement: Unlike traditional idle games where you passively wait for things to happen, Anti-Idle gives you tons of ways to stay actively engaged. The game features many different systems (such as resources, upgrades, mini-games) that encourage constant interaction. You’re encouraged to keep playing and interacting with different elements, including minigames that let you earn in-game currency, experience points, or other bonuses. Multiple Modes of Play: There are several different modes you can play in Anti-Idle, ranging from Idle Mode, where things happen automatically, to Active Mode, where you need to interact and click to progress. The game includes traditional idle game features (e.g., resources building up over time, automated systems) but also adds layers of active involvement, like quests, mini-games, and character upgrades. Upgrades and Unlockables: You unlock new upgrades, systems, and modes as you progress. There are tons of different paths and strategies for how to approach the game, with options to focus on increasing resources, improving automated systems, or engaging in mini-games for more rewards. Humor and Parody: One of the standout features of Anti-Idle: The Game is its humor. The game constantly pokes fun at idle game tropes and genres, often providing jokes, quirky characters, and tongue-in-cheek dialogue. It's as much about the experience and the laughs as it is about the mechanics. Minigames and Challenges: The game includes a wide range of mini-games, from simple click-based activities to more complex puzzle challenges. You’ll also encounter time-limited events and challenges that reward you for participating in active gameplay. Complex Resource Management: Much like in other idle games, you’ll have to manage resources effectively. The game offers a variety of different currencies and upgrades that require careful balancing, ensuring there's always something new to focus on. Achievements and Progression: There are tons of achievements and milestones to hit, and the game provides a sense of progression as you unlock new features, upgrade your systems, and strive for higher levels.

name: AntiC
description: AntiC is an interesting puzzle game where the object is to turn all of the blocks in the given pattern to the same color. It's described by the author as being "a cross between Othello and Life". Okay, not really. But once you get the hang of how it works (red to blue, blue to green, green to red) you can somewhat think ahead to how the puzzle will change to plan your moves, although for larger puzzles it's going to be somewhat trial and error. AntiC is a classic DOS puzzle game where players are tasked with solving a series of increasingly difficult challenges by strategically placing or manipulating objects. The game combines elements of logic, strategy, and timing as players must think ahead and plan their moves carefully to progress through each level. Features: Puzzle-Based Gameplay: Solve various puzzles by moving pieces or arranging elements in specific patterns to unlock the next stage. Challenging Levels: Each level introduces new mechanics and obstacles, requiring players to adapt their strategy and think critically. Simple Controls: Intuitive controls that allow players to focus on solving puzzles without being hindered by complex commands. Increasing Difficulty: As you advance, puzzles become more intricate and require more precise movements or problem-solving. Classic DOS Graphics: Retro-style visuals with a minimalist design, capturing the essence of the early '90s puzzle games.

name: Antman
description: Antman is a simple single-screen platforming game where the object is to kill all of the ants on the level and escape out the exit (right side of the screen). Each level has a slightly different layout, number of ants, maximum bullets you can shoot, and other hazards. The controls are simple and responsive enough, although the random movement of the ant(s) make them difficult to hit, and given your limited ammo, it's somewhat luck-based whether you complete the level or not. Antman is an exciting DOS action-platformer where you control a tiny hero, Antman, navigating through various environments filled with dangerous obstacles and enemies. Shrinking down to the size of an insect, Antman must use his agility, quick thinking, and unique abilities to overcome challenges and defeat foes in his quest to save his world from a sinister threat. Features: Platforming Gameplay: Jump, climb, and run through different levels, each filled with perilous traps, hazards, and enemies. Unique Abilities: Use Antman's small size to access hard-to-reach places, squeeze through tight gaps, and defeat enemies with special attacks. Challenging Obstacles: Face increasingly difficult levels that test your reflexes, timing, and puzzle-solving skills. Various Environments: Explore diverse locations such as gardens, kitchens, and backyards, each with different challenges and enemies. Retro Graphics and Sound: Classic pixel art style with colorful environments, simple animations, and an engaging chiptune soundtrack that enhances the retro feel of the game. Boss Battles: Face off against large, intimidating bosses that require skillful strategy and quick reactions to defeat.

name: Ants
description: Ants is a classic arcade-style game that was released in the early 1990s for MS-DOS. It is an action-puzzle game where players take on the role of an ant, navigating through various environments to complete tasks while avoiding enemies and hazards. Game Overview Title: Ants Genre: Action, Puzzle Platform: MS-DOS Release Year: 1993 (approximate) Developer: Atari Games (or a related studio, depending on the version) Gameplay In Ants, you play as a small ant, working within a colony. The objective of the game is to complete various tasks such as collecting food, avoiding enemies, and completing puzzles across different levels. The game is viewed from a top-down or isometric perspective, showing the ground and obstacles like plants, rocks, and other environmental features that the ant must navigate. Objective: The main goal is to collect food (often depicted as crumbs or seeds) and bring it back to your nest while avoiding threats and obstacles. Some levels have more specific objectives, such as solving puzzles or rescuing other ants. Levels: The game is divided into several levels, each representing a different part of the environment (such as a garden, forest, or underground tunnel system). The difficulty increases as you progress, with more complex puzzles, more aggressive enemies, and more obstacles to navigate. Movement and Actions: You control the ant using the arrow keys or other keyboard inputs. The ant can move in all directions and may need to climb over obstacles or dig through tunnels. Some levels feature obstacles like water or predators (such as spiders, birds, or other insects), which the ant must avoid or outrun. Enemies and Hazards: Throughout the game, you'll encounter various dangers, including: Predators: Spiders, birds, and other animals that pose a threat to the ant. Environmental hazards: Water, falling objects, and other obstacles that can kill the ant. Ant rivalries: Sometimes, other ants (from rival colonies) may be obstacles to your progress. Power-ups: Some versions of the game feature power-ups, such as speed boosts or invincibility, that help you avoid enemies or clear obstacles more effectively.

name: Ants
description: "Ants" is a fun and engaging Flash game that immerses players in the world of ants, focusing on strategy and resource management. Players take on the role of an ant colony leader, guiding their ants in various tasks to ensure the colony thrives. name: Arcade Pool
description: Arcade Pool is a DOS-based billiards game released in the mid-1990s, developed by Stingray Studios and published by Eidos Interactive. It was a popular game for its time, providing players with an arcade-style experience of pool and offering a range of game modes. Arcade Pool stood out due to its realistic physics, smooth controls, and variety of pool game options, making it one of the best billiards games of the era. Variety of Game Modes: 8-Ball: The classic pool game where the goal is to pocket either all the solid-colored balls (1-7) or striped balls (9-15), and then the 8-ball to win. 9-Ball: A faster-paced variation where the goal is to pocket the 9-ball in a specific order. Straight Pool: Players aim to pocket any ball on the table, with the objective being to score a specific number of points. Other Arcade Modes: The game also offers more arcade-like modes, such as timed challenges or mini-games that involve more creative and fun pool-based challenges. Single Player Mode: In single-player mode, you can play against AI-controlled opponents. The AI varies in difficulty, offering challenges for both beginners and experienced players. This mode includes the ability to practice shots or take on a set series of opponents with increasing difficulty. Multiplayer Mode: Arcade Pool also offers local multiplayer, allowing two players to face off against each other in head-to-head competition. The local multiplayer mode was a big draw, as it allowed friends to play together, taking turns at the pool table in an exciting, competitive environment. Realistic Physics: One of the standout features of Arcade Pool was its physics engine. The game accurately replicated the physics of real pool, including the motion of balls after being hit by the cue ball, ball spin, collision angles, and ball-pocketing mechanics. This gave the game a more realistic and immersive feel compared to other arcade-style billiard games of the time. Controls: The controls were simple but effective. Players used the keyboard or a mouse to aim and take shots. The mouse controlled the cue stick, allowing players to line up their shots and apply spin (English) to the cue ball. The left mouse button was used to shoot, with a power meter to adjust the force of the shot. The controls allowed for precision aiming and adjustments in shot strength, which was essential for advanced players trying to make trick shots or strategic plays. Graphics and Sound: The game featured a 2D top-down view of the pool table. The graphics were relatively simple for the time, with realistic representations of the pool balls, the cue stick, and the table. The visuals were clear and functional, providing players with all the necessary information for aiming and making shots. While not as sophisticated as modern 3D games, Arcade Pool's visual design was charming and easy to navigate, with clear table layouts and easy-to-read cues. Sound effects included the clinking of balls as they hit each other and the cue ball, as well as ambient noise from the environment. The sound design was functional but not overly complex. Customization: Players could choose from various cue sticks, which affected the speed and accuracy of the shots. There was a range of different tables and backgrounds to choose from, adding variety and a sense of customization to the game. Power Meter for Shots: A power meter was featured, allowing players to adjust the strength of their shots. This added a layer of strategy to the game, as players could decide whether to go for a soft shot with minimal force or take a risky, powerful shot.
