Levels and Goals: Each level presents a new challenge, with different objectives such as matching a certain number of specific items or reaching a particular score within a limited number of moves or time. The levels progressively increase in difficulty as the grid becomes more complex and new obstacles or restrictions are introduced. Power-ups and Bonuses: Christmas Dimensions includes special power-ups that can help clear sections of the board more efficiently. For example: Bombs: Clear a group of items in a specific area. Special Ornaments: These can clear all items of the same type or a row/column. Snowflakes: These may be used to trigger an entire row or column to clear. These power-ups are earned through gameplay, either by making large matches or completing level objectives quickly. Holiday Themed Graphics and Sound: The game is filled with bright, colorful holiday-themed graphics that feature classic Christmas imagery like ornaments, Santa hats, gingerbread cookies, snowflakes, and gifts. The background music and sound effects feature jolly holiday tunes and festive jingles to enhance the Christmas atmosphere. Time-Limited or Move-Limited Gameplay: Some levels are timed, while others may limit the number of moves you can make. You must complete the objectives before the time runs out or before you run out of moves, adding an element of challenge. Achievements and Rewards: Players can unlock special achievements by completing difficult levels, making large matches, or using power-ups effectively. Rewards could include extra points, new levels, or customization options.

name: Christmas Match 3
description: "Christmas Match 3" is a festive HTML-based match-3 puzzle game where players swap adjacent Christmas-themed items to create matches of three or more identical items. The game typically features a grid filled with various holiday-related icons, such as Christmas trees, ornaments, candy canes, snowflakes, and gifts. The goal is to create matches to score points, clear the board, and complete level objectives. Game Description: Theme: The game is set in a cheerful Christmas environment, with a snowy background, holiday music, and festive visuals. The grid is filled with colorful Christmas items. Gameplay: Players swap two adjacent items (horizontally or vertically) to create a row or column of three or more identical items. When a match is made, the matched items disappear, and new items fall from the top to fill the gaps. Special items or power-ups may appear when matching four or more items, such as bombs (to clear surrounding items) or row/column clears. Objectives: Each level has specific goals, such as reaching a target score, clearing a certain number of specific items, or breaking ice blocks or presents. Players must complete the objectives within a limited number of moves or time. Special Features: Combos: Creating multiple matches in a single move results in combo bonuses. Power-ups: Matching four or more items creates special power-ups that clear larger areas of the grid. Festive Animations: Matches trigger fun animations, like snowflakes falling or gifts opening. Progression: The game includes multiple levels, with increasing difficulty as players progress. New challenges, obstacles, and items are introduced in later levels.

name: Christmas Matchup
description: Christmas Matchup is a tile matching & memory game with a Christmas / Bible theme. You're presented with a set of 25 face-down cards, 12 sets of matching cards plus one "grace" card. You'll need to flip them over, two at at time, and if they don't match, you'll need to remember the card and its position so that you can match it up later.Christmas Matchup (DOS) is a holiday-themed puzzle game where the goal is to match various Christmas-themed items to score points and progress through levels. The game incorporates classic match-3 mechanics, but with a festive twist, using Christmas-themed decorations, gifts, and other related items.

name: Christmas Merge
description: Connect items for Christmas to merge into bigger items. Reach the indicated goal. Drag to connect the same Christmas items and to merge by 3 or more of the same.Christmas Merge (HTML) is a holiday-themed puzzle game that combines the mechanics of a match-3 game with the fun of merging items. The game is designed to get players in the Christmas spirit, featuring colorful visuals of holiday-themed objects such as gifts, trees, snowflakes, and other festive icons. Merging Items: Players start with a variety of Christmas-themed items on the screen (e.g., snowflakes, presents, bells, ornaments). The goal is to drag or click matching items to merge them into more valuable items. For example, merging two small presents might create a larger present, or merging two candy canes could create a decorated candy cane. As players merge items, new and higher-value objects are created, which can be merged again to further progress through the game. Level Progression and Objectives: The game may consist of multiple levels, with each level offering specific objectives that need to be met, such as: Merging a certain number of items. Reaching a target score. Creating specific holiday-themed objects. As players complete levels, the complexity increases, and new challenges are introduced, such as more items to merge or limited moves/time. Power-ups and Boosters: Christmas Merge may include special power-ups or boosters to help players merge items more effectively. These could include: Santa’s Magic: Instantly merges items on the board. Festive Boosters: Clear certain rows or columns, making it easier to find matches and merges. These power-ups are often available through gameplay progression or can be earned by achieving specific objectives. Holiday-Themed Graphics and Sound: The game features colorful and festive visuals filled with holiday decorations, such as snowflakes, presents, Christmas trees, and other symbols. The environment may include snowy backdrops and cozy, holiday-themed rooms. The background music features Christmas carols, jingles, and other seasonal tunes, adding to the cheerful atmosphere.

name: Christmas Mysteries
description: Find all the hidden objects in this Christmas Mystery game. Click to find an object or differences.Christmas Mysteries (HTML) is a holiday-themed hidden object puzzle game that invites players to solve mysteries and discover festive secrets hidden within various Christmas scenes. Set in a magical Christmas world, the game is designed to get players into the holiday spirit while offering an engaging and fun experience filled with festive challenges. Hidden Object Gameplay: The primary objective is to find all the hidden objects listed at the bottom of the screen. These items are typically scattered throughout detailed, snowy landscapes or Christmas-themed rooms, such as decorated living rooms, Christmas markets, or snowy forests. As players search for the items, they must carefully observe the scene and look for cleverly disguised objects. These could be hidden behind other objects, camouflaged by the background, or partially obscured. Hints and Help: If players get stuck and are unable to find an item, the game often provides a hint system. This can highlight an area of the screen or give a subtle clue about where the object is located. In some versions, players may have a limited number of hints or need to earn them by completing challenges. Time Limit and Score: Many hidden object games include a time limit to make the gameplay more challenging. Players must find all the hidden objects within a set amount of time to achieve a high score. In some versions, players may earn extra points for completing the search quickly or for finding all items without using hints. Levels and Progression: Christmas Mysteries typically consists of multiple levels, each with new scenes and different hidden objects to find. As players progress through the game, the scenes become more complex, and the number of hidden items increases. Some levels may introduce special objectives or challenges, such as finding a specific number of items from a certain category (e.g., all the Christmas ornaments or all the snowflakes). Festive Themes and Graphics: The game features beautiful, detailed artwork with Christmas-themed illustrations. Players can explore snowy forests, cozy homes with Christmas trees, festive holiday markets, and other magical winter settings. The visuals are designed to immerse players in the holiday atmosphere, with warm, cozy colors, sparkling lights, and snowy landscapes enhancing the experience. Music and Sound Effects: Christmas Mysteries is complemented by a soundtrack of cheerful holiday music, featuring classic Christmas carols and jingles. The sound effects may include festive sounds like jingling bells, snow falling, or the crackling of a fireplace, which add to the overall atmosphere of the game.

name: Christmas Solitaire
description: Klondike solitaire game for Christmas: move all cards to the top 4 stacks from Ace to King. On the tableau place cards in descending order and alternate color. Click on the top left stack to get a new open card.Christmas Solitaire (HTML) is a festive variation of the classic solitaire card game. This version brings the familiar gameplay of solitaire into a holiday-themed setting, with beautifully designed Christmas graphics, sounds, and a cozy winter atmosphere. Classic Solitaire Rules: Christmas Solitaire typically follows the same rules as traditional Klondike Solitaire, which is the most popular version of the game. The objective is to move all the cards to the four foundation piles, one for each suit (hearts, diamonds, clubs, and spades), in ascending order (Ace to King). Cards are dealt into seven tableau columns. In these columns, cards must be arranged in descending order and alternating colors (e.g., red King on a black Queen). A single card from the stock is available at a time and can be played onto the tableau or foundation piles. Card Movement: You can move cards from the tableau to the foundation piles if they follow the correct suit and order. A King can be moved to an empty space in the tableau. If there are no valid moves left on the tableau, you can draw from the stock pile to continue the game. Holiday Theme and Graphics: The game features festive visuals, including Christmas trees, snowflakes, Santa Claus, stockings, and decorated presents. The cards themselves may have Christmas-themed designs (such as winter scenes, ornaments, or holiday symbols). The background is typically adorned with snow and other seasonal elements, creating a cozy and magical atmosphere as you play. Sound Effects and Music: Christmas Solitaire includes relaxing and cheerful background music, often featuring classic Christmas carols. The sound effects may include jingles, the crackling of a fireplace, or the gentle sound of snow falling, enhancing the festive mood. Scoring and Time: Most versions of Christmas Solitaire will keep track of the time and your moves to offer a score or completion time. While not required, players may enjoy trying to complete the game faster or with fewer moves. Some versions of the game may offer additional bonuses or stars for completing the game within a certain time limit. Hints and Undo: Many versions of Christmas Solitaire include a hint system that shows you the next possible move if you're stuck. An undo feature may also be available, allowing you to take back a move if you make a mistake.

name: Christmas Tree Construction Kit
description: Christmas Tree Construction Kit is not a game per se, it's more of an interactive toy that may entertain young children, or easily entertained adults. As the name implies, you build your own Christmas tree by choosing a tree shape (I highly recommend loading a pre-rendered tree from the disk rather than using the program to draw one!) and then add lights, a star, and other decorations. Once you're happy with your design, your lights will animate and a shrill PC speaker Christmas song will play.Christmas Tree Construction Kit (DOS) is a fun and creative simulation game that lets players design and decorate their own Christmas tree. This game allows you to personalize and build your ideal holiday tree, complete with decorations, lights, and ornaments. It’s a lighthearted and festive experience perfect for the holiday season.

name: Christmas Tree Solitaire
description: Christmas Tree Solitaire is a festive and visually delightful solitaire game that combines the classic pyramid solitaire mechanics with a cheerful Christmas theme. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to remove all cards from the Christmas tree by pairing two cards that add up to a total value of 13. The game is won when the entire tree is cleared. Card Values: Number Cards: Cards 2 through 10 are worth their face value. Face Cards: Jacks (J) are worth 11, Queens (Q) are worth 12, and Kings (K) are worth 13. Aces: Aces (A) are worth 1. Pairing Cards: Valid Pairs: Two cards can be paired if their combined value equals 13. For example, a 5 and an 8, a Queen (12) and an Ace (1), or two Kings (13 each) can be paired. Exposed Cards: Only cards that are not covered by other cards can be paired. These are known as "exposed" cards. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with a pyramid of cards arranged in the shape of a Christmas tree. The bottom layer has the most cards, and each subsequent layer has fewer cards, culminating in a single card at the top. Pairing and Removing: Click on two exposed cards that add up to 13 to remove them from the tree. As cards are removed, new cards become exposed. Deck: If you get stuck, you can draw a new card from the deck to use in pairing. The deck acts as a lifeline, providing new opportunities to continue the game. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the Christmas tree becomes larger, and the number of cards increases, requiring more strategic thinking and planning. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show possible pairs or highlight cards that can be paired. Undo: Some versions of the game might include an undo feature, allowing you to reverse your last move and try a different pair.

name: Christmas Tripeaks
description: Play a Tripeaks Solitaire game for Christmas. Select cards that are one higher or one lower in value than the open card (bottom right).Christmas Tripeaks (HTML) is a festive variation of the popular card game TriPeaks Solitaire. In this game, players must clear the playing field by selecting cards in a sequence from the tableau that are one higher or one lower than the current card in the deck. The holiday theme adds a cozy, Christmas atmosphere, with decorations and sound effects enhancing the experience. Card Layout: The game typically starts with a tableau of cards laid out in a series of peaks or pyramids. The objective is to remove the cards by selecting those that are one rank higher or lower than the current deck card. Players are dealt a starting card, and they can start clearing cards by selecting cards from the tableau that match the required rule. Clearing the Tableau: In Christmas Tripeaks, you can select cards from the tableau that are either one higher or one lower in rank compared to the visible deck card. Aces are considered both high and low, so they can be used as the bridge between King and 2. Once a card from the tableau is selected, it disappears, and the next card becomes the active card. Deck Cards: There is usually a deck of face-down cards, and you must play from that deck to continue removing cards from the tableau. Every time a valid card is selected, a new card is flipped from the deck. Special Cards: Some versions of Christmas Tripeaks may include special cards, such as wild cards or bonus cards, which can help you clear the tableau more easily or give you extra points. Wild Cards: Can be used to match any card on the tableau, making it easier to remove cards. Bonus Cards: May provide extra points or special abilities to aid in clearing the tableau. Christmas Theme: The game features Christmas-themed visuals such as snowflakes, Christmas trees, presents, and decorations. Cards might have holiday-specific designs, such as snowmen, stars, ornaments, and holiday icons. Backgrounds often include winter scenes with snowfall, and Christmas music or jingles create a cozy atmosphere.

name: Christmas Triple Mahjong
description: Triple Mahjong for Christmas. Combine three of the same free tiles to remove the tiles. Try to remove all tiles before time runs out.Christmas Triple Mahjong (HTML) is a holiday-themed variant of the classic Mahjong puzzle game, offering a fun and festive twist to the traditional gameplay. In this version, the goal is still to match and remove tiles from the board, but with a Christmas theme that includes holiday imagery, decorations, and music. Tile Layout: The game presents a Mahjong board, typically with tiles arranged in a pyramid or stacked layout. Players will see Christmas-themed tiles featuring various holiday icons such as Christmas trees, presents, candy canes, bells, and more. Making Matches: The main difference between Christmas Triple Mahjong and standard Mahjong is that in this game, you need to match three identical tiles rather than two. These tiles can be found anywhere on the board, but they must be free—meaning no tiles are stacked above or to the sides of the tile you wish to select. Tile Removal: After you match three identical tiles, they are removed from the board. Your goal is to keep clearing tiles until all are removed. A tile is considered "free" if it is not covered by any other tile and can be moved to the sides or the top row. Hints and Undo: Many versions of Christmas Triple Mahjong provide a hint feature, which suggests a possible match if you are stuck. There is also often an undo button that allows you to backtrack and try a different move. Timer (Optional): Some versions may include a timer to add a little more challenge, where players must clear the board within a certain time limit. Other versions are more relaxed, without time constraints, letting players enjoy the game at their own pace. Christmas Theme: As the name suggests, this version of Mahjong is filled with holiday-themed artwork. The tiles are decorated with Christmas-themed designs such as snowflakes, ornaments, Santa Claus, reindeer, and more. Backgrounds often feature snowy landscapes, Christmas lights, or festive indoor scenes. Cheerful Christmas music or sound effects may play in the background, adding to the festive atmosphere.

name: Christmas Words
description: Find all the letters of the word on the grid.Christmas Words (HTML) is a festive word puzzle game that challenges players to create words using Christmas-themed letters and icons. This game combines the classic word-search concept with a holiday twist, offering players a fun and seasonal way to engage their vocabulary skills.Letter Grid: The game typically displays a grid of random letters. These letters can be arranged in a variety of ways: horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Some versions may also allow players to form words in any direction, while others may be more structured. Forming Words: Players need to connect adjacent letters (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) to form valid words. In Christmas Words, the words are often Christmas-related, such as "snow," "tree," "gift," and "candy cane." Each word can only be used once, and the player needs to find as many different words as possible within the grid. The hint might highlight a word or suggest an area of the grid where a word can be formed. Depending on the version, there may or may not be a time limit. Some versions are relaxed, while others add a challenge with a countdown timer to find all the words before time runs out. Christmas Theme: As expected, the game features Christmas-themed visuals, such as snowy backgrounds, Christmas trees, presents, ornaments, and other festive decorations. The letters in the grid may also be decorated with Christmas symbols like snowflakes, holly, or reindeer to enhance the holiday atmosphere. Christmas music or sound effects may play in the background to add to the festive mood. Scoring: Players typically earn points for each word they form. Longer words or harder-to-find words might yield higher scores. Some versions might reward players with bonus points for completing specific challenges or finding hidden words. Levels and Challenges: Christmas Words may include multiple levels of difficulty, with easier levels featuring smaller grids and simpler words, while harder levels may have larger grids and more complex, obscure Christmas-related words. The game may feature increasingly difficult puzzles as players progress, keeping the gameplay fresh and challenging.

name: Chronicles of Galia: The First Mission
description: Chronicles of Galia: The First Mission is a turn-based RPG created in QBasic. The plot involves retrieving a stolen artifact that is critical to a kingdom's peace and prosperity. Your character is a knight who no longer wants to fight due to a past trauma, but is forced into action. The game is presented quite well, with decently drawn tile-based graphics and an actual storyline which draws you in.Chronicles of Galia: The First Mission is a role-playing video game (RPG) released in 1994 for DOS. The game is set in a fantasy world and combines tactical combat with an engaging story. Players take on the role of characters embarking on a mission in a richly detailed universe full of intrigue, strategy, and battles. Tactical Combat: The game features tactical, turn-based combat. Players control a party of characters, each with unique abilities and stats, and fight against a variety of enemies such as monsters, bandits, and magical creatures. Combat takes place on a grid-based map, where players must position their characters, use spells, and plan attacks strategically. Characters gain experience points (XP) after each battle, which helps them level up, improve stats, and unlock new abilities. Character Customization: Players can customize their party members by choosing their class, abilities, and equipment. Each character has specific strengths and weaknesses, so the player needs to plan the party composition carefully to ensure success in battle. Some characters may specialize in melee combat, while others might focus on magic or healing. Exploration and Quests: As part of the game's story-driven structure, players can explore various towns, villages, and wilderness areas. The game includes a mix of dialogue, puzzle-solving, and combat encounters. There are numerous side quests to complete, along with the main storyline missions that drive the game's progression. Story and Dialogue: The story is central to Chronicles of Galia, with players engaging in dialogue with non-playable characters (NPCs) and making decisions that influence the plot. These choices can determine the outcome of the game and how characters interact with the player. The game is known for its rich narrative, combining elements of fantasy and political drama.

name: Chub Gam 3D: Director's Cut
description: While this game has supposedly won many awards (listed on the ChubGamSoft website) I'm not a huge fan. It plays well enough and has some interesting graphic/gameplay elements (like an actual storyline, and cutscenes to tell it) it just seems quite unprofessional at times. Chub Gam 3D: Director's Cut is a quirky, unique video game released for DOS that blends humor, action, and adventure elements with a 3D perspective. It was designed as a part of the "Chub Gam" series, offering players an engaging experience filled with bizarre gameplay mechanics and over-the-top scenarios. 3D Platforming: The game is centered around 3D platforming mechanics, where players control the main character (Chub) as they navigate through complex, multi-layered environments. The character must jump, climb, and dodge obstacles to advance through levels. Each level presents its own set of challenges, from environmental hazards to enemies and puzzles. Some puzzles may be timed or require the player to gather items scattered around the level. Humor and Bizarre Environments: The game has a distinct sense of humor, with absurd characters and bizarre settings. From the character design to the plot, the game embraces a lighthearted and offbeat tone. Levels range from normal-looking environments to bizarre and surreal landscapes, adding to the game's charm. Enhanced Features (Director's Cut): As a "Director's Cut" version, the game likely includes additional content such as improved visuals, more detailed environments, extra levels, or enhanced gameplay mechanics. It may also feature new voice acting, cutscenes, or expanded story elements that weren't part of the original game. Exploration and Collectibles: The game encourages exploration with hidden items, collectibles, and secret areas that players can discover. These items can improve the character’s abilities or unlock bonus content.

name: Chuck E Cheese's Pizza Panic
description: Chuck E. Cheese's Pizza Panic is a Flash-based arcade-style game that was released as part of Chuck E. Cheese's online games collection. The game revolves around the popular Chuck E. Cheese character and his pizza restaurant, where players must help Chuck E. deliver pizzas to the correct customers while managing various challenges in the restaurant.Chuck E. Cheese's Pizza Panic is a charming, fun, and fast-paced arcade game that is perfect for younger players or anyone looking for a quick and casual game. With its engaging pizza delivery mechanics, colorful graphics, and family-friendly theme, it remains a lighthearted game that captures the essence of the Chuck E. Cheese franchise. Fans of the brand or players seeking a simple, time-management challenge will find enjoyment in this Flash game.

name: Chuck E Cheese's Skate Challenge
description: Chuck E. Cheese's Skate Challenge is a Flash-based game that was part of the Chuck E. Cheese online games collection, offering a fun and interactive skateboarding experience. Players take on the role of Chuck E. Cheese as he skates through various levels, completing challenges and performing tricks to earn points. Skateboarding Controls: Players control Chuck E. as he skates through each level. The objective is to navigate various obstacles and collect items while performing tricks to score points. The game uses simple controls that allow players to steer, jump, and perform tricks during their skateboarding run. Tricks and Stunts: As Chuck E. skates, players can perform various tricks and stunts, such as flips, spins, and grinds, by pressing specific keys or buttons. The more advanced the trick, the more points Chuck E. earns. Obstacles and Hazards: The levels are filled with obstacles like ramps, gaps, and moving hazards. Players must avoid these or jump over them to keep their momentum going. Colliding with obstacles or missing jumps can slow Chuck E. down or cause him to fall, losing valuable time or points. Collectibles: Throughout each level, there are collectibles such as stars or coins that players can grab for extra points. Some levels may feature specific goals or challenges, like collecting a certain number of items to move to the next stage. Levels and Progression: The game progresses through different levels, each with increasing difficulty. As players advance, the levels become faster, and the obstacles become more complex. New challenges, ramps, and tricks are introduced as players progress through the game. Speed and Time Challenges: Players are often racing against the clock, so managing time is crucial. Speeding through the levels and completing challenges quickly boosts the player's score.

name: Cindy's Lemonade Stand
description: Cindy's Lemonade Stand is an extremely simplistic business simulation game where you run your own lemonade stand. Or rather I guess you run Cindy's lemonade stand. Except that you don't really run it; you just decide how much supplies to purchase each week based on the predicted weather, and then set the price for each cup of lemonade. Then you see how much money you make. You have ten weeks to earn as much money as you can. Then the game ends.Cindy's Lemonade Stand is a classic DOS-based simulation game where the player runs a lemonade stand, managing resources, setting prices, and trying to maximize profits while keeping customers happy.

name: Cipher
description: Cipher is a "Cryptoquotes word puzzle game" where the object is to decipher the phrase through a process of deduction, intuition, prior knowledge of how the English language typically works, and sometimes trial and error. The ciphers are known as substitution ciphers, where the alphabet is mixed up (A becomes X, P becomes T, etc) and you need to discover the correct replacements. This game works well once you get the hang of it (use the in-game help) and mouse controls are definitely welcome. It includes 32 phrases so it should keep you occupied for awhile!

name: Circle Link
description: Circle Link is a puzzle type game where the object is to connect rings to allow your ball to pass down through them. This is done by rotating individual rows and columns. At least that's how it's played in theory, in practice the different colors and difficult-to-distinguish rings make it rather difficult. You can play with up to four players taking turns, as well as optionally allow the CPU to play as well. It also features annoying PC sound effects that at least can be turned off, after the initial burst of beeps when you start up the program.

name: Circus Adventures
description: Find all the hidden objects, numbers and differences in the Circus.Circus Adventures is a fun and interactive HTML-based game that brings the excitement of a circus environment into a digital experience. Players embark on a journey filled with various circus-themed challenges, including platforming, puzzle-solving, and skill-based mini-games. Platforming Challenges: The game often involves platforming elements, where the player must navigate through levels, jumping between platforms and avoiding obstacles. The character may need to jump over rings of fire, balance on tightropes, or swing from trapeze bars, mimicking classic circus acts. Mini-Games: Various mini-games may be included, such as juggling, animal training, or performing tricks with circus animals (like elephants, lions, or horses). These mini-games require the player to complete specific actions to succeed, like timing, accuracy, or coordination, to simulate circus acts and earn rewards. Skill Progression: As players progress through the game, their character may unlock new skills, better equipment, or new circus acts. These upgrades allow the player to take on more complex tasks and improve their circus performance. Circus-Themed Obstacles: Throughout the game, players must navigate through various circus-themed environments, such as tents, stages, and arenas, while avoiding obstacles like clowns, animals, or falling props. The challenge comes from both performing the tasks at hand and managing the environment, which can be full of surprises.

name: Circus Bubbles
description: Bubble Shooter in the Circus. Remove all bubbles by shooting bubbles up and matching three or more of the same color.Circus Bubbles is an engaging HTML-based puzzle game that combines the fun of bubble shooting with a circus theme. The objective is to match and pop colorful bubbles, which is the game's core mechanic. As with most bubble shooter games, the player aims to clear the board by matching at least three bubbles of the same color. Bubble Shooting: The player controls a cannon that shoots colorful bubbles at a grid of hanging bubbles. To clear bubbles, the player must match three or more bubbles of the same color. The cannon rotates to aim in different directions, and the player shoots a bubble by clicking or tapping in the desired direction. Match and Pop: When the player matches three or more bubbles of the same color, those bubbles will pop and disappear from the grid. The goal is to clear the grid of bubbles by continuously making matches. Timed or Moves-Based Gameplay: Some versions of the game may have a time limit, requiring the player to clear the bubbles within a certain amount of time. Other versions may limit the number of shots or moves, adding an extra layer of challenge. Power-ups and Special Bubbles: Circus Bubbles may feature special bubbles that offer power-ups. These could include bombs that clear large areas of bubbles, rainbow bubbles that match with any color, or other bonuses that help in clearing the board more efficiently. Players must use these power-ups strategically to maximize their chances of clearing the level. Levels and Progression: The game is typically divided into multiple levels, each with a different bubble arrangement. As the player progresses, the difficulty increases, with more complex patterns and faster gameplay. Some levels might include obstacles or barriers that prevent the bubbles from popping, requiring the player to think creatively.

name: Circus Hidden Letters
description: Find all the hidden letters as fast as possible. Click on the location of a letter.Circus Hidden Letters is an HTML-based puzzle game where players are tasked with finding hidden letters within a circus-themed scene. The game is a hidden object-style game where each level contains a circus-themed image, and your goal is to locate and identify all the hidden letters that are scattered throughout the image. Hidden Letter Search: The player is given a circus-themed image with several letters hidden within it. Players must carefully search through the image and click on the letters they can find. Each letter found is counted towards the player's progress. Time Limit or Moves: Some versions of the game might include a time limit for finding all the letters. In this case, the player must locate all the hidden letters before time runs out. Other versions might give the player a set number of moves or clicks to find all the letters. Hints and Help: To assist the player, hints may be available that reveal the location of a letter or provide a clue about its placement in the scene. Some games also offer a "reveal all" feature once all the letters have been found, showing the full completed scene. Levels and Progression: The game is typically divided into multiple levels. Each new level offers a new circus scene with more letters to find, and the difficulty increases as the player progresses. More complex scenes or additional obstacles (such as added distractions) may appear as the game advances.

name: Circus Hidden Numbers
description: Find all the hidden numbers as fast as possible. Click on the location of a number.Circus Hidden Numbers is an HTML-based hidden object puzzle game where the player must find numbers hidden within a circus-themed image. The game challenges players' observation skills and attention to detail as they search through a colorful and busy scene for the specified numbers. Hidden Number Search: Players are given a list of numbers to find within the circus-themed image. The task is to search through the image and click on the numbers as they find them. Difficulty: The difficulty ramps up as you progress through levels. Ghosts get faster and more aggressive, making it more challenging to avoid them.

name: Classic Snake
description: Collect all the dots and avoid bumping into the wall or your tail.Classic Pac (HTML) is a web-based version of the classic arcade game Pac-Man, which allows players to experience the timeless gameplay directly in their browser. Developed using HTML5, this game brings the iconic maze-chasing action to a new generation while staying true to its roots. Objective: The goal of Classic Pac is to guide Pac-Man through a maze, eating all the pellets while avoiding being caught by four colorful ghosts (Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde). To clear a level, you must consume all the pellets in the maze. There are also special "power pellets" that allow Pac-Man to turn the tables, making the ghosts vulnerable and allowing Pac-Man to eat them for extra points. Controls: Arrow Keys / WASD: Use the arrow keys or the WASD keys to navigate Pac-Man through the maze (up, down, left, right). Pause: The game may allow you to pause with the P key or a similar button. Speed/Power-ups: While Pac-Man moves at a set pace, consuming power pellets briefly gives him increased speed and the ability to eat ghosts, which boosts your score. Ghosts: Blinky (Red): The fastest ghost, always chasing Pac-Man directly. Pinky (Pink): Tries to position itself ahead of Pac-Man’s movements. Inky (Cyan): Moves unpredictably, depending on both Pac-Man’s and Blinky’s positions. Clyde (Orange): A mix of Blinky and Inky’s behavior, alternating between random movement and pursuit. Power Pellets: Located in the four corners of the maze, these larger pellets temporarily turn the ghosts blue. During this time, Pac-Man can eat the ghosts for points, and the ghosts will respawn back in their starting positions. Fruit Items: Fruit items occasionally appear in the maze. These items provide extra points when eaten and add variety to the gameplay. Fruits such as cherries, strawberries, and oranges will appear randomly. Levels: As in the original Pac-Man, each level becomes progressively more difficult, with the ghosts moving faster as you advance. Once all pellets are eaten on a level, the game moves to the next, and you continue to progress through the maze until you lose all your lives. Lives: Pac-Man starts with a set number of lives. If he gets caught by a ghost, a life is lost. When all lives are lost, the game ends. Scoring: Points are awarded for eating regular pellets, power pellets, and ghosts. Eating fruit and completing levels also contributes to your score. The game keeps track of your high score, challenging you to beat your previous best.

name: Classic Solitaire
description: The classic Solitaire game. Move all cards to the four top foundations from Ace to King. On the tableau build down and alternate color.Classic Solitaire (HTML) is the browser-based version of the popular single-player card game, often referred to as "Klondike Solitaire." It’s a relaxing yet challenging game where you aim to organize a shuffled deck of cards into four piles, one for each suit, in ascending order, from Ace to King. Objective: The goal of Classic Solitaire is to arrange all the cards into four foundation piles, each representing one of the suits (hearts, diamonds, clubs, and spades). Each pile should be organized from Ace to King in ascending order. Rules: Deal Cards: The game starts with seven tableau piles, where cards are placed face-up in a sequence. The remaining cards form the stockpile. Foundation Piles: Build each suit from Ace to King. Cards in the tableau need to be moved to the foundation piles by following suit and ascending order. Tableau: Each tableau pile can have cards in descending order and alternating colors. For example, a red 7 can be placed on a black 8, and so on. Stockpile: Cards that are not in play can be drawn from the stockpile. Typically, cards from the stock are drawn in groups of three or one at a time, depending on the game settings. Empty Spaces: If a tableau pile is empty, only a King can be placed in that space. Game Mechanics: Drag and Drop: You can click and drag cards to the foundation piles or tableau piles. When placing a card in the tableau, it must follow the rules of alternating colors and descending order. Drawing Cards: If you can’t make a move in the tableau, you draw cards from the stockpile. Undo/Redo: Some versions of the game may allow you to undo and redo moves, helping you experiment and learn the best strategy. Victory Conditions: The game is won when all cards are arranged in the four foundation piles, from Ace to King, by suit. If no more moves are possible, the game ends in a loss.

name: Classic Sudoku Challenge
description: Dive into the world of logic and numbers with Sudoku Challenge, an engaging and interactive flash game designed for Sudoku enthusiasts of all skill levels! Game Features: Multiple Difficulty Levels: Choose from easy, medium, or hard puzzles to match your skill level and gradually increase the challenge as you improve. Timed Mode: Race against the clock in timed challenges to test your speed and accuracy, with a leaderboard to track your best times. Hints and Solutions: Stuck on a puzzle? Use hints to get a nudge in the right direction, or view the solution if you need a complete answer. Customizable Grids: Adjust grid sizes (4x4, 6x6, or classic 9x9) for a fresh twist on traditional gameplay. Interactive Tutorial: New to Sudoku? Follow an interactive tutorial that guides you through the rules and strategies of the game. Save Progress: Pick up where you left off with an autosave feature that remembers your current puzzle. Challenging Achievements: Complete various achievements for added motivation and bragging rights among friends. Gameplay: Fill the grid with numbers from 1 to 9 (or 1 to 4/6 in smaller grids) while ensuring that each number appears only once per row, column, and designated box. Use logic and deduction to solve each puzzle, improving your skills with every completed game. Get ready to exercise your brain and enjoy hours of fun with Sudoku Challenge! Perfect for quick play sessions or extended puzzle-solving marathons. How quickly can you solve them all?

name: Classic Word Search
description: Classic Word Search game. Find all the words in all levels.Classic Word Search (HTML) is a timeless and popular puzzle game where the player searches for hidden words in a grid of letters. The objective is to find and highlight a list of words, which may be arranged horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, either forwards or backwards. This word search game can be played directly in your browser, offering a great mental challenge while being easy to play. Objective: The goal of the Classic Word Search game is to locate all the hidden words in the letter grid based on the provided word list. Once you find a word, you mark it in the grid. Rules: A grid of letters is presented, with some words hidden within it. You are given a list of words to find in the grid. Words can appear in any direction: horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, either forward or backward. After finding a word, you highlight it by clicking and dragging over the letters in the correct sequence. Once all the words from the list are found, the game is completed. Game Difficulty: Word search puzzles may vary in difficulty based on grid size and the length of the words to find. Some versions may include different themes, like animals, cities, or holidays, adding to the variety. How to Play Classic Word Search (HTML): Start the Game: The game will begin with a grid of letters and a list of words you need to find. The size of the grid and the difficulty of the word list will vary depending on the game version. Locate Words: Look at the list of words and search for them in the grid. Words can be hidden in multiple directions: Horizontally (left-to-right or right-to-left) Vertically (top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top) Diagonally (in all four diagonal directions) Highlight Words: Once you find a word, click and drag your mouse across the letters in the grid that form the word. The game will typically highlight the letters of the word in color once they are selected. Complete the Puzzle: Keep searching for words until all of them have been highlighted in the grid. Once all words are found, the puzzle is complete, and you win!

name: Claw
description: Claw is an elaborate puzzle game where each level consists of 17 interconnected screens. Your goal is to pick up and place blocks which redirect the "movers" onto switches. When you switch enough of the switches on, you can progress to the net part of the level. The game looks decent enough, although the sound doesn't seem to work in DOSBox. There are in-game instructions which will help you figure out the goal and what everything does, but figuring out exactly what you're supposed to do seems rather difficult.

name: Clax
description: No relation to the similarly named Klax, this game is formerly-lost part of gaming history. Alexey Pajitnov is well known as the creator of Tetris, but two other developers were involved with the game: Vadim Gerasimov and Dmitry Pavlovsky, both also employed with Pajitnov at the Computer Centre of the Russian Academy of Sciences. Recently a businessman named Giorgos Saradakis found a long-lost game from Tetris-collaborator Dmitry Pavlovsky on an old hard drive in Bulgaria. Clax is a classic DOS-based arcade puzzle game released in 1989 by Atari Games. It is a mix of puzzle and action elements and is often compared to the famous "Tetris" because of its falling object mechanics, but with its unique twist.

name: CleanUp
description: CleanUp is a Snake / Nibbles variant that plays a bit more like a strategic puzzle game than an action game. The goal is to score points by collecting as many of the stars on the randomly generated playing field as possible, without crashing into a wall or running into your own constantly increasing tail.CleanUp is a DOS-based action and puzzle game that was released in the early 1990s. The game follows the theme of cleaning and organizing a messy environment, but with a fun, arcade-like twist. It is a simple yet engaging game where you must navigate around rooms or areas, picking up trash and cleaning them up while avoiding obstacles and managing time. Objective: The main goal in the game is to clean up the room or area by collecting trash and organizing it within a certain amount of time. Trash Collection: Trash appears randomly around the environment, and you must guide your character to collect it. Once the trash is collected, you need to move it to the designated trash bin or trash can in the room. Time Management: You are often given a limited time to clean the room. If you fail to pick up all the trash in time, you lose a life or fail the level. Obstacles: As the game progresses, new challenges are introduced. These can include obstacles such as moving objects, annoying characters that may try to get in your way, or even environmental hazards that you must avoid while trying to clean. Levels: The game may include multiple levels, each with a different environment to clean, such as rooms, outdoor areas, or more complex settings. The complexity increases with more trash to clean and additional obstacles.

name: Clear the Numbers
description: Clear all the Numbers. Click to get a number on the bottom area and get 3 same numbers there and they are removed.Clear the Numbers is a type of puzzle game that typically challenges players to eliminate numbers from a grid based on specific rules or conditions. While it can vary in exact gameplay mechanics, the general concept of these games revolves around clearing numbered tiles in an orderly fashion to achieve a target score or complete the puzzle. Grid or Tile Setup: The game usually presents a grid of numbers, and players need to interact with them in specific ways to clear the board. Clearing Numbers: The player may be asked to remove numbers that are equal to each other, form a certain sequence, or match a target number using arithmetic operations (like addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division). Matching or Strategy: In some versions of Clear the Numbers, players must match pairs or groups of numbers that follow a rule (e.g., two tiles that add up to 10). In other versions, players might need to perform specific calculations or complete a puzzle with numbers. Special Tiles/Features: Some versions of the game may include special tiles or features, such as bombs or power-ups that can clear multiple tiles at once or grant additional time or points. Time or Moves Limitation: Many games in this genre include a time limit or a limited number of moves to complete the puzzle. The goal is to clear the numbers within the set constraints.

name: Cleopatra
description: Help the Queen of Egypt to retrieve her lost Jewels. Click on tiles that prevent neighbouring tiles to match 3 or more.Cleopatra is a popular puzzle game often found in the genre of match-3 or tile-matching games. These games are known for their easy-to-learn mechanics and addictive gameplay. While the specifics can vary, a typical Cleopatra HTML game will usually feature ancient Egyptian-themed graphics, where the player solves puzzles, matches symbols, and progresses through levels. Objective: The primary objective is usually to match three or more identical symbols (often jewels or tiles with Egyptian motifs) either horizontally or vertically on the game board. Players aim to clear the board, earn points, and advance to the next level. As they progress, the game may introduce new challenges, obstacles, or puzzles. Tile Matching: The player typically swaps adjacent tiles or jewels to create matches of three or more. Once a match is made, the tiles disappear, and new tiles fall into place. Level Progression: The game often features multiple levels with increasing difficulty. Some levels may have specific goals, such as achieving a target score, removing certain tiles, or meeting other challenges. Power-ups: Special tiles or power-ups may appear throughout the game to help clear larger sections of the grid, boost scores, or provide other benefits. Time or Moves Limitation: Some versions of Cleopatra may impose a time limit for each level or restrict the number of moves you can make to achieve the goal.

name: Click '98
description: Click '98 is a version of the popular "Clickomania" (aka "Same Game" and many other names) which runs in DOS. The game itself is in German but the documentation file (README.TXT) is in English (after the German text) and the in-game menus are not too difficult to figure out. The goal of the game is to eliminate as many blocks as possible by selecting groups of two or more of the same color. When selected, that group of blocks will disappear, and blocks above them will fall down. It works well enough, and the "Konfiguration" menu provides options to set the number of colors (4-8) and the size of the playing field.

name: Clif Danger
description: Clif Danger is a platforming game with great presentation but borderline unplayable gameplay. It makes a lot of the right moves, with nice-looking graphics, sounds, and even a lot of "edgy" 90's attitude. There's a story but no one really cares, you complete levels by rescuing "Amazons" (aka scantily clad ladies) and blasting everything else with a variety of weapons. The camera, pacing, and overall control mechanics of the game are not great and perhaps why it doesn't feel very good to play. It's also rather difficult, but it's certainly interesting to experience. (The unskippable ads at the end of the game prompting you to buy the full version are insanely long, I imagine people would've rather rebooted than endure through the whole thing.)

name: Clippy's Windows Defense
description: Clippy's Windows Defense is a fun, retro-themed flash game that takes inspiration from the iconic Microsoft Office assistant, Clippy, and integrates it with the concept of tower defense gameplay. In this game, Clippy, known for his role as a helpful (but often intrusive) guide in older versions of Microsoft Office, becomes a hero defending the digital realm. Objective: The player’s main objective is to stop waves of enemies that try to invade or destroy the digital environment, using Clippy's abilities, usually in the form of defense mechanisms like traps or weapons. Tower Defense Style Gameplay: Much like traditional tower defense games, Clippy's Windows Defense requires players to place and manage defense mechanisms in key areas on the screen to block or destroy enemies before they reach a target area. Clippy as the Hero: Clippy might not be directly involved in attacking enemies but will serve as a central figure who provides assistance or can be upgraded to unlock additional defenses or tools. There may be times when Clippy helps in controlling specific towers or effects during the gameplay. Enemies: Enemies in this game might include representations of various digital threats or viruses, possibly designed with a humorous or retro aesthetic. They could resemble files, pop-up ads, or even malfunctioning programs from an old computer. Levels: Like most tower defense games, the levels progress in difficulty, with enemies becoming stronger and more difficult to deal with as you advance. New types of defenses or upgrades might be unlocked as players progress through the levels. Power-ups/Abilities: The game may feature various power-ups or special abilities that Clippy can activate to aid in defense, such as creating barriers, slowing down enemies, or dealing direct damage to incoming foes.

name: Clone
description: The name of this game doesn't reflect that it is simply a copy of another game. In fact, it is a reference to the unique feature (gimmick?) of this game. It is a normal puzzle game in the sense that the object is to reach the exit to each level by pushing blocks, collecting keys, etc. The difference here is that there are two "player" characters, whom you move at the same time, who both must reach the exit. This game features quality production values and with it's neat gimmick, ensures lots of fun for puzzle fans.

name: Clone Invader
description: A fairly good (but no-frills) rendition of the classic Space Invaders game. There isn't much new here, but you're pretty much guaranteed it will work with any PC you've got laying around your house, so this would be a good game to try on the good old 8086/8088 that you've got laying around. ;) It's not bad overall but it is very basic.Clone Invader is a retro-style arcade game that is heavily inspired by the classic Space Invaders. It features a similar premise and gameplay, where players control a spaceship to defend against waves of invading aliens. The game is simple, addictive, and follows the same principles of space-themed defense that made its inspiration so popular.Objective: The main objective is to defend your base (or spaceship) from waves of alien invaders by shooting them before they reach the bottom of the screen. The player has to eliminate all enemies in each wave to progress to the next stage, with each wave becoming increasingly difficult. Controls: The spaceship is typically controlled using left and right arrow keys or a mouse to move along the bottom of the screen. The player can shoot upwards to destroy the enemies. The player can also utilize power-ups or shields, depending on the version, to aid in their defense. Enemies: The enemies in Clone Invader are often designed to resemble alien ships, and they move in a structured pattern—typically left to right, down a bit, and then back to the opposite side. Some versions of the game might feature bosses or special invaders with unique abilities. Levels and Difficulty: The game consists of multiple levels, and with each new level, the speed and number of enemies increase. The enemies might also change in appearance or behavior as the game progresses, forcing the player to adapt their strategy. Power-ups: Certain versions of the game may introduce power-ups that the player can collect by shooting certain enemies or objects. These can include things like rapid fire, shields, or extra lives.

name: Clorox Memory Game
description: Clorox Memory Game is a flash-based online memory matching game branded by Clorox, a well-known cleaning product company. The game is designed to test players' memory and quick thinking by matching pairs of cards that feature various items or themes associated with Clorox products. Objective: The main goal of Clorox Memory Game is to match pairs of cards that are turned over one at a time. Each card features an image, and when two cards with the same image are revealed, they disappear. The game is typically timed, and players are tasked with clearing the board by finding all the matching pairs before time runs out or within a set number of moves. Gameplay Mechanics: Card Flipping: Players begin with a grid of face-down cards. On each turn, they flip two cards over, trying to match them. If the cards match, they stay face up; if not, they are flipped back face down. Matching Pairs: The cards usually feature images related to Clorox products, like cleaning supplies, disinfectants, or logos. Players must remember the locations of the cards to match them efficiently. Levels: The game might have multiple difficulty levels with larger grids or more challenging images, increasing the number of cards to remember and match. Winning the Game: The game is won by successfully matching all pairs on the board. The time taken or the number of moves may be tracked to provide a score. Some versions of the game may offer a point system or give rewards based on how quickly or efficiently the player finishes the game. Losing the Game: If the player runs out of time or doesn't match all the cards, the game ends, and they are given the option to restart or try again.

name: Clown
description: Clown is a game released anonymously, without a title screen, so the name given to it is based on its executable name. This is a simple platforming game with large sprites where the object is to make it to the end of the map? I think? Never made it even close to the end, and there's no instructions, but that's what it seems like. Although the sprites are big, you move one block at a time, so movement is a bit tricky. Also sometimes it seems like you can go through the blocks, and other times not? It shows you a mini-map of the entire game which is kinda neat. Another weird clown-themed DOS game ... It includes source code in C++.

name: Clueless Chess
description: Clueless Chess is a chess program for beginners. Unlike most chess software which aims to make its CPU opponent as punishingly difficult as possible, Clueless Chess provides you with several levels of not-so-great CPU player so not-so-great chess players like myself have a chance to win. At the bottom level (CLUELESS) the CPU just makes random valid moves. As you move up, the CPU gets slightly better, but nowhere near as good as most chess programs. One nice feature is that automatically saves your game when you exit and asks if you want to continue when you run the program again. An interesting, if niche, chess game.

name: Clyde's Adventure
description: Clyde's Adventure is the first in the (short) series of Clyde games (followed by Clyde's Revenge). The game is quite simple: Run and jump around the level (and use your magic wand) to collect gems and life orbs to keep yourself alive (your Energy constantly counts down so you have to keep finding life orbs).Clyde's Adventure is a DOS-based platformer game that was released in the early 1990s. It is a side-scrolling action game where players control a character named Clyde as he navigates various levels to achieve objectives and overcome obstacles. Character Control: Players control Clyde, who can jump, move left or right, and interact with various objects in the environment. The gameplay typically involves running, jumping, and avoiding enemies or hazards. There may also be sections requiring precise timing for platforming sequences. Levels: The game includes multiple levels that vary in theme and difficulty. The levels are often filled with enemies that Clyde must defeat or avoid, as well as puzzles that require the player to think creatively. Each level can have different environments, such as forests, caves, or castles, with new challenges and enemies appearing as the player progresses. Objective: The primary objective in Clyde's Adventure is to reach the end of each level while overcoming obstacles. The game may feature specific goals, like collecting certain items, defeating specific enemies, or finding hidden paths. Some versions of the game may have a storyline or progression that unfolds as the player advances through the levels. Enemies and Hazards: Throughout the game, Clyde must contend with various enemies such as monsters, robots, or other creatures that attempt to impede his progress. Hazards like spikes, traps, and falling objects further challenge the player and require careful timing to avoid. Power-ups: Clyde's Adventure might feature power-ups scattered across the levels. These power-ups can grant Clyde temporary abilities, like increased speed, higher jumps, or the ability to destroy enemies. Collecting items and power-ups is essential to progressing through the game, as they help to make difficult sections more manageable.

name: Clyde's Revenge
description: A relaxing platformer where the emphasis is on collecting items and making tricky jumps, as well as solving simple puzzles. I say "relaxing" because there are no enemies to worry about, and the MIDI music has a soothing quality about it, although in the game energy works as the time limit and you must keep collecting more as you try to find the exit.Clyde's Revenge is a DOS-based arcade-style action game released in the early 1990s. It is a sequel to the platformer Clyde's Adventure and continues the story of the protagonist, Clyde, who embarks on another journey, this time with a focus on action, combat, and fast-paced gameplay. Character Control: Players control Clyde, who can move left and right, jump, and attack enemies using a variety of weapons or abilities. Clyde can usually collect different types of weapons throughout the game, such as swords, guns, or magical powers. Unlike Clyde's Adventure, which focused more on exploration and puzzles, Clyde's Revenge leans more into combat and action. Levels and Progression: The game features multiple levels, each with different settings, enemies, and challenges. These environments could range from cities and castles to forests and dungeons. Each level introduces new enemies and obstacles, which become progressively harder as the player advances. The goal is typically to defeat enemies and complete objectives to move to the next level, ultimately culminating in a final confrontation or battle. Combat and Weapons: Clyde's Revenge puts a strong emphasis on combat. Players face a variety of enemies, such as monsters, rival characters, or hostile creatures, and must use their weapons effectively to defeat them. Weapons vary throughout the game, and players can collect power-ups and special items that enhance Clyde's abilities, such as stronger attacks, health boosts, or additional lives. Some levels may have boss fights, where players must defeat larger, more powerful enemies with unique attack patterns. Platforming and Challenges: While the game is more combat-focused, platforming elements still play a role. Clyde will need to navigate platforms, avoid traps, and time his movements carefully. There may also be timed challenges or environmental hazards, such as pits, spikes, or moving platforms, that require quick reflexes. Enemies and Hazards: A variety of enemies appear throughout Clyde's Revenge, ranging from simple creatures to more complex bosses with special abilities. Hazards such as spikes, falling objects, or traps add additional layers of difficulty to each level, requiring players to be cautious while fighting or jumping through the environment.

name: Coaster
description: Coaster is one of the first roller coaster simulation games. Published by Disney Software, and including (in the full, non-demo version) some of their well-known coasters, this game allows players to design and ride their own coaster designs. It provides an easy-to-use visual editor, and a decently rendered 3D view when you ride your creation. It seems like that's pretty much it though, there's no simulation aspect, you just build and ride coasters, with a panel of judges or something which rates your creations. So not much "game" here, more like a neat coaster building toy.

name: Cobra
description: Cobra is a snake / Nibbles like game with CGA graphics and a gradual progression in difficulty which introduces new challenges as you progress. As usual for these kinds of games, your primary goal is to avoid crashing into the walls, your own tail (which grows as you collect bonuses) and other obstacles. If you survive long enough, you'll progress to the next level. The first level starts out simply, but later levels introduce new obstacles like death skulls and enemy snakes.Cobra is a DOS action game that was released in the early 1990s. It is a top-down arcade shooter where players control a tank-like vehicle (often referred to as "Cobra") and must navigate through various levels, defeating enemies and avoiding obstacles.

name: Cobra Gunship
description: Cobra Gunship is a side-scrolling mission-based shooting game in the style of Choplifter where you fly your helicopter (COBRA GUNSHIP) through various missions. Six missions are included in the shareware version. The game features nice looking graphics and sound effects. You can also use mouse or keyboard controls which is a great feature.Cobra Gunship is a DOS-based action game released in the late 1980s. It is a helicopter simulation game where players control a military helicopter, the Cobra Gunship, as they engage in combat missions. The game focuses on tactical air combat, where the player must navigate through enemy-infested territories and destroy targets while avoiding enemy fire and obstacles.

name: Cochese
description: A pushing puzzle game, where you must collect various "bad" things (drugs, needles, etc.) and get to the exit within a certain number of moves. The graphics are fairly average MCGA fare, and there's no sound effects, but it could be enjoyable nonetheless. (Note: The game has a strong anti-drug message.)Cochese is a relatively obscure DOS game released in the early 1990s. It is a puzzle game with a unique combination of elements involving strategy, quick thinking, and pattern recognition. The gameplay is somewhat simplistic, but it provides an engaging challenge for players interested in arcade-style puzzles. Tile Matching: Players interact with a grid of tiles, each displaying a different color or pattern. The objective is to match specific tiles by color or pattern, depending on the game’s rules. Matching tiles results in their removal from the grid, and the player gains points. Level Progression: The game features multiple levels, each presenting a new puzzle to solve or more challenging tile layouts to manage. As players progress, the complexity of the puzzles increases, with faster gameplay, more tile colors, and new rules introduced in each stage. Time Pressure and Scoring: Many levels are time-sensitive, requiring players to act quickly and plan their moves to clear tiles before the time runs out. There is usually a score system that rewards players for completing levels quickly and efficiently, as well as for making large tile combinations or clearing obstacles. Obstacles and Power-Ups: In addition to matching tiles, players may face obstacles that make it harder to clear the grid, such as locked tiles, barriers, or limited moves. Some versions of the game might offer power-ups that can help clear difficult sections, such as a tile-shuffling feature or a temporary hint to guide the player.

name: Coffee Mahjong
description: Drink a cup of Coffee in this relaxing Mahjongg solitaire game. Combine 2 of the same free tiles to remove them. Free tiles are highlighted.Coffee Mahjong is an online puzzle game that combines the classic game of Mahjong with a coffee-themed aesthetic. In this variation, players match tiles with different coffee-related images instead of the traditional Mahjong symbols. It retains the core gameplay mechanics of Mahjong but adds a fun twist with the coffee theme. Tile Matching: The goal of Coffee Mahjong is to clear the game board by matching pairs of identical tiles. These tiles typically feature coffee cups, beans, mugs, and other coffee-related imagery. The tiles are arranged in a layered structure, often with some tiles stacked above others, and the player must match pairs of open tiles. A tile is considered open if it is not covered by other tiles and can be moved horizontally or vertically. Game Structure: The game consists of multiple levels, each with different tile arrangements. The tiles may be arranged in various patterns, such as stacked formations or more complex grids, increasing in difficulty as the game progresses. To win, players must match all the tiles and clear the board within a time limit or a set number of moves (depending on the version of the game). Hints and Undo: Many Coffee Mahjong games offer helpful features such as hints or an undo button, which helps players in case they are stuck or want to rethink their last move. Hints may suggest potential tile matches, while undo allows players to reverse their last action. Timer: Some versions of the game may include a timer, adding a sense of urgency as players race against time to clear the tiles. Players can try to complete each level as quickly as possible to achieve high scores.

name: CoffeeBreak Card Games
description: CoffeeBreak Card Games is a shareware game that is probably a bit too limited to entice people to spend the $30US (approximately $55US in today's money!) to buy the full game, despite the decent production values displayed here. The shareware version includes two card games: 52 Pickup and Crazy 8s. Both play decently enough, and thankfully there is a bit more strategy to 52 Pickup than the version my dad had me play back in the day!CoffeeBreak Card Games is a DOS-based collection of classic card games, typically offering a variety of traditional games with a simple interface. It was designed to be easy to play during short breaks, hence the "CoffeeBreak" title. This collection usually includes games like Solitaire, Klondike, Spider Solitaire, FreeCell, and other card games, allowing players to enjoy a quick gaming session on their computer.

name: Coke Zero Retro Electro Football
description: CoffeeBreak Card Games is a DOS-based collection of classic card games, typically offering a variety of traditional games with a simple interface. It was designed to be easy to play during short breaks, hence the "CoffeeBreak" title. This collection usually includes games like Solitaire, Klondike, Spider Solitaire, FreeCell, and other card games, allowing players to enjoy a quick gaming session on their computer. Variety of Card Games: The collection often includes several classic card games, such as: Solitaire (Klondike): The standard single-player card game where the goal is to organize the cards in a specific order. Spider Solitaire: A more challenging version of Solitaire that uses two decks of cards. FreeCell: A Solitaire variant where all the cards are dealt face-up, and players must use strategy to move them into the right order. Piquet, Rummy, and other variations: Some versions of CoffeeBreak Card Games include classic multiplayer card games like Rummy or variations of Piquet, offering more diverse gameplay. Easy-to-Use Interface: As the name suggests, the interface is designed to be simple and easy to understand. The focus is on accessibility and quick play rather than complex rules or deep gameplay. Players can often click and drag cards to make moves or use keyboard shortcuts to play. Short Sessions: Since the collection is meant to be played during short breaks, the game sessions are typically designed to be fast and engaging. This makes it perfect for players who have a few minutes to spare and want to enjoy a quick round of a classic card game. Basic Graphics and Sound: The graphics are often minimalistic, with a simple card deck design and easy-to-read numbers and suits. The sound effects are usually limited, providing basic sounds like card shuffling or placing cards on the board, which adds to the relaxing nature of the game. No-Frills Gameplay: CoffeeBreak Card Games focuses on providing a straightforward, enjoyable experience without any distracting elements. It is ideal for players looking for a relaxing, casual card game session.

name: Cold Dreams
description: Cold Dreams is a rather obscure platforming game with its own unique style, both gameplay-wise and graphically. If I had to compare it to something, in terms of how it controls at least, I suppose it's a little like that Spiderman game that was often pirated back in the 90's. (The Amazing Spider-Man.)Cold Dreams is a DOS-based puzzle-platformer game with a focus on surreal environments and challenging gameplay. It was developed during the era when such games often mixed atmospheric storytelling with intricate level design. Puzzle Solving: Players encounter a variety of environmental puzzles that require logic and timing to overcome. These puzzles may involve activating switches, avoiding traps, and interacting with the environment in creative ways. Platforming: Precise movement is required to navigate platforms, avoid hazards, and reach new areas. The game challenges players with icy surfaces, moving platforms, and tricky jumps. Enemies and Obstacles: Dreamlike enemies and obstacles populate the levels, adding tension and danger. The player has limited means of defending themselves, focusing more on evasion and clever navigation.

name: Coliseum
description: Overview: "Coliseum Decoration" is a creative flash game that allows players to design and customize their own version of the iconic Roman Colosseum. As an architect of ancient Rome, players can unleash their imagination by decorating the arena for various events, such as gladiatorial games, festivals, or public gatherings. Key Features: Arena Layout: Customize the layout of the Colosseum, including seating arrangements, entrance gates, and the arena floor. Decorative Elements: Choose from a variety of decorative items, such as banners, statues, torches, and seating cushions, to create an inviting atmosphere. Thematic Events: Select themes for different events, like a grand gladiatorial battle, a theatrical performance, or a festive celebration, influencing the decorations you can use. Interactive Elements: Place interactive elements, such as vendors, animals, or audience characters, to bring the Colosseum to life. Background Settings: Choose stunning backgrounds that showcase the Colosseum against various scenic backdrops, such as a sunset over Rome or a bustling cityscape. Save and Share: Save your decorated Colosseum and share your design with friends or on social media platforms. Creative Challenges: Participate in timed challenges or specific design tasks to earn bonuses or unlock additional decoration items. Visual and Audio Elements: Graphics: Bright and colorful visuals, with detailed designs of the Colosseum and a wide range of decoration options. Soundtrack: An engaging, thematic score that captures the essence of ancient Roman festivities. "Coliseum Decoration" offers a fun and creative outlet for players to explore their artistic side while learning about the grandeur of one of Rome's most famous landmarks. If you have any specific features or gameplay mechanics you’d like to explore further, just let me know!

name: Color Balls
description: Color Balls is a simple yet engaging DOS puzzle game from the early era of PC gaming. Its focus is on strategy and quick thinking, requiring players to manipulate colored balls to achieve specific goals. Objective: The main goal varies by level but typically involves clearing balls of the same color, arranging them into specific patterns, or preventing the screen from filling up. Mechanics: Players interact with colored balls on a grid or in a confined play area. Actions might include moving, swapping, or shooting balls to match or align them. Once certain conditions are met (like a line of three or more matching balls), those balls disappear, often awarding points or advancing the game state. Difficulty Progression: Levels grow increasingly challenging, introducing more colors, faster-moving balls, or additional obstacles. Strategic planning becomes vital in later stages as players must think ahead to prevent being overwhelmed.

name: Color Catch
description: Catch the blocks with the right color. Move the catchers at the bottom to match it with the falling blocks. Color Catch is an engaging HTML5 game that tests your reflexes, coordination, and color-matching skills. Designed for quick, casual gameplay, it is accessible across devices, including desktop and mobile browsers. Core Mechanics: Players control a paddle, wheel, or character that can change colors (commonly red, green, blue, or yellow). Objects or elements (e.g., balls, squares, or shapes) fall from the top of the screen or appear in motion. The player must match their color to the object before catching or interacting with it. Controls: Simple and intuitive controls, such as tapping or swiping on mobile devices, or keyboard/mouse input on desktops. Controls allow the player to switch colors quickly or move to intercept objects. Scoring: Points are earned for every successful color match. Bonus points may be awarded for combos or streaks of consecutive correct matches. Challenges: As the game progresses, objects fall faster or appear more unpredictably. More colors or additional mechanics (like obstacles) may be introduced to increase difficulty.

name: Color Circle
description: Color Circle is a simple yet addictive reaction-based game that tests your timing and precision. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to stop the pointer at the correct color indicated by the game. Successfully stopping the pointer on the target color allows you to progress through levels. Pointer Movement: Rotating Pointer: A pointer rotates around a circle divided into multiple colored segments. The speed of the pointer can vary, adding to the challenge. Target Color: Before each attempt, the game indicates a specific color where you need to stop the pointer. Stopping the Pointer: Click to Stop: Players must click (or tap) to stop the pointer. The challenge lies in timing the click perfectly to land the pointer on the target color. Precision: The closer you stop the pointer to the center of the target color, the higher your score. Some versions of the game might have a scoring system based on accuracy. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the speed of the pointer may increase, or the number of colors on the circle may grow, requiring quicker reflexes and better timing. Time or Attempt Limits: Some levels may have a time limit or a restricted number of attempts, adding a layer of urgency and strategy to the gameplay. Visuals and Sound: Graphics: The game features a clean, minimalist design with vibrant colors and a smooth, rotating pointer. The circle and segments are visually distinct, making it easy to identify the target color. Soundtrack: The background music is upbeat and engaging, complementing the fast-paced nature of the game. Sound effects, like the "click" of stopping the pointer and the "ding" of a successful stop, enhance the overall experience.

name: Color Combat
description: Color Combat is a fast-paced, humorous, and competitive versus fighting flash game featuring stick figures as the main characters.
