The goal is to remove all cards from the board by matching pairs of identical cards. With its Egyptian-themed visuals, challenging levels, and relaxing gameplay, it’s a perfect choice for card game enthusiasts and puzzle lovers. How to Play Egypt Solitaire: Objective: Remove all cards from the board by matching pairs of identical cards. Only cards that are "free" (not blocked by other cards on top or sides) can be selected. Gameplay: The cards are arranged in various layouts, often resembling pyramids or other Egyptian-themed structures. Look for pairs of identical cards that are free and click on them to remove them from the board. As you remove cards, new ones may become free, allowing you to continue matching. Rules: Only two identical cards that are free can be matched and removed. Cards are considered free if they have no cards covering them and at least one side (left or right) is open. The game ends when all cards are cleared or no more moves are possible. Levels: The game features 100 levels, each with a unique layout and increasing difficulty. Early levels are simpler, while later levels may include more complex card arrangements and obstacles. Hints and Shuffle: If you get stuck, use the hint button to highlight a possible match. Some versions of the game allow you to shuffle the cards to create new matching opportunities. Key Features of Egypt Solitaire: Egyptian Theme: Immersive visuals featuring pyramids, hieroglyphs, and other ancient Egyptian symbols. 100 Levels: A wide variety of challenging and beautifully designed boards. Classic Solitaire Gameplay: Familiar matching mechanics with an Egyptian twist. Relaxing Yet Challenging: Perfect for unwinding while exercising your brain.

name: Egypt Solitaire
description: 100 different levels of Solitaire Fun. Try to remove all cards by combining two of the same.Egyptian Marbles (HTML) is a fun and visually captivating marble shooting puzzle game set in an ancient Egyptian theme. In this game, players shoot colored marbles to match three or more of the same color in a line, aiming to clear them from the board before they reach the end of a path. The game usually involves progressing through multiple levels, each with increasingly difficult obstacles and layouts. Marble Shooter Mechanics: Players control a marble launcher that shoots marbles at a moving chain of marbles. The goal is to match three or more marbles of the same color in a line, which causes them to be removed from the path. The chain of marbles keeps moving, and players must clear the board before the marbles reach a "goal" or end point. Ancient Egyptian Theme: The game is set in a beautifully designed ancient Egyptian environment, featuring pyramids, temples, hieroglyphs, scarabs, and other iconic Egyptian symbols. The marbles may be decorated with Egyptian motifs or symbols, adding to the immersive experience. Levels and Challenges: Egyptian Marbles often includes multiple levels, with each one offering a unique challenge. As players progress, the game introduces new obstacles, such as moving obstacles, walls, or other structures that block shots and make matching marbles more difficult. Some levels may also include time limits or move limits, requiring players to complete the level within a set number of moves or before time runs out. Power-ups and Boosters: Throughout the game, players can unlock various power-ups to help them clear marbles more efficiently. Some examples include: Bombs: Clears a group of marbles in the surrounding area. Rainbow Marble: Matches with any color of marble to help clear lines. Line Clears: Eliminates an entire row or column of marbles. Slowdown: Slows down the movement of the marble chain to give the player more time to think. These power-ups can be used strategically to make progress through harder levels.

name: Eight Off
description: Similar game as Freecell, but predating it and with 8 Free Cells. In contrast to Freecell, build sequences on suit instead of alternating color. Move all cards to theÂ 4 foundations (top right) on suit, ascending. Use theÂ 8 free cells to temporarily park cards. Eight Off (HTML) is a solitaire card game that is part of the "freecell" family. It features a challenging and engaging puzzle experience where the objective is to move all the cards into the foundation piles in a specific order. The game is named Eight Off because the game uses eight tableau columns (instead of the standard seven in traditional solitaire). The game is highly strategic, requiring careful planning and foresight to solve each puzzle. Classic Solitaire Gameplay: The core mechanics of Eight Off are similar to other solitaire games, where cards are arranged in tableau columns, and players must build stacks of cards in descending order, alternating between red and black suits. The foundation piles are built up from Ace to King, and the goal is to move all cards into these piles to win. Eight Tableau Columns: Unlike traditional solitaire, Eight Off uses eight tableau columns instead of seven, which makes the game slightly more complex. These extra columns give the player more room to maneuver cards but also increase the challenge of organizing the tableau to successfully move cards to the foundation piles. Empty Spaces: In Eight Off, there are empty spaces in the tableau, which are valuable for organizing cards. A key rule is that only a King can occupy an empty tableau space, which adds a layer of strategy when deciding where to place cards and how to free up spaces. Card Movement: Players can move cards between the tableau columns, organizing them in descending order and alternating suits (for example, a red 6 can be placed on a black 7). Only one card or a sequence of descending cards in the correct alternating color pattern can be moved at a time. Foundation Piles: The foundation piles start with Aces and must be built up in ascending order from Ace to King, one suit at a time. Each of the four foundation piles is dedicated to a specific suit (Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, or Spades).

name: Elder Scrolls: Arena
description: This is not a demo! It's the full version of this classic RPG game! It has been released by its original developers, and this is great news for all computer RPG fans. Similar to the more modern versions including Daggerfall, Morrowind, Oblivion, and Skyrim, this game has obviously worse graphics but some say its gameplay is still superior. It has a very open-ended and non-linear feel so if you enjoy that type of game, please do check out Elder Scrolls: Arena!Elder Scrolls: Arenados doesn't appear to be an official title in the Elder Scrolls series, so it might be a typo, a fan-made game, or a confusion with a similar name. However, there is an official game titled The Elder Scrolls: Arena which could be the game you're referring to. Let me know if you'd like more information on that! Open-World Exploration: The game is set in the fantasy world of Tamriel, and players can explore various cities, towns, and dungeons, making it one of the earliest examples of an open-world RPG. It was revolutionary for its time, offering players the freedom to roam and complete quests in a large and detailed world. Story and Setting: The story revolves around the hero's quest to defeat the evil wizard Jagar Tharn, who has imprisoned the Emperor of Tamriel. Players must travel across the land to collect pieces of a powerful artifact known as the Staff of Chaos to defeat Tharn. The game is set in Tamriel, and while it doesn't yet feature the full breadth of the world as seen in later games in the series, it does showcase the many provinces of the land. Character Creation: Players can create their own character, choosing from different races, classes, and skills, allowing for a personalized experience. The game features a complex skill system where the player can choose various attributes that will affect combat, magic, and overall gameplay. Combat and Magic: Combat in Arena is primarily first-person, with players using melee weapons, ranged weapons, and magic to defeat enemies. The game introduced a wide array of spells and combat techniques that players could use in battle. Dungeons and Quests: Players can explore different dungeons, each filled with enemies, treasures, and puzzles. The game offers a variety of quests, including main storyline missions as well as side quests for loot and experience. Role-Playing Elements: Arena incorporates role-playing elements like inventory management, leveling up, and skill progression. Players can find loot, level up, and make choices that influence their character's development. NPCs in the game offer quests, hints, and can provide a rich world-building experience.

name: Electranoid
description: Another Breakout/Arkanoid clone, this time from the under-appreciated game design group Pixel Painters. This one looks pretty good, and has a lot of fancy animations, sounds/music, etc. Unfortunately it's not possible to skip the animations that occur during the game which can be annoying; but other than that minor quibble, the game plays quite well and includes most of the Arkanoid conventions like powerups, enemies, etc.Electranoid (DOS) is a classic arcade-style game released in the early 1990s. It combines the gameplay mechanics of Breakout and Arkanoid, where players control a paddle to bounce a ball that breaks blocks on the screen. The game’s primary objective is to clear levels by breaking all the blocks, with each level featuring different patterns and obstacles. The game is known for its fast-paced action and the challenge of managing multiple balls and power-ups. Classic Breakout Gameplay: Electranoid follows the familiar Breakout-style gameplay, where players control a paddle at the bottom of the screen to bounce a ball that breaks blocks arranged at the top. The game typically includes multiple levels, each with its own layout of blocks to destroy. Power-ups: Throughout the game, power-ups and bonuses appear, which can enhance the player's abilities or make the game more challenging. These power-ups can include: Multi-ball: Spawns multiple balls for added difficulty. Paddle size increase: Enlarges the paddle to help catch and bounce the ball more easily. Laser: Allows the player to shoot lasers to destroy blocks directly. Speed modifiers: Change the speed of the ball, either making it faster or slower. Levels and Obstacles: Each level in Electranoid presents a different pattern of blocks that need to be broken. Some levels may have obstacles or special blocks that change the gameplay dynamics. The game often includes moving blocks, indestructible blocks, or blocks that regenerate after being destroyed, adding to the complexity. Difficulty and Progression: As players progress through levels, the game increases in difficulty. Blocks may become harder to break, balls may move faster, or new obstacles may be introduced. The challenge comes from managing the bouncing ball while navigating these obstacles and power-ups.

name: Electric Box
description: Electric Box (Flash) is a puzzle game that involves guiding electricity through various mechanisms to power up a box. In this game, players must solve a series of increasingly complex puzzles by using different objects and elements in the environment to direct and control the flow of electricity to the box. Puzzle Mechanics: In each level, the player is given several components to interact with, such as wires, batteries, switches, light bulbs, and fans. The goal is to connect these components in such a way that electricity flows from the power source to the electric box, lighting it up and completing the level. Level Design: The game is divided into multiple levels, each one introducing new mechanisms and obstacles. Some levels might require you to manipulate fans or use elevators to adjust the position of components. Levels get progressively more difficult, with more components and intricate setups. The puzzles require both logic and creativity to complete. Objects and Components: Players must use different objects to solve puzzles: Wires: Used to connect components. Batteries: Power sources that need to be placed strategically. Switches: Activate or deactivate different parts of the circuit. Fans: Can move objects or clear paths. Light bulbs: Often serve as indicators that the circuit is complete. Elevators: Raise or lower certain elements to help connect the circuit. The challenge is figuring out the best way to place these components to form a working electric circuit. Logic and Strategy: The puzzles require careful planning. Players must think several steps ahead and consider how to use the available objects most efficiently. Some levels require trial and error before finding the right solution, making it both challenging and rewarding.

name: Electricman 2: The Tournament of Voltagen
description: "Electricman 2: The Tournament of Voltagen" is an electrifying fighting flash game that combines martial arts with a unique superhero theme. Players control Electricman, a powerful fighter with the ability to perform stunning combos and special moves in an arena filled with enemies. The gameplay features a mix of 2D fighting mechanics and strategic combat. Players can unleash a variety of attacks, dodge, and counterattack while facing waves of opponents in a tournament-style format. Each match challenges players to demonstrate their skills and timing to defeat increasingly tough foes. The game is known for its smooth animations, vibrant graphics, and a catchy soundtrack that enhances the action. With its engaging combat system and colorful characters, "Electricman 2" offers an exciting experience for fans of fighting games.

name: Electro Man
description: Originally published in Poland under the name "Electro Body" and sometimes styled as "Electroman" (no space), this is one of the games that Epic Megagames (in their early days) published that was made by another developer. This is one such game ... they don't support it anymore. Nevertheless, it's not a bad game. It features a RoboCop-like character which you must try to navigate through the levels while shooting enemies. Not a lot of fast action (and the jumping controls are a bit odd) but other than that, not bad at all. Good if you're looking for a more methodical pace rather than a fast action game. (This page now provides a download of the 2006 free release by the original developers, xLand Games.)

name: Electron Havoc
description: Electron Havoc is a two player strategy game which is similar to the classic Gorillas (of QBasic fame), Scorched Earth, or Worms style game. The object is to destroy your opponent by setting your gun location & velocity. The main difference here is that your shots are affected by the gravitational pull of planets in space so you must carefully plan your shots accordingly.Electron Havoc (DOS) is a retro-style action-shooter game that combines fast-paced gameplay with strategic elements. Set in a futuristic sci-fi world, players take control of a spacecraft or weapon system to navigate challenging environments, eliminate enemies, and achieve objectives. The game likely features a mix of arcade shooting mechanics and puzzle-solving elements to progress through its levels. Fast-Paced Action Gameplay: Players engage in combat with enemy ships, drones, or obstacles in a dynamic environment. The gameplay focuses on precision shooting, quick reflexes, and tactical maneuvering to survive waves of enemies and environmental challenges. Futuristic Sci-Fi Setting: The game takes place in a technologically advanced world, with levels designed to reflect futuristic bases, space environments, or alien landscapes. The graphics, while simplistic by today’s standards, likely use bright, neon colors and sharp designs to depict energy fields, explosions, and electronic hazards. Challenging Levels: Levels increase in complexity as players progress, introducing new enemy types, traps, and puzzles to solve. Each level may have specific objectives, such as destroying certain targets, activating systems, or navigating mazes of obstacles. Weapons and Upgrades: Players may have access to a variety of weapons, from basic blasters to advanced energy cannons. Upgrades or power-ups can be collected during gameplay, enhancing firepower, speed, or defensive capabilities. Strategic Elements: The game incorporates strategy by requiring players to prioritize targets, manage limited resources like ammunition or shields, and plan their movements carefully to avoid hazards. Retro Graphics and Sound: Electron Havoc features classic DOS-era visuals, including pixelated graphics and a simple but effective color palette. The sound design includes retro effects like laser blasts, explosions, and electronic music, adding to the arcade-style atmosphere. Score System: Players earn points for defeating enemies, completing levels, and achieving specific objectives. A high-score system encourages replayability, as players aim to improve their performance.

name: Electronic Aggravation
description: Electronic Aggravation is a competent remake of the board game, based on Pachisi. It's also similar to the more popular modern-day board game Sorry. The object is to move all of your pieces (marbles) around the board into your "home" spaces. Up to six players can compete at once, in any combination of human and computer-controlled opponents.Electronic Aggravation (DOS) is a computer adaptation of the classic Aggravation board game, offering a digital version of the family-friendly strategy game. Released during the DOS era, the game captures the core mechanics of the traditional board game while introducing computer opponents and automated gameplay for added convenience. Core Mechanics of Aggravation: Players roll virtual dice and move their pieces around a track toward the goal. The game includes the classic mechanic of "aggravating" opponents by landing on their space, which sends their piece back to the start. Single and Multiplayer Options: The game allows for both single-player mode (against computer-controlled opponents) and multiplayer mode, where multiple players can take turns. AI opponents simulate human decision-making, adding a layer of challenge for solo players. Customizable Rules: Players can customize certain rules, such as the number of pieces in play or special movement mechanics, tailoring the experience to their preference. Board Layout: The board mirrors the traditional Aggravation game layout, featuring paths for each player's pieces and shortcuts that can speed up movement but come with risks. Visuals and Sound: The game uses simple, colorful graphics to represent the board and pieces, making it visually accessible and easy to understand. Sound effects may include dice rolls, movement sounds, and alerts for "aggravation" events, enhancing the gaming experience. Turn-Based Gameplay: Each player takes their turn sequentially, ensuring a relaxed, strategy-focused pace. Strategy and Luck: Success in Electronic Aggravation requires a mix of strategic planning (e.g., blocking opponents, choosing the safest paths) and luck (dice rolls). Replayability: Like the board game, the digital version has high replay value, with every game offering a unique combination of player actions and dice outcomes.

name: Elemental One
description: a simple platformer made along the theme of Ludum Dare 28

name: Elephant Quest
description: "Elephant Quest" is a whimsical action-adventure flash game that follows the journey of a young elephant on a quest to retrieve his stolen hat. Players explore a colorful, hand-drawn world filled with quirky characters, engaging puzzles, and various enemies. The gameplay features platforming elements, allowing players to jump, run, and engage in battles against foes while collecting items and upgrades. As players progress, they can unlock new abilities and access different areas of the map, enhancing the adventure experience. With its charming art style, catchy soundtrack, and humorous narrative, "Elephant Quest" provides a delightful and immersive experience for players, making it a standout title in the casual gaming genre.

name: Elephant Rave HD
description: Elephant Rave HD (Flash) is a fast-paced and quirky action-arcade game featuring a colorful and chaotic environment. Developed as part of the iconic Elephant series by jmtb02 (John Cooney), this game blends humor, simplicity, and increasingly challenging gameplay to create a unique experience. The "HD" version is an upgraded iteration with enhanced visuals and smoother performance. Simple Controls: Players use either the arrow keys or WASD to move the elephant, making it easy to pick up and play. The game focuses on dodging hazards, with no complex mechanics or attacks. Laser Raves: The "rave" theme of the game is highlighted by the colorful lasers that streak across the screen. These lasers are both visually dazzling and deadly, requiring precise timing and quick reflexes to avoid. Humor and Absurdity: Like other games in the Elephant series, this game incorporates offbeat humor and surreal elements, such as unexpected dialogue or bizarre animations. The absurd nature of the elephant being in a laser-filled rave adds to the charm. Difficulty Scaling: As the game progresses, the lasers become faster and patterns more complex, escalating the difficulty. Players are rewarded for surviving longer and avoiding hazards with increasing scores. Bright Visuals and Music: The "HD" upgrade improves the graphics with sharper visuals, smoother animations, and more vibrant colors. Upbeat, rave-inspired music and sound effects create a high-energy atmosphere. Replayability: With its endless format and randomized laser patterns, the game encourages players to keep retrying to beat their previous high scores. The quick matches and high-energy gameplay make it ideal for short, engaging play sessions.

name: Elevators from Hell
description: The elevators in the game Elevators from Hell are actually quite normal. They aren't evil in any way. It's the robot guard who's chasing you and wants to kill you that you need to watch out for! The object is to collect all of the tokens (they sure look like ASCII character #4 to me) and then get to the exit. To move between floors, you must use the aforementioned elevators by calling them to your current floor, entering them, and then pressing the number of the floor you want. The robot guard is also using the elevators to try to track you down. You'll likely see a lot of game over screens because once the robot zaps you, you're done! Quite a difficult game with very plain graphics.

name: Elfland
description: Elfland is a neat little EGA platform game, seemingly inspired by games like Captain Comic and Commander Keen; it looks and plays sort of like an early Apogee game. You choose your character (either boy Elfie or girl Elfita) and the gameplay involves jumping around levels and trying to figure out where to go next. It's cute and enjoyable, as long as you turn the extremely annoying PC speaker sound effects off.Elfland (DOS) is a charming and colorful platformer game developed in the early 1990s. Aimed at younger players but enjoyable for all ages, Elfland features a whimsical fantasy setting, lighthearted gameplay, and an emphasis on exploration and problem-solving. Players take on the role of an elf tasked with saving their homeland from a threatening force, navigating through magical lands filled with challenges and secrets.

name: Eliminator
description: Eliminator is a Snake / Nibbles / Tron lightcycles clone. Your job is to survive and avoid crashing into walls while your snake gets longer, as your opponent attempts to do the same. This game provides a two-player mode as well as a single player mode against a quite difficult computer opponent. CGA graphics are used and no sound effects. There are no options beyond the aforementioned settings besides setting the speed, but on modern computers you'll need to turn the speed way down to make this game playable.

name: Eliminator Solitaire
description: Eliminate all cards from the tableau by building up or down on the foundations. You can build regardless of suit. You cannot build on the tableau. Eliminator Solitaire (HTML) is a single-player card game that combines elements of traditional solitaire with a unique, strategic twist. Designed for web browsers, the game is accessible on various devices and offers a straightforward yet engaging challenge. Classic Solitaire Mechanics: The game incorporates familiar solitaire rules, such as building sequences or removing matching cards. It offers a unique variation of traditional solitaire, making it both fresh and familiar. Browser-Based Accessibility: No download is required—players can enjoy the game directly in their web browsers. It’s compatible with both desktop and mobile devices, providing a seamless experience across platforms. Strategic Gameplay: Players must plan their moves carefully to eliminate all cards. Decisions have long-term consequences, requiring foresight and adaptability. Customizable Difficulty: Options to adjust the difficulty level make the game suitable for both beginners and experienced players. Players can choose the number of cards in the tableau or the complexity of the rules. Hints and Undo Options: To aid players, the game may offer a hint system for guidance and an undo feature to reverse mistakes. These features make the game less frustrating and more accessible. Minimalistic Design: The interface is clean and intuitive, with a focus on the card layout. Simple animations and smooth transitions make the gameplay visually appealing without being overwhelming. Scoring System: Players can track their performance with a points system based on the number of moves and the time taken to complete a game. High scores encourage replayability. Relaxing Experience: The game is designed to be a relaxing, casual experience with no time limits in standard play. Subtle background music or sound effects may enhance the calming atmosphere.

name: Eliza
description: Eliza was an early attempt at computer AI. The idea was that it would be something like a computer therapist, where you would enter your problems and it would reply with further probing questions to help you with your problems. In practice, due to the simplistic algorithms used, it was most often a thoroughly frustrating experience. (See the screenshot for an example.) This thing is probably good for a laugh and nothing more ... it's all text. ;) As the author says, "Eliza can either cure your psychosis or generate new ones depending on how you take it." There are many versions of this program, this copy includes source code in both Basic and Pascal.

name: Emerald Hunt
description: Emerald Hunt is a Boulderdash-inspired puzzle/strategy game with randomized levels. The goal of course is to collect as many emeralds as possible. Your bulldozer can plow through the dirt to reach them, however watch out for falling boulders that can crush you, and enemies that can kill you. The randomized levels mean that each time you play is different, although since the game is very simple each game will quickly start to feel similar since the different objects are literally strewn randomly around the map. The map is quite large and there are a lot of emeralds to collect, so finishing even one level will be a challenge.

name: Emergency Mission
description: Emergency Mission is a strange game; what at first appears to be a decent but somewhat repetitive shooter game suddenly transforms into a ... hospital simulation? In part 1 of the game you must shoot down 50 enemy ships, while avoiding hitting the medical ships (they look white and make an annoying sound if you shoot them).Emergency Mission (DOS) is a classic action-strategy game that tasks players with completing critical missions in a high-pressure, time-sensitive environment. Set in a variety of challenging scenarios, the game blends fast-paced decision-making with tactical problem-solving, creating a thrilling and immersive experience for fans of strategic gameplay. Mission-Based Gameplay: The game consists of multiple missions, each with unique objectives and environments. Players must analyze the situation, use available resources effectively, and complete tasks to succeed. Action and Strategy Blend: Gameplay combines real-time action (such as combat or navigating obstacles) with strategic decision-making, like resource management and planning. Players must balance speed with precision to meet mission goals. Varied Environments: Missions are set in diverse locations, such as urban buildings, underground complexes, or outdoor areas. Each environment presents unique challenges and hazards, requiring different strategies to overcome. Resource Management: Players may need to manage resources like ammunition, medical supplies, or tools during missions. Making smart decisions about when and how to use these resources is key to success. Team Dynamics: Some missions might involve commanding a team of operatives, with each member having specialized skills. Coordinating actions and assigning tasks effectively can make or break a mission. High-Stakes Atmosphere: A ticking clock or escalating threats create a sense of urgency, keeping players engaged and focused. Mistakes or delays can result in mission failure, adding to the tension.

name: Emoji Mahjong
description: Mahjong with Emojis. Combine two of the same Emojis.Emoji Mahjong (HTML) is a fun and visually engaging twist on the classic mahjong solitaire game. Instead of traditional tiles with Chinese characters or symbols, the game uses colorful and expressive emoji icons, giving the game a modern, playful, and universally appealing vibe. Designed for casual players, it is accessible on web browsers across multiple devices. Emoji-Themed Tiles: The game replaces traditional mahjong symbols with a wide variety of emojis, such as smiley faces, animals, food, and objects. The colorful and familiar icons make the game appealing to a broad audience, including younger players. Classic Mahjong Mechanics: Players must identify and select matching pairs of emoji tiles. Only tiles that are not covered and have at least one free side can be matched. Accessible Design: The game is browser-based, requiring no downloads or installations. It runs smoothly on desktops, tablets, and smartphones, making it ideal for on-the-go play. Multiple Layouts and Levels: The game may include various board layouts, ranging from simple to complex, offering a variety of challenges. As players progress, the levels might become more intricate, requiring greater focus and strategy. Hints and Shuffle Options: If players get stuck, they can use hint options to reveal potential matches. A shuffle feature can mix up the remaining tiles, providing new matching opportunities. Relaxing Gameplay: The game is designed to be stress-free, with no time limits in many modes, allowing players to play at their own pace. Calming background music and sound effects enhance the relaxing experience.

name: Emoji Match
description: Collect the big Emoji by matching emojis. Swap two neighbouring emojis to get three or more of the same in a row/column.Emoji Match (HTML) is a fun and colorful puzzle-matching game where players connect pairs of emoji icons to clear the board. This game takes a modern spin on traditional matching games, featuring popular and expressive emojis as its primary visual elements. Designed for accessibility and enjoyment, it is playable on web browsers across multiple devices. Emoji-Themed Graphics: The game is packed with vibrant and recognizable emojis, including smiley faces, animals, food, and more. The appealing visuals cater to players of all ages, making it universally enjoyable. Simple Gameplay Mechanics: Players click or tap on matching emoji pairs to remove them from the board. Matches can often be made only if there is a clear path between the pairs (as in mahjong connect games), adding a strategic element. Variety of Game Modes: Timed Mode: Complete matches within a set time for an added challenge. Relaxed Mode: Play without time constraints for a stress-free experience. Level Progression: Increasingly complex grids and new emoji themes as the player advances. Power-Ups and Hints: Players can use power-ups like hints to reveal matches or shuffles to rearrange the board when stuck. Special abilities like bombs or rainbow matches might be included in advanced levels. Scoring System: Earn points for each pair matched, with bonuses for streaks or completing levels quickly. Leaderboards may allow for friendly competition with other players. Browser-Based and Mobile-Friendly: The game works seamlessly in web browsers and is optimized for both desktop and mobile devices. No downloads or installations are required. Relaxing Music and Sounds: Cheerful background music and sound effects make the game engaging while providing a soothing atmosphere.

name: Emoji Match 3
description: Match 3 game with Emoji's. Swap 2 emoji's to get 3 or more on a row. Remove the special backgrounds.Emoji Match 3 (HTML) is a vibrant and addictive match-three puzzle game where players swap and match emoji icons to clear the board and earn points. Featuring colorful and expressive emoji designs, this game offers a playful twist on the classic match-3 formula. It is playable directly in web browsers and optimized for both desktop and mobile devices. Emoji-Themed Visuals: The game uses a variety of emojis, including smiley faces, animals, objects, and symbols, for a fun and visually appealing experience. Bright, colorful graphics make the game accessible and engaging for players of all ages. Classic Match-3 Mechanics: Players swap adjacent emojis to create horizontal or vertical lines of three or more identical emojis. Matching larger groups of emojis triggers special effects like explosions, power-ups, or bonus points. Level-Based Challenges: Levels vary in difficulty and objectives, such as clearing specific tiles, collecting certain emojis, or achieving a high score within a move limit. New gameplay mechanics and challenges are introduced as players progress. Power-Ups and Boosters: Create special emojis by matching four or more tiles, triggering abilities like clearing rows, columns, or surrounding areas. Boosters, such as bombs, shuffles, or rainbow emojis, help overcome tricky levels. Scoring System and Rewards: Players earn points for each match, with bonuses for combos and chain reactions. Daily rewards or achievements encourage regular play. Relaxed and Timed Modes: Choose between relaxing, untimed gameplay or more challenging timed modes for added excitement. Suitable for both casual players and those seeking a fast-paced experience. Browser-Based and Mobile-Friendly: The game is easily accessible on web browsers without requiring downloads. Optimized for both touch controls on mobile devices and mouse controls on desktops.

name: Emoji Pairs
description: Try to find all pairs of Emojis. Click to open a tile. Find all pairs before time runs out.Emoji Pairs (HTML) is a delightful and simple memory-matching game where players uncover and match pairs of identical emoji tiles. Featuring bright, familiar emoji icons, the game is designed to test and improve memory skills in a fun, casual format. It is accessible directly in web browsers on desktops and mobile devices. Emoji-Themed Graphics: The game features vibrant emoji icons, such as smiley faces, animals, food items, and symbols. Its colorful and cheerful design appeals to players of all ages. Classic Memory Game Mechanics: Players flip two tiles per turn, aiming to find a matching pair. If the tiles match, they remain face-up; otherwise, they are flipped back over. Difficulty Levels: Grids vary in size and complexity, from small 4x4 boards for beginners to larger grids for a more challenging experience. Higher levels may introduce more unique emojis or time constraints. Timed Mode and Relaxed Play: In timed mode, players race against the clock to complete the board, adding a layer of excitement. Relaxed mode allows for a leisurely experience with no time pressure. Scoring System: Players earn points based on the number of moves, accuracy, and completion time. Bonuses are awarded for completing boards quickly or with minimal mistakes. Hints and Assistance: A hint feature may briefly reveal tile locations for players who are stuck. These options make the game more accessible for younger or less experienced players.

name: Enchantasy: Quest For The Eternal Grimoire
description: Enchantasy seems to be a decent CRPG fantasy game, with the caveat that the author(s) REALLY want you to register this game. The story and environment seem pretty standard for this sort of game, with typical fantasy tropes. You walk around and use hotkeys to perform actions; thankfully the hotkeys are displayed on-screen at all times for easy reference. In the shareware version you are limited to saving your game 5 times.Enchantasy: Quest For The Eternal Grimoire (DOS) is a fantasy adventure game released for MS-DOS, combining elements of role-playing, puzzle-solving, and exploration. Players embark on a magical journey filled with quests, secrets, and challenges, where they aim to uncover the mysteries of the Eternal Grimoire, a powerful and ancient magical artifact. Fantasy Setting: The game is set in a fantasy world filled with mythical creatures, wizards, and ancient lore. Players explore magical landscapes, from enchanted forests to ominous castles, each filled with secrets and challenges. Role-Playing Elements: Players can create and develop their own character, customizing stats such as strength, intelligence, and magic abilities. Throughout the game, players earn experience points, level up, and unlock new skills. Puzzle-Solving: Many areas in the game require players to solve puzzles or decipher ancient riddles in order to progress. These puzzles often involve environmental interactions, magical objects, and clues hidden in the world. Tactical Combat: Players face combat against various enemies such as goblins, wizards, and mythical beasts. Combat is turn-based, requiring strategic planning and the use of magical abilities, potions, and weapons. Multiple Quests and Side-Objectives: The main objective revolves around finding the Eternal Grimoire, but players can also complete various side quests to gain rewards, allies, and uncover hidden lore. Quests may involve helping NPCs, retrieving items, or defeating specific enemies.

name: Enchanted Garden
description: Find all the hidden objects in the Enchanted Garden. You have a limited amount of turns and you will get new turns if you complete a category of objects. So try to find all objects of one category first. Zoom in on double click/tap or use the fullscreen option.Enchanted Garden (HTML) is a match-3 puzzle game set in a whimsical and vibrant garden filled with magical elements. Players work through levels by matching colorful flowers, plants, or magical items to clear the board, earn points, and progress through increasingly challenging stages. The game often includes power-ups, boosters, and unique garden-themed elements that enhance the gameplay experience. Whimsical Garden-Themed Graphics: The game is set in a vibrant, fantasy garden filled with blooming flowers, magical plants, and enchanted creatures. Beautiful, colorful visuals and animations make the gameplay charming and immersive. Match-3 Mechanics: Players swap adjacent items to create matches of three or more identical items. When matches are made, the items disappear, and new ones fall into place, creating opportunities for chain reactions and combos. Special Items and Power-Ups: Special items such as bombs, rainbow flowers, or magic plants can be created by matching larger groups of items. These power-ups help clear the board more effectively or complete specific level objectives. Challenging Levels: As players advance through the game, they encounter increasingly difficult levels, with limited moves, obstacles (such as vines or rocks), and special tasks (like collecting certain flowers or breaking ice). Each level typically has its own objectives, making it more than just a simple matching game. Variety of Objectives: Some levels may require players to clear specific tiles, collect certain items, or complete the level within a set number of moves. This variety adds complexity and keeps the gameplay fresh. Boosters and Hints: Players can earn or purchase boosters to help them progress through tricky levels. Hints are also available to guide players when they are stuck or need assistance in making a move.

name: Endless Break Out
description: Remove the bricks in this endless Break Out Game. Bounce the ball with the paddle and try stay alive.Endless Break Out is a classic arcade-style game that offers a challenging and addictive experience. The objective is to keep the ball bouncing and break as many bricks as possible before it reaches the bottom of the screen. Key Features: Endless Gameplay: The game generates new levels of bricks as you progress, keeping the challenge going indefinitely. Simple Controls: Use the arrow keys or mouse to move the paddle and control the ball's trajectory. Power-ups: Collect power-ups that appear when you break certain bricks to gain special abilities like larger paddles, faster balls, or multi-ball play. Increasing Difficulty: As you break more bricks, the game becomes progressively faster and more challenging. High Score Tracking: Compete with yourself and others to achieve the highest score possible.

name: Endless Dimensions
description: Play a Endless Mahjong Game in 3 Dimensions. Click on two of the same blocks that have at least two adjacent free sides.Endless Dimensions is a captivating 3D Mahjong game that challenges players to match and remove identical tiles within a time limit. The game offers a unique perspective, allowing players to rotate the 3D tile structure to identify matching pairs. Key Features: 3D Tile Structure: Experience a visually stunning 3D environment filled with intricate tile patterns. Time-Based Gameplay: Race against the clock to clear as many tiles as possible before time runs out. Rotation Mechanics: Rotate the 3D structure to discover hidden matching pairs and strategize your moves. Endless Challenge: With countless levels and increasing difficulty, the game offers endless hours of puzzle-solving fun. Relaxing Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a serene gaming experience with soothing music and visually appealing graphics.

name: Endless War 3
description: "Endless War 3" is a dynamic action flash game that combines elements of strategy and combat. Players take on the role of a soldier battling through various intense missions across different battlefields, facing waves of enemies and completing objectives. The gameplay features customizable characters, allowing players to choose their weapons and abilities as they progress. Players can engage in both ground and aerial combat, utilizing a variety of vehicles and equipment to gain an advantage in battles. With its engaging graphics, smooth animations, and a wide range of missions, "Endless War 3" provides an adrenaline-pumping experience. The game's focus on strategic gameplay, combined with fast-paced action, makes it a thrilling choice for fans of military shooters and action games.

name: England Penalty Shootout 2006
description: Overview: "England Penalty Shootout 2006" is a thrilling flash game that recreates the dramatic moments of the 2006 FIFA World Cup quarterfinal match between England and Portugal. Players get to experience the tension of taking penalties and attempting to save them as they aim to lead England to victory. Key Features: Penalty Taking: Step into the shoes of famous England players, including Frank Lampard, Steven Gerrard, and Jamie Carragher, to take penalties against the Portuguese goalkeeper. Goalkeeping Challenge: Switch roles and play as the goalkeeper, trying to save penalties from opposing players. Use timing and positioning to make crucial saves. Realistic Controls: Intuitive controls for aiming and kicking the ball, along with timing mechanics for saves as the goalkeeper. Match Atmosphere: Experience the atmosphere of the World Cup with cheering crowds, authentic sound effects, and commentary snippets to enhance the immersion. Difficulty Levels: Choose from different difficulty levels, from beginner to expert, to test your skills and improve your penalty-taking or saving techniques. Achievements and Unlockables: Complete specific challenges or achieve high scores to unlock new teams, players, or special game modes. Visual and Audio Elements: Graphics: Engaging visuals that replicate the iconic stadium setting, player animations, and the excitement of a penalty shootout. Soundtrack: A dramatic soundtrack accompanied by realistic sound effects of crowd reactions and ball strikes. "England Penalty Shootout 2006" offers an entertaining way to relive one of football's most intense moments, allowing players to rewrite history by securing a win for England. If you’d like more details or specific features, just let me know!

name: Enigma
description: Enigma is a Breakout / Arkanoid type game where you must use your paddle at the bottom of the screen to bounce a ball around and destroy all of the bricks to progress to the next level. There are powerups to collect (multiball, lazer gun, paddle repair ...) and "baddies" that sometimes rush out of the blocks that must be avoided or shot with the gun. (Unlike most games of this type the gun can only be used to kill baddies and not to destroy blocks.) Your ship can take damage from the baddies and still continue to function. There are also "subgames" to play between the levels. (This game was originally shareware but was released as freeware by its developers in 2005.)

name: Enigmacross
description: Enigmacross is a computerized version of an acrostic puzzle. It's sort of like a crossword, but after answering the individual questions, the spaces indicated by the numbers are filled into the larger puzzle. Answering individual questions also reveals a second phrase. It's easier to just try than to describe. Although the interface is not always intuitive, the program works well enough and includes seven acrostic puzzles. There is also an editor to create your own but I couldn't get it to work.Enigmacross is a professional acrostic puzzle development application designed for creating and solving complex word puzzles. It's particularly useful for those who enjoy crafting intricate puzzles with hidden messages or themes. Key Features: Puzzle Creation: Create custom acrostic puzzles with various difficulty levels. Design unique layouts and themes for your puzzles. Set specific word lengths, clue types, and puzzle sizes. Puzzle Solving: Solve puzzles created by yourself or others. Utilize built-in tools to check progress and find hints. Enjoy a satisfying puzzle-solving experience. Advanced Features: Import and export puzzles in various formats. Print puzzles for offline enjoyment. Share puzzles with friends and the online community.

name: Epic Baseball
description: This "Animated 256-color VGA sports simulation" game published by Epic Megagames is a baseball simulation, not an action game. Meaning you don't get to bat, play the outfield, etc. Instead you play the role of manager and try to make the best decisions to help your team win games. Its unfortunate that the game looks so good and the graphics and animations are so smooth, yet you can't actually PLAY baseball! ;) But if you are a fan of the simulation sports genre, definitely check this game out. The developer of this game was known for their sports sims.

name: Epic Pinball
description: My favorite computer pinball games! The shareware version only contains one table, but it's really cool. Great graphics, smooth scrolling, SB sounds, and "good enough" physics. The screen scrolls to follow the ball, and while it's unfortunate that you never get to see the entire table at once, it allows for more detail to be shown on the screen. The shareware version includes a single table, Android (in later versions "Super Android").Epic Pinball is a classic pinball simulation game that was a groundbreaking title for its time. It features a unique top-down perspective, allowing players to see the entire pinball table at once. Key Features: Realistic Physics: The game accurately simulates the physics of a real pinball machine, including the ball's movement, collisions, and the behavior of various table elements. Diverse Tables: Epic Pinball offers a variety of themed tables, each with its own unique layout, obstacles, and challenges. Power-ups and Bonuses: Players can collect power-ups to enhance their gameplay, such as increasing the ball's speed or adding extra balls. Engaging Sound Effects: The game features realistic sound effects that create an immersive pinball experience. High Replayability: With its challenging gameplay and multiple tables, Epic Pinball offers endless hours of fun.

name: Eradicator
description: Eradicator is a unique FPS from Accolade, who are much better known for their Test Drive series and other non-FPS type games. Your mission is to "Disable an automated fortress that has been mysteriously reactivated." This game has some innovative features, like an optional 3rd-person perspective view (like Tomb Raider), different characters to choose from each with their own abilities and maps to play (only one is available in this demo version) as well as a large variety of different weapons. Yet it will still feel very familiar to those who have played DOOM and similar games. The gameplay is fast and furious.

name: Escape Abandoned Power Plant
description: Escape Abandoned Power Plant is a point-and-click flash game that immerses players in a suspenseful adventure inside a desolate, eerie industrial setting. With atmospheric visuals and clever puzzles, the game challenges you to explore, collect items, and solve riddles to find a way out of the abandoned power plant. Gameplay: Objective: You are trapped inside a dilapidated power plant, and your goal is to escape by uncovering hidden clues, solving puzzles, and using items to unlock doors or bypass obstacles. Mechanics: Point-and-click navigation to move through rooms and interact with the environment. Collect and manage inventory items to use them in specific situations. Solve logic puzzles, decipher codes, and find keys to progress through locked areas. Features: Challenging Puzzles: Each area of the power plant presents unique brain-teasers, such as: Repairing broken machinery by arranging gears or wires. Cracking security codes based on cryptic clues scattered in the environment. Finding and combining items to create tools or solve complex problems. Atmospheric Setting: Environment: Dark and foreboding with flickering lights, broken equipment, and ominous machinery. Sound Design: Creepy ambient sounds, such as the hum of generators, distant creaks, and dripping water, add to the tension. Exploration: Multiple interconnected rooms, including control centers, storage areas, and maintenance tunnels, encourage thorough exploration to uncover all necessary items and clues. Story Elements: Discover notes, logs, or environmental hints that reveal the backstory of the abandoned power plant and why it was deserted, adding depth and intrigue to the experience. Timed or Pressure Moments: Some puzzles or sections may be time-sensitive, adding urgency and an adrenaline rush as you race to escape.

name: Escape from Dr. Colosso
description: Escape from Dr. Colosso is one of many games that use the Pie in the Sky 3D Game Creation System engine. The story involves a mad doctor who has done bad stuff, and now you need to shoot your way out after being freed by a for some reason malevolent executioner. Gameplay involves navigating around different areas and shooting people while collecting items, like ammo refills for your gun which are not automatically applied, you need to select them and use them.Escape from Dr. Colosso is a classic 3D action-adventure game that takes players on an exciting journey through a variety of challenging levels. You play as the hero, tasked with rescuing the kidnapped Red Princess from the clutches of the villainous Dr. Colosso. Key Features: 3D Exploration: Immerse yourself in a 3D world filled with intricate levels, hidden secrets, and dangerous enemies. Fast-Paced Action: Engage in intense combat with a variety of weapons and abilities. Puzzle-Solving: Solve challenging puzzles to progress through the game and uncover hidden treasures. Engaging Storyline: Follow a captivating storyline with twists and turns. Stunning Graphics and Sound: Experience stunning visuals and immersive sound effects.

name: Escape From The Ascii Trolls
description: Ever wanted to play funky puzzle/adventure game with ASCII graphics where you must flee or otherwise use your wits and collected items to flee from trolls? Well, if so, this is the perfect game for you! While the controls and interface need some getting used to (read the included docs before playing) this game is fairly unique, includes both puzzle and adventure elements, and yeah I'm always a sucker for ASCII games. :) (The author notes if you run this from Windows to be sure to maximize the window.)

name: Escape Room - Home Escape
description: "Escape Room - Home Escape" is an immersive and challenging point-and-click escape room game where players must find hidden clues, solve puzzles, and unlock secrets to escape from a virtual room. The game is set in a detailed home environment, and players must use their observation skills, logic, and creativity to progress through the game. Game Description: Objective: Escape the room by finding hidden clues, solving puzzles, and unlocking doors or containers. Gameplay: Players explore a detailed home environment, clicking on objects to interact with them. Hidden clues and items are scattered throughout the room, and players must collect and use them to solve puzzles. Puzzles can include riddles, combination locks, pattern recognition, and more. Setting: The game is set in a home environment, such as a living room, bedroom, or kitchen, with various interactive objects and hidden compartments. The atmosphere is immersive, with realistic visuals and sound effects. Puzzles and Clues: Players must find and combine items to progress (e.g., using a key to open a drawer or combining pieces to solve a puzzle). Clues can be hidden in plain sight or require careful observation (e.g., a note under a rug or a pattern on a painting). Progression: The game includes multiple stages, with each stage requiring the player to solve a new set of puzzles to unlock the next area. Players must think critically and pay attention to details to progress. Special Features: Inventory System: Players collect items in an inventory and use them to interact with the environment. Hint System: Players can use hints if they get stuck. Multiple Endings: Depending on the player's choices and speed, there may be different endings.

name: Escape the Building
description: Escape the Building is a classic point-and-click escape room game that challenges players to solve puzzles and escape from various enclosed environments. Key Features: Intricate Puzzles: Players must explore the environment, find hidden clues, and solve a variety of puzzles to progress. Immersive Atmosphere: The game often features a mysterious and suspenseful atmosphere, adding to the challenge and excitement. Multiple Endings: Some games offer different endings based on the player's choices and actions. Hidden Objects: Players must carefully examine the environment to find hidden objects that are essential to solving puzzles. Time Limits: In some cases, players may have a limited amount of time to escape, adding an extra layer of pressure. Escape the Building games offer a fun and engaging experience for those who enjoy problem-solving and exploring virtual worlds.

name: Escape the Forest
description: Escape the forest by walking on all tiles. First click on your start tile and then the direction you want to walk to.Escape the Forest is a captivating adventure game that challenges players to navigate through a mysterious and dangerous forest. Key Features: Survival Horror: Immerse yourself in a tense and atmospheric setting, filled with eerie sounds and unexpected dangers. Exploration: Discover hidden secrets and solve puzzles to progress through the forest. Resource Management: Gather resources to craft tools, weapons, and shelter to survive the harsh conditions. Creature Encounters: Face off against terrifying creatures that lurk in the shadows. Crafting System: Create essential items to aid in your survival, such as fire, traps, and weapons. Escape the Forest offers a thrilling and challenging experience for players who enjoy exploring dark and mysterious environments. Sources and related content

name: Escape the Gym
description: Escape the Gym is a fun and challenging point-and-click escape room game set in a typical gym environment. Key Features: Gym-Themed Puzzles: Players must solve puzzles related to fitness equipment, workout routines, and gym etiquette. Hidden Clues: Clues are cleverly hidden throughout the gym, requiring players to pay close attention to detail. Time Limits: Some versions of the game may have time limits, adding an extra layer of excitement and pressure. Multiple Rooms: Players may need to explore different areas of the gym to find clues and solve puzzles. Logical Reasoning: Deductive reasoning and problem-solving skills are essential to escape successfully. Escape the Gym offers a unique and engaging experience for fitness enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike.

name: Escape the Studio
description: Escape the Studio is a classic point-and-click escape room game set in a creative studio environment. Key Features: Artistic Puzzles: The game often incorporates puzzles related to art, music, or design, such as solving riddles, deciphering codes, or finding hidden objects. Creative Atmosphere: The studio setting provides a unique and inspiring backdrop for the game's puzzles and challenges. Hidden Clues: Clues are cleverly disguised as part of the studio's decor or artwork, requiring players to think outside the box. Time Limits: Some versions of the game may have time limits, adding an extra layer of excitement and pressure. Multiple Endings: Some games offer different endings based on the player's choices and actions.

name: Escape to Obion Episode 1: Fire and Ice
description: "Escape to Obion: Episode 1 – Fire and Ice" is the inaugural installment in the "Escape to Obion" series, a collection of point-and-click adventure games renowned for their intricate puzzles and immersive narratives. In this episode, players embark on a mission to thwart the nefarious Dr. Saturday, who plans to hijack the minds of sentient machines worldwide. The journey begins near Mount Terror, a dormant volcano, where players must navigate through a series of challenges to locate and infiltrate Dr. Saturday's secret laboratory. Gameplay Features: Exploration: Navigate through various static scenes, each filled with interactive hotspots and navigation arrows that guide movement. Puzzles: Encounter a variety of challenges, including connecting circuits to corresponding switches, deciphering cryptic clues, and manipulating objects to progress. Clue Collection: Gather hints and notes scattered throughout the environment, essential for solving subsequent puzzles. Atmosphere: Experience a minimalist design with grainy visuals and subtle sound effects, enhancing the game's immersive quality. The game is structured into multiple chapters, each offering a self-contained adventure while contributing to the overarching storyline. "Fire and Ice" serves as an introduction, presenting shorter puzzles to acclimate players to the game's mechanics. Subsequent episodes, such as "The Hidden Map," "The Alchemist's Notebook," "Closer to Zero," and "The Chemisphere," introduce more intricate challenges and expand upon the narrative.

name: Escape to Obion Episode 2: The Hidden Map
description: "Escape to Obion: Episode 2 – The Hidden Map" is the second installment in the "Escape to Obion" series, a collection of point-and-click adventure games known for their intricate puzzles and immersive narratives. In this episode, players continue their quest to thwart the nefarious Dr. Saturday by navigating through a series of complex challenges to uncover a concealed map essential for progressing in their mission. Gameplay Features: Exploration: Players navigate through various static scenes, each filled with interactive elements and navigation arrows that guide movement. Puzzles: The game presents a variety of challenges, including connecting circuits, deciphering cryptic clues, and manipulating objects to progress. Clue Collection: Hints and notes are scattered throughout the environment, essential for solving subsequent puzzles. Atmosphere: The game features a minimalist design with grainy visuals and subtle sound effects, enhancing the immersive experience. Despite the discontinuation of Adobe Flash Player, "Escape to Obion: Episode 2 – The Hidden Map" remains accessible through platforms that have preserved Flash games via emulation technologies.

name: Escaping The Prison
description: Overview: Escaping The Prison is a humorous point-and-click adventure game that challenges players to help a character named Henry Stickmin break out of prison. With a variety of choices and outcomes, the game is filled with quirky scenarios and entertaining animations. Gameplay Mechanics: Controls: Use the mouse to interact with the environment and make decisions. Players can click on different options to choose Henry's escape methods. Objective: Guide Henry through the prison escape by selecting from multiple choices, each leading to different outcomes—some successful, others hilariously disastrous. Multiple Endings: The game features numerous possible endings, encouraging players to experiment with different strategies and decisions to see all the outcomes. Visuals and Audio: Escaping The Prison features a simple yet charming art style, with colorful animations that enhance the humor and creativity of the game. The sound effects and playful background music complement the lighthearted tone. Target Audience: This game appeals to players of all ages, especially those who enjoy comedic storytelling and adventure games. Its engaging gameplay and humorous scenarios make it accessible and entertaining for both casual gamers and fans of interactive fiction. Platforms: Originally a Flash game, Escaping The Prison can now be found on various gaming sites that support HTML5 or Flash emulation, allowing players to enjoy it on desktops and laptops. Conclusion: With its clever humor and multiple pathways, Escaping The Prison invites players to think creatively and explore different escape strategies. Can you help Henry find the best way out?

name: ET Brain
description: Train your brain. Follow the instructions for every mini game.ET Brain is a collection of brain-training mini-games designed to challenge your cognitive abilities. These games are aimed at improving memory, focus, attention, and problem-solving skills. Key Features: Variety of Mini-Games: The game offers a diverse range of games, such as matching pairs, solving puzzles, and completing sequences. Progressive Difficulty: As you progress, the games become increasingly challenging, keeping you engaged and motivated. Track Your Progress: Monitor your performance over time and see how your cognitive skills improve. User-Friendly Interface: The game is easy to navigate and understand, making it accessible to players of all ages.

name: Euchre
description: Play North American Euchre or British Euchre. Try to win a Euchre game with 3 computer opponents. If you play you need to win 3 hands or more.Euchre is a classic trick-taking card game that involves strategy, bidding, and skillful card play. Key Features: Trick-Taking Gameplay: Players take turns playing cards, with the highest card in the suit led or the highest trump card winning the trick. Bidding Phase: Players bid on the right to choose the trump suit, which determines the highest-ranking cards in the game. Partnerships: Players form partnerships and work together to win tricks and score points. Strategic Play: Skillful card play and strategic thinking are essential to outsmart opponents and win the game. Scoring: Points are awarded based on the number of tricks won and whether a player goes "alone" (playing without a partner).

name: Euchre
description: Euchre is a trick-taking card game that I never learned how to play. So my review here will mostly concentrate on the aesthetics of this game rather than how well or poorly it reflects the traditional game that it virtually emulates. It looks like a card game, will well-drawn graphics, and there are a few options that can be set. There are different "modes" (I suppose like regional variants) which will subtly (?) adjust the rules of the game. Most features (except saving/loading and the "learn" mode which would've been helpful to me) are available in the shareware version.

name: Eulerian Graph
description: Overview: Eulerian Graph Adventure is a captivating puzzle game that introduces players to the concepts of graph theory, specifically Eulerian paths and circuits. Players explore various levels filled with challenges that require strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Key Features: Graph Theory Concepts: Learn about Eulerian paths, circuits, and the fundamental principles of graph theory as you progress through the game. Interactive Puzzles: Solve a variety of puzzles that involve traversing graphs, connecting nodes, and ensuring all edges are visited exactly once (for Eulerian paths) or returning to the starting point (for Eulerian circuits). Level Progression: Start with simple graphs and gradually face more complex challenges, each designed to reinforce your understanding of Eulerian principles. Visual Aids: Colorful graphics and animations illustrate graph structures, making it easier to visualize and understand the connections between nodes. Hints and Help: An integrated hint system offers assistance when players encounter challenging puzzles, guiding them without giving away the full solution. Conclusion: Eulerian Graph Adventure is a fun and educational game that makes learning about graph theory engaging and accessible. It’s perfect for students, math enthusiasts, and anyone looking to enhance their problem-solving skills through interactive gameplay. If you have any specific questions or need tips on solving puzzles, feel free to ask!

name: European Cities
description: Find all the differences in the European Cities. Click on a difference when you did locate it. Use the hint button (bottom right) for a hint.European Cities is a geography-based game that tests your knowledge of European cities. Key Features: Quiz Mode: Answer questions about European cities, such as their location, famous landmarks, or historical significance. Map Quiz: Identify cities on a map of Europe. Time Trials: Race against the clock to answer as many questions as possible. Multiple Difficulty Levels: Choose from easy, medium, and hard levels to suit your skill level. Learning Mode: Learn interesting facts about European cities and their cultures.

name: ev.io
description: Overview: ev.io is an exhilarating multiplayer first-person shooter set in a vibrant sci-fi universe. Combining fast-paced action with smooth mechanics, players engage in intense battles across various maps, utilizing a range of weapons and abilities. The game's focus on mobility and strategy creates a dynamic combat experience that keeps players on their toes. Gameplay Mechanics: Controls: Navigate using WASD or arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and utilize special abilities and weapons with designated keys. Game Modes: Engage in various modes, including team battles, free-for-all matches, and objective-based gameplay. Weapons and Abilities: Choose from an arsenal of weapons, including guns and melee options, while utilizing unique abilities like dashes and grappling hooks to enhance mobility. Power-ups: Collect power-ups scattered throughout the maps to gain temporary advantages, such as increased speed or enhanced damage. Visuals and Audio: ev.io features colorful and polished 3D graphics, with well-designed environments that range from futuristic cities to alien landscapes. The game is accompanied by dynamic sound effects and music that elevate the intensity of each match. Target Audience: This game caters to fans of competitive shooters and fast-paced action, appealing to both casual players and dedicated gamers looking for a thrilling multiplayer experience. Platforms: ev.io is playable in web browsers, making it easily accessible on various devices, including desktops, tablets, and smartphones. Conclusion: With its engaging gameplay and vibrant design, ev.io invites players to immerse themselves in a fast-paced shooter experience. Can you dominate the battlefield and prove your skills in this electrifying arena?

name: Evasive Maneuvers
description: A more laid-back shooting game, Evasive Maneuvers has you in control of your space ship, plowing through various high-tech themed levels, shooting and dropping bombs on various obstacles. You must continually collect fuel (by destroying fuel canisters) to keep flying, while avoiding or destroying everything else. (Though as the docs note, "Destroying an object can be more deadly than leaving the object alone." Cuz many will explode.) Decent graphics and sounds too. The authors of this game have made this formerly shareware game available for free!

name: Even More Bloons
description: Even More Bloons is a classic arcade-style game where you control a monkey armed with darts to pop colorful balloons that float across the screen. Key Features: Simple Controls: Use your mouse or keyboard to aim and shoot darts at the balloons. Increasing Difficulty: As you progress through the levels, the balloons become more numerous and challenging to pop. Power-Ups: Collect power-ups to gain special abilities, such as faster firing or stronger darts. Time Limits: Some levels have time limits, adding an extra layer of challenge and excitement. Addictive Gameplay: The game's simple yet engaging mechanics make it easy to pick up and play.

name: Everest: Iceman's Apprentice
description: Everest: Iceman's Apprentice is a mountaineering (mountain-climbing) simulator. It aims to approximate the experience of climbing a mountain, except without the physical toil and potential of falling to your doom. In the shareware version, you can climb one of two peaks (Rainier in Washington State, or Ama Dablam in Nepal). To progress, you choose which equipment your team should bring, where they should move to next, when they should set up camp, etc. I have absolutely no experience with mountaineering but this game doesn't make me want to start anytime soon. Although it features some high-res photos, the gameplay doesn't feel particularly engaging. Also, you don't even get to climb the game's namesake mountain Everest unless you're able to track down a registered copy!

name: Evets - The Ultimate Adventure
description: Evets - The Ultimate Adventure, is a presumptuously-named roguelike game that in many respects looks like others in the genre, but it manages to do things quite differently than you might think if you're expecting it to play just like Rogue or Nethack. You still have ASCII graphics and randomly generated dungeons. But here you assemble a party of up to four characters of your creation/choosing, each having a class (fighter, mage, thief, or priest) and stats that you also choose. Also fights are handled in a text-based RPG interface more commonly seen in traditional RPGs (where you are given a menu of options for each character such as fight, spell, item, etc). An interesting game with perhaps an overly elaborate party system yet gameplay that seems less robust and more simplistic overall once you get past the four-character party. (See the EVETS.MAN file for instructions.)

name: Evil Care Bears
description: Evil Care Bears (Flash) is a humorous and action-packed Flash game where players control an evil version of the popular Care Bears, who are on a mission to cause chaos and destruction. In this game, the once beloved and cuddly characters are turned into mischievous, villainous beings, and the gameplay involves navigating through different levels, defeating enemies, and completing various objectives. Evil Care Bears Characters: The game features classic Care Bears characters with a dark twist, turning the typically friendly bears into antagonistic figures. Each bear may have its own special abilities, like shooting energy beams, using magic, or other destructive powers. Action-Packed Gameplay: Players engage in fast-paced action, using their powers to fight enemies, destroy obstacles, and cause mayhem in various environments. Combat may involve jumping, shooting, or using special attacks to eliminate foes. Levels and Stages: The game features a series of progressively more challenging levels, where players will face different types of enemies, bosses, and objectives. Each stage may introduce new challenges, such as timed missions, platforming puzzles, or enemy hordes. Humor and Parody: The game plays with the familiar Care Bears franchise by turning its wholesome characters into villains, adding a layer of humor and parody to the experience. The tone of the game is lighthearted and comedic, with over-the-top actions and exaggerated character abilities. Power-Ups and Abilities: Players can collect power-ups that enhance their abilities or help in battle, such as invincibility, damage boosts, or extra health. Special abilities may include summoning dark magic, manipulating the environment, or causing explosions. Simple Controls: The game typically uses easy-to-learn controls, allowing players to jump, attack, and use special moves with a few keys or mouse clicks. This makes the game accessible to both casual and experienced players.

name: Evil Crypt
description: Evil Crypt (DOS) is a classic dungeon crawler adventure game that combines action, puzzle-solving, and exploration. Set in a dark, mysterious crypt, players must navigate through a series of dangerous levels filled with traps, monsters, and puzzles while seeking treasures and uncovering the secrets of the crypt. The game typically features turn-based gameplay with elements of strategy, making it challenging and engaging for players. Dungeon Exploration: The game features maze-like dungeons and crypts filled with traps, enemies, and hidden secrets. Players must explore different rooms, each with its own challenges and rewards. The environment is often dark and atmospheric, adding to the tension of navigating through the crypt. Turn-Based Combat: Players engage in turn-based combat against monsters, using weapons, magic, and tactics to defeat enemies. Each action, from attacking to defending, is performed in turns, requiring players to think ahead and strategize their moves carefully. Puzzle-Solving: The crypt contains various puzzles that players must solve to advance. These puzzles might involve finding hidden switches, unlocking doors, or deciphering cryptic messages or symbols to progress further into the game. Traps and Hazards: Players will encounter traps such as hidden spikes, poison darts, or collapsing floors, requiring careful navigation or the use of special items to avoid damage. Some traps can be disarmed or bypassed using specific items or skills. Items and Inventory Management: As players explore the crypt, they collect items like weapons, armor, potions, and keys. Managing inventory is key, as players must decide when and how to use these items to aid them in combat or puzzle-solving. Monsters and Boss Fights: The crypt is home to a variety of monsters, such as undead creatures, demons, and mystical beings. Powerful bosses may guard key areas of the crypt, and defeating them usually requires preparation and strategy. Character Progression: Players can often level up their character(s), improving stats like health, attack power, magic, and defense. Some versions of the game may include RPG elements where characters gain new abilities or spells as they progress through the dungeon.

name: Evolve! Lite
description: Evolve! Lite (the "Lite" indicating the shareware version) is a life simulation game / simulator where two different life forms vie for supremacy. Rather than controlling the life forms directly, you change the environmental conditions and the creatures' behavior. The latter is controlled via a 3x3 grid of different actions the creature takes in different situations. The game is pretty slickly produced with a nice user interface and a decent help system with a tutorial. This is really not my kind of game but if the topic interests you, you'll likely find this to be an interesting piece of software.

name: Excelsior Phase One: Lysandia
description: Excelsior is an innovative and in-depth RPG. It uses text-mode graphics with a custom character set, 2x1 tiles (your character and most objects are two characters wide) and even includes animated tiles. The story involves being a "Fixer" who travels between dimensions solving irregularities / problems as they occur. It plays like a typical old-style RPG, with turn-based battles, many items / weapons / armors / spells to acquire, and a huge world to explore.Excelsior Phase One: Lysandia (DOS) is a classic, space-themed adventure game with elements of strategy, exploration, and role-playing. Released during the early 90s, it combines space exploration with narrative-driven gameplay, where players explore the galaxy, interact with alien species, and engage in various quests. Set in a distant future, the game takes place in the world of Lysandia, where players must navigate both the political and physical challenges of an expansive interstellar environment.

name: Executioners
description: Definitely a unique game. This one is a fighting game along the lines of Final Fight or Double Dragon. It has great SVGA graphics (considering it was created in 1992!) and SB sound effects. It doesn't have a lot of replayability, but it would definitely be fun for fighting game fans. An ambitious project from the developer who would go on to create the infamous NESticle emulator which would become the watershed moment for video game emulation on PCs.Executioners (DOS) is a futuristic, action-oriented video game that mixes combat, strategy, and arcade-style gameplay. Set in a dystopian future, the game places players in the role of an executioner, tasked with eliminating targets in various high-stakes missions. The game is known for its intense combat and tactical challenges, where players must employ a mix of precision and strategy to succeed. Futuristic Dystopian Setting: The game takes place in a dystopian future, where players navigate through dark and oppressive environments, including cities, high-tech facilities, and urban sprawls. The world is filled with corrupt organizations, crime syndicates, and ruthless political figures, which the Executioner must deal with. Combat-Focused Gameplay: Executioners involves a combination of action and combat, where players use a variety of weapons and tools to take down enemies.
