Players can engage in close-quarters combat, use guns, or employ futuristic weapons to eliminate targets. Stealth and precision are often required, as players must deal with guards, cameras, and other security measures. Tactical Approach: While the game features action, it also encourages tactical thinking, such as positioning, timing, and decision-making. The player can choose whether to eliminate targets quietly or go in guns blazing, with each choice affecting the outcome of the mission. Level-Based Missions: The game is typically broken down into missions where the player must achieve specific objectives, such as infiltrating enemy bases, capturing or eliminating targets, or retrieving sensitive information. Each level increases in difficulty, introducing more complicated enemies, tougher security systems, and diverse mission goals. Weapons and Equipment: As the game progresses, the Executioner can acquire different weapons, gadgets, and tools that help in combat and completing objectives. These may include guns, melee weapons, explosives, hacking tools, and stealth equipment, each of which plays a role in achieving success during missions.

name: Exploding Atoms
description: Exploding Atoms is a game of reactions. Each player (or CPU if you play against the computer) takes turns placing their atoms on a grid. When a grid attains four atoms of the same color, it "explodes" sort of like viruses in the board game Pandemic: An explosion adds one atom to each cell around it, or changes the color of atoms in cells previously occupied by the opponent's pieces. It's an interesting puzzle game with simple graphics which seems to have been heavily "inspired" by a game of the same name created by a different Czech company a year earlier on the ZX Spectrum ... anyways it uses the mouse for choosing where to place atoms which works well. I don't know how much strategy there really is though, since deciding where exactly to place atoms and how all of the explosions will work seems quite difficult, especially later in the game where each turn it seems like most of the board changes color due to all of the explosions.

name: Extinct
description: Extinct (Flash) is a puzzle-based and strategy game with elements of platforming. In this Flash game, players are tasked with helping a small creature navigate through various challenging levels, utilizing clever thinking and precise actions to progress. The game features a unique narrative, where the main character is often caught in situations that require quick reflexes and problem-solving skills.Puzzle and Platforming Mechanics: Extinct (Flash) combines traditional platformer gameplay with puzzles that require the player to think ahead. Players must navigate the environment, avoid traps, and solve environmental puzzles in order to progress. Action and Timing: The game features timed sequences where players must act quickly to avoid dangers like falling objects, dangerous creatures, or traps. Precision and quick reflexes are important, as some levels require perfect timing to complete. Unique Character Design: The main character is usually a small, cartoonish creature, and the player must guide them through the levels. The character may have special abilities or tools that help them solve puzzles and defeat enemies. Challenging Obstacles: Each level introduces new obstacles, such as moving platforms, spikes, lava, and enemy creatures. Players must navigate these dangers carefully, making sure to time their jumps and actions to avoid harm. Environmental Puzzles: The game often requires players to interact with the environment, such as activating switches, avoiding hazards, or finding hidden paths that lead to the next stage. These puzzles may require the player to think critically about how to interact with the surroundings.

name: ExtPrint3r
description: ExtPrint3r is an exploit created by Blobby Boi with the goal of being the successor to ExtHang3r. The exploit recreates the behavior of the LTMEAT Print method by flooding iframes and then printing the page. For whatever reason, printing a page with a ton of iframes hangs the embedded page rather than the page who embedded it. This is exactly what ExtPrint3r exploits, since it also works with extension pages (as long they are under web_accessible_resources). This seems to be much more consistent than other extension-freezing methods, and it also lasts for a longer period of time.

name: Extreme Billiards
description: Remove all balls from the chain. Shoot balls in the chain and get 3 or more of the same connected balls.Extreme Billiards (HTML) is an exciting and fast-paced pool game with enhanced gameplay mechanics and features. Unlike traditional billiards or pool games, Extreme Billiards incorporates a variety of dynamic elements, such as challenging game modes, different table designs, and additional power-ups, making it a more engaging and action-packed experience for players. Multiple Game Modes: Extreme Billiards includes a range of pool game modes, including the popular 8-ball, 9-ball, and straight pool. Some versions may also introduce time-limited challenges, where players must pot balls within a certain timeframe, or tournament modes, where you compete against AI or other players. Dynamic Table Design: The game offers customizable tables, with different themes and layouts for added variety and excitement. Some versions of the game may have moving pockets or additional obstacles on the table, making the gameplay more unpredictable and challenging. Power-Ups and Special Abilities: In Extreme Billiards, players can unlock or use special power-ups that can affect gameplay, such as improving ball control, slowing down time, or making the cue ball behave in unique ways. These power-ups can be activated at key moments to gain an advantage over opponents or enhance personal performance during tricky shots. Realistic Physics and Controls: The game features realistic physics for ball movement, simulating the way billiard balls interact with each other and the pockets on the table. Players control the angle and strength of their shots using a drag-and-release mechanism, offering precision when aiming and shooting. Single-Player and Multiplayer Modes: Extreme Billiards offers both single-player and multiplayer modes, allowing you to either challenge AI opponents or play against friends in local or online multiplayer. Players can take turns in 2-player mode, where each player alternates their shots until one wins. Challenging AI Opponents: For single-player modes, Extreme Billiards features a variety of AI opponents that increase in difficulty as the player progresses. The AI can be programmed to challenge even the most skilled players, adding an extra layer of depth to the game.

name: Extreme Blocks
description: Create horizontal, vertical or diagonal lines with the lines on the falling blocks. Create lines of 3 or more in length to remove them. Remove as many lines as the indicated goal to advance to the next level. Touch a block to rotate it, touch a column to move the block and swipe a block down. You can also use the controls to the right of the playing area.Extreme Blocks (HTML) is an exciting and fast-paced puzzle game that combines elements of match-3 and block elimination gameplay. In this game, players are tasked with clearing blocks from the screen by matching them based on color or other patterns, while overcoming progressively more challenging obstacles and situations. It offers a vibrant and addictive gaming experience with multiple levels and fast-paced action. Block Matching Gameplay: Players must match at least three blocks of the same color (or other types of patterns depending on the version) to eliminate them from the grid. The more blocks you match in a single move, the higher your score. Challenging Levels: Extreme Blocks features multiple levels of increasing difficulty. As you advance, the puzzles become more complex, with the grid becoming more crowded or additional rules and obstacles being introduced. Some levels may require the player to clear the grid within a set number of moves or within a time limit. Power-ups and Special Abilities: Players can use special power-ups that help clear blocks, such as bombs, lightning strikes, or other grid-clearing tools. These power-ups are usually earned by matching larger groups of blocks or by completing difficult puzzles. Vibrant and Colorful Graphics: The game features bright, colorful blocks and visually engaging effects that make it more visually appealing. The designs are simple yet stylish, enhancing the enjoyment of solving the puzzles. Time-Limited and Move-Limited Challenges: In some modes, players are required to clear a certain number of blocks within a specific time limit, adding an extra layer of pressure and excitement. In other cases, the player is limited by the number of moves they can make, making strategic planning crucial to success. Increasing Difficulty: As players progress through levels, the game introduces new challenges, such as new block types or more crowded grids, which increase the difficulty. Some levels might have obstacles like locked blocks or ones that can only be eliminated in specific ways, requiring the player to think ahead.

name: Extreme Pinball
description: If you enjoyed Epic Pinball, you will also likely enjoy and appreciate Extreme Pinball, which uses the same engine. Released approximately two years after their earlier (and more well-known) games, Extreme Pinball was also released for the Sony Playstation. In this demo version, you get the "Rock Fantasy" table, which is one of the four tables included in the full version of the game. The action is fast-paced (perhaps slightly too fast at times) but I guess that's what makes it EXTREME! (The 90's were all about extreme-ness.) Generally good graphics and a rockin soundtrack make this a fun pinball game to play, even if the physics aren't the most accurate.

name: Extreme Vexed
description: Your goal is to move similar blocks together to remove those blocks. Remove all blocks to advance to the next level. Drag blocks to an empty spot to move them.Extreme Vexed (HTML) is an engaging and challenging puzzle game that revolves around matching and clearing blocks from a grid. It’s a modern twist on the classic "Vexed" puzzle genre, with enhanced graphics, more challenging levels, and a variety of obstacles and mechanics to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. The goal is to clear all the blocks from the screen by grouping them based on color or pattern, while navigating through different levels with increasing difficulty. Block Matching Gameplay: The core of the game involves selecting groups of two or more adjacent blocks of the same color to remove them from the grid. Players can only select connected blocks, making it a puzzle of strategy and spatial awareness. Challenging Levels: The game features multiple levels, each with unique configurations of blocks that require different strategies to clear. As you progress, the levels become more complex, introducing more obstacles, special block types, and limited moves or time challenges. Special Blocks and Obstacles: Extreme Vexed introduces special blocks that add variety and challenge to the gameplay. For example, there may be blocks that can’t be removed unless certain conditions are met or obstacles that prevent certain areas from being cleared. Players must think critically about which blocks to remove first in order to strategically clear the grid. Power-ups: Some versions of the game feature power-ups that help players clear difficult sections of the grid, such as bombs or color-changers that allow for more flexibility in matching blocks. These power-ups can be used strategically to clear large clusters of blocks or to remove challenging obstacles. Timer and Move Limit Challenges: In some levels, players are given time limits or move limits to clear the grid, adding an extra layer of urgency and difficulty. These time-based or move-based challenges encourage faster thinking and planning.

name: F-Tetris
description: F-Tetris is a fairly typical Tetris game which provides a few options you can set which may improve your experience. As with the original game, blocks fall down the well, and you need to complete lines to remove them. Options include speed, level, sound, controls, and difficulty ... which includes a "Bastard!" difficultly level which intentionally tries to prevent you from getting the pieces you need. (But we all think Tetris does this anyways right? "C'mon I just need a straight piece!")F-Tetris (DOS) is a variation of the classic Tetris puzzle game, developed for the DOS platform. It retains the core mechanics of the original Tetris, where players must manipulate falling tetrominoes (blocks made of four connected squares) to fit them together and clear lines on a grid. However, F-Tetris may introduce additional features or changes, making it a unique take on the beloved puzzle game.

name: Faces...tris III
description: Faces...tris III (or as it's more commonly known, FacesTris or FaceTris) is the third in the "tris" series of games (following Tetris and Welltris, or possibly the fourth if Hatris is included) designed by Alexey Pajitnov. Like the other games, pieces fall down into the well, and you need to maneuver them, however here the goal is to create faces, comprised of the chin, mouth, nose, and top. Ideally you want to compose faces using pieces of the same faces, but you can combine pieces to make weird hybrid faces (you just get fewer points).

name: FaceTrex
description: FaceTrex is a block-sliding puzzle game which plays quite similarly to Soleau's earlier game Alpha Man. Again here you are pushing sliding blocks, but rather than spelling a word, you just need to get the "face blocks" onto their matching "face tiles". You'll need to carefully plan your moves so that none of your blocks get trapped. Thankfully you have unlimited retries and the levels can be restarted instantly. The game comes with a total of 25 levels for you to try; the first levels aren't too tough but, like many Soleau games, as you progress the levels get rather difficult! (At least, for me they are!)

name: Factory Balls
description: Factory Balls (Flash) is a popular puzzle game that challenges players to use logic and creativity to create specific patterns on balls by following a series of instructions. The game combines elements of color-matching, pattern creation, and problem-solving. It features a factory setting where the goal is to produce balls with the exact specifications given for each level, using a variety of tools and actions available in the game. Color and Pattern Creation: The main objective is to replicate the target ball design shown at the top of the screen. The player must manipulate a plain white ball by using different colors and patterns, applying the correct actions to match the desired look. The game often requires players to layer various colors on the ball or apply other transformations, making it a puzzle of trial and error combined with logic. Multiple Tools: Players can use several tools to manipulate the balls. These tools might include paintbrushes, rollers, water, and cutting machines to create the right combination of colors, shapes, and patterns. Each tool can be used in a specific order to gradually build up the correct ball design. Challenging Puzzles: As players progress through levels, the puzzles become more difficult, with more complex designs to replicate. Some levels require the player to work with more limited tools or fewer steps, testing their efficiency and ability to think ahead. Simple and Relaxing Mechanics: The gameplay is straightforward but requires critical thinking. The player clicks and drags the balls through the various machines and tools, creating new layers and shapes with each action. The controls are easy to learn, with the challenge coming from finding the correct sequence of actions to achieve the goal.

name: Factory Balls 2
description: Factory Balls 2 (Flash) is the sequel to the popular puzzle game Factory Balls. It retains the same basic gameplay mechanics as the original, but with new challenges, tools, and puzzles that make it even more engaging. The game builds on the formula of creating customized balls by combining various actions, adding a layer of complexity with new mechanics and more intricate designs to replicate. New Tools and Actions: Factory Balls 2 introduces new tools and machines that expand on the mechanics from the first game. Players now have more options for modifying the ball, such as different kinds of paints, machines that shape the ball, or tools that add unique effects. Each level requires using these tools in the correct order to achieve the desired outcome, making the puzzles more interesting and varied. Challenging and Creative Puzzles: The game’s difficulty gradually increases as you progress through the levels. The patterns become more intricate, requiring more steps and more tools to solve. The puzzles challenge your creativity and problem-solving skills as you try to figure out the most efficient way to replicate the target design. Sequential Actions: The core mechanic of the game is figuring out the right sequence of actions to transform the ball into the exact design shown in the target. Players must use tools in a specific order to paint, cut, and shape the ball correctly. The challenge comes in knowing what needs to be done first and what can be done later. No Time Pressure: Like the first game, Factory Balls 2 does not impose any time limits, allowing players to take their time to figure out each puzzle. This makes the game relaxing and gives players the freedom to experiment with different strategies and combinations without the stress of a countdown. Visual and Audio Enhancements: Factory Balls 2 builds on the original’s cute, colorful art style, with bright, playful visuals and satisfying animations. The sound effects are whimsical and add to the light-hearted, fun atmosphere of the game.

name: Factory Balls 3
description: Factory Balls 3 (Flash) is the third installment in the Factory Balls puzzle game series, which continues to challenge players with more intricate ball customization puzzles. Like its predecessors, the core gameplay revolves around creating balls that match a target design using various tools and machines. Factory Balls 3 introduces even more complex puzzles, new tools, and additional mechanics to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. New Tools and Machines: Factory Balls 3 introduces new tools that were not present in the previous games, such as machine rollers, cutting devices, and new paint colors that add even more variety to the puzzles. The addition of new machines or modifiers that affect the shape or design of the balls challenges the player to think creatively about how to combine the tools in a specific order. Challenging Puzzles: The game’s puzzles become more complex as players progress, requiring a greater understanding of how to sequence actions and use tools efficiently. Some puzzles may require players to use the tools in non-obvious ways, encouraging out-of-the-box thinking. Sequential Actions: Like the previous games, players must perform sequential actions in a specific order to create the target ball design. For instance, they might need to paint a ball, cut part of it, then paint it again, or use multiple machines to adjust the ball's shape or color until it matches the target. Trial and Error: Factory Balls 3 encourages trial and error gameplay. Players will often need to experiment with different combinations of tools and processes to figure out the correct order of actions. The absence of time limits means players can take their time experimenting with different approaches until they find the right one.

name: Factory Balls 4
description: Factory Balls 4 is the fourth installment in the beloved Factory Balls puzzle game series, continuing the tradition of creating customized balls through logical thinking and problem-solving. Like its predecessors, the goal is to replicate a target ball design using various tools and machines, but Factory Balls 4 introduces even more complex puzzles, new tools, and additional features that keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. New Tools and Machines: Factory Balls 4 introduces new tools and machines that add depth and variety to the puzzle mechanics. For example, there are new methods to paint or shape the ball, creating opportunities for even more intricate designs. Some new machines allow players to create multiple effects in a single step, which adds an additional layer of complexity to the game. More Complex Puzzles: As in earlier games, Factory Balls 4 ramps up the difficulty with each level. The puzzles become more intricate and require more strategic thinking to figure out how to use the available tools in the correct sequence. The designs to replicate become more detailed, often involving more colors, layers, and shapes, challenging players to think creatively. Additional Mechanics: The game introduces additional mechanics, such as changing ball shapes or mixing multiple colors, which were not present in the previous games. Some puzzles may require the player to use more advanced tactics, such as painting and shaping the ball in a specific order to achieve the target design. No Time Pressure: Factory Balls 4 continues the series' tradition of no time limits, allowing players to take their time and experiment with different solutions. This makes the game relaxing and stress-free, allowing for an enjoyable experience where the focus is on creativity and problem-solving.

name: Fairy Godmom
description: This is definitely a unique puzzle game. In it you play a fairy godmother ("Woah, couldn't have figured that out on my own", you say) who must collect magic coins on each board while avoiding killer crabs. (!?!) Anywho, the idea is to use your magic wand to "copy" objects and create them elsewhere to allow you to progress. (It makes sense when you actually play the game. Well, not the evil crabs stuff, but the magic wand stuff.) Neat game. (It used to be listed here as "Fairy Godmother" but that full title isn't used in the game itself.)

name: Fairy Triple Mahjong
description: Match 3 of the same Mahjong tiles. Move tiles to the top free cells. If you have 3 of the same tiles then those tiles are removed.Fairy Triple Mahjong (HTML) is a variation of the classic Mahjong Solitaire game with a unique twist. The game follows the same basic rules as traditional Mahjong Solitaire but introduces additional mechanics to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. The most prominent feature of Fairy Triple Mahjong is that it uses triple matching instead of the usual pair matching, which adds a higher level of challenge and strategy. Triple Tile Matching: Unlike traditional Mahjong Solitaire, where you match pairs of tiles, Fairy Triple Mahjong requires players to match three identical tiles to remove them from the board. This change adds an additional layer of complexity, as players need to plan their moves carefully to ensure they can find three matching tiles and avoid getting stuck with unmatchable tiles. Traditional Mahjong Layout: The game maintains the classic Mahjong layout, which typically consists of several layers of tiles arranged in a pyramid or other complex shapes. The tiles are visually stacked and can be selected from the edges or open areas of the stack. Beautiful Visual Design: Fairy Triple Mahjong features a colorful and attractive theme with fairy tale-like graphics. The tiles themselves are designed with a magical or whimsical theme, including images of flowers, creatures, and other elements that tie into the fantasy atmosphere. The background and animations enhance the enchanting vibe of the game, making it a visually appealing experience. Tile Removal and Strategy: To remove tiles, players must find three identical tiles that are either free or located on the outer edges of the layout. Strategic thinking is essential, as players must not only match the tiles but also keep track of the layout to avoid leaving isolated tiles that are difficult to match later on. Game Objective: The main goal is to remove all tiles from the board by matching sets of three identical tiles. To succeed, players must carefully scan the board, plan their moves, and strategically remove tiles in order to clear the board completely. Undo and Hints: Many Mahjong games, including Fairy Triple Mahjong, offer an undo button to allow players to reverse their last move, as well as hint options to show possible matches. These features help guide players if they are stuck, though using them sparingly adds to the challenge. Relaxing Gameplay: As a puzzle game, Fairy Triple Mahjong provides a relaxing experience without time limits, allowing players to play at their own pace. The focus is on problem-solving, pattern recognition, and careful planning. Difficulty Levels: The game may offer different levels of difficulty, where the layout and number of tiles may vary. Harder levels may feature more complex tile arrangements, requiring more advanced strategies to clear the board.

name: Fairy Word Search
description: Find all the hidden words on the grid. Drag to select a word. Fairy Word Search (HTML) is a fun and magical twist on the classic word search puzzle game. In this version, players are tasked with finding hidden words related to a fairy tale or magical theme, which enhances the overall experience. The gameplay remains faithful to traditional word search rules, but the enchanting atmosphere and themed vocabulary make it a unique and enjoyable experience. Fairy Tale-Themed Vocabulary: The words to be found are inspired by fairy tales, magic, and mythical creatures, such as fairy, wizard, unicorn, and castle. This theme adds a fun and whimsical twist to the usual word search format, making it more engaging for players who enjoy fantasy and fairy tale stories. Relaxing and Engaging Gameplay: Fairy Word Search is a relaxing and enjoyable puzzle game that doesn't impose time limits or strict penalties. Players can take their time searching for words, making it an ideal choice for those looking for a stress-free gaming experience. The game can be played at a casual pace, allowing players to savor the theme while solving the puzzles. Multiple Difficulty Levels: Depending on the game version, Fairy Word Search might feature multiple difficulty levels, such as easy, medium, and hard. Higher difficulty levels might feature larger grids and more challenging words to find. In easier levels, the words might be placed in straightforward horizontal or vertical lines, while harder levels might involve more complex word placements, including diagonal and backward words. Colorful and Magical Theme: The game features bright and colorful graphics, often with a magical background and fairy tale-inspired visuals. This could include imagery like enchanted forests, castles, fairy wings, and sparkling effects, which add to the immersive, whimsical experience. The words are often set against these enchanting backdrops, making the game visually engaging and appealing. Dynamic Grid: The word search grid is dynamic and can be of varying sizes, typically from 10x10 to 20x20 squares. The number of words and their difficulty depends on the size of the grid and the game level. Some versions of the game might allow players to adjust the grid size to suit their preference or difficulty level.

name: Falcon 3.0
description: Falcon 3.0 is a F-16 flight simulator game that sold over 700,000 copies by the end of the 90's. As you might expect, it simulates flying a F-16 fighter jet, and you get to do a lot of shooting, taking down enemy planes. The game's own promotion extols its greatness as being the best F-16 sim at the time, and certainly it was loved by fans of the genre, despite its many bugs. (It was considered a very buggy game.) If you are a fan of flight sims, definitely check it out. (I'm relying mostly on what other people have said since I don't really play these kinds of games myself!)

name: Fall-Zone II
description: Fall-Zone II (sometimes just Fall-Zone in the executable) is a simple game where the object is to collect hearts on the single-screen playing field. Mines constantly (and randomly) fall, and you'll need to plan your route carefully to avoid them. There are also a couple powerups on the map that you'll need to use to temporarily remove some mines. The graphics are very simple but they get the job done. It's a unique game that could be fun to play in short bursts, primarily due to the randomness of the levels. (For an easier game, press the F1 key on the menu to change the option from continual drops of mines, to only dropping mines each time you move.)

name: Falldown
description: Falldown (Flash) is a classic and simple yet addictive arcade-style game where the player controls a ball or character that falls down a vertically scrolling screen. The objective is to avoid obstacles and keep the ball from hitting the top of the screen. The game is fast-paced and requires quick reflexes and strategic movement to survive as long as possible. Endless Falling Gameplay: The core gameplay of Falldown involves the ball constantly falling down the screen. The objective is to stay alive for as long as possible by moving the ball left and right to avoid obstacles and to land in the gaps between them. The game becomes increasingly fast as time progresses, requiring the player to think quickly and move the ball with precision. Simple Controls: The controls in Falldown are typically simple and intuitive. Players can use the left and right arrow keys or the mouse to move the ball across the screen. The challenge comes from maintaining control over the ball while avoiding getting trapped by the platforms or objects in the way. Avoiding Obstacles: The game features different types of obstacles that block the ball’s descent. The goal is to avoid these obstacles by moving the ball between open gaps. If the ball hits a platform or obstacle, the game is over, and the player must start again. Increasing Speed: As the game progresses, the speed at which the ball falls increases, making it more challenging to navigate the platforms and find gaps. The player needs to react quickly to avoid obstacles and keep the ball from getting stuck at the top of the screen. The faster pace tests both reflexes and the ability to stay calm under pressure. Score Tracking: The game typically includes a scoring system based on how long the player survives or how many gaps they successfully navigate. Falldown often features a high score system, encouraging players to keep playing in an effort to beat their previous record. Power-Ups and Bonuses: In some versions of the game, there are power-ups that can aid the player, such as slowing down the falling speed or temporarily providing more room for movement. These power-ups add an extra layer of strategy and can help players survive longer.

name: Falldown 2
description: Falldown 2 (Flash) is a sequel to the original Falldown game, offering enhanced gameplay and new features while retaining the core mechanics that made the first game popular. In this updated version, the goal remains the same—navigate a falling ball through a series of gaps in platforms to avoid obstacles and stay alive. However, Falldown 2 introduces new twists, power-ups, and improvements to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. Enhanced Gameplay: Falldown 2 builds upon the original concept, with more intricate platform arrangements and a greater variety of obstacles to navigate. The game introduces new types of platforms with different behaviors, such as moving or disappearing platforms, which increase the challenge and require more precise timing. Power-Ups and Bonuses: Unlike the original, Falldown 2 includes several power-ups that can help the player survive longer. These may include: Speed boosts: Temporarily slow down the falling speed of the ball. Expanded ball size: Makes it easier to land in gaps and avoid obstacles. Invincibility: Makes the ball immune to obstacles for a short period. These power-ups add a strategic layer, allowing players to plan when and how to use them for maximum benefit. Improved Graphics: Falldown 2 features enhanced visuals compared to its predecessor. The background may include more dynamic and detailed environments, such as animated elements or more vibrant colors. The ball and platform designs are also more polished, making the game visually appealing while still keeping the minimalist style that defines the Falldown series. Increased Difficulty and Speed: As players progress, the falling speed of the ball increases, and the gaps between platforms become narrower. The pace intensifies, requiring quicker reflexes and better timing to avoid getting trapped. The game gets progressively harder, challenging players to keep up with the increasing speed while managing new types of obstacles and platform behavior. New Obstacles and Platform Types: Falldown 2 introduces a variety of new obstacles, such as moving platforms, sticky platforms that slow down the ball, and disappearing tiles that can suddenly vanish, leaving the player with fewer options. These new features add variety to the gameplay, requiring players to adapt their strategy for each level or challenge. Simple Controls: The control system remains easy to grasp—usually involving the left and right arrow keys (or mouse control, depending on the version) to move the ball horizontally. The simplicity of the controls ensures the game remains accessible to players of all ages while still offering a challenging experience. High Score Tracking: Like the original Falldown, Falldown 2 includes a high score system, where players can compete to achieve the best score. This encourages repeated play and improvement as players try to surpass their previous records.

name: Falling Candy
description: Drop down candy and get 3 or more of the same candy in a row.Falling Candy (HTML) is a fun and colorful casual game where the goal is to catch falling candies and avoid obstacles. The game involves quick reflexes and precise movements as you control a character or basket to catch the candy while ensuring it doesn't hit obstacles or fall off the screen. Simple and Addictive Gameplay: The game is easy to pick up, with simple controls—usually left and right arrow keys or mouse movement to control the basket or character. The objective is to catch falling candies while avoiding any obstacles. The fast-paced nature of the game makes it addictive, as players strive to improve their score by catching more candies. Increasing Difficulty: As the game progresses, the speed at which candies fall increases, making it harder to react in time. The candy fall rate gradually picks up, increasing the challenge. In some versions, obstacles may be introduced that the player must avoid. These obstacles could be things like rocks or non-candy objects that fall alongside the candies. Special Candies and Power-ups: Special candies might occasionally fall that give the player extra points, a speed boost, or even the ability to slow down the falling speed temporarily. These bonuses add a strategic element to the game. Power-ups can help improve the player's performance or make it easier to catch candies for a short period. Colorful and Fun Theme: The game typically features bright, colorful graphics with candies in various shapes and colors, such as lollipops, gummies, and chocolates. The backgrounds are often designed to create a playful, sweet-themed atmosphere, adding to the fun and relaxing experience. Progressive Levels and Scoring: Players are rewarded for catching as many candies as possible, with the score displayed on the screen. The more candies caught, the higher the score. Some versions of the game introduce levels, where after a certain number of successful catches, the player advances to a new, more challenging level with faster falling candies or more obstacles. Simple Controls: The controls in Falling Candy are straightforward, allowing players to move the basket or character left and right with the arrow keys or mouse to position it under the falling candies. The simplicity makes it accessible to players of all ages, from children to adults. Casual and Relaxing: While Falling Candy can become challenging, its casual pace and simple gameplay mechanics make it an ideal choice for players looking for a quick, stress-free gaming session. There are no time limits or complex objectives, allowing players to enjoy the game at their own pace.

name: Falling Sudoku
description: Drop down tiles and place according to the Sudoku rules. A number may only appear once in every row, column or 3x3 area.Falling Sudoku (HTML) is an engaging twist on the classic Sudoku puzzle game, combining traditional number placement with falling elements to create a dynamic and exciting challenge. This version of Sudoku introduces falling tiles or blocks containing numbers, and players must strategically place them in the correct spots on the Sudoku grid, while keeping the grid organized and solving the puzzle. Dynamic Falling Numbers: Numbers fall from the top of the screen, and the player must move and place them into the correct cells of the Sudoku grid before they "land" or stack up. This adds a timed element to the gameplay, requiring quick thinking and strategy to solve the puzzle before the grid becomes overwhelmed. Sudoku Rules with a Twist: While the core Sudoku rules are the same, the addition of falling numbers requires players to make faster decisions and think ahead about where to place the numbers, rather than simply filling in spaces at their own pace. Increasing Difficulty: As the game progresses, the falling numbers may speed up, making it more difficult to place them in the right spots on the grid. The difficulty can also increase with more challenging Sudoku puzzles (e.g., harder grids with fewer numbers initially filled in). Control Mechanics: Players can typically move the falling numbers left or right across the grid by using the arrow keys or mouse, and drop them into the correct position. The number blocks may fall automatically or can be manually controlled to "drop" faster if needed, adding a sense of urgency to the game. Timed or Unlimited Mode: Falling Sudoku can feature timed gameplay, where players need to solve the puzzle within a certain time limit, or it could have an unlimited mode for a more relaxed experience. Some versions may introduce a timer that starts ticking down once the numbers begin to fall.

name: Fallout
description: Fallout (no relation to the popular Interplay/Bethesda developed series of RPGs) is a decent-looking variant of the Tetris / Columns style game. It plays mostly like Columns, except that you can both change the order of the three falling blocks, and also switch the triad's orientation from vertical to horizontal. The level setting changes the game's speed, while the difficulty setting chooses how many different colors/patterns are in play, with more of course making the game harder. Fallout (DOS) is the original Fallout game, released in 1997, which started the iconic Fallout series. The game is a post-apocalyptic role-playing game (RPG) set in a world devastated by nuclear war. It combines elements of turn-based combat, exploration, questing, and character development in a richly detailed, open-world environment. Turn-Based Combat: The combat in Fallout is turn-based, meaning players and enemies take turns to perform actions during a battle. Players can attack with various weapons (melee, ranged), use special items, or even talk their way out of situations if their Speech skill is high enough. The V.A.T.S. (Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System), introduced in later games, is not present in the first game, but players can still strategize using the action points system to decide how many actions to perform in one turn. Character Creation and Development: The game features a detailed character creation system, where players can choose from several attributes (Strength, Perception, Endurance, Charisma, Intelligence, Agility, and Luck). These stats affect various aspects of gameplay, from combat effectiveness to the success of dialogue options. As the player progresses, they can also level up and choose new Perks, which give the player special abilities or bonuses, such as better combat skills, resistance to radiation, or enhanced speech abilities. Open-Ended Exploration: Fallout allows players to explore the wasteland, which is made up of a series of interconnected locations, including towns, underground bunkers, and radioactive ruins. The player can choose their path—whether it's to follow the main quest or engage in side quests that can affect the overall story and the player's relationships with different factions and NPCs. Faction Interactions: Throughout the game, players will encounter various factions, such as the Brotherhood of Steel, Raiders, and Super Mutants, each with their own goals and values. How the player interacts with these factions can influence their progression in the game and determine different outcomes, including which factions become allies or enemies. Narrative Choices: The game offers a high degree of player choice in how to solve problems. Players can talk to NPCs, engage in combat, or complete quests in different ways. The consequences of these choices can have a lasting impact on the story, such as affecting the fate of settlements or altering the political landscape of the post-apocalyptic world.

name: Fallout: Vault Dash
description: A fallout themed version of the classic arcade game frogger.Fallout: Vault Dash (Flash) is a fast-paced, strategy-based Flash game set in the Fallout universe. It is a part of the Vault-Tec brand experience, offering players a chance to manage and build their own Vault while dealing with various challenges from the wasteland. Unlike the traditional Fallout RPG games, Vault Dash focuses on quick decision-making, resource management, and tactical gameplay in real-time. Vault Management: The player’s main task is to manage a Vault by assigning Vault dwellers to various tasks. Each dweller has different skills and abilities, which should be utilized wisely to keep the Vault running smoothly. The player must oversee food, water, electricity, and other vital resources, balancing production and consumption while keeping the Vault running efficiently. Real-Time Strategy: Unlike traditional turn-based Fallout games, Vault Dash is played in real-time, requiring the player to act quickly and strategically. Players need to manage multiple tasks at once, assigning dwellers to tasks, monitoring resource levels, and dealing with potential hazards, such as radroaches, raiders, or other random events. Resource Management: Food, water, and electricity are the primary resources that need to be monitored and replenished regularly. Vault dwellers are assigned to different rooms (e.g., power plants, water treatment facilities, or food production areas) to ensure the Vault is self-sufficient. Failure to manage resources leads to dissatisfaction among the dwellers or even the collapse of the Vault. Building and Expanding the Vault: The game allows players to expand their Vault by constructing new rooms, upgrading facilities, and accommodating more Vault dwellers. Players can also customize the Vault layout to optimize resource production and ensure that all areas are functional. Challenges and Random Events: Random events play a significant role in Vault Dash, adding an extra layer of excitement and unpredictability. Events such as attacks by raiders, radroach infestations, or Vault dweller panic can disrupt your operations, and players must react quickly to resolve these issues. Some challenges may require strategic planning, such as assigning the right people to fix a problem or crafting specific items to mitigate an event. Upgrades and Progression: As players progress through the game, they can unlock new upgrades for their Vault and special abilities for their Vault dwellers. By managing resources efficiently and surviving various challenges, players can increase their Vault's size and unlock new, advanced rooms and features that help to improve their Vault's capabilities.

name: Family Crisis
description: Family Crisis (Flash) is a fun, fast-paced puzzle game that involves managing and solving various family-related challenges in a timely manner. The game is set in a humorous and light-hearted environment where the player must help different family members with their daily needs and avoid chaos. Multiple Family Members: The game revolves around different family members, each of whom has specific needs that must be met. This includes tasks like feeding the baby, helping children with homework, doing household chores, etc. The player must prioritize tasks and balance their time to ensure no family member is neglected, or else they could become upset. Timed Gameplay: Family Crisis is a time-based game where the player must complete tasks within a set amount of time. Players must act quickly, deciding which family member to attend to first and how best to allocate their time to keep everyone happy. Task Management: Family members may ask for different things at the same time, like food, attention, or help with homework. The player has to quickly decide which task to handle first and how to manage the household efficiently. Resource management comes into play as players must balance the needs of multiple people in the household, preventing chaos. Challenges and Increasing Difficulty: As the game progresses, the difficulty increases with more family members, higher demands, and more complex tasks. The challenges get tougher as you need to balance more things at once, and failing to take care of family members on time will lead to frustration and potentially losing the game. Humorous and Fun Art Style: The game uses a cartoonish, light-hearted art style, creating a family-friendly atmosphere that adds humor to the chaos of managing a household. Characters are designed to be fun and exaggerated, with quirky personalities that reflect the typical chaos of family life. Reward System: Completing tasks successfully and keeping the family happy earns you points or rewards, which can be used to unlock new levels or features. High scores are often tracked, providing additional incentive for players to improve their performance and manage the family more efficiently.

name: Family Guy: Save the Couch!
description: Family Guy: Save the Couch! (Flash) is an action-packed, time-based Flash game inspired by the popular animated television series, Family Guy. The game revolves around the antics of the Griffin family, where the player must help the characters protect their beloved couch from various obstacles and dangers, all while dealing with the usual humorous chaos of the show's universe. Protecting the Couch: The primary objective is to protect the couch from being damaged or stolen by various obstacles. Players must ensure that no one damages the couch while keeping the environment in order. Objects like TV remotes, furniture, or other random obstacles may appear, and you must act quickly to prevent them from causing trouble. Character Abilities: Players can control various members of the Griffin family, each with their own special abilities. For example: Peter Griffin might use brute strength to stop hazards. Lois Griffin could use her quick reflexes to block certain objects. Stewie Griffin might employ his intelligence to outsmart certain dangers. Each character's ability can be used to protect the couch in unique ways, requiring players to switch between them based on the situation. Time-Based Gameplay: The game is time-sensitive, with challenges increasing as the clock ticks down. You must act quickly to save the couch and prevent things from escalating into a disaster. As time progresses, the hazards get more intense, requiring faster responses and better management of the Griffin family members. Humorous Situations: True to the Family Guy spirit, the game includes humorous situations and references from the show, with quirky events and characters popping up to add extra challenges. Players can expect to deal with family antics and other comedic scenarios that reflect the absurdity of the show’s world. Simple Controls: The game typically uses simple point-and-click mechanics or keyboard controls to switch between family members, direct actions, and interact with the environment. The user interface is intuitive, making it easy for both casual players and fans of the show to jump in and start playing. Multiple Levels and Increasing Difficulty: The game features multiple levels, with each level bringing in more complex scenarios to protect the couch. The difficulty ramps up as the player progresses, introducing more obstacles and demanding faster reaction times.

name: Famous Logo Mahjong
description: Mahjong Solitaire game featuring Famous Logos. Remove all tiles by combining two of the same tiles.Famous Logo Mahjong is a fun and engaging tile-matching puzzle game that challenges players to pair iconic brand logos. The game combines the timeless appeal of Mahjong with a modern twist, featuring globally recognized logos from various industries. Test your memory and visual skills as you clear the board by matching identical logo tiles before the timer runs out. Key Features: Iconic Logos: Match tiles featuring logos from famous brands, making the game familiar and exciting for players of all ages. Challenging Levels: Progress through multiple levels of increasing difficulty with unique layouts. Timed Mode: Beat the clock to earn high scores, adding an element of strategy and urgency. Simple Controls: Tap or click to match tiles, making it easy to play on both desktop and mobile devices. Stylish Graphics: Enjoy sleek visuals and smooth animations that enhance the gaming experience.

name: Famous Paintings 1
description: Click/tap on all the differences in Famous Paintings.Famous Paintings 1 is an artistic and educational HTML puzzle game where players immerse themselves in the world of classic and renowned artworks. Test your memory and knowledge of art history by identifying, matching, or solving puzzles based on famous paintings from celebrated artists. Key Features: Iconic Artworks: Discover masterpieces from legendary artists like Van Gogh, Da Vinci, Monet, and Picasso. Multiple Game Modes: Engage in fun gameplay modes, such as tile matching, trivia, or jigsaw puzzles. Educational Fun: Learn interesting facts about each painting and artist as you progress. Beautiful Graphics: Enjoy vibrant, high-quality images of timeless paintings in stunning detail. Accessible Gameplay: Simple controls and intuitive design make it easy for players of all skill levels to enjoy.

name: Famous Paintings 2
description: Click/tap on all the differences in Famous Paintings 2.Famous Paintings 2 takes you deeper into the world of art, offering a captivating sequel packed with even more iconic masterpieces from history’s greatest painters. Explore, learn, and solve puzzles featuring celebrated artworks while sharpening your observation and problem-solving skills. Key Features: Expanded Artwork Collection: Discover new masterpieces from iconic artists such as Rembrandt, Klimt, Botticelli, and more. Challenging Levels: Enjoy diverse puzzle styles like matching pairs, jigsaw challenges, or memory tests, each with increasing complexity. Art Insights: Uncover intriguing facts about each painting and its creator, adding an educational twist to the gameplay. Enhanced Graphics: Immerse yourself in vivid, high-definition depictions of world-famous artworks. Easy-to-Play Interface: User-friendly controls make it a delightful experience for art enthusiasts and gamers of all ages.

name: Famous Paintings 3
description: Click/tap on all the differences in Famous Paintings 3.Famous Paintings 3 is the ultimate puzzle game for art lovers, offering a fresh collection of world-famous artworks to explore and enjoy. Dive into this third installment featuring even more celebrated masterpieces, engaging puzzles, and fascinating insights about legendary artists. Key Features: New Masterpieces: Discover an expanded selection of iconic paintings from artists like Frida Kahlo, Vermeer, Munch, and many others. Diverse Puzzle Modes: Experience a variety of gameplay options, including tile matching, spot-the-difference, and artistic jigsaws. Interactive Learning: Learn captivating details about the paintings, their history, and the artists behind them as you play. Immersive Visuals: Enjoy high-resolution images and elegant designs that showcase the beauty of the artworks. Easy Accessibility: Intuitive controls and seamless compatibility across devices make it perfect for players of all ages.

name: Fantastic Roboworld
description: Fantastic Roboworld is a game which appears at first to be quite simple, but it has, in addition to its tremendous charm, a surprising amount of depth. In this "jump 'n' run" game (as the author calls it) you jump around the levels, collecting items, powerups, and killing enemies. You can find a variety of powerup items, as well as gems, and coins (which can be used to buy other powerups at in-game shops). Although the levels themselves are fairly straightforward (get to the exit at the right side) there seem to be numerous secrets hidden in every level. The ability to easily look up and down using the up and down arrow keys is helpful. The graphics are decent (I'd say "charming") while the music and sound effects are only okay. Overall this is definitely a hidden gem of a game for fans of this sort of light platforming action / exploring type game.

name: Fantasy - Hidden Stars
description: Find all the hidden stars on the fantasy images. Click on the spot where you found a star.Fantasy - Hidden Stars is a magical and enchanting hidden-object puzzle game that takes players on a journey through fantastical worlds. Your mission is to find cleverly hidden stars in beautifully illustrated fantasy scenes filled with mythical creatures, stunning landscapes, and magical artifacts. Key Features: Captivating Fantasy Worlds: Explore richly detailed scenes featuring castles, dragons, fairies, and other mystical elements. Challenging Gameplay: Sharpen your observation skills as you locate hidden stars, some of which are cunningly camouflaged. Multiple Levels: Progress through a variety of magical settings, each more challenging and visually stunning than the last. Relaxing Experience: Enjoy calming background music and a stress-free gameplay environment. Hint System: Stuck? Use hints to reveal elusive stars and keep your adventure going.

name: Farm Flip Mahjongg
description: Mahjong Solitaire game with 2 sides. Pair up all tiles with the same front image. After a tile has been paired, it flips. If both sides have been paired, a tile is removed.Farm Flip Mahjongg is a delightful twist on the classic Mahjongg game, set in the charming world of farming! Match tiles featuring adorable farm-themed images like animals, crops, and tools, and clear the board while enjoying the relaxing countryside atmosphere. Key Features: Farm-Themed Fun: Match tiles featuring cows, chickens, tractors, corn, and more, bringing a fresh rural vibe to the classic game. Flip Mechanic: Flip tiles to reveal their hidden side and discover new matches, adding a unique layer of strategy. Multiple Levels: Enjoy a variety of layouts and challenges, with increasing difficulty to keep you engaged. Casual and Relaxing: Perfect for unwinding with soothing farm sounds and charming graphics. Mobile and Desktop Friendly: Seamless play on any device, with intuitive controls for tapping or clicking.

name: Farm Girl
description: Help the Farm Girl in this Match 3 Game. Swap two items to match three or more in a row.Farm Girl is an engaging farming simulation game that lets you step into the boots of a hardworking farmer. Help the cheerful farm girl grow crops, care for animals, and build the farm of her dreams while overcoming fun and challenging tasks. Key Features: Exciting Farming Adventures: Plant, water, and harvest a variety of crops while raising adorable animals like cows, chickens, and sheep. Customization: Design and expand your farm with new buildings, decorations, and upgrades to make it uniquely yours. Challenging Missions: Complete daily tasks and special quests to earn rewards and grow your farming empire. Colorful Graphics: Enjoy vibrant, cheerful visuals and charming animations that bring your farm to life. Relaxing Gameplay: Perfect for casual gaming, with an intuitive interface and a peaceful countryside setting.

name: Farm Mahjong
description: Match the same tiles in this Farm Mahjong Solitaire game. You can combine two of the same free tiles. Remove all tiles to advance to the next level.Farm Mahjong is a charming tile-matching puzzle game that combines the classic gameplay of Mahjong with a delightful farm theme. Match tiles featuring cute farm animals, crops, tools, and other countryside elements to clear the board and advance through relaxing yet challenging levels. Key Features: Farm-Themed Tiles: Enjoy a variety of tiles featuring pigs, cows, carrots, tractors, and more, adding a whimsical touch to the game. Classic Mahjong Gameplay: Match pairs of identical tiles to clear them from the board, with intuitive mechanics perfect for all skill levels. Multiple Levels: Explore diverse layouts with increasing difficulty to keep you entertained and engaged. Relaxing Atmosphere: Delight in soothing background music and picturesque farm visuals as you play. Hint and Shuffle Options: Use helpful features to overcome tricky situations and find your next move.

name: Farm Mysteries
description: "Farm Mysteries" is a delightful hidden object game where players explore a charming farm setting to find hidden objects or spot differences between two similar scenes. The game combines observation, attention to detail, and a relaxing farm theme, making it perfect for players of all ages. The goal is to find all the hidden objects or differences within a limited time or number of moves. Game Description: Objective: Find all the hidden objects or differences in the farm scene. Gameplay: Players are presented with a detailed farm scene filled with various objects, animals, and scenery. A list of hidden objects or differences is provided, and players must click on them to find them. The game may include two similar scenes where players must spot the differences between them. Farm Theme: The game features a vibrant farm setting with elements like barns, animals, crops, tractors, and more. Hidden objects or differences are cleverly integrated into the scene, requiring careful observation. Difficulty Levels: The game includes multiple levels, each with a unique farm scene and increasing difficulty. Later levels may introduce more complex scenes or a larger number of hidden objects/differences. Special Features: Hint System: Players can use hints to reveal the location of a hidden object or difference. Timer: Some levels may include a timer to add urgency to the gameplay. Zoom Function: Players can zoom in on specific areas of the scene for a closer look.

name: Farm Stacker
description: Stack animals on the farm. Create groups of five or more of the same animals to remove the groups.Farm Stacker is a fun and addictive puzzle game that challenges you to stack adorable farm animals in a strategic and balanced way. Create towering piles of cows, pigs, chickens, and more without letting them tumble, all while enjoying the charm of a countryside farm! Key Features: Cute Animal Stacking: Place animals like cows, sheep, and goats on top of each other in creative and wobbly arrangements. Physics-Based Gameplay: Test your skills with realistic physics, where every move can make or break your stack. Challenging Levels: Complete progressively harder puzzles with unique stacking goals and layouts. Farmyard Charm: Immerse yourself in a colorful farm setting with cheerful graphics and whimsical animations. Relaxing and Fun: Perfect for casual gaming, with intuitive controls and playful sound effects.

name: Farm Town
description: Grow your Farm and your crops. Grow and harvest your crops and research new machines. Click on the truck to sell your crops.Farm Town is a captivating farming simulation game where you can build, manage, and grow your very own virtual farm. Plant crops, raise animals, and expand your farmstead into a thriving agricultural empire. Perfect for casual players and farming enthusiasts alike! Key Features: Crop Cultivation: Sow seeds, water plants, and harvest bountiful crops like wheat, corn, and vegetables to earn rewards. Animal Care: Raise and nurture livestock such as cows, chickens, and sheep, and collect valuable products like milk and eggs. Farm Expansion: Build new structures, upgrade equipment, and decorate your farm to make it uniquely yours. Quests and Tasks: Complete missions and daily challenges to earn bonuses and unlock new features. Relaxing Gameplay: Enjoy a laid-back farming experience with charming visuals and soothing background music.

name: Fat Ninja
description: Fat Ninja is a quirky and action-packed HTML game where you play as a lovable, yet surprisingly agile, ninja who must navigate through various obstacles, defeat enemies, and complete challenging missions. With a fun and humorous twist, this ninja is far from your average stealthy hero! Key Features: Unique Character: Play as a "fat" ninja with special abilities that make for hilarious and unexpected gameplay. This ninja might not be the fastest, but he’s full of surprises! Action-Packed Combat: Use a combination of weapons, special moves, and stealth tactics to defeat enemies and bosses in thrilling combat sequences. Challenging Levels: Progress through various levels, each with unique challenges, enemies, and traps. Time your moves carefully to avoid obstacles and make your way through increasingly difficult environments. Humorous Gameplay: Enjoy light-hearted and funny moments, with a ninja who doesn’t take himself too seriously, adding a humorous flair to the traditional ninja gameplay. Upgrade System: Collect coins or rewards to upgrade your ninja’s abilities, weapons, and equipment, making him stronger and more capable of tackling tougher challenges. Simple Controls: Easy-to-learn controls that let you jump, attack, and dodge enemies with ease, making it accessible for players of all ages.

name: Fatal Choice
description: Fatal Choice is a simple overhead-view action / adventure game where you drive around your car (?) that can fire bullets somehow, and battle other cars (?) while looking for switches and stuff. That's basically it; there are some decent tile-based graphics, and for a game created in QuickBasic, it plays decently well, with smoothly animated sprites and no flicker, as well as SoundBlaster sound effects. That said the game plays a bit slow, and there are not (at least in the first level) a lot of exciting gameplay elements to be found. It does include an editor to make your own levels.

name: Fatal Fumes
description: Fatal Fumes is a top-down racing game in the style of Micro Machines racing games, and numerous others such as Super Speed or Slicks 'N Slide. The shareware version of this game offers four tracks to race, against the clock or against multiple CPU opponents. (The full version allows competition for two players simultaneously.) Tracks contain a bunch of different obstacles, like jumps, bridges, oil slicks, holes, etc. The game looks good and plays decently enough, although the controls are difficult to get used to; your car moves too fast and/or turns too slowly, at least that's how I experienced it

name: Fate
description: Fate (no relation to the action-RPG of the same name) is perhaps the rarest of the BUILD engine games - the engine used for Duke Nukem 3D among many others. That's because Fate was never released! All we have is this demo. Presumably since its developer/.publisher Intracorp went bankrupt in 1996, that also killed this game. It's unfortunate because what's here seems pretty decent!Fate: The Cursed King (sometimes referred to as Fate DOS) is an exciting action-adventure RPG where players dive into a world filled with monsters, treasures, and epic quests. Set in a dark and mystical fantasy realm, the game is centered around uncovering the curse that plagues the land while battling fierce enemies and solving ancient mysteries. Key Features: Dungeon Crawling: Explore random, procedurally generated dungeons full of traps, enemies, and loot. Each dungeon offers unique challenges and hidden treasures, making every playthrough different. Character Progression: Customize your hero’s skills, attributes, and abilities as you advance through the game. Choose from a variety of classes, like warrior, mage, or rogue, each with their own strengths and playstyles. Monsters and Bosses: Face off against a vast array of enemies, from low-level creatures to powerful bosses. Prepare to engage in intense combat using a variety of weapons, magic, and strategies. Loot and Items: Collect powerful weapons, armor, and magical items that help enhance your character’s strength and abilities. Discover hidden items to gain an edge in your quests. Atmospheric World: Immerse yourself in a rich and detailed world, with dark environments, haunting music, and exciting quests that keep you engaged throughout your journey. Quest System: Take on various quests from NPCs to uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and defeat formidable foes to unravel the mystery of the curse.

name: Fatty Bear's Birthday Surprise
description: Fatty Bear's Birthday Surprise is a perhaps unfortunately named kid's adventure game. It uses the popular Lucasarts SCUMM engine but it's geared towards young players, so the player just needs to click around to get things done. You play as the titular Fatty Bear, who is tasked with helping plan a surprise party for Kayla.Fatty Bear's Birthday Surprise is a delightful point-and-click adventure game designed for children, originally released for MS-DOS. Players join Fatty Bear, a lovable, cheerful bear, as he works to prepare for his best friend’s birthday party. The game is full of fun puzzles, creative activities, and surprises that make it an engaging and wholesome experience for younger players. Key Features: Interactive Adventure: Help Fatty Bear gather decorations, bake a birthday cake, and organize the perfect surprise party. The game involves a variety of tasks like finding hidden objects, solving simple puzzles, and using tools to complete goals. Cute and Colorful Graphics: Enjoy charming, hand-drawn visuals that bring the whimsical world of Fatty Bear to life, with vibrant colors and playful animations. Fun and Educational Activities: The game encourages creativity and problem-solving through different activities, such as baking, wrapping presents, and decorating. Each task is simple but fun to complete, making it great for young children. Non-violent Gameplay: Fatty Bear's Birthday Surprise is a calm, peaceful game with no time limits or stressful situations, allowing kids to play at their own pace. Memorable Characters: Alongside Fatty Bear, you'll meet a variety of other friendly characters who help or provide assistance as you prepare for the big birthday bash. Wholesome Music and Sounds: The game features light, cheerful background music and sound effects, enhancing the friendly, joyful atmosphere.

name: FBI Fred
description: FBI Fred is a strange EGA platforming game starring "FBI Fred" who looks a little like the OG Duke Nukem and spends his time in gross rat and pigeon infested sewers. So you wander around in the subway platform / tunnel, not sure what your goal is, avoiding the baddies; you are given a laser and a gun but only 5 ammo of each. I'm not sure if you ever get more.FBI Fred is a fun and quirky action-adventure game released for MS-DOS in the 1990s. Players control Fred, a bumbling yet determined FBI agent, tasked with solving various crimes, catching criminals, and navigating through humorous scenarios. The game mixes exploration, puzzles, and light-hearted action in a pixelated world. Key Features: Quirky FBI Agent: Take on the role of Fred, a comedic and slightly clumsy FBI agent, who must solve cases with his own unique set of skills (or lack thereof). Interactive Environments: Explore a range of environments, from busy city streets to hidden criminal lairs. The game’s design encourages you to interact with objects and solve puzzles to progress through levels. Humorous Storyline: FBI Fred features a humorous and often absurd storyline, with plenty of amusing dialogue and funny moments that keep the game light-hearted and entertaining. Action and Puzzles: The game combines action sequences, such as chasing down criminals or avoiding traps, with puzzle-solving elements that require players to think critically about their next move. Challenging Gameplay: Players must think on their feet to overcome obstacles, gather evidence, and catch criminals, all while navigating through tricky situations. Retro Graphics and Sound: Enjoy classic 16-bit pixel graphics and simple sound effects that capture the nostalgic feel of 90s DOS games.

name: Feed the Animals
description: Connect animals and their food. Connect the animal with the right food, you can only connect if the connecting path has no more than two changes of direction.Feed the Animals is a fun and fast-paced puzzle game where you help feed various animals by matching food items with the correct animals. The goal is to quickly and accurately deliver the right food to each animal while avoiding mistakes and managing a growing number of hungry creatures! Key Features: Cute Animal Characters: Interact with a variety of adorable animals, such as cows, chickens, pigs, and more. Each animal has specific food preferences that you must match correctly. Matching Gameplay: Drag or click the correct food items to the animals in a time-limited setting. The faster you feed them, the higher your score. Challenging Levels: As you progress, the game becomes more difficult, with more animals and faster-paced food delivery requirements. Keep an eye on the timer and try to feed as many animals as possible without making mistakes. Colorful and Engaging Graphics: Enjoy bright, cheerful visuals with cute animations that make feeding the animals a delightful experience. Increasing Complexity: New animals and food types are introduced as you advance, increasing the challenge and keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. Relaxing Soundtrack: Calm, cheerful music and sound effects enhance the fun, making it a perfect game for all ages.

name: Feed Us
description: Feed Us is an exciting, action-packed Flash game where you play as a hungry, bloodthirsty piranha. Your goal is to eat everything in sight, including fish, swimmers, and even boats, while upgrading your abilities to become more powerful and aggressive. The game offers a thrilling mix of action, strategy, and gore as you evolve your piranha and complete missions in a variety of environments. Key Features: Action-Packed Gameplay: Control a voracious piranha as it swims through different environments, eating anything and everything that crosses its path. Blood and Gore: The game features over-the-top, cartoonish violence as you devour swimmers, fish, and other targets in a fun, gruesome way. The more you eat, the bigger and stronger your piranha becomes! Upgrades and Power-ups: Earn points by completing levels and objectives, which can be used to purchase upgrades for your piranha, including speed boosts, bigger teeth, and special abilities. Challenging Missions: Each level has different goals, such as eating a specific number of enemies, completing objectives, or surviving longer in dangerous environments like lakes, rivers, or oceans filled with predators. Unique Environments: Explore various levels set in different locations, from calm lakes to hazardous, shark-infested waters, each offering new challenges and opportunities for carnage. Fun, Cartoonish Graphics: While the theme is dark and violent, the graphics are exaggerated and cartoonish, adding humor and light-heartedness to the action. Upbeat Soundtrack and Sound Effects: Enjoy energetic background music and fun sound effects that enhance the thrilling experience as you chase down and devour your prey.

name: Feizhou Maoxian
description: Feizhou Maoxian: Africa Adventure is an educational and action-adventure game developed in China. The game features a mix of exploration, puzzle-solving, and cultural learning, with a focus on the continent of Africa and its many wonders. Game Plot and Storyline: The storyline revolves around a young protagonist who embarks on an adventure across Africa. The main goal is to explore various countries and landscapes, solve puzzles, and learn about the culture, geography, and history of the African continent. The game presents Africa as a land of mystery and adventure, filled with wild animals, exotic locales, and unique challenges. The protagonist’s journey takes him through dense jungles, deserts, savannahs, and ancient ruins, where he must overcome obstacles, gather resources, and interact with different characters, many of whom are based on African cultures and folklore.

name: Feizhou Maoxian 2
description: This game, developed in China and designed for the educational adventure genre, continues the protagonist’s journey, but with a deeper focus on African geography, wildlife, culture, and folklore. It is an action-adventure game with point-and-click mechanics that offers both puzzle-solving and exploration elements. The game follows a similar format to its predecessor, featuring a narrative-driven journey through various African environments where players solve challenges, learn about different regions of Africa, and interact with characters based on local traditions. The storyline of the second game also revolves around uncovering mysteries, exploring hidden secrets, and learning about African wildlife, history, and traditions.

name: Fence
description: Fence is a strategy game where the goal is to keep your sheep fenced in a pen. You can build walls and other obstacles to keep your sheep from wandering away, but you lose points for each object that you build. The docs call this a "Tetris-like strategy game" but there's nothing Tetris-like about it. There's actually more to it than this short description, you will need to read the included docs to get more details on things like the shepherd. If you're someone who enjoys strategy games you may like it despite the difficulty in placing items caused by the game's perspective.

name: Ferris Wheel
description: Fun rotating Bubble Shooter game. Try to remove all bubbles.Ferris Wheel is a fun and relaxing HTML-based simulation game where players manage a Ferris wheel at a theme park. Your goal is to load and unload passengers, ensuring they get on and off safely while keeping the ride running smoothly. As the game progresses, the challenge increases, with more passengers to manage and faster pace. Key Features: Manage the Ferris Wheel: Control the Ferris wheel’s rotation, ensuring that passengers can safely board and exit the ride at the right time. Passenger Management: Each passenger has different patience levels. Some may get frustrated if they have to wait too long, while others are more patient. Increasing Difficulty: As you progress through the levels, the number of passengers increases, and the pace of the game speeds up, requiring quicker reactions and better timing. Fun Visuals: Enjoy colorful and vibrant graphics, with a lively amusement park atmosphere complete with excited passengers and bustling crowds. Casual Gameplay: Simple, easy-to-learn mechanics make it an ideal game for relaxing play. Just focus on timing, management, and making sure everyone enjoys their ride! Challenging Missions: Complete specific goals or reach certain milestones to unlock new levels, achieve high scores, or earn bonus rewards.

name: Feudalism
description: Feudalism is an engaging strategy-based Flash game set in a medieval world where players take on the role of a lord or warrior, seeking to conquer territories and build an empire. The game combines elements of combat, resource management, and role-playing as you rise through the ranks to achieve dominance over the kingdom. Key Features: Medieval Warfare: Engage in turn-based combat against enemy factions, using your strategic skills to defeat rivals and expand your influence. Character Progression: Customize and upgrade your character’s abilities, weapons, and armor as you gain experience from battles and quests. Choose from different classes like warriors, archers, or mages, each with unique abilities and playstyles. Feudal System: Manage resources, recruit soldiers, and establish alliances with other factions to strengthen your power. Your goal is to conquer new lands, improve your holdings, and expand your feudal domain. Strategic Combat: Each battle requires careful planning, including positioning units, managing resources, and choosing the right tactics to defeat stronger enemies. Quests and Missions: Complete various quests and missions to earn gold, items, and other resources, helping you progress through the game. Multiple Factions: Interact with different factions, each with its own strengths, weaknesses, and tactics. Some will be allies, while others will be enemies to challenge your rise to power. Detailed Graphics: While the game uses pixelated graphics, they effectively capture the medieval atmosphere with detailed maps, character designs, and animated battles. Easy-to-Play Interface: Simple, accessible controls make the game enjoyable for both casual players and strategy game enthusiasts.

name: Fiddle
description: An interesting puzzle game with many different levels, despite the lack of great graphics and sound effects. The object is to match up different shapes in order to construct perfect squares/rectangles of predetermined sizes. There are various tangible (store-bought) versions of this game, but this one is easier to play and includes a lot more different puzzles.Fiddle is a fun and interactive musical game for MS-DOS where players can create and play melodies by using a virtual fiddle (violin) in a simple, intuitive interface. This retro game is designed to let users explore their musical creativity in a playful and casual way. Key Features: Play Music: Use the on-screen fiddle (violin) to play various notes and create melodies. The game allows players to interact with the fiddle, producing different musical sounds as they "play" the strings. Simple Controls: With basic DOS keyboard inputs, players can easily control the strings of the fiddle to create music. No prior musical knowledge is needed to have fun and experiment with the sounds. Fun and Relaxing: The game is designed to be casual, allowing you to relax and enjoy the process of creating music without time limits or high-pressure gameplay. Musical Exploration: Players can experiment with different rhythms and notes to make original tunes or try to replicate familiar melodies. Retro Graphics and Sounds: The game features simplistic graphics typical of early DOS games, with a basic interface that focuses on the gameplay and musical experience.

name: Field Command
