Use the light bulb for a hint.Paris Hidden Objects is a delightful HTML5 puzzle game that takes you on a virtual journey through the romantic streets and landmarks of Paris. Explore iconic locations like the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and charming cafés as you search for cleverly hidden objects within beautifully illustrated scenes. Each level presents a new Parisian setting with a list of items to find, challenging your observation skills and attention to detail. The game features multiple difficulty levels, hints for when you're stuck, and a relaxing soundtrack that immerses you in the charm of Paris. Perfect for fans of casual and brain-teasing games, Paris Hidden Objects offers an enjoyable escape into the City of Lights, one hidden object at a time!

name: Paris Tripeaks
description: Enjoy Paris in this fun Tripeaks Solitaire game. Remove all cards from the game. You can remove a card that is 1 higher or 1 lower in value than the open card.Paris Tripeaks is an elegant HTML5 card game set against the breathtaking backdrops of Paris. This solitaire-style game challenges players to clear all the cards from the board by selecting cards that are one rank higher or lower than the card in the draw pile. With simple mechanics and addictive gameplay, it's a perfect mix of relaxation and strategy. Each level features stunning Parisian scenery, from the Eiffel Tower at sunset to charming cobblestone streets and café terraces. Players can unlock new locations as they progress, collect power-ups to overcome tricky layouts, and enjoy a serene soundtrack that captures the romance of Paris. Whether you're a solitaire enthusiast or just looking for a calming escape, Paris Tripeaks offers a delightful way to unwind while immersing yourself in the beauty of the City of Lights!

name: Parsifal: A Medieval Fantasy World
description: Parsifal is a turn-based strategy game with a fantasy theme. You play the red guys, and you must defeat the blue guys. And collect all seven of the Grail pieces. There are various different kinds of troops you're given, and each are described in the in-game help, which is indeed helpful. There are also three difficulty settings available. (No two player option though.) It seems like an interesting turn-based strategy game, which I do not personally enjoy, but I'm sure others will find engaging!Parsifal: A Medieval Fantasy World is an immersive DOS role-playing game that transports players to a richly detailed medieval realm filled with magic, intrigue, and adventure. You take on the role of a young hero, Parsifal, who must navigate a land torn apart by warring factions, ancient curses, and mythical creatures. The game features a mix of exploration, turn-based combat, and deep storytelling. Players journey through lush forests, bustling medieval towns, and treacherous dungeons, interacting with NPCs to uncover quests and secrets. Along the way, you'll gather powerful weapons, mystical artifacts, and allies to aid in your quest to bring peace to the kingdom. With its atmospheric pixel art, complex character progression, and captivating soundtrack, Parsifal: A Medieval Fantasy World delivers a classic RPG experience that will appeal to fans of deep, story-driven adventures.

name: Party Jong
description: Have a Party with this fun Mahjong Solitaire game. Combine 2 of the same free (highlighted) tiles.Party Jong is a vibrant and fun-filled HTML5 Mahjong game that puts a festive twist on the classic tile-matching puzzle. Players are challenged to clear the board by matching identical tiles, but with a lively party theme featuring colorful decorations, balloons, and celebratory symbols. Each level introduces unique tile layouts, increasing the difficulty as you progress. Power-ups like shuffles and hints help you tackle tricky puzzles, while the cheerful visuals and upbeat music keep the mood light and engaging. Perfect for casual players and Mahjong enthusiasts alike, Party Jong offers a delightful mix of relaxation and brain-teasing fun, making every round feel like a celebration!

name: Pass-Around Trivia
description: Pass-Around trivia is a Trivial Pursuit-like board game for 1-6 players. Players roll the dice, move to a square, and answer a trivia question in one of four categories: Religion, Sports, World Trivia, or Famous People. If you answer correctly, you get points. At the end of the game, whoever has the most points wins! The game is presented in text mode but it's decently colorful and the trivia questions are of a reasonable difficulty. The game really commends it's "Pass-Around Distribution Model" which is basically like a pyramid scheme: After you register, you enter your registration number into the game, then share your special version of the game.

name: Patriot Command
description: Patriot Command is an unabashed Missile Command clone. It plays similarly to the classic arcade game: Protect you missile silos and cities from the incoming missiles. Earn points for saving more cities, and then progress to the next level, each of which gets tougher. The game includes many configurable options, from gameplay tweaks like unlimited missiles to cosmetic modifications like choosing from different backgrounds. It plays well using the mouse, and the graphics and sounds are basic but serviceable.Patriot Command is a high-stakes DOS strategy game that puts you in charge of defending your homeland from waves of incoming missile attacks and enemy airstrikes. As the commander of a cutting-edge defense system, your mission is to strategically deploy anti-missile rockets, intercept enemy projectiles, and protect vital cities and bases under your care. The game features increasingly challenging levels with faster and more frequent attacks, requiring sharp reflexes and tactical planning. Players can upgrade their arsenal, manage resources, and unlock advanced defenses like laser turrets and EMP blasts to counter the evolving threats. With its retro graphics, intense gameplay, and a tense soundtrack, Patriot Command offers a classic combination of action and strategy that will test your skills as the ultimate defender.

name: PC Golf
description: PC Golf is not a remarkable game, but it IS a text-mode golf simulation from 1985, so that context does make it a little bit interesting. I found no information on who the author might be or anything about the game online really. As mentioned the game is in text mode, and you're given an ASCII drawing of the course. However your ball position is not shown (the asterisk `*` is just the position of the tee) and you must read the textual description of the location, choose your club, and specify how much power to apply to the shot.

name: PC Jigsaw
description: PC Jigsaw is a simple jigsaw-puzzle-like game where you are presented with a scrambled picture and you must rearrange the tiles to put it back together. It was created by Bill Dedes, presumably before he began working under the company name Alive Software. The pieces in the puzzles are all rectangles, so unlike a traditional puzzle they are all the same shape. The game works using the mouse by exchanging positions of pieces. After you finish a picture, the game gives you a rating for how fast you completed it. There are only five pictures included with the shareware version of the game, and although there are three difficulty levels (the picture is divided into smaller pieces) it won't have a lot of longevity.

name: PC Pro-GOLF
description: PC Pro-GOLF is a CGA golf game which does not rely at all on your reflexes. You simply enter your choices, and the game calculates where your ball will land. Unlike most golf games, there is no timing required to hit your ball at just the right moment. Some people may prefer this method, as it relies more on strategy and careful club/shot selection. You get a single golf course to play, and can choose your starting hole and the number of holes to play. It's a pretty basic game with simple CGA graphics.PC Pro-GOLF is a classic DOS golf simulation game that brings the excitement of the fairways and greens to your computer. Players can choose from a variety of courses and compete in realistic golf tournaments, where accuracy, timing, and strategy are key to mastering the game. The gameplay focuses on offering a true-to-life golfing experience with controls that allow you to adjust the power and angle of your shots. You must carefully navigate obstacles like water hazards, sand traps, and varying wind conditions that can affect the ball’s trajectory. With its simple yet engaging mechanics, PC Pro-GOLF provides a fun and relaxing experience for golf enthusiasts, offering a variety of course layouts, multiplayer modes, and a challenge that increases as you progress through the game. Whether you're an experienced golfer or a newcomer, this game offers a satisfying simulation of the sport.

name: PC*Bert
description: PC*Bert is a fantastic clone of the classic Qbert* arcade game, bringing the same addictive gameplay to DOS computers with faithful graphics and sound effects. In PC*Bert, players guide the titular character, PC*Bert, as he hops across a pyramid of tiles, changing their colors while avoiding enemies like Slick and Coily. The game maintains the charm and challenge of the original, offering a nostalgic experience for fans of the arcade classic. With intuitive controls, the task of navigating PC*Bert across the tiles feels smooth and natural. As you progress, the difficulty increases, introducing more enemies and faster-paced action. The game even includes a fun 2-player mode, where two players can take turns or compete simultaneously, making it an excellent option for some friendly competition. Overall, PC*Bert does an excellent job of capturing the essence of Qbert* while adding its own charm. Whether you're playing alone or with friends, it's an enjoyable and challenging arcade conversion for anyone who loves retro gaming!

name: PC-Casino
description: PC-Casino is a collection of three different popular casino games, all done in text-mode: Video poker, slots, and keno. All games are simple to play without many options or extra features. As you can see in the screenshot, I was rather lucky in my first play of video poker. Not sure if it was just luck, if the game is programmed to let you win the first time you play, or if the odds are stacked here to be better than real life. But in any case if you want quick-and-simple versions of these popular gambling games, these work well enough.

name: PC-Connect 4
description: PC-Connect 4 is a Connect 4 clone done in text mode. You try to connect 4 of your own pieces in a row (vertically, horizontally, or diagonally) by dropping them into columns while your opponent (the CPU here, no two-player mode) attempts to do the same. Not much else to say about it ... the game does PC-Connect 4 is a DOS-based version of the classic Connect Four game, where the objective is to align four of your colored discs vertically, horizontally, or diagonally on a grid before your opponent does. The game follows the traditional rules of Connect Four, offering a simple yet strategic experience. In PC-Connect 4, players can engage in one-on-one matches against the computer or another player. The game features intuitive controls, where players drop discs into the columns of a grid and watch them fall into place. Each player must anticipate their opponent's moves while trying to create their own line of four discs. With its easy-to-understand mechanics, clean pixel graphics, and straightforward gameplay, PC-Connect 4 offers an enjoyable and accessible experience for puzzle and strategy lovers. Whether you're playing for fun or honing your skills, the game provides hours of entertainment.work, and there are variable difficulty levels from 1 (easy) to 9 (tough), press the L key to change level during a game.

name: PC-Sherlock: A Game of Logic & Deduction
description: PC-Sherlock: A Game of Logic & Deduction is a classic DOS puzzle game that challenges players to solve complex mysteries through logical reasoning and deduction, much like the legendary detective Sherlock Holmes. In this game, players are tasked with solving various cases by carefully analyzing clues, making logical connections, and eliminating possibilities. The gameplay centers around the concept of deduction, where players must piece together information from the game’s environment, interrogate suspects, and examine evidence to uncover the truth behind each case. Each mystery is structured around a set of clues that lead players toward the solution, but only through careful thought and attention to detail can they identify the correct answers. With a variety of cases to solve, PC-Sherlock offers an engaging and challenging experience that tests your logical thinking and investigative skills. The game features an atmosphere that draws you into a world of intrigue and suspense, with a user-friendly interface and a classic pixel art style that adds to its charm. If you enjoy puzzles, logic games, and detective stories, PC-Sherlock delivers an immersive and satisfying experience.

name: PCBOWL - Electron Lanes
description: PCBOWL is a simple bowling simulator which is presented in CGA graphics mode. You choose the number of bowlers (1-4) and then take turns bowling. You simple position your bowler and press Enter to throw. The ball always goes in a perfectly straight line without any randomness so it's easy to line up your shots. You can also curve your ball after the fact by pressing Left or Right. Due to its simplicity it's pretty easy to get spares so that removes a lot of the challenge and replayability.PCBOWL - Electron Lanes is a quirky and entertaining DOS game that combines elements of bowling with a sci-fi, futuristic twist. Set in a world of electrons and circuits, this game takes place on a glowing, digital bowling alley known as the "Electron Lanes." In the game, players control a ball that rolls down the electron lanes, aiming to knock down pins that are strategically placed on the lane. However, unlike traditional bowling, the lanes in PCBOWL are not straight, and they may have obstacles, curves, or hazards that make targeting the pins more challenging. The ball's movement is affected by the layout of the lane, and you must use precision and timing to guide the ball to the pins. The game features vibrant, retro-inspired pixel graphics and an electronic soundtrack, immersing players in a futuristic atmosphere. It's easy to pick up and play, but as you progress, it becomes more challenging with the introduction of new lanes and obstacles. With its fun concept, smooth gameplay, and creative setting, PCBOWL - Electron Lanes offers a refreshing take on the bowling genre, perfect for fans of retro arcade games and those looking for a lighthearted but engaging experience.

name: Pea Shootin Pete
description: If you've played Spitwad Willy, you've played Pea Shootin' Pete. While I'm not entirely sure about the history of this game, it seems as though after Raoul Said created Spitwad Willy, he either licensed it to Pack Media Company under a new name, or rebranded it when be became involved somehow with the company. Anyways, other than that, it's pretty much the same game, and as such still borrows heavily from Pang (aka Buster Bros).Pea Shootin' Pete is a light-hearted and entertaining DOS arcade-style game where players control Pete, a character armed with a pea shooter. The goal is to shoot peas at various targets that appear on the screen, ranging from moving objects to enemies. The game challenges your accuracy and timing as you try to hit as many targets as possible while avoiding obstacles. The game features simple, yet engaging mechanics where you must aim and fire your pea shooter to hit the moving targets. As you progress, the difficulty increases, with faster-moving targets and more complex patterns to follow. The more accurate you are, the higher your score, and the further you can advance through the game. With its charming pixel art and whimsical sound effects, Pea Shootin' Pete offers a nostalgic, fun, and casual experience, perfect for fans of retro arcade games looking for a quick and enjoyable challenge. The easy-to-understand mechanics make it accessible to players of all ages.

name: Pea-ESP! 2
description: Pea-ESP is a program to test whether you possess ESP, ie Extrasensory Perception. It includes a lot of discussion about the merits and weaknesses of the idea of ESP. The game that's played to test whether you have ESP powers is a simple guessing game: Concentrate your mind carefully, and guess which cup the marble is under. It seems like ESP claims / interest were bigger in the 20th century than they are in the 21st, so this program has lost a lot of it's relevance. But it's interesting as an attempt to study the supposed phenomenon; you can submit your results as part of a supposed study, which likely didn't receive enough interest to generate any worthwhile results.

name: Peach's Dream
description: This is a good-looking VGA sidescrolling game with some adventure elements, as well. You're play the hero on her quest to save her one true love by collecting four keys hidden around the land. The gameplay works quite well, and the graphics and SB sound effects and music are all quite good. It was made by the creator of the way cool "Quest" games, although it bears no resemblance to those games.Peach's Dream is a charming and whimsical DOS adventure game that takes players on a magical journey through a dreamy world. In the game, you control a character named Peach, who embarks on an exciting adventure in a fantastical land full of strange creatures, puzzles, and challenges. The game blends elements of exploration, puzzle-solving, and platforming. As Peach, you'll travel through colorful environments, interact with quirky characters, and uncover hidden secrets in the dream world. The objective is to help Peach navigate through the dreamscape and solve various puzzles to progress. With its delightful pixelated graphics and enchanting soundtrack, Peach's Dream offers an engaging and relaxing experience for players who enjoy light-hearted adventures. The game's simple mechanics, combined with its magical atmosphere, make it a fun and nostalgic experience for anyone seeking a retro adventure game.

name: Pedes
description: Pedes is a competent combination of Snake and a maze game. Originally given away as a registration bonus for the game Glook (and later provided for free on the author's website) Pedes has you playing as a worm, chasing other worms in a Pac-Man-esque maze. (In the sense of how your worm moves and automatically turns corners.) You must eat the worms from behind, or crash into them to destroy some of their segments, or run into them head-first as long as your worm is bigger than theirs. It plays well enough once you get the hang of it, and later levels introduce some new gameplay features to keep it from getting too stale.

name: Peg Solitaire
description: Remove all the Pegs but one by jumping over Pegs.Peg Solitaire is a classic HTML5 puzzle game that challenges players to remove pegs from a board by jumping over them, aiming to leave only one peg remaining. The game is usually played on a cross-shaped board, but it can also appear in different configurations like a triangular or rectangular grid. The rules are simple: you start with a full set of pegs on the board, and to remove a peg, you must jump one peg over another into an empty space. The jumped peg is then removed. The goal is to continue jumping pegs until only one peg is left, ideally in the center of the board. Peg Solitaire HTML versions typically feature clean, interactive designs, where players can click or drag pegs to make their moves. The game often includes different difficulty levels, allowing you to start with easier configurations and gradually progress to more challenging ones. Some versions also provide hints or the option to undo moves to help players solve more difficult puzzles. With its simple mechanics, strategic depth, and satisfying gameplay, Peg Solitaire is a great choice for puzzle enthusiasts looking for a fun and mentally stimulating challenge!

name: Penguin
description: Penguin is a quirky and fun Flash game where the player controls a snowman whose goal is to hit falling penguins. The penguins drop from the top of the screen, and it's the player's job to use the snowman to catch or hit the penguins before they hit the ground. In this game, players typically move the snowman left or right along the bottom of the screen to aim for the falling penguins. The more penguins you hit, the higher your score. However, the game becomes more challenging as the penguins fall faster or in more unpredictable patterns as you progress. The game’s simple mechanics, cartoonish graphics, and fun concept make it an enjoyable and light-hearted arcade-style game. It's easy to play for all ages and provides a fun, fast-paced challenge to improve your timing and reflexes.

name: Penguin Cubes
description: Slide cubes and connect 3 or more of the same cubes. Click or tap to slide a new cube.Penguin Cubes is an engaging and fun HTML5 puzzle game that challenges players to match and remove colored cubes in a grid, with the added twist of penguins! The goal is to clear the screen by matching cubes of the same color, causing them to disappear. As you progress, the puzzle becomes more challenging, with new types of cubes, obstacles, and various penguin-themed visuals that add a playful charm to the experience. The gameplay is typically based on a grid or matrix, and players must click or drag to match adjacent cubes of the same color. The more cubes you match in a single move, the higher your score. As you eliminate cubes, the remaining ones may shift or fall into new positions, requiring you to think strategically and plan ahead. Penguin Cubes features colorful, cartoonish penguin-themed graphics and a relaxing soundtrack, making it an enjoyable experience for puzzle enthusiasts and casual players alike. It’s perfect for anyone looking for a light yet engaging challenge that gets progressively more difficult as you advance through levels!

name: Penguin Diner
description: Penguin Diner is a beloved Flash time-management game where players help Penny the Penguin run a busy diner in the snowy Antarctic. The goal is to seat customers, take their orders, serve food, and collect payments as efficiently as possible to keep everyone happy and earn tips. Gameplay: Players guide Penny as she seats customers at tables, takes their orders, and delivers their food once it’s ready. Happy customers tip more generously, while unhappy ones might leave, affecting your earnings for the day. As the game progresses, levels become more challenging with more customers and faster-paced service requirements. Earnings can be spent on upgrades like faster shoes for Penny, more comfortable chairs, or better kitchen equipment to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction.

name: Penguin Solitaire
description: Penguin Solitaire is a delightful HTML5 card game that offers a unique twist on the traditional solitaire experience. Set in a frosty, penguin-themed environment, this game challenges players to organize cards in a specific sequence or suit to win the game. Its playful winter setting and charming visuals make it a standout choice for fans of solitaire and casual games. Gameplay: The game typically starts with a shuffled deck of cards spread across columns and piles, and the objective is to organize the cards into foundations, usually sorted by suit and in ascending order. Players can move cards between columns by following the rules of the solitaire variation, such as alternating colors or descending order. Strategic thinking is key to uncover hidden cards and free up space for additional moves. Some versions of Penguin Solitaire might include icy-themed obstacles or power-ups to spice up the gameplay, such as freezing cards or hints to help when you’re stuck. With its relaxing yet strategic gameplay, crisp graphics, and fun penguin-themed atmosphere, Penguin Solitaire is a charming way to enjoy a classic card game with a frosty twist!

name: Penguin Word Twist
description: Help the penguin to guess words. Can you guess all words with the given letters?Penguin Word Twist is a fun and educational HTML5 word puzzle game that combines vocabulary challenges with an adorable penguin theme. In this game, players help a cheerful penguin uncover hidden words by rearranging a set of scrambled letters. The goal is to find as many words as possible within a given time limit or before progressing to the next level. Gameplay: Players are presented with a series of jumbled letters and must form valid words by clicking or typing them. Each level has a specific goal, such as uncovering a set number of words or finding the longest possible word. Hints or power-ups may be available to help players discover trickier words. As players advance, the puzzles become more challenging, with longer words or more complex letter arrangements. With its cute penguin animations, snowy backdrops, and engaging gameplay, Penguin Word Twist offers a delightful mix of fun and learning. Perfect for players of all ages, this game helps improve vocabulary and spelling skills while providing a relaxing yet mentally stimulating experience!

name: Pente
description: A connect 5 board game. The players alternate in placing stones of their color. The players aim to align five stones of the same color (vertical, horizontal or diagonal). Captures are obtained by flanking pairs of an opponent's stones in any same direction (captures must consist of pairs; flanking a single stone does not result in a capture). A player wins by scoring five stones in a row, or capturing five pairs of opponent stones. Pente is a strategic HTML5 board game based on the classic abstract game of the same name. It's a two-player game that combines the simplicity of Tic-Tac-Toe with the deeper strategy of Go, making it both accessible to beginners and engaging for seasoned players. Gameplay: Players take turns placing stones (or markers) on a grid. The goal is to either align five of your stones in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) or capture your opponent's stones by flanking two of theirs between two of your own. Captures are an important part of the strategy—if you capture ten of your opponent's stones, you win the game. The game requires foresight, planning, and adaptability, as you must balance offensive moves with blocking your opponent's progress. Pente HTML versions typically feature clean and intuitive interfaces, making it easy to place stones and plan moves. You can play against an AI opponent or a friend, with options to adjust difficulty levels or customize board size. With its mix of simplicity and depth, Pente is a timeless game of logic and tactics that offers endless replayability for fans of board games and competitive challenges.

name: Pentix
description: Pentix is a DOS-based puzzle game and a variant of the classic Tetris. It takes the familiar block-stacking mechanics of Tetris and adds an extra layer of challenge by introducing more complex pentomino shapes (blocks made up of five squares) instead of the traditional tetrominoes (blocks made up of four squares). Gameplay: Players must rotate and position falling pentomino shapes to create complete horizontal lines, which are then cleared from the board. The game ends when the stack of blocks reaches the top of the screen, so strategic placement and quick thinking are key. Compared to Tetris, the pentomino shapes are larger and more irregular, making it harder to fit them together, which increases the difficulty level. As the game progresses, the speed of the falling blocks increases, challenging the player's reflexes and planning abilities. With its retro graphics, simple controls, and addictive gameplay, Pentix offers a fresh twist on a timeless classic, providing a more challenging and engaging experience for puzzle enthusiasts and fans of Tetris-style games.

name: Pentominos
description: Pentominos (or as it's more commonly spelled, Pentominoes) is a variant of the game that Tetris was inspired by. The goal is to arrange various five-block pieces into specific rectangle shapes of 60 blocks, of the sizes 6 x 10, 5 x 12, 4 x 15 or 3 x 20. Unlike Tetris, the blocks do not move, so you have as much time as you want to rotate / flip the pieces, try different options, and try again. It works well enough using the mouse. However, note that you may need to press Ctrl-F10 to manually lock the mouse in DOSBox or the game may not detect your mouse. Also the game is available in both English and French.

name: Pentris
description: Pentris is like Tetris, except the pieces are pentominoes. It's described on the title screen as being "a game for very smart people". Well, if you've played Tetris, but feel like it's just too easy, or the pieces are big an unwieldy enough, try Pentris. Being made of five blocks each instead of four, they're much harder to stack. But if you're looking for a challenge, this may be for you! You can select your difficulty level, but other than that there are no options, and only a couple of PC speaker beeps and clicks throughout the game.

name: Pepsi Handball
description: Pepsi Handball is an exciting Flash-based sports game that brings the fast-paced action of handball to life with a fun and refreshing twist. Sponsored by Pepsi, the game features vibrant visuals and a simple control scheme, making it easy for players of all skill levels to jump in and enjoy. Gameplay: Players control a handball team, passing the ball between teammates, dodging opponents, and aiming to score goals against the opposing team’s goalie. The game involves a mix of strategy and reflexes, as you must time your passes and shots carefully to outmaneuver defenders and score. Levels become progressively harder, with quicker opponents and more challenging gameplay mechanics introduced as you advance. The Pepsi branding is integrated seamlessly into the game, often appearing as background elements or power-ups that boost your speed or accuracy. With its combination of sporty action, smooth controls, and engaging challenges, Pepsi Handball is a fun, fast-paced game that captures the spirit of handball while offering a lighthearted and casual gaming experience. Perfect for quick gaming sessions, it’s a memorable addition to the lineup of branded Flash games!

name: Perestroika
description: Also known as Toppler, this Russian made game (with text in Russian, but its not really necessary to play the game) was apparently made, in part, as a social political commentary. Right, whatever, it's a fun game to play. The object is to hop across rapidly sinking and reappearing lily pads, collecting bonus tokens and eventually making it to the last golden coin (?) token, and moving on to the next level. Strangely entertaining!Perestroika (also known as Toppler) is a unique and symbolic DOS arcade game developed during the late 1980s and inspired by the political and economic reforms of the Soviet Union, referred to as "Perestroika." The game uses its quirky gameplay and abstract graphics to represent themes of change, adaptation, and survival. Gameplay: Players control a small frog-like character (symbolizing change or reform) that must hop across lily pads in a pond, which represent a rapidly shifting and unstable environment. The goal is to collect tokens (often symbolic of political or economic points) and safely reach the next level while avoiding falling into the water as the lily pads disappear or move unpredictably. Hazards include sinking platforms, enemies like bugs, and increasingly difficult navigation as the game progresses. Success requires careful planning, quick reflexes, and the ability to adapt to the constantly changing layout of the platforms. Features: The game combines arcade action with an underlying political allegory, reflecting the instability and uncertainty of the Soviet Union's Perestroika period. Simple yet addictive gameplay, accompanied by colorful graphics and a retro soundtrack, makes it a memorable experience. Perestroika is a fascinating piece of gaming history that stands out for its creative mechanics and clever political symbolism, offering a challenging and meaningful arcade experience.

name: Perils of Treasure Mountain
description: Perils of Treasure Mountain is a modern game done with CGA graphics which easily could pass for being an authentic game released many years ago. Your goal is to collect the treasure said to be hidden in a mine. In order to do that, you'll need to avoid many obstacles like snakes and bandits, while collecting and using items that will aid your noble (?) quest. The game plays well, with simple controls that work as they should. Your character moves block-by-block which could take some getting used to for some players but it works well for this action / adventure hybrid game.

name: Permanent Daylight
description: For those of you who enjoyed classic adventure games from Sierra like Space Quest, King's Quest and Leisure Suit Larry (for older gamers, of course ...) and Lucasarts games like Monkey Island, this is the game for you! It's a bit short (I finished it in roughly a half hour) and the plot is a bit of an adventure game cliche by now, but it has great graphics and an interface almost identical to that of the later Sierra point and click games.Permanent Daylight is a unique and atmospheric DOS action-adventure game with a sci-fi twist. The game immerses players in a futuristic world where they must navigate surreal landscapes, solve puzzles, and survive against challenging foes, all under the constant glare of eternal daylight. Gameplay: Players control a protagonist tasked with exploring a mysterious, brightly lit environment, where shadows are nonexistent, and the perpetual daylight has unsettling effects on the world. The game combines exploration with fast-paced combat, requiring players to outwit enemies and make use of environmental elements for survival. Puzzles and obstacles are scattered throughout the levels, challenging players to use logic and creativity to progress. The persistent daylight introduces unique gameplay mechanics, such as light-based hazards or visibility puzzles, making the environment itself a key part of the challenge. Features: Graphics and Atmosphere: Retro-style pixel graphics with an otherworldly aesthetic create a captivating and eerie atmosphere. Sound Design: An ambient soundtrack and dynamic sound effects enhance the immersive experience. Storyline: The narrative explores themes of isolation, survival, and the mysteries behind the unending daylight. Permanent Daylight stands out as a thought-provoking and challenging DOS game, blending action, strategy, and a mysterious setting to create a memorable gaming experience for fans of retro adventures.

name: Pesten
description: Pesten: the Dutch version of Crazy Eights. Be the first player to play away all your cards.Pesten is a classic Dutch card game, often referred to as the Dutch version of "Crazy Eights," available in an HTML5 format for easy play on modern devices. This multiplayer game is easy to learn yet full of strategy and surprises, making it a fun choice for players of all ages. Gameplay: The goal of the game is to be the first player to get rid of all your cards. Players take turns playing cards that match the rank or suit of the card on the discard pile. If a player can't play a card, they must draw from the deck. Special cards have unique effects: 7: Forces the next player to draw two cards. 8: Skips the next player's turn. Jack: Acts as a wild card, allowing the player to choose the next suit. Other variations may include additional rules, depending on the house rules. Features in the HTML Version: Single-player or multiplayer mode: Play against AI or challenge friends. Customizable rules: Adjust the special card effects to match your preferred way of playing. Smooth interface: Drag-and-drop functionality or simple click-to-play controls. Visuals and Sounds: A colorful and lively design paired with fun sound effects to enhance the experience. Pesten HTML offers an entertaining digital version of the beloved card game, perfect for casual gaming sessions or honing your strategy skills. Whether you're a fan of Crazy Eights or just love card games, this version brings the fun of Pesten to your browser!

name: Pet Lianlian Kan
description: "Lianlian Kan" is a classic puzzle game that often features different themes, including car brands and other popular motifs. The gameplay typically involves matching tiles or items to clear them from the board, and it can be quite addictive. If you're looking for a specific Flash game with a car brand theme or similar puzzle games, it might be harder to find since many Flash games are no longer supported. However, you can look for modern versions or similar puzzle games on various online gaming platforms or app stores. If you need help finding alternatives, just let me know!

name: Pet Link
description: Fun Mahjong Link game with Pets. Connect two of the same pets to remove the pets from the game. You can only use a connecting path with a maximum of 2 turns.Pet Link is an adorable and relaxing HTML5 puzzle game where players match pairs of cute animal tiles to clear the board. With its simple gameplay and charming visuals, it's a delightful game for players of all ages. Gameplay: The goal is to match pairs of tiles featuring adorable pets, such as cats, dogs, rabbits, and more, by drawing a line between them. Tiles can only be linked if the path between them has no more than two turns (90-degree angles). As you progress, the board layouts become more complex, and the time to clear the board may be limited, adding a layer of challenge. Power-ups and hints are sometimes available to help when you're stuck. Features: Cute Graphics: Bright, cheerful visuals with lovable pet-themed designs. Progressive Levels: Increasing difficulty with new layouts and challenges as you advance. Relaxing or Timed Modes: Play at your own pace in a relaxing mode or test your skills with a time limit. Accessible Gameplay: Intuitive controls, typically using just clicks or taps, make it easy to pick up and play. Pet Link HTML is perfect for casual gamers who enjoy light, brain-teasing puzzles combined with a heartwarming theme. It’s a great way to unwind while testing your observation and pattern-matching skills!

name: Pet Mahjongg
description: Combine 2 of the same free pet tiles to remove them from the game. Free tiles are highlighted. You can combine any flower tile with another flower tile, the same applies to the season tiles.Pet Mahjongg is a delightful and casual HTML5 version of the classic Mahjong game, featuring cute pet-themed tiles. The goal is to match pairs of identical tiles in order to clear the board, and as you progress, the challenge increases with more complex tile arrangements and limited time. Gameplay: Matching Tiles: Players must find and match pairs of identical pet-themed tiles (such as puppies, kittens, and other animals) to clear the board. Tile Restrictions: Tiles can only be matched if they are "free" — meaning they are not covered by other tiles and are not locked between two adjacent tiles. Strategic Play: The challenge comes in planning which tiles to match and when, as each move affects the available options for later. Timed Mode: Some versions feature a timer, adding a sense of urgency to the gameplay, while others allow for a more relaxed pace. Features: Adorable Graphics: Featuring a variety of cute pets as the tile designs, adding a fun, whimsical atmosphere. Relaxing yet Challenging: While the game starts easy, it becomes more complex as you progress, making it enjoyable for players of all skill levels. Multiple Levels: Increasing difficulty as you clear levels, with different tile layouts and challenges. Undo/Hint Options: Some versions offer hints or the ability to undo moves, helping players when they’re stuck. Pet Mahjongg HTML is perfect for fans of Mahjong who enjoy cute and calming themes, offering a relaxing and engaging puzzle experience that can be played at your own pace. Whether you're playing casually or aiming for the highest score, it's a great way to unwind while exercising your mind.

name: Pet-Jet
description: Pet-Jet is a Galaxian / Galaga inspired shoot-em-up. It features high-res 640 x 480 graphics and high-intensity alien-blasting action! Your ship actually moves in blocks rather than moving smoothly, so that takes some getting used to. But you can mostly just fire rapidly and kill most of the aliens as they move back and forth along the screen. Be cast though because the aliens will soon start flying down to attack you! The controls are a bit awkward (use the right Alt / Ctrl buttons to move left / right, and Spacebar to shoot) especially since I tend to accidentally hit my Windows key while playing and breaking the action! Unfortunately they can't be reconfigured.

name: Peter Pan: A Story Painting Adventure
description: Peter Pan: A Story Painting Adventure is a simple game aimed at young children. You control Peter Pan as he goes on an adventure and encounters a variety of different challenges. You interact by choosing an action that one of the four "Paintbox Pals" at the bottom of the screen suggests to help Peter get out of trouble. All of the actions are valid and will work, so there's not really any challenge to the game, it's more like a "Choose Your Own Adventure" where all of the options win. It might be fun for small kids because the production values are high.

name: Peter-Box
description: Peter-Box (aka PeterBox or Peter Box) is a block-pushing game, similar to Sokoban or Boxxle. It seems to play fairly well, you are able to save your progress, and the graphics are simple but functional. There aren't many innovations to the classic formula here however, and all of the levels consist of pushing blocks onto X's.Peter-Box is a classic DOS puzzle game, released in the early 1990s, that combines elements of strategy, problem-solving, and logic. It is a top-down maze game where players navigate a small character (Peter) through various levels, with the ultimate goal of collecting objects, avoiding obstacles, and solving puzzles within each level. Gameplay: The player controls Peter, a character who moves around a maze-like environment filled with boxes, obstacles, and other challenges. The core mechanic involves pushing and stacking boxes in a specific way to clear paths or reach certain areas, much like in games such as Sokoban. Each level presents different arrangements of boxes, and players need to carefully plan their moves to avoid getting stuck or blocking themselves from completing the objective. The difficulty increases as new puzzles are introduced, requiring more complex box arrangements or timing to complete tasks within a level. Features: Challenging Puzzles: The game features various levels that test your problem-solving and spatial awareness skills. Simple Controls: The controls are straightforward, typically involving movement with the keyboard arrow keys or WASD keys and interaction with objects. Increasing Complexity: As you progress, the puzzles become harder, with new obstacles, more boxes to move, and more complicated layouts to navigate. Retro Graphics: The game features classic pixelated graphics and a minimalist design that was typical of early DOS games. Peter-Box is a fun, brain-teasing puzzle game that offers hours of entertainment for fans of strategy and logic games. Though simple in design, it provides a rewarding challenge as you work your way through increasingly difficult puzzles. If you enjoy games that test your spatial reasoning and puzzle-solving skills, this is a great classic to explore.

name: Petris
description: Petris is a text-mode clone of the classic puzzle game Tetris, but with a twist. It introduces unconventional mechanics that ramp up the difficulty and challenge players in unexpected ways. With its minimalist design and unique gameplay features, Petris offers a fresh and engaging experience for fans of the genre. Game Features: Text-Mode Design: Minimalist Aesthetic: The game is rendered in ASCII characters, giving it a retro, text-based look. Simple Interface: The well, blocks, and score are displayed using basic characters, making it lightweight and easy to run on any system. Unique Mechanics: Beginner Level: Pieces do not move down automatically. Players must manually move each piece downward, adding a layer of strategy and control. Medium Easy Level: A 10-second timer is introduced. If the player doesn’t drop the piece in time, it automatically falls for them. Medium Hard Level: Players cannot rotate the blocks, forcing them to rely solely on positioning. Expert Level: Combines the timer from Medium Easy and the no-rotation rule from Medium Hard, creating a highly challenging experience. Wide Well: The game’s well is wider than traditional Tetris, making it harder to clear lines and requiring more strategic planning. Scoring and Progression: Line Clearing: Clear lines to earn points, with higher scores for clearing multiple lines at once. Increasing Difficulty: As the game progresses, the mechanics become more challenging, testing the player’s adaptability and skill. Controls: Keyboard Inputs: Simple controls for moving pieces left, right, and down, as well as rotating them (where allowed). Manual Dropping: Players must actively drop pieces in Beginner mode, adding a unique twist to the gameplay.

name: PhantomTris
description: PhantomTris is, in most ways, a pretty typical Tetris clone. It looks like it's done in text mode, but a certain feature (I'll mention it in a moment) reveals that it's actually not. It plays the same way as regular Tetris: Drop the pieces, make lines, and clear 'em from the well. You can set they keys, the speed, and also the "zoom". What does "zoom" do? Well, it zooms in and out on the well while you're playing, making everything gradually smaller and then everything gets gradually larger again, then repeat. It's strange and distracting and not at all enjoyable, but hey, if you want to play Tetris except want to make it slightly more annoying, give it a shot ...

name: Pharaoh's Tomb
description: It's a classic! Apogee Software (who went on to publish Commander Keen, Duke Nukem, and many other famous games) published Pharaoh's Tomb first. It's a platform/puzzle game that's low on action and high on tricky jumps and movements. Clearly some influence from games like Montezuma's Revenge and Rick Dangerous. It admittedly has poor CGA graphics and annoying PC speaker sound effects and one-hit deaths ... but it's still cool as a classic platform jumping game. The full version of this game game has been released for free.

name: Pharmacy
description: Pharmacy is a Dr Mario clone. Strangely, the included docs only reference Tetris: "Pharmacy is similar to Tetris, only more addictive." This game was released about four years after Dr Mario, so there's clearly some influence there. Maybe they were hoping Nintendo wouldn't mind as long as they didn't mention Dr Mario? Anyways, the goal here is to match four of the same color pill segments/viruses to clear them from the well. Once you get rid of all the viruses you move to the next level. It plays fine, and looks decent although pretty plain. (There are some graphical glitches related to the mouse, but it may be a DOSBox issue, and it doesn't affect the gameplay.) There are some minimal options, and you can even play a simultaneous two-player game which is a neat feature.

name: Phase2
description: Phase2 is a graphically impressive game with extremely difficult controls which makes it not much fun to play. The goal is to protect your buildings using your flying ship. Before the level you buy weapons to use, and fly around by tilting your ship using the mouse and using a thruster. The issue is that you lose power whenever you touch the ground, and it's nearly impossible to even get to the buildings to defend them without dying, let alone destroy all of the enemy ships. Maybe with a lot of practice it's doable, but as it stands, it's more of an impressive tech demo with 3D graphics and Soundblaster sound effects than an enjoyable game.

name: Phylox
description: Phylox is a retro side-scrolling shoot-'em-up (shmup) developed by Beavis-Soft, the creators behind the iconic kart racing engine used in Wacky Wheels and Skunny Kart. In this fast-paced action game, players take control of a spacesuit-wearing hero who must blast their way through hordes of mutated insect enemies, using a combination of standard weapons and grenades to clear the path and survive the onslaught. Game Features: Side-Scrolling Action: Players move from left to right across a scrolling 2D plane, battling waves of enemies and avoiding obstacles. The game features multiple levels, each with unique environments and increasingly difficult enemy patterns. Player Character: A spacesuit-wearing hero equipped with a blaster for standard attacks and grenades for clearing large groups of enemies. The character can move in all directions (up, down, left, right) to dodge enemy fire and position themselves for attacks. Enemies and Bosses: Mutated Insects: A variety of creepy-crawly enemies with unique attack patterns and behaviors. Boss Fights: At the end of each level, players face a challenging boss that requires strategy and skill to defeat. Weapons and Power-Ups: Blaster: The primary weapon for taking down enemies one by one. Grenades: Limited-use explosives that clear the screen of enemies and obstacles. Power-Ups: Occasionally, players can collect power-ups to enhance their blaster or gain temporary abilities. Controls: Keyboard or Joystick: Players can choose their preferred input method for precise control. Simple Mechanics: Easy-to-learn controls for movement, shooting, and grenade usage. Retro Aesthetic: Pixel Art Graphics: A classic 16-bit style with vibrant colors and detailed sprites. Chiptune Music: Catchy, upbeat music that complements the fast-paced gameplay. Difficulty and Challenge: Increasing Difficulty: Enemies become more numerous and aggressive as the game progresses. Limited Resources: Grenades are scarce, requiring players to use them strategically.

name: Pickle Wars
description: Pickle Wars is a sidescrolling shooting, jumping, and item collection game. The gameplay itself is fairly basic, the animation is a bit clunky but overall the game still plays fairly well. The plot is that giant pickle-shaped aliens are trying to take over the Earth, and only brave Dave, armed with his Salad Shooter, can save the world. The graphics and sound effects are pretty average, but both are unique, as is the storyline. I didn't personally enjoy it as much as Apogee or Epic's sidescrollers, but you'll have to try it out for yourself ... its a relatively well-known game from its time.

name: Pico's School
description: "Pico's School" is a classic Flash game created by Tom Fulp, the founder of Newgrounds. Released in 1999, this action-packed game combines elements of shooting, puzzle-solving, and humor in a quirky, school-themed setting. Players take on the role of Pico, a student who must defend his school from a gang of bullies and other bizarre enemies. Game Features: Storyline: Pico arrives at school only to find it overrun by a gang of bullies led by the menacing Cassandra. Armed with a water pistol, Pico must fight his way through the school to rescue his classmates and restore order. Gameplay Mechanics: Shooting Action: Players use Pico’s water pistol to shoot enemies, with limited ammo that can be replenished by collecting water bottles. Puzzle Elements: Some levels require players to solve puzzles or find keys to progress. Boss Battles: Each level ends with a challenging boss fight, requiring strategy and quick reflexes to defeat. Levels and Environments: The game features multiple levels set in different areas of the school, including classrooms, hallways, and the gym. Each level introduces new enemies and obstacles, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging. Enemies: A variety of quirky enemies, including bullies, nerds, and even a giant worm, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns. Weapons and Power-Ups: Water Pistol: Pico’s primary weapon, effective against most enemies. Grenades: Limited-use explosives for dealing with large groups of enemies. Health Packs: Restore Pico’s health, which is essential for surviving tougher encounters. Controls: Keyboard Inputs: Simple controls for movement, shooting, and using grenades. Intuitive Interface: Easy-to-learn mechanics that make the game accessible to players of all skill levels. Retro Aesthetic: Pixel Art Graphics: A charming, retro-style visual design that adds to the game’s nostalgic appeal. Humor and Quirkiness: The game is filled with humorous dialogue and absurd situations, characteristic of Tom Fulp’s signature style.

name: Picture Pie - Harbour City
description: Play a picture pie puzzle in Harbour City. You can swap 2 adjacent parts. Try to complete the image."Picture Pie - Harbour City" is a soothing and visually engaging puzzle game where players piece together a beautiful, vibrant image of a bustling harbor city. Designed in HTML, this game combines the charm of traditional jigsaw puzzles with the convenience of digital play. Perfect for players of all ages, it offers a relaxing yet stimulating experience. Game Features: Objective: Players must assemble a complete image of a picturesque harbor city by dragging and dropping puzzle pieces into their correct positions. Gameplay Mechanics: Drag-and-Drop Interface: Intuitive controls allow players to easily move puzzle pieces around the screen. Rotatable Pieces: Some pieces may need to be rotated to fit correctly, adding an extra layer of challenge. Snap-to-Place: Pieces snap into place when correctly positioned, providing satisfying feedback. Puzzle Difficulty: Adjustable Difficulty: Players can choose from different difficulty levels by selecting the number of pieces (e.g., 50, 100, 200). Customizable Experience: Options to show or hide the reference image, and toggle piece rotation on or off. Visuals and Design: Stunning Artwork: The harbor city image features vibrant colors, detailed architecture, and lively scenes of boats, markets, and people. High-Quality Graphics: Crisp, high-resolution images ensure a visually pleasing experience. Sound and Music: Relaxing Music: Calm, ambient background music enhances the soothing atmosphere. Sound Effects: Subtle sounds for piece movements and placements add to the immersive experience. User Interface: Clean and Intuitive Design: Easy-to-navigate menus and controls make the game accessible to all players. Responsive Design: The game is optimized for both desktop and mobile devices, ensuring a seamless experience across platforms. Progress Tracking: Timer: Optional timer feature for players who want to challenge themselves to complete the puzzle quickly. Save Progress: Players can save their progress and return to the puzzle later.

name: Picture Puzzle
description: Picture Puzzle is a fairly standard mixed-up-picture game, where the image is broken up into pieces and you need to put each rectangular piece back into its proper place to re-assemble the image. This program allows you to change the difficulty by specifying the size of the pieces (and therefore the number of pieces) but unfortunately the minimum number (at least in the shareware version) is 32, which is likely too complex for small children to handle. The game also comes with only three images, and they are in a proprietary format so you can't just add your own. These factors limit the target audience and replayability of the game.

name: Pile of Tiles
description: Combine 2 of the same (free) tiles to remove the tiles. Remove all tiles to advance to the next level."Pile of Tiles" is an engaging and strategic puzzle game where players must arrange and match tiles to achieve high scores. Designed in HTML, this game combines elements of classic tile-matching games with unique mechanics that challenge players to think ahead and plan their moves carefully. Perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike, "Pile of Tiles" offers endless hours of fun and mental stimulation. Game Features: Objective: Players must match three or more identical tiles to clear them from the board and earn points. The goal is to achieve the highest score possible before running out of moves or filling the board. Gameplay Mechanics: Tile Matching: Match three or more tiles of the same type to clear them from the board. Special Tiles: Create special tiles by matching four or more tiles, which can clear entire rows, columns, or large areas when activated. Combo System: Chain multiple matches in a single move to earn bonus points and create powerful effects. Levels and Challenges: Progressive Difficulty: As players advance through levels, the game introduces new challenges, such as obstacles, limited moves, or time constraints. Unique Objectives: Some levels have specific goals, such as clearing a certain number of tiles or achieving a target score. Visuals and Design: Colorful Tiles: Vibrant and visually appealing tile designs make the game attractive and enjoyable. Clean Interface: A user-friendly interface with clear indicators for moves, scores, and objectives.

name: Pile of Tiles Connect
description: Connect Mahjong tiles and remove all tiles. You can connect when the connecting path has no more than two bends."Pile of Tiles Connect" is a captivating and strategic puzzle game where players must connect matching tiles to clear the board and achieve high scores. Designed in HTML, this game combines elements of classic tile-matching games with unique mechanics that challenge players to think ahead and plan their moves carefully. Perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike, "Pile of Tiles Connect" offers endless hours of fun and mental stimulation. Game Features: Objective: Players must connect two or more identical tiles to clear them from the board and earn points. The goal is to achieve the highest score possible before running out of moves or filling the board. Gameplay Mechanics: Tile Connecting: Connect two or more tiles of the same type to clear them from the board. Connections can be made horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Special Tiles: Create special tiles by connecting four or more tiles, which can clear entire rows, columns, or large areas when activated. Combo System: Chain multiple connections in a single move to earn bonus points and create powerful effects. Levels and Challenges: Progressive Difficulty: As players advance through levels, the game introduces new challenges, such as obstacles, limited moves, or time constraints. Unique Objectives: Some levels have specific goals, such as clearing a certain number of tiles or achieving a target score.

name: Pinball
description: Classic Pinball game. Use the arrow keys to control the game or drag and tap on the screen."Pinball" is a digital recreation of the classic arcade pinball machine, designed in HTML to bring the excitement and nostalgia of the beloved game to your browser. With realistic physics, vibrant visuals, and engaging gameplay, this HTML pinball game offers hours of fun for players of all ages. Whether you're a pinball wizard or a casual player, this game captures the essence of the arcade experience. Game Features: Realistic Pinball Physics: The game simulates the physics of a real pinball machine, including ball movement, flipper action, and bumpers. Players can control the flippers to keep the ball in play and aim for high scores. Interactive Playfield: Bumpers and Targets: Hit bumpers and targets to earn points and activate special features. Ramps and Chutes: Navigate the ball through ramps and chutes for bonus points and multi-ball opportunities. Spinners and Rollovers: Spin the spinners and activate rollovers to increase your score. Multiple Levels and Modes: Classic Mode: Play a traditional pinball game with a single ball and a focus on high scores. Multi-Ball Mode: Activate multi-ball for chaotic and high-scoring gameplay. Challenge Mode: Complete specific objectives, such as hitting a certain number of targets or achieving a target score. Visuals and Design: Vibrant Graphics: The playfield features colorful and detailed designs, reminiscent of classic arcade pinball machines. Dynamic Lighting: Light effects and animations enhance the visual appeal and excitement.

name: Pinball Breakout
description: What do you get if you combine Pinball and Breakout? Shoot all the bricks using the pinball flippers."Pinball Breakout" is an innovative HTML game that combines the best elements of pinball and Breakout into one exciting experience. Players control flippers to keep a ball in play, while also breaking through rows of bricks to score points. With its unique blend of mechanics, vibrant visuals, and addictive gameplay, "Pinball Breakout" offers a fresh take on two classic arcade genres. Game Features: Hybrid Gameplay: Pinball Mechanics: Use flippers to keep the ball in play, aiming for targets and bumpers to score points. Breakout Elements: Break through rows of bricks at the top of the screen to earn additional points and clear the level. Interactive Playfield: Bumpers and Targets: Hit bumpers and targets to earn points and activate special features. Bricks: Break bricks to score points and uncover power-ups or hidden bonuses. Ramps and Chutes: Navigate the ball through ramps and chutes for bonus points and multi-ball opportunities. Power-Ups and Special Features: Power-Ups: Collect power-ups that enhance gameplay, such as larger flippers, faster balls, or extra lives. Multi-Ball Mode: Activate multi-ball for chaotic and high-scoring gameplay. Special Bricks: Some bricks have special effects, such as exploding to clear surrounding bricks or dropping power-ups.

name: Pinball Dreams
description: Pinball Dreams is a four-table pinball simulation created by Digital Illusions. (Only one is available in the demo.) The tables in the full version include Ignition, Steel Wheel, Beat Box, Nightmare. Although the game was originally released on the Amiga and later ported to DOS and many other systems, it looks, plays, and sounds great here as well."Pinball Dreams" is a legendary pinball simulation game originally released in 1992 for DOS. Developed by Digital Illusions CE (DICE), it brought the thrill of arcade pinball to personal computers with stunning graphics, realistic physics, and addictive gameplay. Featuring four unique pinball tables, "Pinball Dreams" became a benchmark for digital pinball games and remains a beloved classic among retro gaming enthusiasts. Game Features: Four Unique Pinball Tables: Ignition: A space-themed table with ramps, bumpers, and a focus on multi-ball action. Steel Wheel: A high-speed table with a racing theme, featuring loops and challenging targets. Beat Box: A music-themed table with a DJ setup, sound effects, and rhythm-based challenges. Nightmare: A spooky, Halloween-inspired table with eerie visuals and tricky shots. Realistic Pinball Physics: The game simulates the physics of a real pinball machine, including ball movement, flipper action, and bumper reactions. Players can control the flippers to keep the ball in play and aim for high scores. Interactive Playfield Elements: Bumpers and Targets: Hit bumpers and targets to earn points and activate special features. Ramps and Chutes: Navigate the ball through ramps and chutes for bonus points and multi-ball opportunities. Spinners and Rollovers: Spin the spinners and activate rollovers to increase your score. Game Modes: Single Player: Play on any of the four tables to achieve the highest score. Multiplayer: Compete against friends in a high-score challenge. Practice Mode: Learn the layout and mechanics of each table without pressure. Visuals and Design: Detailed Graphics: Each table features vibrant, detailed designs with unique themes and animations. Dynamic Lighting: Light effects and animations enhance the visual appeal and excitement.

name: Pinball Dreams 2
description: Pinball Dreams 2 carries on the tradition started by the first game. It features four new tables: Neptune, Safari, Revenge of the Robot Warriors, and Stall Turn. Only one, "Revenge of the Robot Warriors", is available in the demo version of the game. It features a busty lady holding guns. Yup, typical mid 90's aesthetic is here with gusto in this game."Pinball Dreams 2" is the highly anticipated sequel to the original "Pinball Dreams," released in 1993 for DOS. Developed by Digital Illusions CE (DICE), this game builds on the success of its predecessor with new pinball tables, enhanced graphics, and even more challenging gameplay. Like the original, "Pinball Dreams 2" captures the excitement of arcade pinball and remains a beloved classic among retro gaming enthusiasts. Game Features: Four New Unique Pinball Tables: Partyland: A festive, carnival-themed table with bright colors, ramps, and a focus on multi-ball action. Speed Devils: A high-octane table with a racing theme, featuring loops, jumps, and challenging targets. Pirates Gold: A swashbuckling adventure-themed table with treasure chests, cannons, and hidden bonuses. Stones 'n' Bones: A spooky, dungeon-themed table with eerie visuals, traps, and tricky shots. Realistic Pinball Physics: The game simulates the physics of a real pinball machine, including ball movement, flipper action, and bumper reactions. Players can control the flippers to keep the ball in play and aim for high scores. Interactive Playfield Elements: Bumpers and Targets: Hit bumpers and targets to earn points and activate special features. Ramps and Chutes: Navigate the ball through ramps and chutes for bonus points and multi-ball opportunities. Spinners and Rollovers: Spin the spinners and activate rollovers to increase your score. Game Modes: Single Player: Play on any of the four tables to achieve the highest score. Multiplayer: Compete against friends in a high-score challenge. Practice Mode: Learn the layout and mechanics of each table without pressure. Visuals and Design: Enhanced Graphics: Each table features more detailed and vibrant designs with unique themes and animations. Dynamic Lighting: Improved light effects and animations enhance the visual appeal and excitement.

name: Pinball Extravaganza
description: Pinball Extravaganza is a basic pinball-type game. Programmed by a high school student, it lacks a lot of finesse and doesn't do a great job of approximating an actual pinball experience. You do get a launcher, ramps, and targets to hit. But the ball behaves wildly, and it's difficult to actually use the flippers to hit the ball where you want it. A single table is included, with high scores."Pinball Extravaganza" is a classic DOS pinball game that brings the excitement and challenge of arcade pinball to your computer. Released in the early 1990s, this game features a variety of pinball tables with unique themes, realistic physics, and engaging gameplay. Designed for pinball enthusiasts, "Pinball Extravaganza" offers hours of fun and nostalgia for fans of retro gaming. Game Features: Multiple Pinball Tables: The game includes several unique pinball tables, each with its own theme, layout, and challenges. Themes range from sci-fi and fantasy to sports and adventure, providing diverse gameplay experiences. Realistic Pinball Physics: The game simulates the physics of a real pinball machine, including ball movement, flipper action, and bumper reactions. Players can control the flippers to keep the ball in play and aim for high scores. Interactive Playfield Elements: Bumpers and Targets: Hit bumpers and targets to earn points and activate special features. Ramps and Chutes: Navigate the ball through ramps and chutes for bonus points and multi-ball opportunities. Spinners and Rollovers: Spin the spinners and activate rollovers to increase your score. Game Modes: Single Player: Play on any of the tables to achieve the highest score. Multiplayer: Compete against friends in a high-score challenge. Practice Mode: Learn the layout and mechanics of each table without pressure.

name: Pinball Fantasies
description: Pinball Fantasies is a highly acclaimed pinball simulation game and a sequel to the popular Pinball Dreams. Known for its detailed graphics, catchy music, and realistic physics, the game offers an immersive and entertaining pinball experience. The demo version allows players to enjoy the game for 10 minutes before it shuts down, providing a taste of the full game's excitement. With its vibrant tables and engaging gameplay, Pinball Fantasies is a must-play for pinball enthusiasts and retro gaming fans. Key Features: Detailed Graphics: The game features beautifully designed pinball tables with vibrant colors and intricate details. Great Music: Each table has its own unique soundtrack, adding to the immersive experience. Realistic Physics: The game's physics engine provides an authentic pinball feel, making it satisfying to play. Multiple Tables: The full game includes several themed tables, each with its own objectives and challenges. Demo Version: The demo allows players to experience the game for 10 minutes, offering a glimpse of the full version's features. How to Play: Launch the Ball: Use the spacebar or a designated key to launch the ball onto the table. Control the Flippers: Use the left and right arrow keys or other controls to operate the flippers and keep the ball in play. Score Points: Hit targets, ramps, and other elements on the table to score points and trigger special features. Complete Objectives: Each table has unique objectives and challenges to complete, adding depth to the gameplay. Avoid Drain: Keep the ball from falling through the drain at the bottom of the table to extend your playtime.

name: Pinball Illusions
description: Pinball Illusions is a sequel to Pinball Fantasies which increases the resolution and adds new exciting tables. This demo includes the "Law 'n Justice" table (one of the four tables included in the full commercial release) which is a nice looking table with several ramps, bumpers, and three flippers. "Pinball Illusions" is a classic DOS pinball game developed by Digital Illusions CE (DICE) and released in 1995. Known for its stunning graphics, realistic physics, and engaging gameplay, "Pinball Illusions" is the third installment in the acclaimed "Pinball Dreams" series. It features four unique pinball tables, each with its own theme and challenges, offering players a diverse and immersive pinball experience. Game Features: Four Unique Pinball Tables: Excalibur: A medieval-themed table with castles, knights, and magical elements. Stones 'n' Bones: A spooky, dungeon-themed table with eerie visuals, traps, and tricky shots. Speed Devils: A high-octane table with a racing theme, featuring loops, jumps, and challenging targets. Nightmare: A Halloween-inspired table with creepy visuals and challenging gameplay. Realistic Pinball Physics: The game simulates the physics of a real pinball machine, including ball movement, flipper action, and bumper reactions. Players can control the flippers to keep the ball in play and aim for high scores. Interactive Playfield Elements: Bumpers and Targets: Hit bumpers and targets to earn points and activate special features. Ramps and Chutes: Navigate the ball through ramps and chutes for bonus points and multi-ball opportunities. Spinners and Rollovers: Spin the spinners and activate rollovers to increase your score. Game Modes: Single Player: Play on any of the four tables to achieve the highest score. Multiplayer: Compete against friends in a high-score challenge. Practice Mode: Learn the layout and mechanics of each table without pressure.

name: Ping Pong
description: ping pong fluxaza"Ping Pong" is a simple yet addictive HTML game that recreates the classic arcade experience of table tennis. Designed for quick and fun gameplay, this digital version of Ping Pong allows players to compete against an AI opponent or a friend in a fast-paced match. With intuitive controls and smooth mechanics, it’s perfect for casual gaming sessions. Game Features: Gameplay Mechanics: Paddle Control: Players control a paddle to hit the ball back and forth across the screen. Ball Physics: The ball moves realistically, bouncing off paddles and walls with accurate angles and speed. Scoring System: Points are scored when the opponent fails to return the ball. The first player to reach a set score (e.g., 11 points) wins. Game Modes: Single Player: Play against an AI opponent with adjustable difficulty levels (easy, medium, hard). Multiplayer: Compete against a friend on the same device, with each player controlling their own paddle. Visuals and Design: Minimalist Design: Clean and simple graphics with a focus on gameplay. Color Scheme: A retro-inspired color palette with contrasting colors for the paddles, ball, and background. Sound and Music: Sound Effects: Satisfying "ping" and "pong" sounds when the ball hits the paddles or walls. Background Music: Optional upbeat music to enhance the gaming experience.

name: Pipe Dream
description: Also known as Pipe Mania or Pipemania, this game about connecting pipes to allow liquids to flow freely spawned a huge number of imitators. Actually I don't know if Pipe Dream is the first of this kind of game, but it's probably the most well-known. This demo version allows you to choose one of three levels from the full game, each with its own custom tileset. The game looks great, and plays well, allowing use of the keyboard or mouse to place your pieces."Pipe Dream" is a classic DOS puzzle game developed by The Assembly Line and published by LucasArts in 1989. The game challenges players to construct a pipeline by connecting pipe pieces before a timer runs out. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, "Pipe Dream" became a popular title in the late 1980s and early 1990s, appealing to puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike. Game Features: Gameplay Mechanics: Pipe Placement: Players must connect pipe pieces to create a continuous pipeline. Timer: A timer counts down, and players must complete the pipeline before it reaches zero. Flow Rate: Once the pipeline is connected, a fluid begins to flow through it. The longer the pipeline, the more points are earned. Pipe Pieces: Straight Pipes: Basic pieces that connect in a straight line. Curved Pipes: Pieces that allow the pipeline to change direction. Cross Pipes: Pieces that allow the pipeline to branch in multiple directions. Special Pieces: Unique pieces that can alter the flow or provide bonuses. Levels and Difficulty: Progressive Difficulty: As players advance through levels, the game introduces more complex pipe layouts and faster timers. Unique Challenges: Some levels have specific objectives, such as creating a pipeline of a certain length or achieving a target score. Visuals and Design: Simple Graphics: The game features a clean and straightforward visual design, focusing on the puzzle elements. Color Coding: Different colors are used to distinguish between various pipe pieces and the fluid flow. Sound and Music: Sound Effects: Satisfying sounds for placing pipe pieces and the fluid flowing through the pipeline. Background Music: Upbeat and engaging music that complements the fast-paced gameplay. Controls: Keyboard Inputs: Simple controls for moving and placing pipe pieces (e.g., arrow keys and spacebar). Intuitive Interface: Easy-to-learn mechanics that make the game accessible to players of all skill levels.

name: Pirada
description: Pirada is a single-player puzzle / luck game where the object is to uncover flipped playing cards in a 5 x 5 grid, attempting to get rows and/or columns to add to a total of 21. The cards are randomly shuffled and laid out before each round. You score points based on how many "21's" you get in a round. You may also uncover a grenade instead of a card, which means you'd better click the "Finished" button to end the round quickly before the grenade explodes. It's a simple game with no options available to set, but it plays fine using the mouse as expected.

name: Pirate Bubbles
description: Help the Pirate Shoot the bubbles. Shoot bubbles up and create a group of 3 or more of the same bubbles to remove them."Pirate Bubbles" is an exciting and colorful HTML bubble-shooting game with a pirate theme. Players take on the role of a pirate aiming to clear the screen of bubbles by matching three or more of the same color. With its engaging gameplay, vibrant graphics, and pirate-themed elements, "Pirate Bubbles" offers hours of fun for players of all ages. Game Features: Gameplay Mechanics: Bubble Shooting: Players shoot bubbles from a cannon at the bottom of the screen to match and clear bubbles of the same color. Matching: Match three or more bubbles of the same color to pop them and earn points. Chain Reactions: Create chain reactions by strategically popping bubbles to clear large sections of the screen. Pirate Theme: Pirate Cannon: The bubble shooter is designed as a pirate cannon, adding to the thematic appeal. Treasure Chests: Occasionally, treasure chests appear, providing bonus points or power-ups when hit. Levels and Challenges: Progressive Difficulty: As players advance through levels, the game introduces more complex bubble arrangements and faster-moving bubbles. Unique Objectives: Some levels have specific goals, such as clearing a certain number of bubbles or achieving a target score. Power-Ups and Special Bubbles: Power-Ups: Collect power-ups that enhance gameplay, such as bombs to clear large areas or rainbow bubbles that match any color. Special Bubbles: Some bubbles have unique effects, such as exploding to clear surrounding bubbles or freezing bubbles in place.

name: Pirate Fry and Volcano Island
description: Fry is an enthusiastic adventurer looking to become a pirate! (Sounds ... familiar? *cough*Monkey Island*cough*) He needs to acquire a pirate's license, and to get it, he'll need to pass a series of challenges set before him by the pirate guild. As you might expect this game is a graphical adventure in the style of Sierra or Lucasarts point-and-click games. It was created using the Adventure Game Studio creation program (back then it was still called Adventure Creator)."Pirate Fry and Volcano Island" is a classic DOS adventure game that combines elements of exploration, puzzle-solving, and action. Released in the early 1990s, the game follows the daring exploits of Pirate Fry as he navigates the treacherous Volcano Island in search of hidden treasure. With its engaging storyline, challenging puzzles, and retro graphics, "Pirate Fry and Volcano Island" offers a nostalgic gaming experience for fans of classic adventure games. Game Features: Storyline: Players take on the role of Pirate Fry, a swashbuckling adventurer on a quest to uncover the legendary treasure hidden on Volcano Island. The island is filled with dangers, including volcanic eruptions, traps, and rival pirates, making the journey both thrilling and perilous. Gameplay Mechanics: Exploration: Navigate through various locations on Volcano Island, including jungles, caves, and ancient ruins. Puzzle-Solving: Solve a variety of puzzles to unlock hidden paths, find keys, and uncover clues to the treasure's location.
