Avoid Enemies: Steer clear of guards, robots, and other hazards that stand in your way. Solve Puzzles: Use your wits to overcome obstacles, such as locked doors, moving platforms, and hidden passages. Humor and Charm: The game’s lighthearted tone and humorous references to spy tropes add to its appeal. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but offer enough variety and challenge to keep players engaged. Visuals and Design: Secret Agent features EGA graphics, which, while limited in color, are clean and functional. The level designs are detailed and thematic, capturing the espionage setting with a retro charm. The character and enemy sprites are well-designed, and the interface is intuitive, ensuring that players can focus on the gameplay. Sound: The sound design includes catchy chiptune music and basic sound effects for actions like jumping, collecting items, and defeating enemies. The audio complements the game’s retro aesthetic and adds to the overall experience.

name: Secret Double Klondike
description: Secret Double Klondike is a challenging and engaging card game that combines elements of Klondike Solitaire with a unique twist. The goal is to build eight foundations in ascending order from Ace to King, while arranging cards on the tableau in descending order and alternating colors. With its additional foundations and strategic gameplay, Secret Double Klondike offers a fresh and rewarding experience for fans of solitaire games. Gameplay: The gameplay in Secret Double Klondike follows the traditional Klondike Solitaire rules with some key differences: Eight Foundations: Build eight foundations at the top of the screen in ascending order (Ace to King) and by suit. Tableau: Arrange cards on the tableau in descending order and alternating colors (red and black). Stock: Click the stock on the left to reveal a new open card, which can be played on the foundations or tableau. Strategy: Plan your moves carefully, as the additional foundations and tableau rules add complexity to the game. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and foresight to master. Visuals and Design: Secret Double Klondike features clean and functional graphics, with distinct card designs and a user-friendly interface. The layout is intuitive, making it easy to follow the game’s progress and plan your moves. The overall design is polished and straightforward, keeping the focus on the gameplay. Sound: The sound design is minimal, with basic sound effects for moving cards and completing sequences. The audio is unobtrusive, allowing players to concentrate on the strategic aspects of the game. Challenge and Replayability: The game’s challenge comes from the additional foundations and the need to carefully manage the tableau and stock. The replayability lies in the game’s variability, as each deal offers new opportunities to refine your tactics and try different strategies.

name: Secret Russian
description: Secret Russian is a challenging and strategic card game that combines elements of Russian Solitaire with hidden cards, adding an extra layer of complexity to the traditional solitaire formula. The goal is to move all the cards to the four foundations, building them in ascending order and by suit, while arranging cards on the tableau in descending order and by suit. With its hidden cards and strategic gameplay, Secret Russian offers a fresh and rewarding experience for fans of solitaire games. Gameplay: The gameplay in Secret Russian follows the traditional Russian Solitaire rules with a unique twist: Four Foundations: Move all cards to the four foundations at the top of the screen, building them in ascending order (Ace to King) and by suit. Tableau: Arrange cards on the tableau in descending order and by suit. Hidden Cards: Some cards are initially hidden, adding an element of uncertainty and strategy to the game. Move Open Cards and Sequences: All open cards and complete sequences can be moved to the foundations or other tableau piles. Strategy: Plan your moves carefully, as the hidden cards and tableau rules add complexity to the game. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and foresight to master. Visuals and Design: Secret Russian features clean and functional graphics, with distinct card designs and a user-friendly interface. The layout is intuitive, making it easy to follow the game’s progress and plan your moves. The overall design is polished and straightforward, keeping the focus on the gameplay. Sound: The sound design is minimal, with basic sound effects for moving cards and completing sequences. The audio is unobtrusive, allowing players to concentrate on the strategic aspects of the game. Challenge and Replayability: The game’s challenge comes from the hidden cards and the need to carefully manage the tableau and foundations. The replayability lies in the game’s variability, as each deal offers new opportunities to refine your tactics and try different strategies.

name: Seek and Destroy
description: Seek and Destroy is an entertaining and well-polished shooting game that stands out for its superb VGA graphics and Sound Blaster sound effects. Players take on missions using either a helicopter or a tank, navigating battlefields that smoothly rotate 360 degrees around their chosen vehicle. With its engaging gameplay and high-quality presentation, Seek and Destroy offers a thrilling experience for fans of action and shooting games, even though it didn’t gain widespread recognition upon its release. Gameplay: The gameplay in Seek and Destroy revolves around completing missions with either a chopper or a tank: Choose Your Vehicle: Before each mission, select either a helicopter or a tank, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. Complete Missions: Navigate the battlefield, destroy enemy targets, and achieve mission objectives. 360-Degree Rotation: The battlefield smoothly rotates around your vehicle, providing a dynamic and immersive perspective. Controls: The game controls are responsive and intuitive, allowing players to focus on the action. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but offer enough variety and challenge to keep players engaged. Visuals and Design: Seek and Destroy features superb VGA graphics, with detailed environments, vehicles, and explosions. The 360-degree rotation of the battlefield adds a unique and immersive visual element, making the game stand out from other shooters of its time. The overall design is polished and visually appealing, enhancing the gameplay experience. Sound: The game’s Sound Blaster sound effects are high-quality and immersive, with realistic engine noises, explosions, and gunfire. The audio complements the action and adds to the overall intensity of the game.

name: Seeker
description: Seeker is a game similar to Black Box and others I've seen before (notably more than once on Shovelware Diggers show). The object is to locate five hidden places on the 8x8 grid by firing energy beams. Based on the results (beam returns back, gets reflected elsewhere, gets absorbed) you can gradually reason out where the hidden places are located. Personally I don't enjoy this kind of game, but since I have seem multiple variations of it, some people must like it. At least this version offers mouse support, in fact it requires it to play.

name: Seeker of Wisdom
description: Seeker of Wisdom (or just "Seeker" everywhere past the title screen) is a strange early text-mode game from William Soleau of Soleau Software fame. The backstory and gameplay description included in the instructions is complicated, but basically you choose one of three positions to release your agent, and he runs around, and collects things (you don't control him past the initial drop) and then hopefully doesn't get caught by the counter-agent. It seems like mostly luck, and I'm still not sure what exactly the point is.

name: Senet
description: Senet is a classic board game from ancient Egypt, often considered one of the oldest known board games in history. The objective is to be the first player to move all your pieces off the board by strategically navigating them through a series of squares. With its simple yet engaging mechanics, Senet offers a fascinating glimpse into ancient Egyptian culture and provides a timeless and enjoyable experience for players of all ages. Gameplay: The gameplay in Senet revolves around strategic movement and dice-like mechanics: Move Pieces: Players take turns moving their pieces along a grid of 30 squares, arranged in three rows of ten. Roll Sticks: Instead of dice, players traditionally use sticks or knucklebones to determine how many squares to move. Avoid Obstacles: Certain squares have special rules, such as sending a piece back or blocking an opponent’s progress. Win the Game: The first player to move all their pieces off the board wins. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but offer enough depth to keep players engaged and challenged. Visuals and Design: Senet features simple and functional graphics, with a board layout and pieces that are easy to distinguish. The design is often inspired by ancient Egyptian art, adding a historical and cultural touch to the game. The interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, ensuring that players can focus on the strategic gameplay. Sound: The sound design is minimal, with basic sound effects for moving pieces and rolling sticks. The audio is unobtrusive, allowing players to concentrate on the game’s strategic elements.

name: Sensei Mahjongg
description: Sensei Mahjongg is a traditional Mahjong Solitaire game that stays true to the classic tile-matching formula. The goal is to clear the entire layout by matching pairs of identical tiles that are free (not blocked by other tiles on either side). With its straightforward mechanics and relaxing gameplay, Sensei Mahjongg offers a delightful experience for fans of puzzle games and Mahjong enthusiasts alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Sensei Mahjongg follows the traditional Mahjong Solitaire rules: Match Tiles: Find and select two identical tiles that are free (not covered and with at least one free side) to remove them from the board. Clear the Layout: The goal is to remove all tiles from the board by matching pairs. Strategy: Plan your moves carefully, as removing certain tiles can block or unlock others, affecting your ability to complete the layout. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and foresight to master. Visuals and Design: Sensei Mahjongg features clean and functional graphics, with traditional Mahjong tile designs and a user-friendly interface. The layout is intuitive, making it easy to follow the game’s progress and plan your moves. The overall design is polished and straightforward, keeping the focus on the puzzle-solving experience. Sound: The sound design is minimal, with basic sound effects for matching tiles and completing sequences. The audio is unobtrusive, allowing players to concentrate on the strategic aspects of the game.

name: Sensible World of Soccer
description: Sensible World of Soccer (often referred to as Sensible Soccer on the title screen) is a fast-paced and arcade-like soccer simulation game that has become a classic in the sports genre. In this demo version, players are assigned a team and play a match until one side scores a goal. Known for its simplicity, speed, and fun gameplay, Sensible World of Soccer offers an accessible and entertaining experience for soccer fans and casual gamers alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Sensible World of Soccer is designed to be quick and easy to pick up: Fast-Paced Matches: The game emphasizes speed and fluidity, with matches that are fast and action-packed. Simple Controls: Use the Shift key to kick the ball, making the controls intuitive and easy to learn. Tiny Players: The players are represented by small, pixelated sprites, but the gameplay remains smooth and responsive. Demo Version: In this version, players are assigned a team and play until a goal is scored, providing a quick and engaging experience. The game’s mechanics are straightforward, allowing players to focus on the fun and excitement of the match. Visuals and Design: Sensible World of Soccer features simple and functional graphics, with tiny player sprites and a top-down view of the field. While the visuals are minimalistic, they are effective and contribute to the game’s fast-paced and arcade-like feel. The interface is clean and easy to navigate, ensuring that players can focus on the action. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects for kicking the ball, crowd reactions, and other in-game actions. The audio is functional and complements the gameplay without being distracting.

name: Sergeant Duffy and the Kidnapped Scientist
description: Sergeant Duffy & the Kidnapped Scientist is not a good game. It's definitely made by someone who was experimenting with game development, perhaps for the first time. However it is a game that people would likely remember playing once they downloaded it, and it does offer some variety, so it's included here. Your mission is to rescue the kidnapped scientist Dr Jones. First you fly through a vertically scrolling stage avoiding obstacles, then jump through a spike-strewn cavern to rescue the doctor. Then the game ends.

name: SerpentHead
description: SerpentHead is inspired by the classic first-person adventure game Shadowgate (as the developers themselves note) and it features a similar plot (explore the castle) and also a similar UI (click a verb, then click a thing). The story for the game is LENGTHY and included in a separate file (see README.DOC) for those who want to read the whole backstory. Basically you click around, trying things on things, until you make progress. There doesn't seem to be as much that will instantly kill you (like Shadowgate) but on the other hand, the castle itself doesn't seem nearly as interesting as the classic game.

name: SerpentHead Deluxe
description: SerpentHead Deluxe is a reimagined version of the original SerpentHead game, featuring upgraded graphics, a simplified user interface, and a lengthy introduction with enhanced visuals. The game retains the core gameplay of the original, which is reminiscent of first-person adventure games like Shadowgate, but with less intricate room designs. While the improvements in visuals and presentation are notable, the gameplay remains largely unchanged, offering a nostalgic yet somewhat simplistic experience for fans of retro adventure games. Gameplay: The gameplay in SerpentHead Deluxe follows the same formula as the original: First-Person Exploration: Navigate through a series of rooms, solving puzzles and uncovering the story. Inventory Management: Collect and use items to progress through the game. Puzzle Solving: Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and advance the narrative. Simplified Interface: The user interface has been streamlined, making it easier to interact with the game world. While the gameplay is functional, it lacks the depth and complexity of more well-known adventure games like Shadowgate. Visuals and Design: SerpentHead Deluxe features upgraded graphics compared to the original, with a larger viewing area and more detailed visuals. The introduction sequence includes nice visuals and text, replacing the original DOC file and adding to the game’s presentation. The overall design is polished and more visually appealing, enhancing the player’s immersion. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects and possibly background music, though the audio is not a standout feature of the game. The focus remains on the visuals and gameplay.

name: Set the Hostages Free
description: Set the Hostages Free is a unique and innovative game created in 1981, notable for its use of color ASCII text-mode "graphics" and its early exploration of action and strategy mechanics. The game tasks players with rescuing hostages by shooting bandits that move around a central area, all while managing a limited number of shots. With its rotating gun/pointer and fast-paced gameplay, Set the Hostages Free feels reminiscent of classic arcade games like Tempest, Qix, or Warlords, making it a fascinating piece of gaming history. Gameplay: The gameplay in Set the Hostages Free is simple yet challenging: Rotate and Shoot: Control a gun/pointer that rotates around the game board, shooting at bandits that move around the central area. Rescue Hostages: The hostages are represented by ASCII characters (1 & 2) in the center of the board. To rescue them, you must eliminate the bandits. Limited Shots: Players have a limited number of shots, adding a layer of strategy and precision to the gameplay. Fast-Paced Action: The game requires quick reflexes and careful aiming to succeed, similar to classic arcade shooters. The game’s mechanics are easy to understand but difficult to master, offering a rewarding challenge for players. Visuals and Design: Set the Hostages Free features color ASCII text-mode "graphics", with characters and symbols representing the gun, bandits, and hostages. While the visuals are minimalistic, they are functional and add to the game’s retro charm. The interface is straightforward, keeping the focus on the action. Sound: As a text-mode game from 1981, Set the Hostages Free does not include sound effects or music. The focus is entirely on the gameplay and the challenge of rescuing the hostages.

name: Shadow Ape
description: Shadow Ape is a unique and unconventional first-person graphical adventure game that draws inspiration from classics like Shadowgate and Deja Vu. The game simplifies the adventure formula by limiting player actions to Use, Take, and Do, and features a minimalistic design with only a few interactive elements in each location. While the lack of an obvious story and the mysterious title may leave players puzzled, Shadow Ape offers a quirky and distinct experience for fans of retro adventure games. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shadow Ape is streamlined and straightforward: Three Actions: Players can Use, Take, or Do with objects in the environment, limiting the complexity of interactions. Limited Interactions: Each location has only a few interactive elements, making it easier to find solutions through trial and error. Puzzle Solving: The primary goal is to find keys and open doors to progress through the game. Minimalist Design: The game’s simplicity and lack of a clear narrative make it a unique and somewhat cryptic experience. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but may feel overly simplistic compared to more complex adventure games. Visuals and Design: Shadow Ape features basic graphical visuals, with a first-person perspective that immerses players in the game world. The environments are minimalistic, with only a few objects to interact with in each location. The design is functional but lacks the detail and atmosphere of more polished adventure games. Sound: The sound design is minimal, with basic sound effects for actions like opening doors or picking up items. The audio is unobtrusive but does little to enhance the overall experience.

name: Shadow Fighters
description: Shadow Fighters is a fast-paced and action-packed fighting game that pits two fighters against each other in intense one-on-one battles. Known for its smooth animations, responsive controls, and diverse character roster, Shadow Fighters offers a thrilling experience for fans of the fighting game genre. The game’s focus on dual fights ensures that players can enjoy competitive matches with friends or against the AI. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shadow Fighters revolves around one-on-one combat: Diverse Characters: Choose from a roster of unique fighters, each with their own special moves and fighting styles. Smooth Controls: The game features responsive and intuitive controls, allowing players to execute combos and special moves with precision. Dual Fights: Engage in competitive matches against a friend or the AI, with a focus on strategy, timing, and skill. Special Moves: Each character has a set of special moves and finishing techniques, adding depth and variety to the combat. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but offer enough depth to keep players engaged and challenged. Visuals and Design: Shadow Fighters features detailed and fluid animations, with well-designed characters and dynamic backgrounds. The visual style is polished and immersive, creating an exciting atmosphere for the fights. The interface is clean and easy to navigate, ensuring that players can focus on the action. Sound: The sound design includes energetic music and impactful sound effects for punches, kicks, and special moves. The audio complements the fast-paced action and adds to the overall intensity of the fights.

name: Shadow Knight
description: Shadow Knight is the kind of game a lot of young aspiring game developers made, perhaps in QuickBasic, back in the early 90's. It's textmode and simulates a warrior of your choice (fighter, thief, mage, or thug) killing things to get gold, to get better weapons, to kill enemies. One difference here is that even though you battle in a dungeon, you fight human opponents (apprentice mages, druids, priests, etc). The entire game is menu-driven, and there is not much depth past the character creation (re-roll until you get good stats) and then grinding to kill stuff. Worth checking out if you enjoy textmode games or very simple RPGs.

name: Shadow Warrior
description: Shadow Warrior is a classic first-person shooter developed using the Build engine, the same engine that powered Duke Nukem 3D. Released in 1997, the game was somewhat overshadowed by Quake, which had introduced true 3D environments and superior graphics the year before. However, Shadow Warrior remains a beloved title for its fast-paced gameplay, humor, and unique setting, even if some of its humor may be considered offensive by modern standards. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shadow Warrior shares many similarities with Duke Nukem 3D: First-Person Shooting: Engage in fast-paced combat with a variety of weapons, including katanas, shurikens, and firearms. Interactive Environments: The game features interactive elements, such as breakable objects, secret areas, and environmental hazards. Humor and Personality: The protagonist, Lo Wang, is known for his over-the-top one-liners and humorous dialogue, though some of the jokes may be considered offensive. Level Design: The game’s levels are well-designed, offering a mix of exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving. The game’s mechanics are easy to pick up but offer enough depth and variety to keep players engaged. Visuals and Design: Shadow Warrior features 2.5D graphics, with sprite-based characters and environments rendered in the Build engine. While the visuals are not as advanced as Quake’s true 3D graphics, they are colorful, detailed, and full of personality. The game’s Asian-inspired setting, with temples, dojos, and urban environments, adds a unique flair to the design. Sound: The sound design includes catchy music, voice acting for Lo Wang, and impactful sound effects for weapons and explosions. The audio enhances the game’s atmosphere and adds to the overall experience. Challenge and Replayability: The game’s challenge comes from the variety of enemies and the need to explore levels to find secrets and resources. The replayability lies in the desire to discover all the hidden areas, master the weapons, and enjoy the game’s humor and personality. Legacy: As a Build engine game, Shadow Warrior stands out for its fast-paced gameplay, humor, and unique setting. While it may not have achieved the same level of recognition as Duke Nukem 3D or Quake, it remains a beloved title for fans of retro shooters.

name: Shadowcaster
description: Shadowcaster is a game with an interesting concept that was perhaps overshadowed by the title with the bigger name and similar specs, namely Ultima Underworld, also released by ORIGIN a year earlier. Like that game, Shadowcaster is a 3D first-person perspective RPG. It utilizes a 3D engine created by John Carmack in between the Wolfenstein 3D engine and the DOOM engine. Carmack commented that it "almost had a crazy voxel character rendering system, but it wound up with conventional scaled sprites." (Source) Anyways, as to the actual game ... unlike many games of this type, you do not have a party of characters. Rather the game's protagonist, Kirt, has shapeshifting abilities and can transform into several other forms, each with their own unique powers.

name: ShadowForce
description: ShadowForce is a first-person perspective adventure game, the first game developed by Midnight Synergy aka Interspace Software. It proceeds similarly to other games in the genre, with its own unique quirks, like instead of interacting directly with the main game screen, you interact with the two smaller windows on the side. There are a group of four protagonists traveling together, and to progress you must find and use items, as well as engage in turn-based combat. It seems to work together decently well and has an actual story to try to tie everything together.

name: Shadowkeep 1 - The Search
description: Shadowkeep 1 - The Search is a classic old-school 3D-ish RPG that draws inspiration from dungeon-crawling games like Dungeon Hack and the Might & Magic series. The game immerses players in a blocky, grid-based world where exploration and puzzle-solving are key. Starting in a forest with blocky trees, players must wander and figure out their objectives, making it a somewhat open-ended but potentially challenging experience. With its retro design and focus on exploration, Shadowkeep 1 - The Search is a niche title that will appeal to fans of traditional 3D RPGs but may frustrate or bore others. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shadowkeep 1 - The Search revolves around exploration and puzzle-solving: Open-Ended Exploration: Players start in a forest and must wander to uncover objectives, secrets, and pathways. Grid-Based Movement: The game uses a grid-based system for movement and interaction, typical of old-school dungeon crawlers. Map Usage: A map is essential for navigating the blocky, maze-like environments and avoiding getting lost. Puzzle Solving: The game requires players to solve puzzles and figure out their next steps, adding a layer of challenge. The game’s mechanics are simple but can be tricky to master due to the open-ended nature and lack of clear direction. Visuals and Design: Shadowkeep 1 - The Search features blocky, retro 3D graphics, with environments and characters rendered in a simplistic, grid-based style. The visuals are functional but lack the detail and polish of more modern RPGs. The forest, dungeons, and other locations are designed to evoke a sense of mystery and exploration, though the blocky aesthetic may not appeal to everyone. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects and possibly ambient music, though the audio is not a standout feature of the game. The focus remains on the exploration and puzzle-solving aspects.

name: Shaft
description: Shaft is a monochrome textmode action game which has some similarities to the classic arcade game Elevator Action, but a much more simplified version. In the game several bombs have been hidden in a building. Your goal is to defuse them all before they explode. Each has a timer that counts down, and you'll need to strategically defuse them using the elevator and/or stairs. The game is pretty simple once you determine your strategy, so although it gives the option to increase the difficulty by adding more bombs, it likely won't hold your interest for too long.

name: Shakii the Wolf
description: Shakii the Wolf is a platforming game where you control the titular Shakii (who looks more like a fox than a wolf) as he climbs higher and higher through the levels. You have to keep moving because otherwise the slowly rising water will get you. Graphics and sounds are pretty good in this game, although the animation and camera movement is a little choppy. The game shows off some fun game elements in this one level demo, although the game design itself can be questionable - I got stuck in the level at one point due to falling down and not being able to jump high enough to get back up.

name: Shanghai Dynasty
description: Classic Mahjong Game with also a kids version. Try to remove all tiles by pairing up free tiles.Shanghai Dynasty is a classic and visually appealing Mahjong game designed as an HTML game. The objective is to clear the board by matching pairs of identical tiles that are free (not blocked by other tiles on either side). With its elegant design, relaxing gameplay, and variety of layouts, Shanghai Dynasty offers a delightful experience for fans of Mahjong and puzzle enthusiasts alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shanghai Dynasty follows the traditional Mahjong Solitaire rules: Match Tiles: Find and select two identical tiles that are free (not covered and with at least one free side) to remove them from the board. Clear the Board: The goal is to remove all tiles from the board by matching pairs. Variety of Layouts: The game offers multiple tile layouts, each with its own unique challenge. Relaxing Experience: The game’s pace is calm and meditative, making it a great way to unwind. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and foresight to master.

name: Shanghai Dynasty
description: Shanghai Dynasty is a classic and visually appealing Mahjong game designed as a Flash game. The objective is to clear the board by matching pairs of identical tiles that are free (not blocked by other tiles on either side). With its elegant design, relaxing gameplay, and variety of layouts, Shanghai Dynasty offers a delightful experience for fans of Mahjong and puzzle enthusiasts alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shanghai Dynasty follows the traditional Mahjong Solitaire rules: Match Tiles: Find and select two identical tiles that are free (not covered and with at least one free side) to remove them from the board. Clear the Board: The goal is to remove all tiles from the board by matching pairs. Variety of Layouts: The game offers multiple tile layouts, each with its own unique challenge. Relaxing Experience: The game’s pace is calm and meditative, making it a great way to unwind. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and foresight to master. Visuals and Design: Shanghai Dynasty features elegant and detailed graphics, with beautifully designed tiles and backgrounds. The game’s aesthetic is polished and immersive, creating a relaxing and enjoyable atmosphere. The user interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. Sound: The game’s soundtrack and sound effects are calming and pleasant, with soothing music and subtle audio cues for matching tiles and completing sequences. The audio enhances the relaxing and enjoyable nature of the game.

name: Shanghai Mahjong
description: Shanghai Mahjong is a classic and comprehensive Mahjong Solitaire game that offers 100 different layouts for players to enjoy. The objective is to clear the board by matching pairs of identical tiles that are free (not blocked by other tiles on either side). With its wide variety of layouts, elegant design, and relaxing gameplay, Shanghai Mahjong provides a rich and engaging experience for fans of Mahjong and puzzle enthusiasts alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shanghai Mahjong follows the traditional Mahjong Solitaire rules: Match Tiles: Find and select two identical tiles that are free (not covered and with at least one free side) to remove them from the board. Clear the Board: The goal is to remove all tiles from the board by matching pairs. 100 Layouts: The game offers 100 unique tile layouts, each with its own level of difficulty and complexity. Relaxing Experience: The game’s pace is calm and meditative, making it a great way to unwind. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and foresight to master. Visuals and Design: Shanghai Mahjong features elegant and detailed graphics, with beautifully designed tiles and backgrounds. The game’s aesthetic is polished and immersive, creating a relaxing and enjoyable atmosphere. The user interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. Sound: The game’s soundtrack and sound effects are calming and pleasant, with soothing music and subtle audio cues for matching tiles and completing sequences. The audio enhances the relaxing and enjoyable nature of the game. Challenge and Replayability: With 100 different layouts, Shanghai Mahjong offers a wide range of challenges, from simple and relaxing to complex and demanding. The game’s replayability is high, as players can work through the various layouts, improve their skills, and achieve high scores. Legacy: As a comprehensive Mahjong Solitaire game, Shanghai Mahjong stands out for its variety of layouts and elegant design. It’s a great example of how a classic puzzle game can be expanded to offer a rich and engaging experience.

name: Shape Fold
description: Shape Fold is an engaging puzzle game that challenges players to fold various shapes into specific configurations. In this game, players are presented with a series of geometric shapes that need to be manipulated and transformed to fit into designated outlines. The gameplay involves using logical thinking and spatial awareness to determine how to fold the pieces correctly. Each level introduces new challenges and complexities, requiring players to think creatively about how to achieve the desired shape. With its colorful graphics, intuitive controls, and progressively challenging levels, Shape Fold offers a satisfying experience for fans of puzzle games. It encourages critical thinking and problem-solving skills while providing a fun and relaxing gaming environment.

name: Shape Grid
description: Shape Grid is a simple yet addictive puzzle game that challenges players to move shapes on a grid to create groups of four or more identical tiles, which are then removed. With its straightforward mechanics and increasing difficulty, Shape Grid offers a fun and engaging experience for fans of puzzle games and casual gamers alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shape Grid revolves around strategic tile movement and matching: Move Shapes: Drag and drop shapes on the grid to create groups of four or more identical tiles. Remove Tiles: When four or more identical tiles are grouped together, they are removed from the grid. Score Points: Earn points for each group of tiles removed, with larger groups yielding higher scores. Increasing Difficulty: The game becomes progressively more challenging as the grid fills up and the shapes become more varied. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and planning to master. Visuals and Design: Shape Grid features clean and colorful graphics, with distinct shapes and a user-friendly interface. The grid layout is intuitive, making it easy to follow the game’s progress and plan your moves. The overall design is polished and straightforward, keeping the focus on the puzzle-solving experience. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects for moving tiles and removing groups. The audio is unobtrusive, allowing players to concentrate on the strategic aspects of the game.

name: Shape Mahjong
description: Shape Mahjong is a unique and visually appealing Mahjong Solitaire game that replaces traditional Mahjong tiles with shapes. The objective is to clear the board by matching pairs of identical shapes that are free (not blocked by other tiles on either side). With its innovative design, relaxing gameplay, and strategic depth, Shape Mahjong offers a fresh and engaging experience for fans of puzzle games and Mahjong enthusiasts alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shape Mahjong follows the traditional Mahjong Solitaire rules with a twist: Match Shapes: Find and select two identical shapes that are free (not covered and with at least one free side) to remove them from the board. Clear the Board: The goal is to remove all shapes from the board by matching pairs. Strategic Thinking: Plan your moves carefully, as removing certain shapes can block or unlock others, affecting your ability to complete the layout. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and foresight to master. Visuals and Design: Shape Mahjong features clean and colorful graphics, with distinct shapes and a user-friendly interface. The game’s aesthetic is polished and modern, creating a relaxing and enjoyable atmosphere. The user interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. Sound: The sound design includes calming music and subtle sound effects for matching shapes and completing sequences. The audio enhances the relaxing and enjoyable nature of the game.

name: Shape Shifter
description: Shape Shifter is an RPG by Jeff Kintz (aka J. Kintz) and one of his earliest known games; as such, although it includes some very interesting ideas, it's a bit rough around the edges. As the title suggests, you can shape shift into three forms: A tiger, a snake, and a mouse, each with their own unique abilities. Your goal is to gain enough enlightenment to enter the castle, and to do so you must explore the desert world in which you're placed. The movement is a bit wonky, as your character moves seemingly one pixel at a time, making it a bit of a chore to get anywhere, especially when there are random encounters. There seems to be some real depth to this game though for those willing to put in the effort to explore it.

name: Shapez
description: Shapez is a captivating and addictive factory-style puzzle game where players design and optimize automated systems to create complex shapes and colors. Inspired by games like Factorio, Shapez focuses on simplicity and creativity, allowing players to build intricate factories without the pressure of enemies or time limits. The goal is to produce specific shapes and colors by combining and processing basic components, then deliver them to the central hub. With its minimalist design, open-ended gameplay, and satisfying mechanics, Shapez is a perfect time-waster and a great way to exercise your problem-solving skills. How to Play: Extract Basic Shapes: Start by extracting simple shapes like circles, squares, and rectangles from the environment using extractors. Process Shapes: Use machines to cut, rotate, stack, and paint shapes to create more complex designs. Combine Shapes: Merge different shapes and colors to produce the required output for the hub. Automate Production: Build conveyor belts and machines to automate the production process, ensuring a steady flow of shapes to the hub. Expand and Optimize: Continuously expand your factory and optimize your systems to meet increasingly complex shape requirements. Features: Minimalist Design: The game features clean, simple graphics that focus on the gameplay and mechanics. Open-Ended Gameplay: There are no enemies or time limits, allowing players to experiment and build at their own pace. Incremental Challenges: Each level introduces new shapes and colors, gradually increasing the complexity of the puzzles. Automation Focus: The game emphasizes automation and efficiency, rewarding players who design clever and optimized systems. Relaxing and Satisfying: The lack of pressure and the focus on creativity make Shapez a relaxing yet engaging experience. What the hell, was this written by ChatGPT?

name: Shards
description: Shards is a puzzle game that involves matching sets of tiles with symbols on them. You'll need to move your ball around the levels, trying to get tiles to match, while probably struggling with the controls a bit in the beginning. "All the keys you'll need" are cursors to move, Spacebar to toggle the "cross wires" and M to toggle "stone-move-mode", but the way the game works is not intuitive, at least not for me. The graphics are alright, but I'm not really a fan of the two songs which only play during the levels, of which there are only 10 in the shareware version.

name: Sharp Shooter
description: Sharp Shot is a pretty average "tank battle" game like Tank Wars or the perhaps more famous game Scorched Earth. You and up to 8 (!) other human players take turns setting your tank canon's angle & velocity, trying to eliminate the other players. There are four difficulty settings (which change the layout of the hills and position of the tanks) and you can turn sound on and off. You can also choose to move your tank during your turn, but if you move you lose your chance to shoot on that turn. Otherwise it's "first one to hit wins" with lovely CGA graphics.

name: Shaw's Nightmare
description: Without a doubt, the strangest game using Ken Silverman's Build Engine that I've ever seen. Started when the author was 11 years old, this project looks nothing like the typical dark and gritty 3D FPS games we've come to expect. With graphics that look like they were drawn in MS Paint, and music that sounds "sparse" at best, this is likely unlike anything you've played before. The storyline is too long to recount here, but it's described on the game's official website. The game is technically impressive (certain features seem to be added to the Build Engine) and clearly a lot of work has gone into it. This version is the latest, the "Fotom Pack" which includes five full missions, each with multiple levels. At the same time, it can be difficult to play, at least in DOSBox, since it can sometimes move slowly, and the visuals and sound effects can be exceedingly distracting. Is it art? Or a game? Or both? Or neither? Definitely a labor of love that's worth seeing! (More discussion of the game is available on the DoomWorld forums.)

name: Sheep and Wolves
description: Sheep and Wolves is a fun and challenging puzzle game where players must save sheep from wolves by bouncing them to safety. The goal is to guide the sheep through a series of obstacles while avoiding the black wolves. With its simple mechanics, increasing difficulty, and charming theme, Sheep and Wolves offers an engaging and enjoyable experience for fans of puzzle games and casual gamers alike. Gameplay: The gameplay in Sheep and Wolves revolves around strategic bouncing and avoidance: Bounce the Sheep: Use trampolines or other mechanisms to bounce the sheep toward safety. Avoid Wolves: Steer clear of black wolves that will capture the sheep if they come into contact. Complete Levels: Each level presents a new challenge, with increasingly complex layouts and obstacles. Save the Sheep: The goal is to guide as many sheep to safety as possible while avoiding the wolves. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require careful planning and quick reflexes to master. Visuals and Design: Sheep and Wolves features colorful and charming graphics, with cute sheep, menacing wolves, and vibrant environments. The game’s aesthetic is polished and inviting, creating a fun and enjoyable atmosphere. The user interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. Sound: The sound design includes cheerful music and playful sound effects for bouncing sheep and avoiding wolves. The audio complements the game’s lighthearted theme and adds to the overall enjoyment.

name: Shell Challenge
description: Shell Challenge is a fast-paced and addictive reaction game that tests players’ speed and accuracy. The objective is simple: click as fast as possible on the shell indicated in the top right corner of the screen. With its straightforward mechanics and increasing difficulty, Shell Challenge offers a fun and competitive experience for players looking to test their reflexes and improve their reaction times. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shell Challenge is quick and easy to understand: Click the Shell: As soon as the game starts, click on the shell indicated in the top right corner of the screen. Speed Matters: The faster you click, the higher your score. Increasing Difficulty: The game becomes more challenging as the shells move faster or change positions more frequently. Compete for High Scores: Challenge yourself or compete with friends to achieve the highest score. The game’s mechanics are simple but require quick reflexes and sharp focus to excel. Visuals and Design: Shell Challenge features clean and minimalistic graphics, with colorful shells and a straightforward interface. The design is functional and easy to follow, ensuring that players can focus on the task at hand. The overall aesthetic is polished and modern, making the game visually appealing. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects for clicking the shells and achieving high scores. The audio is unobtrusive but adds to the game’s fast-paced and competitive atmosphere.

name: Shell Shockers
description: "Shell Shockers" is an exciting multiplayer first-person shooter game where players take on the role of eggs armed with a variety of weapons. Set in a colorful, cartoonish environment, players can engage in fast-paced battles against other players online, using skill and strategy to emerge victorious. The gameplay features different game modes, including free-for-all and team-based matches, allowing players to choose their preferred style of play. Players can customize their egg characters with unique skins and weapons, including rifles, shotguns, and grenades. With its smooth controls, vibrant graphics, and a humorous twist on the shooter genre, "Shell Shockers" offers a fun and competitive experience that encourages teamwork and quick reflexes. The game’s blend of action and lightheartedness makes it a popular choice for both casual gamers and FPS enthusiasts.

name: Sherlock
description: Sherlock is a unique and engaging logic puzzle game that challenges players to use their deductive reasoning skills to determine the positions of images in an array. With its variety of clues and built-in instructions, Sherlock offers a fresh and intellectually stimulating experience for fans of logic puzzles and brain teasers. While the graphics are average, the game’s innovative mechanics and challenging gameplay make it a standout title for puzzle enthusiasts. Gameplay: The gameplay in Sherlock revolves around deduction and logic: Determine Positions: Use clues to figure out the correct positions of images in a grid or array. Variety of Clues: The game provides different types of clues, which may take some time to learn but add depth to the puzzles. Built-In Instructions: The game includes instructions to help players understand the rules and mechanics. Logical Thinking: Plan your moves carefully, as the puzzles require careful analysis and deduction to solve. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but offer enough complexity to keep players engaged and challenged. Visuals and Design: Sherlock features average graphics, with simple designs for the images and grid layout. While the visuals are not groundbreaking, they are functional and clear, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. The interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, making the game accessible to all players. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects for interactions and completing puzzles. The audio is unobtrusive, allowing players to concentrate on the logical aspects of the game.

name: Shift
description: Shift is an action-packed puzzle flash game that challenges players to navigate through a series of levels by manipulating the environment and solving puzzles. The game’s unique mechanic involves shifting the perspective of the screen to alter the layout of the level, allowing players to overcome obstacles and reach the exit. With its clever design, increasing difficulty, and engaging gameplay, Shift offers a fresh and exciting experience for fans of puzzle and action games. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shift revolves around perspective shifting and puzzle-solving: Shift the Screen: Press a key to shift the perspective of the screen, which changes the layout of the level and allows players to navigate obstacles. Navigate Levels: Use the shift mechanic to move through platforms, avoid hazards, and reach the exit. Solve Puzzles: Each level presents unique challenges that require careful planning and timing to solve. Increasing Difficulty: The game becomes progressively more challenging as new elements and obstacles are introduced. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and quick reflexes to master. Visuals and Design: Shift features clean and minimalist graphics, with a black-and-white color scheme that emphasizes the game’s focus on perspective and spatial awareness. The design is polished and functional, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. The interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, making the game accessible to all players. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects for shifting, moving, and completing levels. The audio is unobtrusive but complements the game’s fast-paced and engaging atmosphere.

name: Shift 2
description: Shift 2 is the sequel to the original Shift, building on the innovative perspective-shifting mechanic and introducing new challenges and features. This action-packed puzzle flash game continues to challenge players with clever level designs, new obstacles, and increased complexity. With its refined gameplay, engaging puzzles, and minimalist design, Shift 2 offers a fresh and exciting experience for fans of puzzle and action games. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shift 2 expands on the original’s mechanics with new elements and increased difficulty: Shift the Screen: Press a key to shift the perspective of the screen, altering the layout of the level and allowing players to navigate obstacles. Navigate Levels: Use the shift mechanic to move through platforms, avoid hazards, and reach the exit. New Challenges: The sequel introduces new obstacles, such as moving platforms, enemies, and environmental hazards, adding depth to the puzzles. Increasing Complexity: The game becomes progressively more challenging as new mechanics and level designs are introduced. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and quick reflexes to master. Visuals and Design: Shift 2 features clean and minimalist graphics, with a black-and-white color scheme that emphasizes the game’s focus on perspective and spatial awareness. The design is polished and functional, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. The interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, making the game accessible to all players. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects for shifting, moving, and completing levels. The audio is unobtrusive but complements the game’s fast-paced and engaging atmosphere.

name: Shift 3
description: Shift 3 is the third installment in the Shift series, continuing the tradition of innovative perspective-shifting mechanics and challenging puzzle gameplay. This action-packed puzzle flash game introduces new levels, additional obstacles, and enhanced complexity, offering a fresh and exciting experience for fans of the series and newcomers alike. With its minimalist design, engaging puzzles, and refined mechanics, Shift 3 delivers a satisfying and intellectually stimulating experience. Gameplay: The gameplay in Shift 3 builds on the foundation of its predecessors with new features and increased difficulty: Shift the Screen: Press a key to shift the perspective of the screen, altering the layout of the level and allowing players to navigate obstacles. Navigate Levels: Use the shift mechanic to move through platforms, avoid hazards, and reach the exit. New Obstacles: The game introduces new challenges, such as lasers, moving enemies, and timed switches, adding depth to the puzzles. Enhanced Complexity: The levels are more intricate, requiring careful planning and precise execution to solve. The game’s mechanics are easy to learn but require strategic thinking and quick reflexes to master. Visuals and Design: Shift 3 features clean and minimalist graphics, with a black-and-white color scheme that emphasizes the game’s focus on perspective and spatial awareness. The design is polished and functional, ensuring that players can focus on the puzzle-solving experience. The interface is intuitive and easy to navigate, making the game accessible to all players. Sound: The sound design includes basic sound effects for shifting, moving, and completing levels. The audio is unobtrusive but complements the game’s fast-paced and engaging atmosphere.

name: Shift 4
description: Shift 4 is the fourth installment in the Shift series, continuing the tradition of innovative perspective-shifting mechanics and challenging puzzle gameplay. This action-packed puzzle flash game introduces new levels, additional obstacles, and enhanced complexity, offering a fresh and exciting experience for fans of the series and newcomers alike. With its minimalist design, engaging puzzles, and refined mechanics, Shift 4 delivers a satisfying and intellectually stimulating experience. Navigate Levels: Use the shift mechanic to move through platforms, avoid hazards, and reach the exit. New Obstacles: The game introduces new challenges, such as lasers, moving enemies, and timed switches, adding depth to the puzzles.
