Physics-Based Gameplay: Realistic collapsing mechanics that add to the challenge. Cute Characters: Adorable animals that make the game even more enjoyable. Progressive Difficulty: Starts easy but becomes more complex as you advance.

name: Traffic Control
description: Traffic Control is a strategic and engaging puzzle game where players take on the role of a traffic controller, managing the flow of vehicles and pedestrians at busy intersections. The goal is to prevent accidents and keep traffic moving smoothly by operating traffic lights and making timely decisions. It’s a game that tests your multitasking skills, quick thinking, and ability to handle pressure. How to Play Traffic Control: Objective: Control traffic lights to ensure vehicles and pedestrians can move safely through intersections. Prevent collisions and traffic jams while keeping the flow of traffic efficient. Setup: A busy intersection or multiple intersections are displayed, with vehicles and pedestrians waiting to cross. Traffic lights are positioned at each lane, and you can click on them to change their state (red, yellow, green). Gameplay: Click on traffic lights to change their color: Green: Allows vehicles or pedestrians to move. Yellow: Signals caution, preparing vehicles to stop. Red: Stops vehicles or pedestrians. Monitor the flow of traffic and adjust the lights to avoid collisions and keep traffic moving. As the game progresses, more vehicles and pedestrians are introduced, increasing the complexity. Challenges: Multiple intersections or lanes require careful coordination. Emergency vehicles (e.g., ambulances, fire trucks) may appear, requiring priority. Pedestrians crossing the street add another layer of complexity. As levels advance, traffic density and speed increase, making it harder to manage. Winning: Successfully manage traffic for a set amount of time or until all vehicles and pedestrians have safely crossed. Avoid accidents and traffic jams to complete the level. Key Features of Traffic Control: Realistic Traffic Simulation: The game mimics real-world traffic scenarios, making it both challenging and educational. Strategic Thinking: Requires planning and quick decision-making to manage multiple lanes and intersections. Increasing Difficulty: Levels become more complex as you progress, with more vehicles, pedestrians, and intersections. Relaxing Yet Engaging: Perfect for unwinding while still providing a mental challenge.

name: Traffic Department 2192
description: This solidly built mission-based action shooting game is well made, features good graphics and sound effects, and an interesting storyline. In the game you play a "Traffic Cop", but what you usually end up doing is just blowing up all of the enemy ships around. The game is fast-paced and fun, with good controls, although sometimes its a little hard to figure out where you're going, and the fast-paced action means that you will often unintentionally run into things. At least, I did. Maybe you're a way more awesome futuristic traffic enforcement agent than I am ...

name: Traffic Racer
description: Traffic Racer is an exhilarating and fast-paced endless racing game that puts players behind the wheel in a high-speed dash through busy traffic. The goal is to navigate through lanes of oncoming cars, trucks, and buses while avoiding collisions and staying on the road for as long as possible. With simple controls, addictive gameplay, and progressively challenging traffic, Traffic Racer offers a thrilling experience for racing enthusiasts and casual gamers alike. Gameplay Overview: Endless Racing: The game features an endless racing mode where players drive through a busy highway, dodging traffic and trying to survive as long as possible. Steering Controls: Players use the arrow keys (or on-screen arrows) to steer their car left and right, switching lanes to avoid collisions with other vehicles. Traffic Avoidance: The primary objective is to avoid crashing into other cars, trucks, and buses. Collisions end the game, so quick reflexes and sharp focus are essential. Progressive Difficulty: As players progress, the traffic becomes denser, and vehicles move faster, increasing the challenge and requiring quicker reactions. Multiple Cars: Players can unlock and choose from a variety of cars, each with different handling, speed, and performance characteristics. Some cars are better suited for navigating tight traffic, while others offer higher top speeds. Fuel Management: In some versions of the game, players must also manage fuel by collecting fuel canisters scattered along the road. Running out of fuel ends the game. Score and Distance: Players earn points based on the distance traveled and the number of vehicles they pass without crashing. The goal is to achieve the highest score possible. Realistic Graphics: The game features realistic 3D graphics, with detailed car models, dynamic lighting, and immersive environments that enhance the racing experience. Multiple Modes: In addition to the endless mode, Traffic Racer may include other modes, such as time trials or missions, where players complete specific objectives. Key Features: Simple Controls: Easy-to-use arrow keys or on-screen buttons for steering. Endless Gameplay: Race as long as possible while avoiding collisions. Progressive Difficulty: Traffic becomes denser and faster as the game progresses. Multiple Cars: Unlock and choose from a variety of vehicles with different stats. Fuel Management: Collect fuel canisters to keep driving (in some versions). Realistic Graphics: Immersive 3D visuals and dynamic environments. Score System: Earn points based on distance and vehicles passed.

name: Traffic Racer 2
description: Traffic Racer 2 is an exhilarating and fast-paced racing game where you navigate through busy traffic, collect bonuses, and avoid collisions. The game offers a thrilling driving experience with realistic traffic patterns and challenging obstacles. With its simple controls and addictive gameplay, it’s a perfect choice for racing enthusiasts and casual gamers alike. How to Play Traffic Racer 2: Objective: Race through busy traffic and collect bonuses. Avoid collisions with other vehicles to keep your car intact. Gameplay: The screen displays a busy highway with multiple lanes of traffic. Use the arrow keys or on-screen arrows to steer your car left and right. Collect bonuses such as coins or power-ups while avoiding collisions. Controls: Arrow Keys or On-Screen Arrows: Steer your car left and right. Accelerate: Some versions allow you to control the speed of your car. Levels: The game features multiple levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the traffic becomes denser, and the speed increases. Scoring: Points are awarded for distance traveled and bonuses collected. Bonus points may be given for completing levels quickly or with fewer collisions. Key Features of Traffic Racer 2: Realistic Traffic Patterns: Navigate through busy highways with realistic traffic. Simple Controls: Easy to learn but challenging to master. Addictive Gameplay: Perfect for quick play sessions or longer gaming marathons. Progressive Difficulty: Starts easy but becomes more complex as you advance.

name: Train Switch
description: Train Switch is a captivating and strategic puzzle game that challenges players to move wagons and complete trains by connecting wagons of the same type. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to complete trains by connecting wagons of the same type. The game is won when all wagons are correctly connected to form complete trains. Wagon Movement: Selecting Wagons: Click on a wagon to select it, then click on a destination to move the wagon to that location. Connecting Wagons: Wagons of the same type must be connected to form a complete train. This involves moving wagons to align them in the correct order. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with a layout of wagons scattered across the tracks. Some wagons may already be connected, while others need to be moved to complete the trains. Moving Wagons: Click on a wagon and then click on a destination to move it. The goal is to align wagons of the same type to form complete trains. Completing Trains: Once all wagons of the same type are connected, the train is complete and removed from the tracks. Continue this process until all trains are completed. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the number of wagons and the complexity of the track layouts increase, requiring more strategic thinking and planning. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show possible moves or highlight wagons that can be moved to progress. Undo: Some versions of the game might include an undo feature, allowing you to reverse your last move and try a different strategy.

name: Transland
description: According to the included documentation, Transland has an interesting backstory of how it came to exist, created by members of ORIGIN Systems back in the mid 90's. From the included readme file: "Untried, untested, and never finished, Transland was never intended for public consumption. In fact, Transland is the result of an exercise by some creative folks here at ORIGIN who were learning about the ins and outs of 3-D games." How it eventually DID get released, I'm not sure, but it's definitely an interesting short game / tech demo. You wander around in one of four different areas and perform tasks as you marvel at the mid-90's era 3D graphics, generated without the aid of a 3D accelerator. Not only the environments themselves but also the objects (people, for example) are rendered in 3D (not sprites).

name: Transport Mahjong
description: Transport Mahjong is an innovative and engaging twist on the classic Mahjong puzzle game, centered around the theme of transportation and vehicles. In this game, players are tasked with combining two or three different tiles to complete various vehicles, such as cars, trains, airplanes, and boats. The game offers a unique and creative approach to Mahjong, blending traditional tile-matching mechanics with the fun and excitement of building vehicles. Gameplay Overview: Transport-Themed Tiles: The game features a variety of tiles depicting different parts of vehicles, such as wheels, engines, wings, propellers, and hulls. Each tile is beautifully illustrated, adding a vibrant and dynamic element to the game. Combining Tiles: The primary objective is to find and combine two or three different tiles that together form a complete vehicle. For example, combining a wheel, a chassis, and an engine might complete a car, while combining wings, a fuselage, and a tail might complete an airplane. Completing Vehicles: When the correct combination of tiles is selected, they form a complete vehicle and are removed from the board. Players must strategize and think ahead to identify which tiles can be combined to create valid vehicles. Discovering Valid Vehicles: To assist players, the game includes a '?' button that reveals all valid vehicle combinations. This feature helps players learn the different combinations and plan their moves accordingly. Clearing the Board: The goal is to remove all the tiles from the board by completing as many vehicles as possible. As tiles are removed, new layers and patterns are revealed, requiring players to continuously adapt their strategy. Level Progression: Each level presents a new tile arrangement, often inspired by different transportation themes such as urban streets, airports, train stations, and harbors. As players advance, the layouts become more complex and challenging, with more tiles and intricate patterns. Hints and Shuffles: To assist players, the game may offer hints that highlight possible combinations or a shuffle feature that rearranges the remaining tiles to provide new opportunities for matches. Time and Moves: Some versions of the game may include time limits or move restrictions, adding an extra layer of challenge. Players must think quickly and plan their moves carefully to complete the level within the given constraints. Transportation Themes and Backgrounds: The game is rich in transportation visuals, with stunning backgrounds depicting various modes of transport and related environments. The sounds of engines, horns, and ambient noises enhance the immersive experience. Key Features: Transport-Themed Tiles: Vibrant and beautifully illustrated tiles depicting different parts of vehicles. Vehicle Combinations: Unique gameplay mechanic of combining two or three different tiles to complete vehicles. Discovery Feature: '?' button to reveal all valid vehicle combinations, helping players learn and strategize. Multiple Levels: A variety of levels with increasing difficulty, each offering a unique tile arrangement and visual theme. Hint System: Optional hints to help players when they are stuck. Shuffle Option: Ability to shuffle the tiles to reveal new matching opportunities. Transportation Immersion: Stunning visuals and soundscapes that bring the world of transportation to life.

name: Transport Tycoon
description: Transport Tycoon is considered a classic in the real-time strategy genre, and its author went on to develop the tremendously popular RollerCoaster Tycoon series. The game has you in charge of a transport company, beginning in the 1930's. You'll need to build railroads, buses, and other forms of transportation to get passengers where they want to go. However other rival companies will try to do the same. In this demo version, only railroads can be built. The game features good graphics and sounds, and although this is really not my type of game at all it seems like it has solid foundations. The modern-day free & open source remake OpenTTD offers bug fixes and improvements to the original game and ports it to modern operating systems, if you're interested in that sort of thing!

name: Transylvania
description: In the realm of spooky DOS horror games appropriate for Halloween, there are not many that come to mind that are able to achieve a sense of apprehension using only primitive CGA graphics and short bursts of text. But Transylvania, in which you are facing not just a vampire but also a werewolf, does an admirable job. On your quest to rescue Princess Sabrina you'll need to explore the Transylvania countryside and use the typical VERB NOUN text-based command interface to interact with the world. If the werewolf appears, make sure that your next command is to leave the area, otherwise you won't last long! (This game was originally a commercial game but was released for free by its original authors.)

name: Trap
description: Trap is a simple, relaxing text-mode game ("now in color!" says the game when you start it up) where the object is to trap all of the monsters (ASCII char 16's) between rotating doors. You move your character (the @ symbol from numerous roguelikes is moonlighting here) around the room, moving the doors around to try to trap 'em. You can't die so you're actually racing to trap them as fast as possible to earn the best score. It's deceptively tricky. (And freeware, despite what the FILE_ID.DIZ says. Apparently it was $5 but this version is free.) Source code in BASICA / GW-BASIC included!

name: Trapped 2
description: Trapped 2 is a Snake / Nibbles clone with a tremendous amount of options. The object of course is to drive your constantly elongating snake around the map, avoiding crashing into yourself or the other players. It allows up to 4 simultaneous players on a single keyboard, which is pretty neat if it actually works. (Four people slamming keys at the same time may not be properly detected on most keyboards/systems ...) You can also play against computer opponents. The main problem is that, despite some gameplay powerups and such to collect, the game itself is a bit slow and underwhelming.

name: Travelers Quest
description: Travelers Quest is a captivating and visually stunning 3D Mahjong puzzle game where players embark on a journey through exotic locations, solving puzzles by removing matching pairs of cubes. The game combines the classic tile-matching mechanics of Mahjong with a 3D twist, offering a fresh and immersive experience. The goal is to clear the board by removing all cubes in pairs of the same type, using strategy and observation to succeed. How to Play Travelers Quest: Objective: Remove all cubes from the board by matching pairs of the same type. Clear the entire board to complete the level and progress through the quest. Setup: A 3D structure of cubes is displayed, each featuring unique symbols or designs. Cubes are arranged in layers, with some cubes hidden beneath others. Gameplay: Only cubes that are not blocked by others (i.e., accessible from the top or sides) can be selected. Click or tap on two identical cubes to remove them from the board. As cubes are removed, new cubes become accessible. Continue matching pairs until all cubes are cleared. Challenges: Some cubes may be buried under others, requiring you to clear the top layers first. Limited moves or time constraints can add to the difficulty. As you progress, the structures become more complex, with more cubes and fewer obvious matches. Winning: Successfully match all pairs and clear the board to complete the level. Key Features of Travelers Quest: 3D Mahjong Gameplay: Offers a fresh twist on the classic Mahjong formula with 3D structures. Exotic Locations: Travel through beautifully designed levels inspired by real-world destinations. Strategic Depth: Requires planning and foresight to clear cubes efficiently. Relaxing Yet Challenging: Perfect for unwinding while still providing a mental workout. Example Scenario: You start with a 3D structure of cubes featuring symbols like flowers, animals, and geometric shapes. You spot two matching flower cubes on the top layer and remove them. Next, you find two matching animal cubes on the side and remove them. As you continue, you carefully plan your moves to uncover hidden cubes and clear the structure.

name: Travelogue Escape
description: Travelogue Escape is a point-and-click escape room-style Flash game that combines puzzle-solving, exploration, and storytelling. Set in a richly detailed environment, the game immerses players in a mysterious world where they must uncover clues, solve puzzles, and piece together the narrative to escape or achieve a specific goal. While Flash games are no longer widely supported due to the discontinuation of Adobe Flash, games like Travelogue Escape were popular for their engaging gameplay and atmospheric design. Key Features: Point-and-Click Mechanics: Players interact with the environment by clicking on objects, characters, or areas to examine, collect, or use items. The intuitive controls make the game accessible to players of all skill levels. Puzzle-Solving: The game features a variety of puzzles, ranging from inventory-based challenges (using collected items in the right way) to logic puzzles and riddles. Puzzles are often integrated into the environment, requiring players to observe details and think critically. Exploration: Players explore beautifully designed scenes, often with a hand-drawn or highly stylized art style. Each location is filled with interactive elements, hidden clues, and secrets to uncover. Story-Driven Gameplay: The game typically has a narrative that unfolds as players progress, often involving mystery, adventure, or a quest for escape. Dialogue, notes, and environmental storytelling provide context and depth to the experience. Atmospheric Design: The game creates a strong sense of immersion through detailed visuals, ambient sound effects, and sometimes a haunting or whimsical soundtrack. The art style and tone vary depending on the theme, ranging from eerie and mysterious to lighthearted and adventurous. Inventory System: Players collect items throughout the game, which are stored in an inventory. These items are used to solve puzzles or unlock new areas, often requiring creative thinking to determine their purpose. Multiple Endings or Challenges: Some versions of the game may feature multiple endings or branching paths based on player choices or puzzle solutions. Replayability is encouraged through hidden secrets or alternative solutions.

name: Treasure Chests
description: Treasure Chests is an engaging and visually appealing memory game that challenges players to match pairs of identical treasures hidden within chests. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to clear the board by matching pairs of chests that contain the same treasure. The game is won when all chests are successfully matched and removed from the board. Memory Matching: Chests: The game features a grid of chests, each hiding a treasure. Players must remember the locations of different treasures to make successful matches. Matching: Click on two chests to reveal their treasures. If the treasures match, both chests are removed from the board. If they do not match, the chests close again, and players must try to remember their locations for future turns. Treasure Types: The game includes a variety of treasures, such as gold coins, jewels, artifacts, and other valuable items. Each treasure is visually distinct, adding to the game's appeal. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with all chests closed. Players begin by clicking on chests to reveal the treasures hidden inside. Matching Pairs: The challenge lies in remembering the locations of the treasures to make successful matches. The fewer attempts you make to find matching pairs, the higher your score. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the number of chests increases, and the grid becomes larger, requiring better memory and strategic thinking. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show the locations of matching treasures, helping you make successful pairs. Timed Mode: Some versions of the game might include a timed mode, adding an extra layer of challenge by requiring players to match pairs within a certain time limit.

name: Treasure Hunt
description: Treasure Hunt is a captivating puzzle game where players dig their way to hidden treasure by rotating and connecting path pieces. The game combines strategic thinking, spatial awareness, and problem-solving skills to create a challenging and rewarding experience. How to Play Treasure Hunt: Objective: Rotate and connect path pieces to create a continuous route from the starting point to the treasure. Dig through the grid to uncover the treasure while avoiding obstacles. Setup: The game is played on a grid, with some tiles showing visible path pieces and others hidden. The starting point is marked, and the treasure is hidden somewhere on the grid. Gameplay: Rotate the visible path pieces to connect them and form a continuous path. As you connect the path, you’ll dig through the grid, revealing hidden tiles and uncovering the treasure. Some tiles may contain obstacles (e.g., rocks, traps) that block your path or require special actions to bypass. Challenges: Limited moves or rotations add pressure to solve the puzzle efficiently. Hidden tiles and obstacles require careful planning and strategy. As you progress, levels become more complex with larger grids and more intricate path layouts. Winning: Successfully connect the path to the treasure to complete the level. Earn bonus points for solving the puzzle in fewer moves or discovering hidden secrets. Key Features of Treasure Hunt: Strategic Gameplay: Requires careful planning and spatial reasoning to connect paths and avoid obstacles. Progressive Difficulty: Starts with simple puzzles and gradually introduces more complex challenges. Hidden Secrets: Some levels may include bonus treasures or hidden items to discover. Engaging Theme: The treasure-hunting theme adds excitement and a sense of adventure.

name: Treasure Hunt Math
description: Treasure Hunt Math is an educational game designed to make learning basic arithmetic skills fun and engaging. By combining math problems with a treasure-hunting adventure, the game encourages students to practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in an interactive and enjoyable way. Here’s a closer look at what makes Treasure Hunt Math a valuable and entertaining tool for learning: Gameplay Overview: Treasure Hunt Math blends math practice with an adventurous treasure hunt, creating a unique and engaging learning experience: Objective: Search for specific items on the screen and solve math problems to collect treasure. Each correct answer brings you closer to completing the treasure hunt. Math Problems: The game presents math problems based on the difficulty and type of operations you select before starting. Problems can include addition (+), subtraction (-), multiplication (x), and division (/). Customization: Before starting the game, you can adjust the difficulty level and choose which types of math problems to include. This allows the game to be tailored to the player’s skill level and learning goals. Treasure Hunt: The treasure hunt aspect adds an element of exploration and discovery, making math practice feel like an adventure. Players must locate hidden items on the screen and solve the associated math problems to collect them. Graphics and Presentation: Graphics: The game uses EGA (Enhanced Graphics Adapter) graphics, which are colorful and visually appealing. The treasure hunt scenes are well-designed and engaging. Sound: The sound effects are minimal but fitting, with cheerful noises for solving problems and collecting treasure. There’s no music, which keeps the focus on the gameplay. Interface: The interface is user-friendly, with clear instructions and easy-to-navigate menus.

name: Treasures of Atlantis
description: Treasures of Atlantis is an enchanting and adventurous match-3 puzzle game that takes players on an underwater journey to uncover the legendary treasures of the lost city of Atlantis. The game combines classic match-3 mechanics with a captivating theme, challenging players to swap bubbles and create matches of three or more to progress through the levels. By making clever combinations, you can unlock special bonuses and power-ups to help you discover the hidden riches of Atlantis. How to Play: Swap Bubbles: Swap two adjacent bubbles to create a row or column of three or more matching bubbles. Clear the Board: Matched bubbles will disappear, and new bubbles will fall into place, potentially creating chain reactions. Special Combinations: Create matches of four or more bubbles to generate special power-ups, such as bombs or lightning bolts, which can clear large sections of the board. Complete Objectives: Each level has specific goals, such as clearing a certain number of bubbles, collecting treasures, or breaking through obstacles. Discover Treasures: Progress through the levels to uncover the secrets and treasures of Atlantis. Features: Atlantis Theme: The game is set in the mystical underwater world of Atlantis, featuring stunning visuals and immersive sound effects. Special Power-Ups: Create powerful bonuses by making larger matches or combining special bubbles. Multiple Levels: The game offers a wide variety of levels with increasing difficulty, ensuring hours of engaging gameplay. Challenging Objectives: Each level presents unique challenges and goals, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. Relaxing and Fun: With its soothing underwater atmosphere and satisfying match-3 mechanics, Treasures of Atlantis is perfect for unwinding and enjoying a mental challenge.

name: Tri
description: Tri is a straightforward yet engaging puzzle game where the objective is to collect all items on the screen by maneuvering your "Tri" (a triangular-shaped character) through a grid-based level. The game’s simplicity and unique movement mechanics make it an enjoyable, low-stress puzzle experience. Here’s a detailed breakdown of what Tri has to offer: Key Features: Unique Movement Mechanics: Your Tri can only move in straight horizontal or vertical lines. Once it starts moving, it continues in that direction until it hits an item, an obstacle, or goes off the screen. This adds a layer of strategy to the gameplay. Objective: The goal is to collect all items on the screen by navigating your Tri through the level. You must plan your moves carefully to avoid obstacles and ensure you don’t get stuck or destroyed. Randomly Generated Levels: While the early levels are relatively simple, the game features randomly generated levels that increase in complexity as you progress. Later levels require more strategic thinking and precision. Passable Graphics: The graphics are functional and clean, with a simple tileset that changes every few levels to keep the visuals fresh. While not groundbreaking, they serve the game’s purpose well. Low Mental Tax: Tri is designed to be a relaxing puzzle game that doesn’t require intense concentration. It’s perfect for short play sessions or when you want to unwind with a light challenge. Obstacles and Hazards: As you advance, levels introduce more obstacles and hazards, such as walls, traps, or enemies, that can destroy your Tri if you collide with them. Tileset Variety: The game changes its tileset (visual theme) every few levels, offering a slight visual refresh and keeping the experience from becoming monotonous. Gameplay: Controls: The controls are simple, typically involving arrow keys or a mouse to direct your Tri’s movement. Movement: Your Tri moves in a straight line until it hits something, so you’ll need to anticipate its path and plan accordingly. Strategy: The challenge lies in figuring out the optimal sequence of moves to collect all items without getting trapped or destroyed.

name: Tri Towers Solitaire
description: Tri Towers Solitaire is an engaging and strategic card game where the goal is to remove all the cards and reveal the three hidden towers. The game follows the classic Tripeaks Solitaire mechanics, requiring players to remove cards that are one rank higher or lower than the open card at the bottom of the screen. If you get stuck, you can click on the closed stack to draw a new open card. With its unique tower-revealing objective and familiar gameplay, Tri Towers Solitaire offers a fun and rewarding experience for solitaire enthusiasts. How to Play: Open Card: Start with an open card at the bottom of the screen. This is your reference card for making moves. Remove Cards: Click on cards from the three towers that are one rank higher or lower than the open card. For example, if the open card is a 7, you can remove a 6 or an 8. New Open Card: If you run out of moves, click on the closed stack to draw a new open card and continue playing. Reveal the Towers: Successfully remove all the cards to reveal the three hidden towers and complete the game. Features: Tower-Revealing Objective: The unique goal of revealing three hidden towers adds an extra layer of excitement to the gameplay. Classic Tripeaks Mechanics: Retains the familiar rules of Tripeaks Solitaire, making it easy to learn for fans of the genre. Strategic Gameplay: Planning your moves and managing the closed stack adds a layer of strategy to the gameplay. Relaxing Yet Challenging: The game is perfect for unwinding while still providing a satisfying mental challenge.

name: Tri-Fruit Solitaire
description: Tri-Fruit Solitaire is a delightful and refreshing twist on the classic Tripeaks Solitaire card game, featuring a fruity theme that adds a fun and vibrant touch to the traditional gameplay. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to remove all the cards from the three peaks (hence "Tripeaks") by playing cards that are either one rank higher or one rank lower than the open card at the bottom. The game is won when all cards are cleared from the peaks. Card Ranks: Cards are ranked from Ace (low) to King (high). You can play a card that is either one rank above or one rank below the current open card. For example, if the open card is a 7, you can play a 6 or an 8. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with three peaks of face-down cards and a single face-up open card at the bottom. Playing Cards: Select a card from the peaks that is either one rank higher or one rank lower than the open card. When you play a card, it becomes the new open card. Uncovering Cards: As you remove cards from the peaks, new cards are uncovered, allowing you to continue playing. Deck: If you get stuck, you can draw a new card from the deck to use as the open card. The deck acts as a lifeline, providing new opportunities to continue the game. Fruit Theme: The game features a fruity twist with cards adorned with various fruit designs, such as apples, bananas, oranges, and more. This adds a colorful and playful element to the traditional card game. Special Cards and Power-Ups: Some versions of the game might include special cards or power-ups that can help you clear the peaks more efficiently, such as: Wild Cards: Can be played as any rank. Shuffle: Rearranges the remaining cards in the peaks, potentially revealing new playable cards. Undo: Allows you to undo your last move, giving you a second chance to make a better play. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the peaks may become larger, or the number of cards in the deck may decrease, adding to the challenge. Visuals and Sound: Graphics: The game boasts vibrant, high-quality graphics with detailed fruit-themed card designs and a clean, user-friendly interface. The peaks are visually distinct, making it easy to see which cards are playable. Soundtrack: The background music is cheerful and upbeat, complementing the fruity theme. Sound effects, like the "click" of playing a card or the "shuffle" of the deck, enhance the overall experience.

name: Tribolo
description: Tribolo is a game similar to the Othello board game (and similar games like the classic Hexxagon) but with the twist that there are three players all competing at once. In this case, this means you versus two computer opponents. (Not sure why there is no three player option?) The rules of placement are a bit more complicated than regular Othello (I guess that's required when you have three colors rather than two) so be sure to read the included doc file for help. As usual with Soleau games, basic EGA graphics in the typical Soleau style.

name: Trick Ball
description: Trick Ball is a fun and addictive puzzle game where players remove balls from a table by colliding matching balls of the same color. The game combines elements of strategy, physics, and quick thinking, making it both challenging and entertaining. The goal is to clear the table by matching and removing all the balls, using precise shots and clever planning to succeed. How to Play Trick Ball: Objective: Remove all balls from the table by colliding matching balls of the same color. Clear the entire table to complete the level. Setup: A table is displayed with various colored balls arranged in a specific pattern. A cue ball or shooter ball is provided to launch and collide with the other balls. Gameplay: Aim the cue ball by adjusting the angle and power of your shot. Launch the cue ball to collide with other balls on the table. When two or more balls of the same color collide, they are removed from the table. Continue launching the cue ball until all balls are cleared. Challenges: Some balls may be blocked or require precise angles to hit. Limited moves or time constraints can add to the difficulty. As you progress, the levels become more complex, with more balls and obstacles. Winning: Successfully remove all balls from the table to complete the level. Key Features of Trick Ball: Physics-Based Gameplay: Requires precise aiming and understanding of angles and momentum. Color Matching: Combines strategy and observation to match and remove balls. Progressive Difficulty: Starts with simple levels and gradually introduces more challenging layouts. Quick Play Sessions: Levels are short and perfect for quick bursts of gameplay.

name: Trick Blast
description: Trick Blast is a lively and engaging DOS game that draws inspiration from classic tabletop games like Crossfire. The core gameplay revolves around firing projectiles (similar to metal ball bearings) to knock a ball into your opponent's goal, creating a fast-paced and competitive experience. The game is visually vibrant, with colorful graphics that enhance its energetic atmosphere, complemented by satisfying sound effects that add to the excitement. One of the standout features of Trick Blast is its versatility in gameplay modes. Players can choose to challenge the computer, with adjustable difficulty settings to suit their skill level, or engage in a head-to-head match against a friend. The game supports both shared-keyboard play and keyboard-versus-mouse setups, making it accessible for different playstyles and preferences. Despite its simplicity, Trick Blast is well-crafted and offers a fun, addictive experience. Its straightforward mechanics and competitive nature make it a great choice for quick gaming sessions or friendly matches. Overall, it’s a polished and entertaining DOS game that captures the essence of classic arcade-style fun.

name: Tricky Quiky Games
description: This promotional platform game from Nestle Germany has you running around as the the Nestle Bunny (aka "Quiky") collecting Nesquik products. The story: A distinctly Dr Wily-ish villain deferred to as a "crazy doctor" has stolen the recipe book (ostensibly for Nesquik products?) and you must find and return it! The game plays a little like Sonic, a little like Mario, and overall feels a bit floaty. Throughout the fifteen levels you'll be collecting a lot of Nesquik stuff; if you collect the letters to spell NESQUIK you'll get to walk through a pretty boring bonus level. The graphics are decent enough, and have some influence from the Bit Brothers style. Not bad for a free promo game included in cereal boxes, but not great either.

name: Tripeaks Creatures
description: Tripeaks Creatures is an engaging and fun card game that combines the classic Tripeaks (or Golf) solitaire gameplay with a whimsical creature-themed twist. The game features 40 levels of progressively challenging puzzles, offering hours of entertainment for players of all skill levels. How to Play: The objective is to clear the pyramid-like layout of cards by selecting cards that are either one rank higher or one rank lower than the open card at the bottom of the screen. For example, if the open card is a 7, you can play a 6 or an 8 from the layout. If you get stuck, you can click on the closed stack at the top to draw a new open card and continue the game. The goal is to clear all the cards in the layout to complete the level and advance to the next one. Features: 40 Levels: Each level presents a unique layout and increasing difficulty, keeping the gameplay fresh and challenging. Creature Theme: The game adds a playful touch with its creature-themed design, making it visually appealing and fun. Simple Rules, Addictive Gameplay: The easy-to-learn mechanics make it accessible, while the strategic depth ensures it remains engaging.

name: Tripeaks Farm
description: Tripeaks Farm is a delightful and relaxing solitaire card game set in a charming farm-themed environment. Based on the classic Tripeaks (or Golf) solitaire gameplay, this version adds a cozy farm aesthetic, making it a perfect choice for casual gamers and card game enthusiasts alike. The goal is to clear all the cards from the pyramid-like layout by selecting cards that are one rank higher or lower than the open card at the bottom of the screen. How to Play: Objective: Remove all the cards from the Tripeaks layout by matching them to the open card at the bottom. Matching Rules: You can select a card from the layout if it is one rank higher or lower than the open card. For example, if the open card is a 7, you can play a 6 or an 8. Open Card: The open card starts as the card at the bottom of the screen. After you play a card, it becomes the new open card. Draw Pile: If you get stuck, you can click on the draw pile to reveal a new open card and continue playing. Winning: The game is won when all cards from the Tripeaks layout are successfully removed. Features: Farm Theme: The cheerful farm setting, complete with adorable animals and crops, creates a relaxing and enjoyable atmosphere. Simple Rules: Easy-to-learn mechanics make it accessible for players of all ages and skill levels. Strategic Gameplay: While the rules are simple, planning your moves and managing the draw pile adds a layer of strategy to keep the game engaging. Relaxing Experience: With no time limits or pressure, Tripeaks Farm is perfect for unwinding and enjoying a calming card game session.

name: Tripeaks Halloween
description: Tripeaks Halloween is a festive and spooky twist on the classic Tripeaks solitaire card game, perfect for the Halloween season. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to remove all the cards from the three peaks (hence "Tripeaks") by playing cards that are either one rank higher or one rank lower than the open card. The game is won when all cards are cleared from the peaks. Card Ranks: Cards are ranked from Ace (low) to King (high). You can play a card that is either one rank above or one rank below the current open card. For example, if the open card is a 7, you can play a 6 or an 8. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with three peaks of face-down cards and a single face-up open card at the bottom. Playing Cards: Select a card from the peaks that is either one rank higher or one rank lower than the open card. When you play a card, it becomes the new open card. Uncovering Cards: As you remove cards from the peaks, new cards are uncovered, allowing you to continue playing. Deck: If you get stuck, you can draw a new card from the deck to use as the open card. The deck acts as a lifeline, providing new opportunities to continue the game. Special Cards and Power-Ups: Some versions of the game might include special cards or power-ups that can help you clear the peaks more efficiently, such as: Wild Cards: Can be played as any rank. Shuffle: Rearranges the remaining cards in the peaks, potentially revealing new playable cards. Undo: Allows you to undo your last move, giving you a second chance to make a better play. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the peaks may become larger, or the number of cards in the deck may decrease, adding to the challenge. Visuals and Sound: Graphics: The game features spooky, Halloween-themed graphics with eerie card designs and a festive interface. The peaks are visually distinct, making it easy to see which cards are playable. Soundtrack: The background music is haunting and atmospheric, complementing the Halloween theme. Sound effects, like the "whoosh" of playing a card or the "creak" of uncovering a new card, enhance the overall experience.

name: Tripeaks Solitaire
description: Tripeaks Solitaire is a fun and engaging card game that puts a unique twist on the classic solitaire formula. The goal is to remove all the cards from the three peaks by selecting cards that are one rank higher or lower than the open card at the bottom of the screen. If you get stuck, you can draw a new open card by clicking on the closed top stack. With its simple rules and strategic depth, Tripeaks Solitaire is perfect for casual gamers and card game enthusiasts alike. How to Play: Open Card: Start with an open card at the bottom of the screen. This is your reference card for making moves. Remove Cards: Select cards from the three peaks that are one rank higher or lower than the open card. For example, if the open card is a 7, you can remove a 6 or an 8. New Open Card: If you run out of moves, click on the closed top stack to draw a new open card and continue playing. Clear the Peaks: Successfully remove all the cards from the three peaks to win the game. Features: Simple Rules: Easy-to-learn mechanics make the game accessible for players of all ages and skill levels. Strategic Depth: Planning your moves and managing the closed stack adds a layer of strategy to the gameplay. Relaxing Gameplay: With no time limits or pressure, Tripeaks Solitaire is perfect for unwinding and enjoying a calming card game session. Multiple Levels: The game offers a variety of levels with increasing difficulty, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging.

name: Triplane Turmoil
description: Triplane Turmoil is a DOS-based flight combat game that pays homage to the classic Sopwith while introducing improved graphics, sound, and mission variety. The game puts players in the cockpit of a World War I-style triplane, tasked with completing a series of missions that involve flying, bombing, and dogfighting. While it offers a more polished experience than its predecessors, it also comes with a learning curve and some quirks that players need to navigate. Key Features: Graphics and Sound: One of the standout aspects of Triplane Turmoil is its enhanced visuals and audio. The game features detailed sprite work, vibrant colors, and smooth animations, which were impressive for its time. The sound effects and music add to the immersion, creating a more engaging experience compared to earlier flight games. Missions: The game offers a variety of missions, including bombing runs, aerial dogfights, and reconnaissance tasks. This diversity keeps the gameplay fresh and provides a sense of progression as you advance through the campaign. Controls: The controls are designed to mimic the feel of piloting a biplane, with mechanics for climbing, diving, and maneuvering. However, the game’s control scheme can be tricky to master, especially for newcomers. The documentation is essential for understanding how to play effectively. Player Roster and Controls Setup: A notable quirk is that control settings must be adjusted in the PLAYER ROSTER area rather than the CONTROLS section. This unintuitive setup can lead to confusion, as players might expect to customize controls in the more obvious location. Multiplayer: The game supports multiplayer modes, allowing players to engage in dogfights or cooperative missions with friends. This adds replayability and makes it a fun option for competitive or collaborative play. Strengths: Improved Presentation: The upgraded graphics and sound make Triplane Turmoil a visually and audibly appealing game for its era. Mission Variety: The diverse mission types provide a well-rounded gameplay experience, catering to different playstyles and keeping things interesting. Nostalgic Appeal: Fans of classic flight games like Sopwith will appreciate the modernized take on the genre.

name: Triple Cars
description: "Triple Cars" is a fun and fast-paced match-3 puzzle game where players match three or more identical cars to remove them from the board. The goal is to clear the board by making as many matches as possible, with increasing difficulty as the game progresses. The game features vibrant car designs and exciting gameplay, making it perfect for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike. Game Description: Objective: Match three or more identical cars to remove them from the board and clear all cars to advance to the next level. Gameplay: Players are presented with a grid filled with various car designs (e.g., sports cars, trucks, sedans, etc.). Players swap adjacent cars to create matches of three or more identical cars. When a match is made, the cars are removed, and new cars fall into place from the top. Car Designs: The game features a variety of car designs, each with its own unique color and style. Examples include red sports cars, blue trucks, yellow sedans, and green SUVs. Difficulty Levels: The game includes multiple levels, each with a unique grid layout and increasing difficulty. Later levels may introduce more car types, larger grids, or limited moves. Special Features: Power-Ups: Matching more than three cars can create power-ups that clear large areas or specific rows/columns. Hint System: Players can use hints to find possible matches if they get stuck. Combo System: Players earn bonus points for creating chain reactions or multiple matches in a row.

name: Triple Coins
description: Triple Coins is a dynamic and engaging puzzle game that challenges players to match three or more identical coins by rotating the game screen. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to match three or more identical coins by rotating the game screen. The game is won by clearing the board of coins or achieving specific level objectives. Coin Matching: Rotation: Use the arrow keys or on-screen arrows to rotate the game screen. This changes the orientation of the coins, allowing you to align them in rows or columns. Matching: When three or more identical coins align in a row or column after rotation, they are matched and removed from the board. New coins fall into place, potentially creating chain reactions for more points. Coin Types: The game features a variety of coins, each with unique designs and colors. These coins can range from gold and silver to themed coins, depending on the game's aesthetic. Power-Ups and Special Coins: Matching more than three coins can create special coins or power-ups, such as: Bomb Coins: Explode to clear surrounding coins. Line Clearers: Clear an entire row or column of coins. Rainbow Coins: Act as wildcards, matching with any type of coin. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the coin arrangements become more complex, and the number of coins increases, requiring more strategic thinking and precision. Time or Move Limits: Some levels may have a time limit or a restricted number of moves, adding a layer of urgency and strategy to the gameplay.

name: Triple Connect
description: Triple Connect is a captivating and strategic puzzle game that challenges players to connect three or more identical tiles by drawing a path between them. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to remove all tiles from the board by connecting three or more identical tiles. The game is won when the entire board is cleared. Tile Matching: Connecting Tiles: To remove tiles, you must connect three or more identical tiles by drawing a continuous path between them. The path can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal but must be unobstructed. Path Rules: The path between tiles must be clear of obstacles and other tiles. If a valid path exists, the connected tiles will be removed from the board. Tile Types: The game features a variety of tiles, each with unique designs and colors. These tiles can range from fruits and gems to themed objects, depending on the game's aesthetic. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with a grid of tiles arranged in a specific pattern. Some tiles may be blocked or require special conditions to be removed. Connecting Tiles: Click or drag to draw a path between three or more identical tiles. When connected, the tiles are removed, and new tiles fall into place, potentially creating chain reactions for more points. Clearing the Board: Continue connecting and removing tiles until the entire board is cleared. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the tile arrangements become more complex, and the number of tiles increases, requiring more strategic thinking and planning. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show possible connections or highlight tiles that can be connected. Undo: Some versions of the game might include an undo feature, allowing you to reverse your last move and try a different path. Visuals and Sound: Graphics: The game boasts vibrant, colorful graphics with detailed tile designs and a clean, user-friendly interface. The tiles and backgrounds are animated, making the game lively and fun. Soundtrack: The background music is upbeat and engaging, complementing the puzzle-solving nature of the game. Sound effects, like the "click" of connecting tiles and the "crunch" of matches, enhance the overall experience.

name: Triple Dimensions - Ice Age
description: Triple Dimensions - Ice Age is a captivating and visually stunning 3D Mahjong game set in the Ice Age era. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to remove all tiles from the 3D Mahjong layout by matching and moving them to the bar on the right. The game is won when all tiles are successfully removed. Tile Matching and Movement: Selecting Tiles: Click on a tile to select it. You can only select tiles that are free, meaning they are not covered by other tiles and have at least one side (left or right) free. Moving Tiles: Move selected tiles to the bar on the right. The bar can hold a limited number of tiles, so strategic planning is essential. Removing Tiles: When three identical tiles are placed in the bar, they are removed from the game. This creates space for more tiles to be moved and matched. 3D Mahjong Layout: Ice Age Theme: The game features a 3D Mahjong layout with tiles designed to reflect the Ice Age theme, such as ice blocks, prehistoric animals, and other related symbols. Complex Structures: The tiles are arranged in intricate, multi-layered structures that require careful navigation and planning to clear. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with a 3D Mahjong layout filled with various tiles. Some tiles may be partially hidden or blocked by others. Matching and Moving: Select and move tiles to the bar, aiming to create groups of three identical tiles for removal. As tiles are removed, new tiles become accessible. Clearing the Layout: Continue matching and moving tiles until the entire 3D layout is cleared. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the 3D layouts become more complex, and the number of tiles increases, requiring more strategic thinking and planning. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show possible moves or highlight tiles that can be moved to the bar. Undo: Some versions of the game might include an undo feature, allowing you to reverse your last move and try a different strategy.

name: Triple Mahjong
description: Triple Mahjong is a unique and engaging twist on the classic Mahjong game, where players must match three identical tiles instead of the traditional two. The game features beautifully designed tiles, including special flower and season tiles that can be matched with any other flower or season tile, respectively. Free tiles are highlighted, making it easier to plan your moves. With its innovative mechanics and relaxing gameplay, Triple Mahjong offers a fresh and rewarding experience for puzzle enthusiasts. How to Play: Match Tiles: Find and select three identical tiles to remove them from the board. Tiles are considered "free" if they are not blocked by other tiles on either the left or right side and are highlighted for easy identification. Special Tiles: Combine flower tiles with any other flower tile and season tiles with any other season tile, regardless of their specific design. Clear the Board: Strategically remove all the tiles to complete the level and progress to the next stage. Plan Ahead: Think carefully about your moves, as some tiles may become blocked if you don’t clear them in the right order. Features: Triple Matching: The requirement to match three identical tiles adds a new layer of challenge and strategy. Special Tiles: Flower and season tiles can be matched with any other tile of their type, providing flexibility in gameplay. Highlighted Free Tiles: Free tiles are clearly highlighted, making it easier to plan your moves and strategize. Multiple Levels: The game offers a variety of levels with increasing difficulty, ensuring hours of engaging gameplay. Relaxing and Fun: The combination of beautiful tile designs and calming gameplay makes it perfect for unwinding.

name: Triple Mahjong 2
description: Triple Mahjong 2 is the exciting sequel to the original Triple Mahjong game, offering even more challenging and engaging tile-matching puzzles. This version retains the core mechanic of matching three identical tiles instead of the traditional two, but introduces new levels, layouts, and features to keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. With its beautiful tile designs, relaxing atmosphere, and strategic depth, Triple Mahjong 2 is perfect for fans of Mahjong and puzzle games. How to Play: Match Tiles: Find and select three identical tiles to remove them from the board. Tiles are considered "free" if they are not blocked by other tiles on either the left or right side and are highlighted for easy identification. Special Tiles: Combine flower tiles with any other flower tile and season tiles with any other season tile, regardless of their specific design. Clear the Board: Strategically remove all the tiles to complete the level and progress to the next stage. Plan Ahead: Think carefully about your moves, as some tiles may become blocked if you don’t clear them in the right order.

name: Triple Memory
description: Triple Memory is a variation of the popular "match two" game where you flip cards over and see if they match; if they don't, they get flipped back over and you need to remember where they are. This game works the same way, except you turn over THREE cards each turn and need to match three cards to win. It's a simple change that makes the game a little more challenging. There are not many options though, and only one tileset; it includes an editor to create your own tiles but you need the registered version to save them. Overall it works well and if you are looking for a slightly different memory game this might do the job.

name: Triple Tiles
description: "Triple Tiles" is a fun and addictive puzzle game where players combine three identical tiles to remove them from the board. The goal is to clear the board by matching and removing all tiles, advancing to the next level with increasing difficulty. The game requires strategic thinking and quick reflexes to match tiles before the board fills up. Game Description: Objective: Combine three identical tiles to remove them from the board and clear all tiles to advance to the next level. Gameplay: Players are presented with a grid filled with various tiles (e.g., fruits, animals, shapes, or numbers). Players click on three identical tiles to remove them from the board. New tiles fall into place after a match is made, and the game continues until the board is cleared or no more matches are possible. Tile Types: The game features a variety of tile types, each with its own unique design and color. Examples include fruits (apples, bananas, oranges), animals (cats, dogs, birds), or shapes (circles, squares, triangles). Difficulty Levels: The game includes multiple levels, each with a unique tile layout and increasing difficulty. Later levels may introduce more tile types, larger grids, or limited moves. Special Features: Hint System: Players can use hints to find possible matches if they get stuck. Timer: Some levels may include a timer to add urgency to the gameplay. Combo System: Players earn bonus points for creating chain reactions or multiple matches in a row.

name: Tristix
description: Tristix is a Tetris-inspired game that adds a couple of new elements to the typical Tetris formula: * Random special blocks like a bomb or a "shooter" appeal when a line is cleared * Blocks can be comprised of 1-5 squares (rather than 4 in the original Tetris) * Up to four players can play simultaneously sharing the same keyboard (not sure how well that would work in practice ...) It also looks and controls fairly competently, so if you're interested in a Tetris-like games with these options (and plenty more configurable within the game) give this a try. Note that the default one-player (player 1) keys are not the arrows, see the in-game options to re-set them! The author of this game released the registered version for free

name: Trivia Whiz
description: Trivia Whiz is a very basic trivia program, notable mostly because it was an early release by George Broussard's Micro F/X Software that was published by Apogee. As of 2005 it had long been removed from Apogee's catalog and they released the full version for free (five trivia games). The game is in text-mode, and simply presents a series of questions in various randomly chosen categories (such as history, geography, and sports) and you must guess the answer (from 2-4 multiple choice options) until you get enough questions incorrect to end the game. There are no options to set (like specifying only a single category) and no multiplayer option. All five of the games are identical except for the list of questions.

name: Troddlers
description: Troddlers is a variant of Lemmings. The goal is the same: Lead the Lemmin... err, Troddlers, to the exit. Here though instead of assigning jobs to them, you create blocks. The Troddlers walk on the walls, and you use the blocks to lead their path to the exit. (Some levels have alternative objectives as well.) It's a fun innovative twist on the classic Lemmings formula, but it does take a little getting used to. The graphics are well drawn and animated, and the sounds are good too. This demo version gives you a sample of what the full game includes.

name: Troff II
description: Troff II is a Snake-inspired game (released before QBasic's Nibbles) which features decent enough gameplay and controls, but is hampered somewhat by the difficult computer AI opponent. The goal here is to collect enough points by collecting items (and avoid losing points by running into things) to meet the level objective and move on. There are some options that can be set from the main menu, but the game basically plays like Snake except with a heavier emphasis on collecting stuff. It does come with source code in Turbo Pascal 5.5 if you're into that sort of thing.

name: Troll's Tale
description: On-Line Inc, creators of such famous adventure games as King's Quest and Space Quest. This one in particular is a kid's game created by Al Lowe, famous for the Leisure Suit Larry series of games. Your quest is to find the 15 treasures which have been hidden by a troll. To progress in the game you choose one of several options at the bottom of the screen. The graphics are CGA (what do you expect from a game made in 1984?) so they are rather poor by today's standards but the game will still likely be fun for young gamers since it is uncomplicated. (Thanks goes to creator Al Lowe for releasing this game for free.) NOTE: Press the Spacebar to select an option, and then press Enter to choose it.

name: Trolls
description: Trolls has a lot going for it, including color graphics, a Soundblaster soundtrack, and classic Sonic-esque gameplay mixed with a European, Bitmap Brothers type style. It seems to be based on the Trolls toys that were insanely popular for a brief period of time in the early 90's. It's a platformer so you jump around and collect things (smaller trolls?!) before heading to the exit. The main problem is that the backgrounds are so colorful, and there are so many sprites flying around, that it's difficult to even see what you can jump on and what you can't. You start off without any weapons, and taking hits seems almost unavoidable. This game offers a single level from the full game which offers seven worlds with multiple levels in each world.

name: Tron1992
description: Tron1992 is an unofficial, unlicensed adaptation of the classic TRON light cycles game. The objective is to pilot your light cycle around the screen, avoiding collisions with your opponent’s trail, your own trail, and the walls. The game offers both single-player and two-player modes, allowing you to compete against a (somewhat dimwitted) computer opponent or a friend on the same keyboard. While the graphics are very basic, the game includes some customization options to tweak the experience. It’s a simple yet fun homage to the iconic light cycles battle from TRON. Key Features: Light Cycles Gameplay: The core gameplay involves controlling a light cycle that leaves a trail behind it. The goal is to outmaneuver your opponent and force them to crash into your trail, their own trail, or the walls. Single-Player and Two-Player Modes: You can play against a computer-controlled opponent or compete against a second player on the same keyboard. The two-player mode adds a competitive and social element to the game. Basic Graphics: The visuals are simple and functional, with minimalistic representations of the light cycles and trails. While not visually impressive, they serve the purpose of the game. Customization Options: The game includes some customization options, allowing players to adjust settings such as speed, trail length, and other parameters to tailor the experience to their liking. Simple Controls: The controls are easy to learn, typically involving arrow keys or similar inputs to move the light cycle. This makes the game accessible to players of all skill levels.

name: Tron1996
description: Tron is a lightcycles game based on the movie which plays similarly to Snake, Nibbles, and dozens of other games. Unlike those games however this game uses actual art and names from the Disney-produced movie, which I'm sure they didn't have permission to use. In any case, up to four players (human or CPU controlled) can play at once, and the game also adds missiles that you can pick up and use, although I had some difficulty actually using them. Overall it's a decent but not particularly remarkable Tron game.

name: TRONIC
description: Tronic is a decent Arkanoid clone that is only marred by slightly stiff controls. The game plays like many other Arkanoid / Breakout knock-offs, with decent graphics, music, and sound effects. There are a variety of levels (not sure how many in the shareware version, there's 50 in the registered) and many powerups you can collect, notably one that allows your paddle to move vertically as well as horizontally. The controls are a bit "stiff" as mentioned above, since for every tap of the arrow keys or move of the mouse your paddle glides a fair distance left or right, making precise moves difficult. It does otherwise play quite well though, and even includes a built-in level editor.

name: Troy
description: Troy is a simple and charming side-scrolling platformer designed with younger players in mind. Featuring colorful VGA graphics and straightforward gameplay, it’s a kid-friendly game that offers a gentle introduction to platforming mechanics. While it may not be particularly exciting for more experienced gamers, it’s a great choice for children or casual players. Here’s a detailed look at what makes Troy a fun and accessible game: Key Features: Side-Scrolling Platformer: The game follows the classic side-scrolling formula, where players control the main character, Troy, as he runs, jumps, and navigates through levels. Kid-Friendly Design: The game is designed to be accessible and enjoyable for younger players, with simple controls and non-threatening enemies. Cute Dinosaur-Like Protagonist: Troy, the main character, is a friendly dinosaur-like creature with a charming design that appeals to children. VGA Graphics: The game features colorful and detailed VGA graphics, giving it a vibrant and visually appealing look. Solid Gameplay: While the gameplay is basic, it’s well-executed and easy to pick up, making it ideal for younger or less experienced gamers. Non-Violent: The game focuses on exploration and platforming rather than combat, making it a safe and enjoyable experience for kids. Troy 2000: Fans of Troy may want to check out Troy 2000, a modern Windows game by the same author that offers similar gameplay with updated graphics and features. Gameplay: Objective: Guide Troy through a series of side-scrolling levels, avoiding obstacles and collecting items. Controls: Use the arrow keys or joystick to move Troy left and right. Press the jump button to leap over gaps and obstacles. Levels: Each level features simple platforming challenges, such as jumping over pits, avoiding hazards, and navigating platforms. Collectibles: Look for items to collect, which may add to your score or provide other benefits. Why Play Troy? For Kids: The game’s simple controls, cute protagonist, and non-violent gameplay make it a great choice for young children. For Casual Gamers: If you’re looking for a relaxing and straightforward platformer, Troy offers a stress-free experience. For Nostalgia: The colorful VGA graphics and retro platforming mechanics are a nostalgic treat for fans of early PC gaming.

name: Troy
description: Overview: "Troy: Strategic Conquest" is a strategic flash game that immerses players in the legendary Trojan War. Players must build armies, manage resources, and engage in tactical battles to lead their chosen side—whether it be the Greeks or the Trojans—to victory. Key Features: Faction Selection: Choose to play as either the Greeks or the Trojans, each with unique units, abilities, and strategies. Base Building: Construct and upgrade your stronghold, managing resources like wood, stone, and food to strengthen your army and defenses. Unit Management: Train a variety of units, including infantry, archers, and cavalry, each with distinct strengths and weaknesses. Tactical Battles: Engage in real-time or turn-based battles, utilizing terrain, unit positioning, and special abilities to outmaneuver opponents. Quests and Campaigns: Progress through a series of quests that reflect key events in the Trojan War, unlocking new units and upgrades as you advance. Diplomacy and Alliances: Form alliances with other factions or negotiate temporary truces to strengthen your position on the battlefield. Research and Development: Invest in technologies that improve your military capabilities, resource production, and defensive structures. Visual and Audio Elements: Graphics: Detailed 2D or isometric graphics depicting ancient settings, unit designs, and battle animations. Soundtrack: An engaging score accompanied by sound effects for battles, resource gathering, and unit movements. Educational Aspects: Historical Context: Offers insights into the events and characters of the Trojan War, educating players about ancient Greek mythology and history. "Troy: Strategic Conquest" combines resource management, tactical warfare, and rich storytelling, providing an engaging experience for strategy enthusiasts and fans of ancient history alike. If you'd like to explore specific gameplay mechanics or features further, let me know!

name: Troy Solitaire
description: Troy Solitaire is a unique and engaging card game that combines elements of traditional solitaire with a matching mechanic. The goal is to remove all the cards from the playing field by combining pairs of the same cards. It’s a game that requires strategy, observation, and a bit of luck to master. How to Play Troy Solitaire: Objective: Remove all the cards from the board by matching pairs of the same rank (e.g., two Kings, two 7s, etc.). Clear the board completely to win the game. Setup: A set of cards is laid out in a specific pattern (e.g., a pyramid, a grid, or a random arrangement). Some cards may be face-up, while others are face-down and only revealed as adjacent cards are removed. Gameplay: Look for pairs of cards with the same rank that are either: Adjacent to each other (horizontally or vertically). Accessible (not blocked by other cards). Select the pair to remove them from the board. As cards are removed, new cards may become accessible, allowing you to continue matching. The game ends when either all cards are removed (win) or no more moves are possible (lose). Challenges: Some cards may be blocked by others, requiring you to plan your moves carefully. Limited moves or time constraints can add to the difficulty. As you progress, the layouts become more complex, with more cards and fewer obvious matches. Winning: Successfully remove all the cards from the board to win the game. Key Features of Troy Solitaire: Simple Rules: Easy to learn but challenging to master. Strategic Depth: Requires planning and foresight to clear the board efficiently. Multiple Layouts: Different card arrangements keep the gameplay fresh and engaging. Relaxing Yet Challenging: Perfect for unwinding while still providing a mental workout.

name: Trugg
description: Trugg is a solid and enjoyable clone of the classic Boulderdash, offering the same addictive puzzle-solving gameplay with a few unique twists. While it may not revolutionize the genre, it’s a well-crafted game that captures the essence of Boulderdash and provides plenty of entertainment for fans of retro puzzle games. Here’s a closer look at what makes Trugg a fun and challenging experience: Gameplay Overview: Trugg follows the same core mechanics as Boulderdash, with players navigating through underground levels filled with hazards, treasures, and puzzles: Objective: Complete each level by collecting treasures and reaching the exit without getting crushed by boulders or killed by other hazards. Level Design: Each level is a grid-based maze filled with dirt, rocks, gems, and enemies. You must dig through dirt, push boulders, and avoid hazards like falling rocks and enemies to progress. Hazards and Enemies: Boulders and rocks can fall and crush you if you’re not careful. Enemies move in predictable patterns, but they can still pose a threat if you’re not paying attention. Treasures: Collecting treasures is often necessary to unlock the exit. Some levels require you to collect a certain number of treasures before you can finish. Shareware Version: The shareware version includes 20 levels, which provide a good amount of gameplay but may leave you wanting more. Graphics and Presentation: Graphics: The visuals are simple but effective, with clear representations of the underground environment, boulders, gems, and enemies. While not groundbreaking, the graphics are functional and fit the game’s retro aesthetic. Sound: The sound effects are minimal but fitting, with satisfying noises for digging, collecting treasures, and avoiding hazards. There’s no music, which keeps the focus on the gameplay. Interface: The interface is straightforward, with clear indicators for your score and remaining treasures.

name: Trump Sweeper
description: Trump Sweeper is a creative and humorous twist on the classic Minesweeper game, where instead of avoiding mines, players search for hidden "Trumps" (likely referring to images, icons, or references related to Donald Trump). The game retains the strategic and logical elements of Minesweeper but adds a fun and thematic layer to the gameplay. How to Play Trump Sweeper: Objective: The goal is to locate all the hidden "Trumps" on the grid without clicking on any non-Trump tiles. Use numerical clues to deduce the locations of the Trumps. Setup: The game is played on a grid (e.g., 9x9, 16x16, or custom sizes). A certain number of Trumps are hidden randomly across the grid. Non-Trump tiles display numbers indicating how many Trumps are adjacent to that tile (including diagonally adjacent tiles). Gameplay: Click on a tile to reveal what’s underneath: If it’s a Trump, the game ends (you lose). If it’s a number, use the clue to determine where the Trumps might be. If it’s a blank tile, it will reveal all adjacent non-Trump tiles automatically. Right-click (or use a flagging mechanic) to mark tiles you believe contain Trumps. Continue uncovering tiles and marking Trumps until all Trumps are correctly identified. Winning: You win by successfully flagging all the Trumps and revealing all non-Trump tiles. Key Features of Trump Sweeper: Classic Minesweeper Mechanics: The game retains the logical and strategic core of Minesweeper, requiring players to use deduction and pattern recognition. Thematic Twist: The addition of a Trump-themed element adds humor and novelty to the game. Customizable Grids: Players can choose different grid sizes and difficulty levels to suit their preferences. Endless Replayability: The random placement of Trumps ensures that no two games are the same

name: Tube
description: Tube is a very cool demo / freebie / thing created by a programmer at Bullfrog Productions and subsequently released for free on various old PC gaming magazine disks. The included text file is rather confusing since it explicitly states that this is "neither Freeware nor Shareware" and that it shouldn't be distributed but then says it may "only be passed on chargefree via Online". So anyways, this is a 3D perspective racing / action / shooting game, although it's more of a demo than a game. You race forwards, move, shoot, and admire the smooth-scrolling backgrounds, loops, and other cool stuff going on. A fun experience, at least for a short amount of time!

name: Tube Jumpers
description: Tube Jumpers is a local multiplayer that can be played with up to 4 people. In the game you have to make sure to stay on your floating tube.

name: Tubes
description: Tubes is a unique and engaging falling block puzzle game that draws inspiration from classics like KLAX while introducing its own twist with a tube-based mechanic. The game challenges players to create lines of colored atoms by strategically dropping them into a beaker, offering a fresh take on the familiar falling block formula. Here’s a closer look at what makes Tubes a fun and interesting puzzle game: Gameplay Overview: Tubes combines elements of traditional falling block games with a unique tube-based system, creating a fresh and challenging experience: Objective: Your goal is to create lines of three or more atoms of the same color by dropping them into the beaker (playing field). Atoms stream through various tubes, and you must decide when to drop them into the beaker or store them for later use. Tube Mechanics: Atoms move through a series of tubes before reaching the beaker. You can store up to three atoms at a time in a queue, allowing you to plan your moves more strategically. The tube system adds a layer of complexity, as you must anticipate the order in which atoms will arrive and plan accordingly. Beaker (Playing Field): The beaker is where you drop the atoms to create lines. Once a line is formed, it disappears, and you earn points. If the beaker fills up with atoms and no more can be dropped, the game ends. Scoring: Points are awarded based on the number of atoms in a line and the complexity of the combinations you create. Bonus points may be awarded for clearing multiple lines at once or creating larger combinations. Graphics and Presentation: Graphics: The visuals are simple but effective, with colorful atoms and a clear representation of the tubes and beaker. The tube-based design gives the game a unique look. Sound: The sound effects are minimal but fitting, with satisfying noises for dropping atoms and clearing lines. Interface: The interface is straightforward, with clear indicators for your score and the atoms in your queue.

name: Tubular Worlds
description: Tubular Worlds is a pretty good space shooting game, where the screen scrolls left and you shoot wave after wave of enemies while collecting powerups for your ship.
