If you’re curious about early DOS shooters or just feeling nostalgic, it might be worth a quick look—but don’t expect a polished or seamless experience!

name: Zee Artillery
description: Zee Artillery is a simple yet entertaining two-player tank battle game that draws inspiration from classics like Tank Wars and Scorched Earth. With its minimalist gameplay mechanics and competitive focus, it’s a great choice for quick, head-to-head battles. Here’s a detailed look at what makes Zee Artillery a fun and straightforward game: Key Features: Two-Player Tank Combat: The game is designed for two players, each controlling a tank. The goal is to destroy the opponent’s tank by firing projectiles and scoring points. Simple Controls: Each player uses a single key to control their tank: Player 1: Press and hold the A key to set power, release to stop, and press again to fire. Player 2: Press and hold the L key to set power, release to stop, and press again to fire. Timing and precision are key to hitting your target. Wind Mechanics: Wind affects the trajectory of your shots, adding an extra layer of strategy. Players must account for wind direction and strength when aiming. Scoring System: A direct hit on the opponent’s tank scores 2 points. A kill caused by an explosion (e.g., from a nearby projectile) scores 1 point. The first player to reach a set number of points wins. Minimalist Design: The game features simple graphics and straightforward gameplay, making it easy to pick up and play. Quick Matches: Matches are fast-paced and perfect for short gaming sessions or quick competitions between friends. Gameplay: Objective: Score points by hitting your opponent’s tank with projectiles. The first player to reach the target score wins. Controls: Player 1: Use the A key to set power and fire. Player 2: Use the L key to set power and fire. Wind: Adjust your aim to account for wind direction and strength. Scoring: Direct hit: 2 points. Explosion kill: 1 point.

name: Zentris
description: Zentris is a decent-looking clone of the classic Tetris falling-block game. It offers a few simple options (mostly what information is displayed in the sidebars) and plays well using the keyboard and/or mouse. There is no music, just some PC speaker sound effects. Ironically, the "zen" aspect of the game is somewhat overwhelmed by the constant nag screens begging the player to register: At the beginning of the game, after the title screen, and also after you quit. These screens all have mandatory wait periods. The full version is no longer for sale, so it's a shame there's no way around these annoyances.

name: Zeroth Zone
description: Zeroth Zone is a DOS-based shooting game that draws inspiration from the classic arcade game Scramble. The gameplay is relatively slow-paced, focusing on precision and strategy rather than fast reflexes. Players control a spaceship that flies horizontally across a rocky terrain, requiring careful navigation to avoid crashing into the ground. The primary objective is to shoot down missiles that occasionally rise from the ground while ensuring you don't accidentally destroy fuel tanks scattered throughout the level. These fuel tanks are essential for keeping your ship powered, adding a layer of resource management to the gameplay. Destroying them can lead to running out of fuel, which likely results in losing the game. The graphics are described as "okay," meaning they are functional but not particularly advanced or detailed by modern standards. The sound effects are average, typical of the era, with basic shooting and explosion sounds that complement the gameplay without standing out. Overall, Zeroth Zone offers a straightforward yet challenging experience, blending shooting mechanics with careful resource management and terrain navigation. It’s a nostalgic title for fans of retro arcade-style games.

name: Zig Zag Gate
description: Zig Zag Gate is a fast-paced, reflex-based arcade game where the goal is to navigate a moving object (often a ball or a shape) through a series of zigzagging gates. Players must tap or click to change the shape or direction of the object to match the gate's opening and successfully pass through without crashing. The game tests your timing, precision, and reaction speed as the gates become more challenging over time. How to Play Zig Zag Gate: Objective: Guide the object (e.g., a ball, square, or other shape) through all the gates by matching its shape or position to the gate's opening. Controls: Tap or Click: Change the shape or direction of the object to align it with the gate. Timing is crucial—tap too early or too late, and you'll crash into the gate. Gameplay: The object moves forward automatically, and gates appear in quick succession. Each gate has a specific opening (e.g., top, bottom, left, or right) that you must match by tapping to adjust the object's position or shape. Progression: The game starts slow but gets faster and more challenging as you advance. Gates may rotate, move, or have smaller openings, requiring quicker reflexes. Crashing: If the object doesn't align with the gate's opening, it crashes, and the game ends. Key Features of Zig Zag Gate: Simple Controls: Easy to learn but hard to master—just tap or click! Fast-Paced Action: Keeps you on your toes as the speed increases. Minimalist Design: Clean visuals with a focus on the gates and the object. Endless Challenge: See how many gates you can pass before crashing.

name: ZigSaw
description: ZigSaw is a jigsaw puzzle type game that uses square blocks on a grid rather than the typically-shaped pieces used in such puzzles. The game is from 1988 so it boasts only black-and-white graphics and includes only a single puzzle (a picture of a pirate) with more and an image conversion program being offered as part of the registered package. The game works fairly well. You must scroll through each puzzle piece individually, but this is probably a design decision to make it a bit more difficult. Generally though with it's monochrome graphics, single puzzle, and unusual layout it's definitely not the best jigsaw program out there!

name: Zipman 3
description: Zipman 3 (no idea if episodes 1-2 ever were released) has the germ of a good game (decent sprite-based graphics and presentation) but some technical problems hamper it a bit. Your tiny character controls a bit erratically, as does the camera which does not scroll smoothly as you move forward. You cannot attack so you must avoid your enemies. Those problems, combined with the "one hit game over" problem (as in start the whole GAME over, not just the level) cause this one to be an intriguing but unfulfilling game. (It seems like this was a precursor to Aro, a superior game by one of the same authors as this game.)

name: ZJZ RISK
description: ZJZ RISK is a version of the popular board game Risk. Up to six human players can take turns trying to take over the world. First you choose your countries (or allow the computer to choose for you) then assign armies. Then it's time to attack the other nations or re-arrange your armies. It seems like this is a fairly decent clone / homage to the board game, although the keyboard-only controls make things a bit more awkward than they need to be. Also the map layout is a bit strange, for example with certain Canadian provinces covering half the Canada map. The graphics and sounds are also bare-bones. Probably better to play a physical board game if you can!

name: Zmiy
description: Zmiy is a minimalist DOS game that faithfully replicates the classic Snake (or Nibbles) formula, where players control a growing snake that must eat items while avoiding collisions with its own tail. As a clone of the iconic QBasic game Nibbles, Zmiy doesn’t introduce many new features but offers a solid and enjoyable experience for fans of the original. Its use of text-mode graphics and small executable size make it a lightweight and nostalgic throwback to early PC gaming. Key Features: Gameplay: The goal is to guide a snake around the screen, eating numbers (or other items) that cause its tail to grow longer. Each level requires the player to eat a set number of items (e.g., nine) to progress. The challenge increases as the snake grows, making it harder to maneuver without colliding with its own tail or the walls. Text-Mode Graphics: Zmiy uses text-mode graphics, with the snake and items represented by ASCII characters. By default, it runs in VGA 80x50 mode, which provides a slightly higher resolution than standard text modes. Small Executable: The game is incredibly lightweight, with a very small executable file size. This makes it easy to run on older systems or through DOS emulators. Source Code Included: Zmiy comes with its source code, making it a great resource for programmers interested in learning how to create simple games or modify existing ones. Simple Controls: The controls are straightforward, typically using the arrow keys to change the snake’s direction. This makes the game easy to pick up and play. Strengths: Faithful to the Original: Zmiy stays true to the classic Snake/Nibbles formula, providing a familiar and enjoyable experience for fans of the genre. Lightweight and Accessible: The small executable and text-mode graphics make it easy to run on virtually any system, including older hardware or DOS emulators. Educational Value: The inclusion of source code makes Zmiy a great learning tool for aspiring programmers who want to understand the mechanics of simple game development. Nostalgic Appeal: For players who grew up with QBasic games like Nibbles, Zmiy offers a nostalgic trip down memory lane. Weaknesses: Lack of Innovation: Zmiy doesn’t add much to the classic Snake formula, which may make it feel repetitive or unoriginal to players looking for something new. Primitive Graphics: The text-mode visuals, while charming in their simplicity, may not appeal to players accustomed to more modern or visually polished games. Limited Features: The game is very basic, with no additional modes, power-ups, or customization options to enhance replayability.

name: Zodiac Mahjong
description: Zodiac Mahjong is a captivating and visually stunning mahjong game that combines the classic tile-matching gameplay with the mystical theme of the 12 zodiac signs. Each tile features beautifully designed symbols representing the zodiac, creating a unique and immersive experience. The goal is to clear the board by matching pairs of identical free tiles, removing them one by one until all tiles are gone and you can advance to the next level. How to Play: Match Tiles: Find and select two identical free tiles to remove them from the board. Tiles are considered "free" if they are not blocked by other tiles on either the left or right side. Zodiac Theme: The tiles feature the 12 zodiac signs, such as Aries, Taurus, Gemini, and more, adding a thematic twist to the traditional mahjong gameplay. Clear the Board: Strategically remove all the tiles to complete the level and progress to the next, more challenging layout. Shuffle or Hint: If you get stuck, you can use a shuffle feature to rearrange the tiles or a hint to reveal a possible match. Features: Zodiac Theme: The 12 zodiac signs are beautifully represented on the tiles, creating a visually appealing and mystical atmosphere. Multiple Levels: The game offers a variety of levels with increasingly complex layouts, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging. Relaxing and Strategic: The combination of relaxing tile-matching and strategic planning makes it suitable for both casual players and mahjong enthusiasts. Hints and Shuffles: Helpful features like hints and shuffles ensure that players of all skill levels can enjoy the game without frustration.

name: Zombie Inglor
description: Zombie Inglor,a unique blend of RPG (Role-Playing Game) mechanics and first-person shooting in a flash game format. Although it is not a mainstream title, based on your description, it likely has elements that combine exploration, quests, and combat with a zombie-apocalypse theme. First-Person Shooting Mechanics: You’d probably control the character from a first-person perspective, engaging in combat against waves of zombies. Weapons could include guns, melee weapons, and possibly throwable items like grenades or Molotov cocktails. RPG Elements: Character progression, with leveling up or gaining experience points from killing zombies and completing quests. Quests could involve tasks like rescuing survivors, gathering supplies, or clearing out infected zones. An inventory system to manage weapons, items, and resources. Exploration: Players might be able to explore different parts of a zombie-infested city or wasteland, uncovering hidden locations, loot, and NPCs (non-playable characters). There could be different areas to explore, such as abandoned buildings, forests, or underground bunkers. Story and Quests: Quests might range from simple objectives (kill X number of zombies) to more complex ones involving storylines, factions, and interactions with NPCs. There could be side-quests to discover lore, hidden items, or special weapons. Survival and Resources: Managing limited ammo, health packs, and other supplies could add a layer of strategy to the game. Some RPG elements might include crafting or scavenging for new weapons, armor, or items. Gameplay: The combination of RPG and FPS means players would not only shoot their way through hordes of zombies but also engage in quests to unlock new abilities, weapons, or areas. Players may have to manage both combat and story-based elements, which could provide a unique experience compared to more traditional shooters or RPGs.

name: Zombies1997
description: Zombies (1997) is a straightforward and action-packed zombie-slaying game that delivers a no-frills, hack-and-slash experience. While it may lack the depth and complexity of modern games like Vampire Survivors, its simplicity and relentless action make it a fun and nostalgic choice for fans of retro gaming. Here’s a closer look at what makes Zombies a unique and entertaining title: Gameplay Overview: The gameplay in Zombies is as simple as it gets: you’re a lone survivor armed with an axe, and your goal is to fend off endless waves of zombies. Here’s what you can expect: Objective: Survive as long as possible by killing zombies that attack from all sides. There’s no complex storyline or objectives—just pure, unrelenting zombie-slaying action. Controls: The controls are basic, typically involving arrow keys for movement and a single button for attacking with your axe. The simplicity makes it easy to pick up and play, but the sheer number of zombies keeps the tension high. Zombie Waves: Zombies come at you from all directions, and their numbers increase as you progress. The game’s challenge lies in managing the horde and avoiding getting overwhelmed. Gore: The game doesn’t hold back on the gore, with green-colored blood splattering everywhere as you hack through zombies. It’s a satisfying (if somewhat cartoonish) visual effect.

name: Zombocalypse
description: Zombocalypse is a fast-paced, top-down shooter Flash game developed by Armor Games. Set in a zombie apocalypse, the game challenges players to survive waves of undead hordes using an arsenal of weapons and power-ups. Known for its intense action, humorous tone, and addictive gameplay, Zombocalypse has become a favorite among fans of zombie-themed games. While Flash games are no longer widely supported due to the discontinuation of Adobe Flash, Zombocalypse remains a memorable title for its chaotic fun and replayability. Key Features: Top-Down Shooter Gameplay: Players control a survivor from a top-down perspective, navigating through levels filled with zombies. The goal is to survive as long as possible while killing zombies and completing objectives. Weapon Variety: The game features a wide range of weapons, including pistols, shotguns, machine guns, flamethrowers, and more. Each weapon has unique stats and effects, allowing players to choose their preferred playstyle. Power-Ups and Upgrades: Players can collect power-ups to enhance their abilities, such as increased speed, health regeneration, and temporary invincibility. Weapons can also be upgraded to improve their effectiveness. Zombie Hordes: The game features waves of zombies with increasing difficulty and variety. Different types of zombies, such as fast runners or explosive zombies, add to the challenge. Humorous Tone: Despite the zombie apocalypse setting, the game maintains a lighthearted and humorous tone. The dialogue and animations add a comedic element to the intense action. Multiple Levels and Modes: The game includes a campaign mode with multiple levels, each with unique objectives and challenges. Some versions may also feature endless survival modes for players who want to test their skills. Cooperative Multiplayer: Zombocalypse offers a cooperative multiplayer mode, allowing players to team up with friends to survive the zombie hordes. Working together adds a layer of strategy and fun to the gameplay. Simple Controls: The game uses intuitive mouse and keyboard controls: WASD/Arrow Keys: Move the character. Mouse: Aim and shoot. The easy-to-learn controls make the game accessible to players of all skill levels. Pixel Art Style: The game features colorful, pixelated graphics that add to its charm and retro appeal. The visuals are simple yet effective, keeping the focus on the action.

name: zombsroyale.io
description: Overview: ZombsRoyale.io is a thrilling multiplayer battle royale game that blends elements of traditional survival games with fun, cartoonish graphics. Players drop into a large map filled with loot, weapons, and other players, all vying to be the last one standing. Gameplay Mechanics: Controls: Use the WASD keys for movement, the mouse to aim and shoot, and various keys to use items and build structures. Objective: Drop into the map, collect weapons, items, and resources, and eliminate other players while avoiding the encroaching poison zone. The goal is to be the last player or team alive. Loot and Weapons: Discover a wide variety of weapons, from guns to melee weapons, and utilize items like shields and health kits to survive longer. Building: Players can gather materials to build structures for defense or strategic advantage during combat. Visuals and Audio: ZombsRoyale.io features colorful, pixelated graphics that create a lighthearted yet engaging atmosphere. The sound effects and upbeat background music enhance the excitement of the gameplay, making each match enjoyable. Target Audience: This game appeals to players of all ages who enjoy fast-paced multiplayer action and battle royale mechanics. Its accessible gameplay and fun visuals make it suitable for both casual gamers and those looking for competitive experiences. Platforms: ZombsRoyale.io can be played directly in web browsers, making it easily accessible on desktops, laptops, and mobile devices without the need for downloads. Conclusion: With its engaging gameplay and vibrant style, ZombsRoyale.io invites players to jump into the action and prove their skills in a battle for survival. Are you ready to drop in and become the ultimate champion?

name: Zone 66
description: Zone 66 is a classic top-down shooter from Epic MegaGames (now Epic Games), known for its smooth-scrolling graphics, fast-paced action, and driving techno soundtrack. In this game, players control a highly maneuverable ship in a 360-degree top-down world, tasked with destroying everything in sight. Before each mission, you can equip your ship with various weapons and power-ups, adding a layer of strategy to the otherwise chaotic gameplay. With its intense action and customizable loadouts, Zone 66 is a great choice for fans of twitchy, fast-paced shooters. Key Features: Top-Down Shooter Gameplay: The game features fast-paced, 360-degree top-down shooting action, where players control a highly maneuverable ship and destroy enemies and structures. Smooth-Scrolling Graphics: The game boasts smooth-scrolling graphics, which were impressive for its time and contribute to the fluid and immersive gameplay. Driving Techno Soundtrack: The energetic techno soundtrack complements the fast-paced action, adding to the game’s intensity and atmosphere. Customizable Loadouts: Before each mission, players can equip their ship with various weapons and power-ups, allowing for strategic customization based on the mission’s demands. Destructive Objectives: The primary objective is to destroy everything in sight, including enemy ships, structures, and other targets. The game encourages aggressive and relentless gameplay. Intense Action: The game is designed for fans of fast-paced, twitchy shooters, with constant action and challenging enemies. Gameplay Overview: Mission Preparation: Before each mission, players can customize their ship’s loadout with various weapons and power-ups. 360-Degree Movement: The ship can move freely in all directions, allowing for precise maneuvering and targeting. Destruction Galore: The goal is to destroy all enemies, structures, and targets in each mission, often under time constraints or with limited resources. Power-Ups and Upgrades: Collect power-ups during missions to enhance your ship’s capabilities and survive the onslaught of enemies.

name: Zong
description: Zong is a polished and well-designed Arkanoid clone that offers the classic brick-breaking gameplay fans of the genre know and love. Despite its name, which might suggest a connection to Pong, the game is firmly rooted in the Arkanoid tradition, featuring power-ups, varied levels, and the familiar paddle-and-ball mechanics. While it doesn’t introduce many new ideas to the genre, its slick user interface and solid design make it a worthwhile choice for fans of brick-breaking games. Key Features: Classic Arkanoid Gameplay: The core gameplay involves controlling a paddle to bounce a ball and break bricks, much like the classic Arkanoid. The mechanics are tight and responsive, providing a satisfying experience. Power-Ups: The game includes various power-ups that can enhance gameplay, such as expanding the paddle, adding extra balls, or increasing ball speed. These power-ups add a layer of strategy and excitement to the game. Slick User Interface: Zong features a clean and intuitive user interface, making it easy to navigate menus and start playing. The polished design is a standout feature of the game. Varied Levels: The game offers a variety of levels with different brick layouts and challenges, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging. Solid Design: The game is well-crafted, with smooth controls and balanced difficulty. It’s clear that attention was paid to making the gameplay experience as enjoyable as possible. Gameplay Overview: Brick Breaking: Players control a paddle to bounce a ball and break bricks, aiming to clear the screen of all bricks to advance to the next level. Power-Ups: Certain bricks release power-ups that provide temporary advantages, such as multi-ball or paddle expansion. Level Progression: Each level presents a new layout of bricks and challenges, requiring players to adapt their strategies. High Score Challenge: The game encourages replayability through its high-score system, motivating players to improve their skills and achieve higher scores.

name: Zonker
description: Zonker is a straightforward and simple DOS game that follows the classic Snake (or Nibbles) formula. Players control a growing snake, aiming to avoid crashing into their own tail or, in two-player mode, their opponent’s tail. While the game doesn’t introduce any groundbreaking features, it offers a functional and enjoyable experience for fans of the genre, with a few customizable options to tweak the gameplay. Key Features: Gameplay: The core gameplay is identical to the classic Snake formula. Players control a snake that grows longer as it consumes items, and the goal is to avoid crashing into walls, obstacles, or the snake’s own tail. In two-player mode, the objective expands to also avoid the opponent’s tail. Single-Player Mode: In single-player mode, there is no CPU opponent. Instead, players focus on surviving as long as possible while their snake grows longer and the game becomes more challenging. Two-Player Mode: The game supports two-player competitive play, where both players control their own snakes and try to outlast each other. Customizable Options: Players can adjust settings such as: Obstacles: Add walls or barriers to the playing field to increase difficulty. Snake Speed: Control how fast the snake moves, allowing for easier or more challenging gameplay. High Native Screen Mode: The game runs in a higher screen resolution compared to many DOS games of its time, providing a clearer and more visually appealing experience. Strengths: Classic Gameplay: The Snake formula is timeless and easy to pick up, making Zonker accessible to players of all skill levels. Two-Player Mode: The addition of a competitive two-player mode adds replayability and fun for multiplayer sessions. Customization: The ability to adjust obstacles and snake speed allows players to tailor the game to their preferred difficulty level. High Resolution: The game’s higher native screen mode makes it visually cleaner and more enjoyable compared to lower-resolution DOS games. Weaknesses: Lack of Innovation: Zonker doesn’t introduce any new mechanics or features to the Snake formula, making it feel derivative and unremarkable. No CPU Opponent: The single-player mode lacks a CPU opponent, which limits its appeal for solo players looking for a challenge. Basic Presentation: While the higher resolution is a plus, the overall visuals and sound design are minimal and lack polish.

name: Zoo Animals
description: Zoo Animals is a fun and interactive puzzle game where players assemble animal images by moving and matching their body parts. The game is designed to be both entertaining and educational, making it perfect for kids and animal lovers of all ages. How to Play Zoo Animals: Objective: Complete the animal images by correctly matching and placing their body parts (e.g., heads, bodies, tails, legs). Setup: The game presents a set of mixed-up animal parts on the screen. Each animal is divided into several pieces (e.g., head, torso, legs, tail). Gameplay: Drag and drop the animal parts to their correct positions to form complete animals. Match the colors, patterns, and shapes to ensure the pieces fit together perfectly. Once all parts are correctly placed, the animal image is complete, and you can move on to the next one. Challenges: Some parts may look similar, requiring careful observation to match them correctly. As you progress, the number of animals and parts increases, adding to the difficulty. Winning: The game is complete when all the animal images are correctly assembled. Key Features of Zoo Animals: Educational and Fun: Teaches kids about different animals and their body parts while keeping them entertained. Interactive Gameplay: Simple drag-and-drop mechanics make it easy for players of all ages to enjoy. Vibrant Graphics: Colorful and detailed animal images make the game visually appealing. Variety of Animals: Includes a wide range of zoo animals, such as lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and more.

name: Zoo Collapse
description: Zoo Collapse is a fun and engaging puzzle game set in a vibrant zoo environment. The goal is to collapse groups of two or more identical animals by clicking on them, helping you reach the level's goal. With its colorful visuals, charming animal characters, and strategic gameplay, it’s a perfect choice for players who enjoy matching games and lighthearted challenges. How to Play Zoo Collapse: Objective: Collapse groups of two or more identical animals by clicking on them. Reach the level's goal, such as clearing a certain number of animals or achieving a target score. Gameplay: The screen displays a grid filled with various zoo animals, such as lions, elephants, monkeys, and more. Click on groups of two or more identical animals to collapse them and remove them from the grid. New animals will fall into place, and the goal is to clear as many as possible to complete the level. Controls: Click/Tap: Select groups of identical animals to collapse them. Undo: Some versions allow you to undo moves if you make a mistake. Levels: The game features multiple levels, each with increasing difficulty. Goals may include clearing a specific number of animals, achieving a target score, or completing the level within a limited number of moves. Scoring: Points are awarded for each group of animals collapsed. Larger groups or special combinations may earn bonus points. Key Features of Zoo Collapse: Zoo Theme: Vibrant and lively visuals featuring a variety of zoo animals. Matching Gameplay: Fun and challenging mechanics for collapsing groups of animals. Progressive Difficulty: Starts easy but becomes more complex as you advance. Relaxing Yet Engaging: Perfect for casual play while still offering a mental challenge.

name: Zoo Mahjong
description: Zoo Mahjong is a delightful and family-friendly twist on the classic Mahjong puzzle game, set in a vibrant zoo environment. In this game, players are tasked with matching and removing identical Mahjong tiles, each adorned with charming animal illustrations, to clear the board and progress through various levels. The game combines the traditional Mahjong mechanics with a fun and engaging zoo theme, making it accessible and enjoyable for players of all ages. Gameplay Overview: Animal-Themed Tiles: Instead of traditional Mahjong symbols, the tiles in Zoo Mahjong feature a variety of adorable animals such as lions, elephants, pandas, monkeys, and more. Each tile is beautifully illustrated, adding a playful and colorful element to the game. Matching Tiles: The primary objective is to find and match three identical animal tiles. When three matching tiles are selected, they are removed from the board. Only tiles that are not covered by others and have at least one side free (left or right) can be clicked. Clearing the Board: The goal is to remove all the tiles from the board. As tiles are removed, new layers and patterns are revealed, requiring players to continuously adapt their strategy. Level Progression: Each level presents a new tile arrangement, often inspired by different zoo habitats such as the savannah, jungle, Arctic, and rainforest. As players advance, the layouts become more complex and challenging, with more tiles and intricate patterns. Hints and Shuffles: To assist players, the game may offer hints that highlight possible matches or a shuffle feature that rearranges the remaining tiles to provide new opportunities for matches. Time and Moves: Some versions of the game may include time limits or move restrictions, adding an extra layer of challenge. Players must think quickly and plan their moves carefully to complete the level within the given constraints. Zoo Themes and Backgrounds: The game is rich in zoo-themed visuals, with vibrant backgrounds depicting various zoo enclosures and environments. The soothing sounds of nature and cheerful animal noises enhance the immersive experience. Key Features: Animal-Themed Tiles: Adorable and beautifully illustrated animal tiles that appeal to players of all ages. Multiple Levels: A variety of levels with increasing difficulty, each offering a unique tile arrangement and visual theme. Hint System: Optional hints to help players when they are stuck. Shuffle Option: Ability to shuffle the tiles to reveal new matching opportunities.

name: Zoo Mysteries
description: Zoo Mysteries is an exciting hidden object and spot-the-difference game set in a vibrant zoo environment. The goal is to find all the hidden objects or differences in each scene, uncovering the mysteries of the zoo. With its colorful visuals, engaging gameplay, and animal-themed fun, it’s a perfect game for players who enjoy exploration and puzzle-solving. How to Play Zoo Mysteries: Objective: Find all the hidden objects or differences in each zoo-themed scene. Explore the zoo and uncover its mysteries by clicking on the objects or differences. Gameplay: Each level features a detailed scene of a zoo, filled with animals, enclosures, and hidden objects. Look for hidden objects listed at the bottom of the screen or spot the differences between two similar images. Click on the objects or differences to mark them as found. Controls: Click/Tap: Select and mark hidden objects or differences. Zoom: Some versions allow you to zoom in for a closer look at the scene. Levels: The game features multiple levels, each with a unique zoo scene and set of hidden objects or differences. As you progress, the scenes become more detailed, and the objects or differences harder to find. Hints: If you’re stuck, use the hint button to reveal the location of a hidden object or difference. Hints are limited, so use them wisely! Key Features of Zoo Mysteries: Zoo Theme: Vibrant and lively scenes featuring a variety of animals and zoo environments. Hidden Object and Spot-the-Difference Gameplay: Fun and challenging searches for cleverly concealed items or differences. Beautiful Graphics: Immersive and detailed visuals that bring the zoo to life. Relaxing Yet Engaging: Perfect for unwinding while exercising your observation skills.

name: Zoobie Blocks
description: Zoobie Blocks is an exciting and fast-paced puzzle game that challenges players to shoot blocks and create groups of three or more to remove them from the board. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to clear the board by shooting blocks and creating groups of three or more identical blocks. The game is won when all blocks are successfully removed from the board. Block Shooting: Shooting Blocks: Use the mouse or touchscreen to aim and shoot blocks onto the board. The blocks will stick to other blocks upon contact. Creating Groups: When three or more identical blocks are connected, they form a group and are removed from the board. Larger groups yield higher scores. Special Bonus Items: Helpers: On the bottom left of the screen, you have access to special bonus items that can help you clear the board more efficiently. These items can include bombs, color changers, and other power-ups. Using Bonus Items: Click on a bonus item to activate it. For example, a bomb can clear a large area of blocks, while a color changer can transform blocks into a specific color to create groups. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with a board partially filled with blocks. Your task is to shoot new blocks onto the board to create groups and clear the blocks. Shooting and Grouping: Aim carefully and shoot blocks to create groups of three or more. Use the bonus items strategically to maximize your score and clear the board faster. Clearing the Board: Continue shooting and grouping blocks until the entire board is cleared. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the board becomes more complex, and the number of blocks increases, requiring more strategic thinking and precision. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show optimal shooting angles or highlight areas where groups can be formed. Undo: Some versions of the game might include an undo feature, allowing you to reverse your last move and try a different strategy.

name: Zoobiedoku
description: Zoobiedoku is a delightful and educational twist on the classic Sudoku puzzle game, featuring a variety of animals instead of numbers. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to place all the animals on the grid such that each animal appears only once in every row, column, and block. The game is won when the entire grid is correctly filled according to these rules. Grid Layout: Standard Sudoku Grid: The game uses a 9x9 grid divided into 3x3 subgrids or blocks. Animal Tiles: Instead of numbers, the grid is filled with various animal tiles. Each animal represents a unique symbol that must be placed correctly. Placement Rules: Unique in Row: Each animal can appear only once in every row. Unique in Column: Each animal can appear only once in every column. Unique in Block: Each animal can appear only once in every 3x3 block. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with some animals already placed on the grid. These pre-filled tiles provide clues to help you solve the puzzle. Placing Animals: Drag and drop the correct animal tiles into the empty cells, ensuring that the placement adheres to the Sudoku rules. Validation: The game may offer real-time validation, highlighting incorrect placements to help you correct mistakes. Difficulty Levels: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the number of pre-filled tiles decreases, requiring more strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show possible placements or highlight errors. Undo: Some versions of the game might include an undo feature, allowing you to reverse your last move and try a different placement. Visuals and Sound: Graphics: The game features vibrant, colorful graphics with adorable animal designs and a clean, user-friendly interface. The animal tiles and cheerful backgrounds create a joyful and inviting atmosphere. Soundtrack: The background music is calming and fitting for a puzzle game, with sound effects like the "click" of placing tiles and the "ding" of completing a level enhancing the overall experience.

name: Zoobies Collapse
description: Zoobies Collapse is a fun and addictive puzzle game that challenges players to clear the board by removing groups of connected Zoobies. Here's a detailed description of the game: Gameplay Mechanics: Objective: The primary goal is to remove all Zoobies from the board by clicking on groups of two or more connected Zoobies of the same type. The game is won when the entire board is cleared. Zoobie Matching: Connected Zoobies: Zoobies are connected if they are adjacent to each other horizontally or vertically. Diagonal connections do not count. Group Size: You must click on groups of at least two connected Zoobies of the same type to remove them. Larger groups will yield higher scores. Game Flow: Initial Setup: The game starts with a grid filled with various types of Zoobies. The arrangement and types of Zoobies vary by level. Removing Zoobies: Click on a group of two or more connected Zoobies of the same type to remove them from the board. When Zoobies are removed, the remaining Zoobies may shift to fill the gaps, potentially creating new groups to remove. Clearing the Board: Continue removing groups of Zoobies until the entire board is cleared. The game advances to the next level once the board is empty. Level Progression: The game is divided into levels, each with increasing difficulty. As you progress, the grids become larger, and the number of Zoobie types increases, requiring more strategic thinking and planning. Hints and Assistance: Hints: If you get stuck, the game may offer hints to show possible groups of Zoobies that can be removed. Undo: Some versions of the game might include an undo feature, allowing you to reverse your last move and try a different strategy.

name: Zoobies Connect
description: Zoobies Connect is a delightful and whimsical mahjong-style puzzle game featuring the adorable and funny Zoobies characters. The goal is to clear the board by connecting pairs of identical Zoobies tiles, but with a unique twist: the connecting line between the tiles cannot have more than two 90-degree angles. This adds a strategic layer to the gameplay, making it both fun and challenging. With its charming characters and vibrant visuals, Zoobies Connect is perfect for players of all ages who enjoy lighthearted puzzle games. How to Play: Match Zoobies: Find and connect two identical Zoobies tiles to remove them from the board. Path Rules: The connecting line between the tiles can have no more than two 90-degree angles. If the path requires more angles, the tiles cannot be matched. Clear the Board: Strategically remove all the tiles to complete the level and progress to the next stage. Plan Ahead: Think carefully about your moves, as some tiles may become blocked if you don’t clear them in the right order. Features: Adorable Zoobies: The game features a variety of cute and funny Zoobies characters, each with its own unique design and personality. Unique Pathing Rules: The restriction on the number of angles adds a strategic challenge, requiring players to think carefully about their connections. Multiple Levels: The game offers a variety of levels with increasingly complex layouts, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging. Colorful and Fun: The vibrant visuals and playful theme make the game visually appealing and enjoyable for players of all ages.

name: Zoobies Match
description: Zoobies Match is a charming and lively match-3 puzzle game featuring the adorable Zoobies characters. The game follows the classic match-3 formula, where players swap two adjacent Zoobies to create rows or columns of three or more identical Zoobies, causing them to disappear. Each level has a specific number of Zoobies you need to remove to advance, adding a fun and challenging objective. With its colorful graphics, cute characters, and engaging gameplay, Zoobies Match is perfect for fans of casual puzzle games. How to Play: Swap Zoobies: Swap two adjacent Zoobies to create a row or column of three or more identical Zoobies. Remove Zoobies: Matching Zoobies will disappear from the board, and new Zoobies will fall into place, potentially creating chain reactions. Reach the Goal: Each level has a specific number of Zoobies you need to remove to advance to the next level. Plan Ahead: Think strategically about your moves, as some swaps can create multiple matches or trigger special power-ups. Features: Zoobies Theme: The game features a variety of cute and colorful Zoobies characters, adding a playful and fun atmosphere. Classic Match-3 Mechanics: Easy-to-learn rules make the game accessible for players of all ages and skill levels. Multiple Levels: The game offers a variety of levels with increasing difficulty, ensuring hours of engaging gameplay. Colorful Graphics: Vibrant and cheerful visuals make the game visually appealing and enjoyable to play. Special Combos: Create larger matches or special combinations to trigger powerful effects and clear more Zoobies at once.

name: Zool
description: Zool ("Ninja of the 'Nth' dimension") is a colorful platforming game with prominent product placement for Chupa Chups brand candies. The game takes strong inspiration from Sega's Sonic series (the FILE_ID.DIZ below even refers to it as a "Sonic the Hedgehog clone") but it retains its own unique feel. Your character Zool (some sort of ninja) can shoot to take down his enemies as he explores the many candy-laden stages. You can also collect a variety of powerups as you run around the levels. Not the most unique game but it can be entertaining, much like other mascot-based platformers of the era. (Note that you use the Insert key to shoot and arrow keys to move.)

name: Zorak: The Mountain of Terror
description: Zorak is an Ultima-inspired CRPG with a fantasy setting. The author notes that the game is a "prototype" so I don't know exactly how much of it is actually completed, and there are no registration instructions despite it being labeled in-game as shareware. It was also meant to show off the author's upcoming (and presumably cancelled) game-making system to make games like this yourself dubbed the "Asylum Game System". The game itself sticks firmly to Ultima tropes, including the graphics and gameplay elements, with some droning MIDI music in the background. You can try to talk to people, however you'd better know the right keywords to get them to speak. You can also attack people in the city, which will result in being thrown in jail. There's a large world to explore but not much story development that I could find beyond the introductory message. The hotkeys are not listed anywhere so you'll need to use trial and error. Probably worth trying for nostalgia only, it's not really a fully-functional game.

name: Zork: The Great Underground Empire
description: Zork: The Great Underground Empire is a seminal interactive fiction game, and the first in a series of influential text adventure games from Infocom. I don't often add interactive fiction games to the archive (see IF Archive for more of those) but I'll make exceptions for exceptional games! Originally released for the TRS-80 in 1980, the DOS port keeps the story and gameplay of the original game. (Most people probably remember playing it on DOS anyways!) This version is actually "Mini-Zork", described as a "Reader's Digest" version of the full game intended as a demo. It's described in the included readme thusly: "This program is a sample of the first Zork text adventure, published around 1981. The full game is available in the Lost Treasures of Infocom collection, volume 1, as well as in the Zork Anthology." Truly a classic of the genre!

name: Zorlim's Arcade Volleyball
description: Zorlim's Arcade Volleyball is a fun and lighthearted variation of the classic Arcade Volleyball game. Designed for two players, the game pits you against a human opponent in a fast-paced volleyball match. While it improves on the original with better graphics, varied backgrounds, and enhanced sound effects, the ball movement feels less realistic, which may take some getting used to. Despite this, the game offers a simple and enjoyable multiplayer experience for fans of retro sports games. Key Features: Two-Player Volleyball: The game is designed for two players, with no CPU opponent available. Players compete to knock the volleyball into each other’s court, scoring points by making the ball land on the opponent’s side. Simple Controls: Players can move left and right, jump, and hit the ball. The controls are easy to learn, making the game accessible for players of all skill levels. Improved Graphics and Sound: Compared to the original Arcade Volleyball, this version features better graphics, including varied backgrounds, and enhanced sound effects. These improvements add to the game’s visual and auditory appeal. Unrealistic Ball Physics: The ball movement feels less realistic than in the original game, which may be a point of contention for some players. However, this quirk can also add to the game’s charm and unpredictability. Fast-Paced Gameplay: The matches are quick and energetic, requiring quick reflexes and coordination to outmaneuver your opponent.

name: Zorro
description: Zorro is based on the masked outlaw character. Basically, the game is a blatant rip-off of Prince of Persia. It's almost like Capstone got hold of the code for PoP, changed the graphics/sounds, and generally made the game worse with poor level design. I'm not sure who designed these levels or who thought this would be an adequate representation of the character but although it superficially seems like PoP it doesn't seem to do justice to Zorro or this style of game. (Note: Press F1 when the game starts for a list of keyboard keys.)

name: Zottris
description: Zottris is a unique take on the Tetris falling-block genre of games. It features the classic "well" and different colored blocks falling down, but instead of moving them around, you selectively destroy individual blocks in order to try to align rows of the same color. It's a simple idea and it works pretty well, with mouse or keyboard controls. You have a limited number of "zots" (you use up one whenever you destroy a block) and you regain some when you complete a line. Definitely worth checking out if you like Tetris but are looking for a different kind of challenge.

name: Zuma Ball
description: Zuma Ball is a fun and addictive match-3 puzzle game inspired by the popular Zuma series. The goal is to shoot colored balls into a chain to create groups of three or more balls of the same color, causing them to disappear. Players can earn bonus points by hitting special bonus spots and must avoid hitting bumpers that can disrupt their progress. With its simple controls, colorful graphics, and engaging gameplay, Zuma Ball is perfect for fans of casual puzzle games. How to Play: Shoot Balls: Touch the screen or click the mouse to shoot a ball into the chain. Aim carefully to create matches. Match 3 or More: Create groups of three or more balls of the same color to make them disappear and earn points. Bonus Spots: Hit special bonus spots marked with points to earn extra rewards. Avoid Bumpers: Be careful not to hit bumpers, as they can disrupt your progress and make the game more challenging. Change Ball Color: Tap the shooter to change the color of the ball you're about to shoot, allowing for better strategic planning. Features: Zuma-Inspired Gameplay: The game retains the core mechanics of the popular Zuma series, making it easy to pick up and play. Bonus Points: Earn extra points by hitting special bonus spots on the chain. Colorful Graphics: Vibrant and cheerful visuals make the game visually appealing and enjoyable to play. Simple Controls: Easy-to-learn mechanics make the game accessible for players of all ages and skill levels. Strategic Depth: Changing ball colors and planning your shots adds a layer of strategy to the gameplay.

name: Zuma Legend
description: Zuma Legend is an exciting and addictive match-3 puzzle game inspired by the classic Zuma gameplay, but with a fresh twist. The game features 100 levels of challenging and colorful puzzles where players must shoot balls into a moving chain to create matches of three or more identical balls. With its fast-paced action, strategic gameplay, and vibrant visuals, Zuma Legend offers hours of entertainment for puzzle and arcade game fans. How to Play: Shoot Balls: Tap the screen to shoot a ball from the central shooter into the chain of moving balls. Match 3 or More: Create matches of three or more balls of the same color to make them disappear and slow down the chain. Change Ball Color: Tap the shooter to cycle through available ball colors and choose the one that best fits your strategy. Stop the Chain: Prevent the chain of balls from reaching the end point by clearing as many balls as possible. If the chain reaches the end, the game is over. Power-Ups and Combos: Create larger matches or use special power-ups to clear more balls and earn higher scores. Features: 100 Levels: The game offers a wide variety of levels, each with unique layouts and increasing difficulty to keep you engaged. Colorful Graphics: Vibrant and eye-catching visuals make the gameplay visually appealing and enjoyable. Strategic Gameplay: Plan your shots carefully to create chain reactions and maximize your score. Power-Ups: Unlock and use special power-ups to clear large sections of the chain or overcome tricky situations. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple controls make the game accessible, while the challenging levels provide a satisfying experience for skilled players.

name: Zuma: The Lost Treasure
description: Zuma: The Lost Treasure is a match puzzle Flash game that is part of the popular Zuma series, originally developed by PopCap Games. The game revolves around shooting colored balls from a stone frog idol to create matches of three or more same-colored balls, preventing them from reaching the end of a winding path. With its addictive gameplay, vibrant visuals, and challenging levels, Zuma: The Lost Treasure became a classic in the puzzle genre. While Flash games are no longer widely supported due to the discontinuation of Adobe Flash, Zuma: The Lost Treasure remains a beloved title for its engaging mechanics and replayability. Key Features: Match Puzzle Mechanics: Players shoot colored balls from a stone frog idol to create matches of three or more same-colored balls. Matching balls causes them to disappear, slowing down the advancing chain of balls. Winding Paths: The game features intricate, winding paths that the balls travel along. Players must strategically shoot balls to create matches and prevent the chain from reaching the end. Power-Ups: Special power-ups appear throughout the game, such as: Reverse: Reverses the direction of the ball chain. Slow Down: Slows the movement of the balls. Explosion: Destroys nearby balls. These power-ups add an extra layer of strategy to the gameplay. Multiple Levels: The game includes a variety of levels, each with unique layouts and increasing difficulty. Players must complete each level to progress to the next. Timed and Survival Modes: In addition to the main campaign, the game may feature timed or survival modes for added challenge. These modes test players' speed and precision under pressure. Vibrant Visuals and Sound: The game features colorful, tropical-themed graphics that are visually appealing. The soundtrack and sound effects enhance the immersive experience. Simple Controls: Players use the mouse to aim and shoot balls, making the game easy to learn but difficult to master. The intuitive controls allow players to focus on strategy and quick thinking. Replayability: The game encourages replayability through high scores, challenging levels, and bonus objectives. Players can aim to achieve perfect scores or complete levels with fewer moves.

name: Zyclunt
description: Zyclunt (also known as "Blade Warrior") is a side-scrolling fighting / platformer where you battle lots of robots, destroying them with your mighty sword. The game plays like a fighting game since you must defeat all of the enemies in a section before moving on (complete with "GO!" indicator) however the action takes place on a single "plane" like shooters such as Contra. The graphics and presentation of the game are great, with large detailed sprites and impressive graphical flourishes. There are also sometimes powerups to collect, and massive bosses to battle. However the gameplay is a bit clunky, since many of the enemy shots seem impossible to avoid, and controlling your character is not always smooth.

name: Zyll
description: Marketed by IBM as an adventure game Zyll is a text-based RPG with randomized elements where the object is to retrieve the "Black Orb". After choosing your class (warrior/thief/wizard) your adventure begins, and you are given various action options as you proceed. By modern standards it's pretty basic, but at the time it was considered innovative. One neat thing is that it supports two player gameplay. Note that because it was designed for old XT-style keyboards, it uses the F1-F8 keys for all/most commands.

name: Fortnite
description: Fortnite is a free-to-play Battle Royale game with numerous game modes for every type of game player. Watch a concert, build an island or fight.

name: Roblox
description: Roblox is the ultimate virtual universe that lets you create, share experiences with friends, and be anything you can imagine. Join millions of people and discover an infinite variety of immersive experiences created by a global community!

name: Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0
description: Welcome to Call of Duty®: Warzone™, the massive free-to-play combat arena. Experience thrilling modes & new gameplay features in Area 99, Urzikstan and Rebirth Island.

name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare
description: Experience a visceral Campaign or assemble your team in the ultimate online playground with multiple Special Ops challenges and a mix of Multiplayer maps and modes.

name: Grand Theft Auto V
description: Grand Theft Auto V for PC offers players the option to explore the award-winning world of Los Santos and Blaine County in resolutions of up to 4k and beyond, as well as the chance to experience the game running at 60 frames per second.

name: Rust
description: The only aim in Rust is to survive. Everything wants you to die – the island’s wildlife, other inhabitants, the environment, and other survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another night.

name: Apex Legends
description: Apex Legends is the award-winning, free-to-play Hero Shooter from Respawn Entertainment. Master an ever-growing roster of legendary characters with powerful abilities, and experience strategic squad play and innovative gameplay in the next evolution of Hero Shooter and Battle Royale.

name: Among Us
description: An online and local party game of teamwork and betrayal for 4-15 players…in space!

name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 4
description: Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 features gritty, grounded, fluid multiplayer combat, the biggest Zombies offering ever with three full undead adventures at launch, and Blackout, where the universe of Black Ops comes to life in two massive battle royale experiences. Black Ops 4 is a robust, refined, and customizable Call of Duty PC shooter experience with uncapped framerate, 4K resolution, HDR, support for ultrawide monitors, and additional features built for the PC community.

name: Counter-Strike 2
description: For over two decades, Counter-Strike has offered an elite competitive experience, one shaped by millions of players from across the globe. And now the next chapter in the CS story is about to begin. This is Counter-Strike 2.

name: Overwatch 2
description: Overwatch 2 is a free-to-play, team-based action game set in the optimistic future, where every match is the ultimate 5v5 battlefield brawl.

name: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege
description: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six® Siege is an elite, tactical team-based shooter where superior planning and execution triumph.

name: FIFA 22
description: Powered by Football™, EA SPORTS™ FIFA 22 brings the game even closer to the real thing with fundamental gameplay advances and a new season of innovation across every mode.

name: FIFA 21
description: Football is back with EA SPORTS™ FIFA 21, featuring more ways to team up on the street or in the stadium to enjoy even bigger victories with friends.

name: NBA 2K24
description: Experience hoops culture in NBA 2K24. Enjoy loads of action and limitless personalized MyPLAYER options in MyCAREER. Build your perfect lineup in MyTEAM. Feel more responsive gameplay and polished visuals while playing with your favorite NBA and WNBA teams in PLAY NOW.

name: NBA 2K23
description: Rise to the occasion in NBA 2K23. Showcase your talent in MyCAREER. Pair All-Stars with timeless legends in MyTEAM. Build your own dynasty in MyGM, or guide the NBA in a new direction with MyLEAGUE. Take on NBA or WNBA teams in PLAY NOW and feel true-to-life gameplay.

name: Rocket League
description: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem with easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven competition. Rocket League includes casual and competitive Online Matches, a fully-featured offline Season Mode, special “Mutators” that let you change the rules entirely, hockey and…

name: Genshin Impact
description: Genshin Impact is an open-world action RPG. In the game, set forth on a journey across a fantasy world called Teyvat. In this vast world, you can explore seven nations, meet a diverse cast of characters with unique personalities and abilities, and fight powerful enemies together with them, all on the way during your quest to find your lost sibling.

name: World of Warcraft
description: World of Warcraft is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game released in 2004 by Blizzard Entertainment. Join thousands of mighty heroes in Azeroth, a world of magic and limitless adventure.

name: ELDEN RING
description: THE CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED FANTASY ACTION RPG. Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between.

name: Destiny 2
description: Destiny 2 is an action MMO with a single evolving world that you and your friends can join anytime, anywhere, absolutely free.

name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
description: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online
description: Join over 22 million players in the award-winning online multiplayer RPG and experience limitless adventure in a persistent Elder Scrolls world. Battle, craft, steal, or explore, and combine different types of equipment and abilities to create your own style of play. No game subscription required.

name: Dota 2
description: Every day, millions of players worldwide enter battle as one of over a hundred Dota heroes. And no matter if it’s their 10th hour of play or 1,000th, there’s always something new to discover. With regular updates that ensure a constant evolution of gameplay, features, and heroes, Dota 2 has taken on a life of its own.

name: Fall Guys
description: Fall Guys is a free, cross-platform massively multiplayer party royale game. Clumsily compete in absurd obstacle courses with friends or build your very own chaotic course to share with the community.

name: Baldur’s Gate 3
description: Baldur’s Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal, survival and sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.

name: Hogwarts Legacy
description: Hogwarts Legacy is an immersive, open-world action RPG. Now you can take control of the action and be at the center of your own adventure in the wizarding world.

name: Starfield
description: Starfield is the first new universe in 25 years from Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4.

name: Cyberpunk 2077
description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night City — a dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
description: Winner of over 175 Game of the Year Awards and recipient of over 250 perfect scores, RDR2 is the epic tale of outlaw Arthur Morgan and the infamous Van der Linde gang, on the run across America at the dawn of the modern age. Also includes access to the shared living world of Red Dead Online.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
description: You are Geralt of Rivia, mercenary monster slayer. Before you stands a war-torn, monster-infested continent you can explore at will. Your current contract? Tracking down Ciri — the Child of Prophecy, a living weapon that can alter the shape of the world.

name: God of War
description: His vengeance against the Gods of Olympus years behind him, Kratos now lives as a man in the realm of Norse Gods and monsters. It is in this harsh, unforgiving world that he must fight to survive… and teach his son to do the same.

name: God of War Ragnarök
description: Kratos and Atreus embark on a mythic journey for answers before Ragnarök arrives – now on PC.

name: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2
description: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 is the next game in PlayStation’s critically acclaimed Marvel’s Spider-Man franchise. Developed by Insomniac Games in collaboration with Marvel Games and PlayStation for the PS5 console.

name: Marvel’s Spider-Man
description: In Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered, the worlds of Peter Parker and Spider-Man collide in an original action-packed story. Play as an experienced Peter Parker, fighting big crime and iconic villains in Marvel’s New York. Web-swing through vibrant neighborhoods and defeat villains with epic takedowns.

name: Marvel’s Spider-Man: Miles Morales
description: After the events of Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered, teenage Miles Morales is adjusting to his new home while following in the footsteps of his mentor, Peter Parker, as a new Spider-Man. When a fierce power struggle threatens to destroy his home, Miles must take up the mantle of Spider-Man and own it

name: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla
description: Become Eivor, a Viking raider raised to be a fearless warrior, and lead your clan from icy desolation in Norway to a new home amid the lush farmlands of ninth-century England. Find your settlement and conquer this hostile land by any means to earn a place in Valhalla.

name: Assassin’s Creed Mirage
description:
In Assassin’s Creed Mirage, you are Basim, a cunning street thief with nightmarish visions seeking answers and justice.

Join an ancient organization and come to understand a new creed – one that will change Basim’s fate in ways he never could have imagined.

name: Battlefield 2042
description: Battlefield™ 2042 is a first-person shooter that marks the return to the iconic all-out warfare of the franchise.

name: Sea of Thieves
description: Sea of Thieves is a smash-hit pirate adventure game, offering the quintessential pirate experience of plundering lost treasures, intense battles, vanquishing sea monsters and more. Dive in with this revised edition of the game, which includes access to digital bonus media.

name: Halo Infinite
description: From one of gaming’s most iconic sagas, Halo is bigger than ever. Featuring an expansive open-world campaign and a dynamic free to play multiplayer experience.

name: Diablo IV
description: The endless battle between the High Heavens and the Burning Hells rages on as chaos threatens to consume Sanctuary. With ceaseless demons to slaughter, countless Abilities to master, nightmarish Dungeons, and Legendary loot, this vast, open world brings the promise of adventure and devastation. Survive and conquer darkness – or succumb to the shadows.

name: Diablo II: Resurrected
description: Diablo II: Resurrected is a remastered version of the quintessential action RPG Diablo II. Pursue the mysterious Dark Wanderer and fight the denizens of hell as you uncover the fate of the Prime Evils Diablo, Mephisto, and Baal, now in up to 4K (2160p) resolution on PC.

name: Hearthstone
description: Deceptively simple and insanely fun, Hearthstone is a fast-paced strategy card game from Blizzard Entertainment.

name: Terraria
description: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

name: Minecraft Dungeons
description: Fight your way through an exciting action-adventure game, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and set in the Minecraft universe!

name: Ghost of Tsushima
description: The year is 1274. Samurai warriors are the legendary defenders of Japan—until the fearsome Mongol Empire invades the island of Tsushima, wreaking havoc and conquering the local population. As one of the last surviving samurai, you rise from the ashes to fight back. But honorable tactics won’t lead you to victory. You must move beyond your samurai traditions to forge a new way of fighting—the way of the Ghost—as you wage an unconventional war for the freedom of Japan.

name: Horizon Forbidden West
description: Experience the epic Horizon Forbidden West™ in its entirety with bonus content and the Burning Shores expansion included. The Burning Shores add-on contains additional content for Aloy’s adventure, including new storylines, characters, and experiences in a stunning yet hazardous new area.

name: Horizon Zero Dawn
description: Experience Aloy’s legendary quest to unravel the mysteries of a future Earth ruled by Machines. Use devastating tactical attacks against your prey and explore a majestic open world in this award-winning action RPG!

name: Lost Ark
description: Embark on an odyssey for the Lost Ark in a vast, vibrant world: explore new lands, seek out lost treasures, and test yourself in thrilling action combat in this action-packed free-to-play RPG.

name: Dead by Daylight
description: Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined Survivors face a bloodthirsty Killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror with horror gaming’s best asymmetrical multiplayer.

name: War Thunder
description: War Thunder is the most comprehensive free-to-play, cross-platform, MMO military game dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft, from the early 20th century to the most advanced modern combat units. Join now and take part in major battles on land, in the air, and at sea.

name: Path of Exile
description: You are an Exile, struggling to survive on the dark continent of Wraeclast, as you fight to earn power that will allow you to exact your revenge against those who wronged you. Path of Exile is an online Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. The game is completely free and will never be pay-to-win.

name: Path of Exile 2
description: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

name: ARK: Survival Evolved
description: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate… and escape!

name: Stardew Valley
description: You’ve inherited your grandfather’s old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

name: Phasmophobia
description: Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost-hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.

name: No Man’s Sky
description: No Man’s Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.

name: Warframe
description: Awaken as an unstoppable warrior and battle alongside your friends in this story-driven free-to-play online action game

name: Assassin’s Creed Origins
description: ASSASSIN’S CREED® ORIGINS IS A NEW BEGINNING *The Discovery Tour by Assassin’s Creed®: Ancient Egypt is available now as a free update!* Ancient Egypt, a land of majesty and intrigue, is disappearing in a ruthless fight for power.

name: Assassin’s Creed Odyssey
description: Assassin’s Creed Odyssey is an action-adventure game where you choose the hero you want to become. Embark on an epic journey from outcast to living legend to uncover the secrets of your past and change the fate of Ancient Greece. Fight in visceral battles on both land and sea to become a true hero

name: Persona 5 Royal
description: Don the mask and join the Phantom Thieves of Hearts as they stage grand heists, infiltrate the minds of the corrupt, and make them change their ways!

name: Persona 5 Strikers
description: Join the Phantom Thieves and strike back against the corruption overtaking cities across Japan. A summer vacation with close friends takes a sudden turn as a distorted reality emerges; reveal the truth and redeem the hearts of those imprisoned at the center of the crisis!

name: Persona 5 Tactica
description: Join the Phantom Thieves as they lead an uprising of the heart! Assemble an all-star team of heroes in a brand-new story in this thrilling combat adventure set in Persona’s iconic universe.

name: Persona 4 Golden
description: A coming of age story that sets the protagonist and his friends on a journey kickstarted by a chain of serial murders.

name: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE
description: Cloud Strife, an ex-SOLDIER operative, descends on the mako-powered city of Midgar. The world of the timeless classic FINAL FANTASY VII is reborn, using cutting-edge graphics technology, a new battle system and an additional adventure featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.

name: FINAL FANTASY XVI
description:
Enter the dark fantasy world of Valisthea in this highly anticipated single-player action RPG.

The 16th standalone entry in the legendary Final Fantasy series marks a darker turn for the RPG franchise, with a complex tale of revenge, power struggles and unavoidable tragedy.

name: Mortal Kombat 1
description: Discover a reborn Mortal Kombat™ Universe created by the Fire God Liu Kang. Mortal Kombat™ 1 ushers in a new era of the iconic franchise with a new fighting system, game modes, and fatalities!

name: Mortal Kombat 11
description: Mortal Kombat is back and better than ever in the next evolution of the iconic franchise.

name: Street Fighter 6
description: Here comes Capcom’s newest challenger! Street Fighter™ 6 launches worldwide on June 2nd, 2023 and represents the next evolution of the Street Fighter™ series! Street Fighter 6 spans three distinct game modes, including World Tour, Fighting Ground and Battle Hub.

name: TEKKEN 8
description: Get ready for the next chapter in the legendary fighting game franchise, TEKKEN 8.

name: TEKKEN 7
description: Discover the epic conclusion of the long-time clan warfare between members of the Mishima family. Powered by Unreal Engine 4, the legendary fighting game franchise fights back with stunning story-driven cinematic battles and intense duels that can be enjoyed with friends and rivals.

name: Resident Evil 4
description: Survival is just the beginning. Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors, tracks the president’s kidnapped daughter to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.

name: Resident Evil 4 (2005)
description: (Release: 2014) Special agent Leon S. Kennedy is sent on a mission to rescue the U.S. President’s daughter who has been kidnapped.

name: Resident Evil Village
description: Experience survival horror like never before in the 8th major installment in the Resident Evil franchise – Resident Evil Village. With detailed graphics, intense first-person action and masterful storytelling, the terror has never felt more realistic.

name: Resident Evil 2
description: A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors. An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you. Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

name: DARK SOULS
description: Then, there was fire. Re-experience the critically acclaimed, genre-defining game that started it all. Beautifully remastered, return to Lordran in stunning high-definition detail running at 60fps.

name: DARK SOULS II: Scholar of the First Sin
description: DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin brings the franchise’s renowned obscurity & gripping gameplay to a new level. Join the dark journey and experience overwhelming enemy encounters, diabolical hazards, and unrelenting challenge.

name: DARK SOULS III
description: Dark Souls continues to push the boundaries with the latest, ambitious chapter in the critically-acclaimed and genre-defining series. Prepare yourself and Embrace The Darkness!

name: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
description: Game of the Year – The Game Awards 2019 Best Action Game of 2019 – IGN Carve your own clever path to vengeance in the award winning adventure from developer FromSoftware, creators of Bloodborne and the Dark Souls series. Take Revenge. Restore Your Honor. Kill Ingeniously.

name: MONSTER HUNTER: WORLD
description: Welcome to a new world! In Monster Hunter: World, the latest installment in the series, you can enjoy the ultimate hunting experience, using everything at your disposal to hunt monsters in a new world teeming with surprises and excitement.

name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE
description: Rise to the challenge and join the hunt! In Monster Hunter Rise, the latest installment in the award-winning and top-selling Monster Hunter series, you’ll become a hunter, explore brand new maps and use a variety of weapons to take down fearsome monsters as part of an all-new storyline.

name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE: SUNBREAK
description:
Monster Hunter Rise: Sunbreak is an expansion to the original Monster Hunter Rise.

Featuring improved gameplay and nimble-feeling additions to combat mechanics, unique new monsters and hunting locales, and a new difficulty level in the form of Master Rank quests.

As the hunter who saved Kamura from calamity, you must now journey to the far-off reaches of Elgado, an outpost near a Kingdom beset by a sinister new nemesis—the elder dragon Malzeno!

name: DOOM Eternal
description: Hell’s armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer in an epic single-player campaign to conquer demons across dimensions and stop the final destruction of humanity. The only thing they fear… is you.

name: Hollow Knight
description: Forge your own path in Hollow Knight! An epic action adventure through a vast ruined kingdom of insects and heroes. Explore twisting caverns, battle tainted creatures and befriend bizarre bugs, all in a classic, hand-drawn 2D style.

name: Red Dead Redemption
description:
America, early 1900’s. The era of the cowboy is coming to an end.

When federal agents threaten his family, former outlaw John Marston is sent across the American frontier to help bring the rule of law. Experience intense gun battles, dramatic train robberies, bounty hunting and duels during a time of violent change.

Red Dead Redemption is an epic battle for survival in a beautiful open world as John Marston struggles to bury his blood-stained past, one man at a time.

name: DEATH STRANDING
description: From legendary game creator Hideo Kojima comes an all-new, genre-defying experience. Sam Bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the Death Stranding. Carrying the disconnected remnants of our future in his hands, he embarks on a journey to reconnect the shattered world one step at a time.

name: Control
description: Winner of over 80 awards, Control is a visually stunning third-person action-adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

name: Star Control: Origins
description: Star Control is a space role-playing game in which you command Earth’s first interstellar starship on a mission to save the Earth from hostile alien empires.

name: SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE
description: The long-awaited third game in the groundbreaking SUPERHOT franchise – MIND CONTROL DELETE gives you more insight into the world of SUPERHOT, more story, more signature gameplay. Keep dancing the slow-motion ballet of destruction for so much longer than ever before.

name: HITMAN 3
description: Enter the world of the ultimate assassin. HITMAN World of Assassination delivers the definitive stealth action experience, putting you in the shoes of Agent 47, a master assassin. Explore immersive locations, uncover hidden secrets, and eliminate targets with complete freedom of approach.

name: FAR CRY 6
description: Dive into the gritty world of a modern-day guerrilla revolution to liberate a nation from its oppressive dictators.

name: Far Cry 5
description: Discover the open world of Hope County, Montana, besieged by a fanatical doomsday cult. Dive into the action solo or two-player co-op in the story campaign, use a vast arsenal of weapons and allies, and free Hope County from Joseph Seed and his cult.

name: Metro Exodus
description: Flee the shattered ruins of the Moscow Metro and embark on an epic, continent-spanning journey across the post-apocalyptic Russian wilderness. Explore vast, non-linear levels, lose yourself in an immersive, sandbox survival experience, and follow a thrilling story-line that spans an entire year in the greatest Metro adventure yet.

name: Hades
